Mean patient age was 38 years.

pmid-16731419.summary_ja: 15歳女性の症例報告である。顆粒腫性腎炎と右卵巣の巨大な充実性骨盤内腫瘤を認めた。腎生検では非乾酪性肉芽腫と稀な抗酸菌が確認された。左卵管卵巣摘出術と病期分類の結果、非乾酪性肉芽腫性炎症を伴う卵巣未分化胚細胞腫と診断された。腎病変は傍腫瘍症候群である可能性が治療上重要と指摘している。
pmid-16731419.summary_en: This case report describes a 15-year-old girl with granulomatous nephritis and a large solid pelvic mass in the right ovary. Renal biopsy showed non-caseating granulomas with rare acid-fast bacilli, while elevated CA-125 and LDH suggested a malignant process. Left salpingo-oophorectomy and staging revealed an ovarian dysgerminoma containing extensive non-caseating granulomatous inflammation, with no acid-fast organisms. The authors emphasize the differential diagnosis of pelvic tuberculosis and sarcoidosis, and note that the renal findings may represent a paraneoplastic syndrome that affects treatment planning.

pmid-16731607.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）に発生した「皮膚型」血管肉腫の症例報告である。卵巣奇形腫に生じる体細胞型悪性腫瘍は稀で、扁平上皮癌が最も多い。血管系腫瘍が卵巣奇形腫の二次的体細胞腫瘍として報告されることは稀であり、その診断的特徴と合併症を記載している。
pmid-16731607.summary_en: This case report describes an angiosarcoma with cutaneous-type features arising within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, a dermoid cyst. Somatic malignancies in ovarian teratomas are rare, with squamous cell carcinoma being the most common. The authors describe the diagnostic features and complications of this vascular tumor, which is rarely reported as a secondary somatic tumor in ovarian teratomas. The report highlights the range of malignancies that can develop within mature teratomas and the importance of careful histopathological evaluation.

pmid-16733205.summary_ja: 化学療法後の転移性胎児性癌25例を対象に、OCT4、CD30、サイトケラチンを免疫組織化学的に比較した研究です。OCT4陽性率は76%で、CD30より高い感度を示しました。化学療法後の診断マーカーとしてOCT4の有用性が示されています。
pmid-16733205.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study compared OCT4, CD30, and cytokeratin AE1/AE3 in 25 cases of metastatic embryonal carcinoma after chemotherapy. OCT4 was positive in 76% of cases, while CD30 was lost in several OCT4-positive tumors, with complete loss in four. Six cases (24%) were negative for both markers but showed strong cytokeratin staining. The authors conclude that OCT4 has better sensitivity than CD30 for identifying postchemotherapy metastatic embryonal carcinoma, supporting its use as a diagnostic marker in this challenging setting.

pmid-16734880.summary_ja: 精巣のburned-out胚細胞腫瘍で、DU-PAN-2が高値を示した症例報告です。頸部リンパ節生検で胎児性癌と診断され、シスプラチンなどによる化学療法4コースでDU-PAN-2は正常化し転移も消失しました。
pmid-16734880.summary_en: This case report describes a burned-out testicular tumor with lung and lymph node metastases in which serum DU-PAN-2 was markedly elevated while CA19-9, AFP, and beta-hCG were normal. Cervical lymph node biopsy revealed embryonal carcinoma. Four courses of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin normalized DU-PAN-2 and resolved the metastases. The authors note this is only the second reported embryonal carcinoma producing DU-PAN-2 and describe secretor and Lewis gene typing, which can affect normal reference ranges for CA19-9 and DU-PAN-2.

pmid-16735607.summary_ja: 性分化疾患(DSD)患者における胚細胞腫瘍のリスクについて、マーカーや早期病変、性腺ゴナドブラストーマとの関連を含めて総説しています。さらに、個々の腫瘍リスクを評価するための新たなDSD分類の提案がなされています。
pmid-16735607.summary_en: This review examines the risk of germ cell tumors in patients with disorders of sex development (DSD). It covers markers such as TSPY and OCT3/4, early germ cell changes including maturation delay and in situ neoplasia, and the high-risk 'undifferentiated gonadal tissue' linked to gonadoblastoma. The authors discuss limitations of confusing intersex terminology and unclear criteria distinguishing maturation delay from early malignant transformation. They propose a new classification system for DSD to help estimate individual tumor risk and refine prevalence estimates across diagnostic groups.

pmid-16735707.summary_ja: 小児の性腺外悪性胚細胞腫瘍165例を後方視的に解析した研究です。5年全生存期間は83.4%でした。12歳以上が最も重要な予後因子で、年齢と胸部原発の組み合わせは特に予後不良でした。
pmid-16735707.summary_en: This pediatric intergroup study retrospectively analyzed 165 children with stage I–IV extragonadal malignant germ cell tumors treated on a cisplatin dose-intensity trial. Five-year overall survival was 83.4% and event-free survival was 79.0%. Age of 12 years or older was the strongest prognostic factor for both outcomes, and the combination of age and thoracic primary site identified a high-risk group with about six times the risk of death. The authors conclude that age is the most predictive factor and that older patients with thoracic tumors form a biologically distinct subgroup.

pmid-16736189.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト精巣の発生過程および精巣上皮内癌、性腺芽腫、胚細胞腫瘍におけるポドプラニン(gp36/Aggrus)の発現を検討した。胚細胞腫瘍を有する精巣ではPDPNのmRNAとタンパク質が検出されたが、正常成人精巣では検出されなかった。gp36は初期胎児の原始生殖細胞と未熟なセルトリ細胞にも発現しており、CISおよびセミノーマの既知マーカーであるM2A抗原と類似していた。これらの知見から、M2A(D2-40)とgp36は同一であると考えられ、ポドプラニンは発生期精巣において細胞間相互作用に関与することが示唆された。
pmid-16736189.summary_en: This study examined podoplanin (gp36/Aggrus) expression during human testis development and in testicular carcinoma in situ, gonadoblastoma, and germ cell tumors. PDPN mRNA and protein were detected in testes with germ cell neoplasia but not in normal adult testis. gp36 was also expressed in early fetal gonocytes and immature Sertoli cells, mirroring M2A antigen, a known marker of CIS and seminoma. The findings support that M2A (D2-40) and gp36 are identical and suggest podoplanin has a role in cell-cell interactions in developing testis.

pmid-16736229.summary_ja: 生後3か月の停留精巣の乳児に発生した腹腔内未熟奇形腫の症例報告です。完全切除後、後腹膜リンパ節転移が出現し、リンパ節郭清と化学療法を行いました。3年間再発はありませんでした。
pmid-16736229.summary_en: This report describes a 3-month-old infant with cryptorchidism who presented with an asymptomatic abdominal mass, later diagnosed as immature teratoma arising from an intra-abdominal undescended testis. Ultrasonography and CT showed a multicystic mass with calcifications, and tumor markers were normal. Complete resection was followed by retroperitoneal metastasis during follow-up, treated with lymphadenectomy and BEP chemotherapy. The infant remained recurrence-free for three years. The authors recommend careful evaluation of nonpalpable testes and postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy for such tumors.

pmid-16739885.summary_ja: 精索に発生した未分化型の胚細胞腫瘍の症例を報告し、burned-out型の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の傍精巣局在として提示しています。精巣傍組織の悪性腫瘍は大部分が肉腫であるため、診断の難しさについても考察しています。
pmid-16739885.summary_en: This case report describes a completely undifferentiated germ cell tumor arising in the spermatic cord, a paratesticular location of burned-out non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. The authors review the classification of testicular germ cell tumors into seminoma and non-seminoma for treatment planning, noting non-seminomas include yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma, teratoma, and undifferentiated tumors. They discuss the difficulty of diagnosing paratesticular germ cell tumors, which are otherwise predominantly sarcomas.

pmid-16740299.summary_ja: パラフィン包埋組織をマイクロダイセクションし、マイクロサテライトDNA解析で妊娠性と非妊娠性の絨毛癌を鑑別する方法を検討しました。妊娠性絨毛癌は非母体由来の遺伝子型を示し、この市販アッセイは迅速で簡便な鑑別法であると結論しています。
pmid-16740299.summary_en: This study developed a PCR-based microsatellite DNA assay to distinguish gestational from non-gestational choriocarcinoma using microdissected paraffin tissue. Five choriocarcinomas diagnosed as gestational showed non-maternal, androgenic genotypes, while one previously non-gestational case was of maternal origin. Hydatidiform mole controls showed androgenic or mixed profiles, consistent with known complete and partial moles. The authors conclude that this commercially available assay is a quick and convenient method to discriminate gestational from non-gestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-16741525.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ22例を対象に、高分解能融解アンプリコン解析でc-kitの活性化変異を検索した。エクソン17変異は18%、エクソン11変異(L576P)は5%に認められた。FISHではほとんどの症例でc-kitのポリソミーが示唆され、変異の有無による差は認めなかった。標準治療に抵抗性の患者でKIT標的薬の候補を迅速に選別できる可能性が示された。
pmid-16741525.summary_en: This study screened 22 testicular seminomas for activating c-kit mutations using high-resolution melting amplicon analysis. Exon 17 mutations were found in 18% of cases and an exon 11 mutation (L576P) in 5%. FISH suggested most seminomas are polysomic for c-kit, with no significant FISH difference between mutation-positive and mutation-negative tumors. The authors propose the method as a rapid screen for identifying seminoma patients whose tumors may respond to KIT-targeted drugs, potentially benefiting patients refractory to standard therapy.

pmid-16750249.summary_ja: 3歳男児の陰嚢内腫瘤で、透光性を示した。超音波検査で水瘤を伴わない不均一な腫瘤が確認され、右根治的精巣摘除術で成熟奇形腫と診断された。小児の精巣腫瘍として卵黄嚢腫瘍が多いとされてきたが、良性の奇形腫の方が多いとの知見が示されている。触知しない精巣では超音波検査で水瘤を評価すべきと結論している。
pmid-16750249.summary_en: A 3-year-old boy presented with an enlarged transilluminating scrotal mass. Ultrasonography showed a heterogeneous mass without hydrocele, and right radical orchiectomy confirmed a mature teratoma. The authors note that although yolk sac tumor has traditionally been cited as the most common prepubertal testicular neoplasm, benign teratomas are now recognized as more frequent. They conclude that transilluminating prepubertal tumors can occur and that ultrasonography should be used to evaluate hydroceles when the testis is impalpable.

pmid-16753377.summary_ja: 精巣超音波検査で偶然見つかった触知しない精巣腫瘤4例に、術中超音波ガイド下の切除生検を施行した。腫瘍マーカーは全例陰性で、術中凍結切片は全例良性だった。遅延して根治的精巣摘除術を受けた2例でセミノーマが確認され、摘除標本に浸潤性腫瘍の残存はなかった。切除辺縁を正常精巣組織とすることと、遅延根治的精巣摘除術の必要性を認識することを強調している。
pmid-16753377.summary_en: Four men aged 22 to 31 years with nonpalpable incidental testicular masses found on scrotal ultrasound underwent intraoperative ultrasound-guided excisional biopsy. Tumor markers were negative and frozen section showed benign lesions in all cases. Permanent pathology revealed seminoma in two patients who underwent delayed radical orchiectomy, and no residual invasive tumor was found in those specimens. The authors consider this approach reasonable for nonpalpable masses, but stress that margins must show normal testis and that delayed radical orchiectomy may be needed.

pmid-16753380.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対して化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた532例を解析した。リンパ節標本の44%に奇形腫成分が認められた。精巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍、精巣摘除標本の奇形腫、化学療法後のリンパ節径の変化率、救援化学療法の不要が独立した予測因子であった。化学療法後も奇形腫が残存しやすく、術前の予測に有用な因子が同定された。
pmid-16753380.summary_en: This study of 532 men who underwent post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors sought predictors of teratoma in the retroperitoneum. Teratomatous elements were found in 44% of nodal specimens. Independent predictors were testicular yolk sac tumor, teratoma in the orchiectomy specimen, relative change in nodal size after chemotherapy, and no requirement for salvage chemotherapy. The authors conclude that teratoma remains a common residual histology after chemotherapy and that these variables can help predict its presence before surgery.

pmid-16757095.summary_ja: 本第II相試験は、シスプラチン抵抗性の胚細胞腫瘍18例を対象に、オキサリプラチンとゲムシタビンの救援療法を検討した。その大半は精巣原発であった。1例が臨床的完全寛解に達し、部分寛解の2例のうち残存腫瘤を完全切除した例もあった。これら3例はいずれも精巣原発の胎児性癌で、18〜44か月の時点で無病であった。著者らは、本レジメンが標準用量で安全かつ有効であると結論づけている。
pmid-16757095.summary_en: This phase II study tested oxaliplatin plus gemcitabine as salvage therapy in 18 patients with cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumors, most of whom had testicular primaries. One patient achieved clinical complete remission, and two others had partial remissions, with complete surgical resection of residual masses in the partial responders. These three cases had testicular embryonal carcinoma and remained disease-free at 18 to 44 months. The authors conclude that the regimen is safe and active at standard dose for cisplatin-refractory testicular GCT.

pmid-16760276.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍120例のうち35例(30%)が、シスプラチン併用化学療法後に残存腫瘤の切除を受けた。切除標本では分化型奇形腫が63%を占めた。残存腫瘤の二次切除は転移性精巣がんの治療に依然不可欠であり、成熟奇形腫や生存腫瘍の切除が長期生存に寄与すると結論づけている。
pmid-16760276.summary_en: This single-institution study reviewed 120 patients with metastatic germ cell tumors treated between 1991 and 2004. Of these, 35 patients (30%) underwent surgical resection of residual masses after cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and salvage chemotherapy was given when tumor markers remained elevated. Most resections (86%) were performed in patients with normal markers and partial remission. Residual histology showed differentiated teratoma in 63% and viable tumor in 7%. Four patients died of their malignant germ cell tumor. The authors conclude that secondary resection remains essential in metastatic testicular cancer, and that resection of mature teratoma or viable cancer improves long-term survival.

pmid-16762828.summary_ja: 2歳のダウン症候群男児に停留精巣を伴う精巣セミノーマが発生した症例報告で、ヒトで報告された最年少例とされる。停留精巣やダウン症候群が発症リスクを高める可能性を文献的に検討している。停留精巣のある症例には早期の精巣固定術と定期的なフォローアップが推奨される。
pmid-16762828.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old boy with Down syndrome, cryptorchidism, and a testicular seminoma, described as the youngest testicular seminoma reported in humans. The authors review the links between cryptorchidism, testicular dysgenesis syndrome, and seminoma risk, along with the increased incidence of testicular tumors in Down syndrome. They recommend early orchidopexy and regular follow-up for affected children, and thorough gonadal examination for all patients with Down syndrome.

pmid-16770111.summary_ja: 縦隔セミノーマの再発・胸壁再発に対し、化学放射線療法と救済手術後もシスプラチン・エトポシドで再増殖を抑えきれなかった25歳男性に大量化学療法と自家末梢血幹細胞移植を実施した症例。重篤な合併症なく、1年後も無病であった。
pmid-16770111.summary_en: A 25-year-old man with recurrent mediastinal seminoma and chest wall recurrence, previously treated with chemoradiotherapy and salvage surgery, received high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation after cisplatin and etoposide failed to control regrowth. Treatment was tolerated without lethal complications, and the patient remained disease-free one year later. The report suggests HDC with PBSCT may benefit selected intractable cases.

pmid-16771750.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者で、12年後に対側精巣腫瘍が再発し、その後鎖骨上窩転移と癌性胸膜炎を生じた。胸部放射線療法後に突然の心停止で死亡した。剖検で臓側胸膜転移の直接浸潤による心膜炎が確認され、極めてまれな転移経路であることが示された。
pmid-16771750.summary_en: A 30-year-old man with left testicular seminoma stage II disease underwent orchiectomy, chemotherapy, and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, then right testicular seminoma 12 years later. After prophylactic irradiation and later left supraclavicular metastasis treated with chemoradiotherapy, he developed pleuritis carcinomatosa and died suddenly of cardiac arrest after thoracic irradiation. Autopsy showed pericarditis from direct invasion by visceral pleural metastasis.

pmid-16779993.summary_ja: HIV感染を妊娠中に診断された女性の胎児に生じた仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告です。妊娠17週の超音波検査では異常は指摘されませんでしたが、帝王切開時に大きな仙骨部腫瘤を伴う生児が出生しました。新生児期に650gの腫瘤を摘出し、児は安定しました。HIV合併妊娠における急速増大例の初報告です。
pmid-16779993.summary_en: This case report describes a sacrococcygeal teratoma that grew rapidly in a fetus carried by a woman with HIV infection diagnosed during pregnancy. Ultrasound at 17 weeks showed normal fetal anatomy, but delivery was complicated by a large sacral mass in a live infant. The 650-g mass was surgically excised in the neonatal period, and the infant was stabilized. The authors describe this as the first report of a rapidly growing sacrococcygeal teratoma in a neonate from an HIV-complicated pregnancy and call for further research on sacrococcygeal teratoma and HIV in pregnancy.

pmid-16780096.summary_ja: 32歳日本人女性が咳嗽、呼吸困難、左頸部リンパ節腫脹で受診しました。hCGとβ-hCGが著明高値で、LDHも上昇し、AFPは正常範囲でした。前縦隔腫瘤と両肺の多発結節があり、CT下肺生検でhCG陽性の異型細胞を認め、原発性縦隔絨毛癌と診断されました。BEP療法4コースで部分奏効が得られました。
pmid-16780096.summary_en: A 32-year-old Japanese woman presented with cough, dyspnea, and left cervical lymphadenopathy. hCG and beta-hCG were markedly elevated, LDH was raised, and AFP was normal. CT showed an anterior mediastinal mass and multiple lung nodules, with normal abdominal and pelvic imaging. A CT-guided lung biopsy showed hCG-positive atypical cells, leading to a diagnosis of primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma. Four courses of BEP chemotherapy produced a partial response. The authors report it as the first such case in a Japanese woman.

pmid-16783058.summary_ja: 高リスク臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（精巣）41例を対象としました。BEP 2コース群（24例）とEP 2コース群（17例）を比較しました。BEP群の1例が成熟奇形腫の再発で後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けました。両群とも無再発生存で、EP群は白血球減少が少なく、EP 2コースは同等の効果を持つ低毒性の選択肢とされました。
pmid-16783058.summary_en: This study evaluated 41 patients with high-risk clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis treated with adjuvant chemotherapy between 1994 and 2005. Group I received two BEP cycles and group II received two EP cycles, omitting bleomycin. One patient in group I required retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for a recurrent mature teratoma. All patients were alive and relapse-free at median follow-up of 75 and 49 months. Grade 2-3 leukopenia was more frequent with more BEP cycles. The authors conclude that two EP cycles are as effective and less toxic.

pmid-16783758.summary_ja: 精巣におけるAID（活性化誘導シチジン脱アミノ化酵素）の発現を検討しました。AIDは精母細胞で発現し、減数分裂への関与が示唆されました。前駆病変のIGCNUとセミノーマでは発現が認められず、混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍32例中3例のみで発現が見られました。胚細胞腫瘍の発症への関与は否定的と結論されました。
pmid-16783758.summary_en: This study examined activation-induced cytidine deaminase (AID) expression in normal human testis and testicular germ cell tumors. AID was expressed in spermatocytes, mostly cytoplasmic with some nuclear staining, suggesting a role in meiosis. The precursor lesion IGCNU and seminomas were AID-negative, and only three of 32 mixed non-seminomatous germ cell tumors showed expression. The authors conclude that continued AID expression is unlikely to be involved in the pathogenesis of germ cell tumors, although a role in their genetic aberrations remains uncertain.

pmid-16787549.summary_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣腫瘤の管理を解説した総説です。多くは機能性嚢胞、嚢胞性奇形腫、漿液性嚢胞腺腫などの良性病変です。悪性の場合は胚細胞腫瘍や境界悪性腫瘍が多く、低病期・低悪性度が一般的とされます。超音波検査が主要な画像検査で、腫瘍マーカーは妊娠自体で上昇するため主にフォローアップに用いられます。
pmid-16787549.summary_en: This review addresses the management of adnexal masses during pregnancy. Most are benign, including functional cysts, benign cystic teratomas, and serous cystadenomas. Malignant cases are typically germ cell or borderline tumors, usually low stage and low grade. Ultrasound is the primary imaging modality, while tumor markers are mainly used for monitoring because pregnancy itself can raise them. Expectant management suits most asymptomatic, nonsuspicious cysts, and surgery is reserved for large, symptomatic, or suspicious masses. Chemotherapy has been used in advanced ovarian cancer with minimal fetal toxicity.

pmid-16790090.summary_ja: 15歳女児の胸腔内成熟奇形腫由来の短期培養細胞を解析しました。唯一の細胞遺伝学的異常として均衡型転座t(8;22)が見出されました。FISHとRT-PCRでPPP2R2AとCHEK2の融合を同定し、接合部にはレトロウイルス関連配列が挿入されていました。プロモーター入れ替えによるCHEK2発現の異常が発がん機序として最も考えられ、胚細胞腫瘍の一部で病因的に重要と示唆されました。
pmid-16790090.summary_en: This study characterized a balanced translocation t(8;22) found as the sole cytogenetic aberration in short-term cultured cells from an intrathoracic mature teratoma in a 15-year-old girl. FISH and RT-PCR showed fusion of PPP2R2A and CHEK2, with an endogenous retrovirus-related sequence inserted at the junction. No additional mutations were found, and no in-frame fusion open reading frame was produced. Promoter swapping leading to deregulated CHEK2 expression is therefore the most likely oncogenic mechanism. The authors suggest that CHEK2 and/or PPP2R2A deregulation is pathogenetically important in a subset of germ cell tumors.

pmid-16790263.summary_ja: 満期妊娠後に発症した非胞状奇胎性絨毛癌68例の後方視的多施設研究。単剤メトトレキサートで治療可能な患者群は特定できず、スコア上低リスクでも併用化学療法を速やかに開始すべきと結論づけている。全生存期間（全生存率）は86%であった。
pmid-16790263.summary_en: This retrospective Dutch multicenter cohort of 68 non-molar choriocarcinoma patients, 44 of whom followed a term pregnancy, examined whether post-term choriocarcinoma can be managed with single-agent methotrexate. Most post-term patients were high-risk by WHO scoring, and 75% were methotrexate-resistant. Lung and liver metastases were common, often due to diagnostic delay. Overall survival was 86%. No subgroup suitable for monotherapy could be identified, supporting immediate combination chemotherapy even when scoring suggests lower risk.

pmid-16790400.summary_ja: 肺および後腹膜に播種した絨毛癌の症例報告。巨大な腫瘤が十二指腸へ瘻孔を形成していたが、化学療法のみで完全寛解に至った。進行した後腹膜の胚細胞腫瘍でも全身化学療法が奏効しうることを示す。症例報告であり標準的な治療方針を示すものではないが、臨床的に示唆に富む。
pmid-16790400.summary_en: A case report describing disseminated choriocarcinoma involving the lungs and retroperitoneum, which formed a large adenopathic mass fistulizing into the duodenum. The patient achieved complete resolution with chemotherapy alone. The report highlights that extragonadal germ cell tumors with aggressive local invasion and fistula formation can respond completely to systemic chemotherapy without additional local treatment.

pmid-16790450.summary_ja: 筑波大学病院で導入BEP療法を受けた精巣がん患者42例の後方視的検討。現代の支持療法により用量減量は少なく、相対用量強度は高く維持された。白血球減少が最も多い毒性で、治療関連死は認めなかった。5年原因特異的生存率は85%であった。
pmid-16790450.summary_en: A retrospective review of 42 Japanese testicular cancer patients who received BEP induction chemotherapy at Tsukuba University Hospital. With modern supportive care, dose reductions were rare and relative dose intensities remained high (0.95 to 0.97). Leukopenia was the most frequent toxicity, and there were no treatment-related deaths. Two patients developed bleomycin pneumonitis that resolved. The five-year cause-specific survival rate was 85%.

pmid-16792550.summary_ja: 77歳男性の剖検例で、原発性肺絨毛癌と腺癌成分が合併していた極めてまれな症例。生前診断はなされず、急速な呼吸不全で死亡した。二相性の絨毛癌成分を認め、β-hCGや胎盤性アルカリホスファターゼの免疫組織化学で栄養膜細胞の分化が示された。
pmid-16792550.summary_en: An autopsy case of a 77-year-old Japanese man with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma combined with adenocarcinoma, undiagnosed before death from rapid respiratory failure. The lung tumor showed a biphasic choriocarcinoma pattern, and immunostains for placental alkaline phosphatase and beta-hCG supported trophoblastic differentiation. The adenocarcinoma and choriocarcinoma components were intermingled, raising the possibility of a rare collision tumor or a closely related origin.

pmid-16800267.summary_ja: 卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫の消化管上皮成分から発生した腺癌の症例報告。顕微鏡的検査と免疫組織化学的検査で診断された。奇形腫の悪性転化の大多数は扁平上皮癌であり、腺癌は稀である。消化管上皮由来の腺癌は本例で5例目の報告にあたり、極めて珍しい組織型として記録された。
pmid-16800267.summary_en: This case report describes adenocarcinoma arising from gastrointestinal epithelial elements within a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary. Malignant transformation of such teratomas is rare, and most reported cases are squamous cell carcinomas, with adenocarcinomas being uncommon. Diagnosis was established by microscopic examination and immunohistochemistry. The authors note that this is only the fifth reported case of adenocarcinoma arising from gastrointestinal epithelium in a benign cystic teratoma, underscoring its rarity and the value of documenting such unusual histologic variants.

pmid-16801317.summary_ja: 出生前に頸部の充実性腫瘤として発見された胎児頸部奇形腫の症例報告。妊娠中絶後に腫瘍と胎児血の細胞遺伝学的検査を行い、腫瘍細胞の一部に追加の染色体マーカーを持つクローンを認めた。胎児頸部奇形腫は稀な病態であり、染色体再構成の検出のため遺伝学的検査の検討が推奨されている。
pmid-16801317.summary_en: This report describes a fetal cervical teratoma identified prenatally as a solid neck mass and studied cytogenetically after pregnancy termination. Cytogenetic analysis of both fetal blood and tumour revealed a karyotype with an additional chromosome marker present in a clone of tumour cells, which the authors note has not previously been described in the recent literature. Fetal cervical teratoma is a rare condition. The authors recommend considering genetic investigation in such cases to identify chromosomal rearrangements.

pmid-16803542.summary_ja: 1994年から2004年に治療した高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍33例を対象に、EMA/CO化学療法の有効性と毒性を後方視的に検討。全生存期間(全生存率)は90.9%であった。肝転移や絨毛癌の組織型が予後に影響し、最も重篤な毒性は白血球減少であった。EMA/COは高リスクGTNに有効で忍容性も良好と結論づけている。
pmid-16803542.summary_en: This retrospective study assesses the efficacy and toxicity of the EMA/CO regimen in 33 patients with high-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia treated between 1994 and 2004. Overall survival was 90.9%, and complete response and survival were influenced by liver metastasis, antecedent pregnancy, choriocarcinoma histology, and blood group. Drug resistance occurred in 18.2% of patients. The most severe toxicity was grade 3-4 leukopenia. The authors conclude that EMA/CO is highly effective for high-risk GTN and is well tolerated.

pmid-16803554.summary_ja: 卵管妊娠後に大網に生じた子宮外絨毛癌の症例報告。24歳女性が不正性膣出血で受診した。術後にβ-hCGは低下したが再上昇し、病理で絨毛癌と確定した。子宮病変や他の転移はなかった。外科的切除と複数コースの化学療法が有効であった。
pmid-16803554.summary_en: This case report describes extrauterine choriocarcinoma arising in the greater omentum after a tubal pregnancy in a 24-year-old woman who presented with irregular vaginal bleeding. Serum beta-hCG fell rapidly after surgical excision but later rose again. Pathology confirmed choriocarcinoma without uterine lesions or other metastases. Multiple courses of combined chemotherapy were effective. The authors conclude that surgical excision combined with chemotherapy is effective for this rare presentation.

pmid-16806440.summary_ja: 絨毛癌と胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を含む39例の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍で、7q11.2と8p12-p21の欠失を解析。非胞状奇胎由来の腫瘍でヘテロ接合性の消失を認め、8p12-p21に最小欠失領域を同定した。完全な欠失は少数で、完全胞状奇胎後の腫瘍には欠失がなかった。胞状奇胎患者の予後指標としては有用性が低いと結論づけている。
pmid-16806440.summary_en: This study uses fluorescent microsatellite genotyping to map deletions on chromosomes 7q11.2 and 8p12-p21 in 39 gestational trophoblastic tumours, including choriocarcinoma and placental site trophoblastic tumours. Loss of heterozygosity was found in non-molar pregnancy-derived tumours, and a minimal region of loss was defined at 8p12-p21. However, complete loss was uncommon, and no deletions occurred in tumours following complete molar pregnancy. The authors conclude these deletions are unlikely to be useful prognostic markers in molar pregnancy management.

pmid-16808649.summary_ja: 救済的後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に生じた大量の乳糜腹水の一例。化学療法後の腫瘤切除後、保存的治療に抵抗したため腹腔鏡で漏出部を同定し、クリップとフィブリン糊で閉鎖した。5年間再発はみられなかった。後腹膜手術のまれな合併症として、胚細胞腫瘍の救済手術における注意点を示す。
pmid-16808649.summary_en: This case report describes massive chylous ascites that developed after simultaneous pneumonectomy and laparoscopic excision of a post-chemotherapy residual mass in a patient undergoing salvage retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Conservative management failed, so exploratory laparoscopy located the leak, which was clipped and sealed with fibrin glue. No recurrence was observed over 5 years. The report highlights chylous ascites as a rare complication of retroperitoneal surgery, relevant to germ cell tumor salvage surgery.

pmid-16809892.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍（セミノーマ、未熟奇形腫、胎児性癌の混合型）の24歳男性で、血球貪食症候群と汎血球減少を発症した症例報告。骨髄に異型組織球と9番染色体トリソミーを認めた。化学療法に反応せず死亡し、剖検で未熟組織球の浸潤が確認され、真性悪性組織球症と診断された。
pmid-16809892.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man with a mixed-type mediastinal germ cell tumor (seminoma, immature teratoma, embryonal carcinoma) who developed hemophagocytic syndrome and pancytopenia after diagnosis. Bone marrow showed atypical histiocytes, and karyotyping revealed trisomy 9. Despite chemotherapy, he died of diffuse alveolar damage. Autopsy confirmed diffuse infiltration by immature CD68-positive histiocytes, leading to a diagnosis of true malignant histiocytosis associated with the mediastinal germ cell tumor.

pmid-16810062.summary_ja: 子宮内膜漿液性癌に絨毛癌成分を伴う61歳女性の症例報告。血清hCGは225,000IU/Lと著明に高値で、化学療法に反応せず発症2か月で死亡した。文献的検討から、妊娠性絨毛癌に類似しhCGが高値で予後不良な型と、hCGが低値で予後良好な型の2種類が存在すると提唱している。
pmid-16810062.summary_en: This report describes a 61-year-old woman with endometrial serous carcinoma containing a choriocarcinomatous component, with markedly elevated serum hCG (225,000 IU/L) and diffuse pulmonary metastases that caused death within 2 months despite chemotherapy. Reviewing published cases, the authors propose two distinct entities: one hCG-high, rapidly fatal type resembling gestational choriocarcinoma, and one with low hCG and better prognosis in which the nontrophoblastic component determines outcome.

pmid-16810501.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における腫瘍抑制候補遺伝子testisinのエピジェネティックな不活化を検討した。5'非翻訳領域のCpG部位がメチル化による発現抑制に重要であった。定量的メチル化特異的PCRで腫瘍では正常精巣より高いメチル化と低い発現を認め、非セミノーマで高メチル化が強かった。バイオマーカーとしての可能性が示された。
pmid-16810501.summary_en: This study examined epigenetic silencing of the testisin gene, a putative tumor suppressor, in testicular germ cell tumors. Bisulfite sequencing in cell lines identified 5' untranslated region CpG sites critical for silencing. Quantitative methylation-specific PCR in 33 tumors and 19 normal testes showed markedly higher methylation and lower expression in tumors, with non-seminomas more methylated than seminomas. The assay distinguished tumor from normal tissue with high sensitivity and specificity, suggesting methylation as a potential biomarker.

pmid-16814851.summary_ja: 子宮の悪性腫瘍で、癌肉腫に卵黄嚢腫瘍が併存した65歳日本人女性の症例報告。卵黄嚢腫瘍成分は免疫組織化学でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性であった。手術と化学療法を受けた。子宮内膜癌肉腫に併存する卵黄嚢腫瘍の報告としては3例目で、異常に分化した体細胞由来と考察している。
pmid-16814851.summary_en: This case report describes a 65-year-old Japanese woman with a uterine malignancy diagnosed as primary carcinosarcoma concomitant with a yolk sac tumor of the uterus. The yolk sac tumor component was positive for alpha-fetoprotein on immunohistochemistry. She underwent surgery and chemotherapy. The authors note this is only the third documented case of yolk sac tumor concomitant with endometrial carcinosarcoma and propose that histogenesis reflects aberrantly differentiated somatic cells.

pmid-16818070.summary_ja: 馬蹄腎から発生した先天性腎内奇形腫の新生児症例報告。妊娠37週の超音波検査で腹部腫瘤が指摘され、生後20日に腫瘍摘出と右腎摘除術が行われた。病理診断は未熟奇形腫であった。腎内奇形腫は極めてまれで、馬蹄腎由来の未熟奇形腫は初の報告と考えられる。新生児の腎腫瘤の鑑別診断に含めることを推奨している。
pmid-16818070.summary_en: A neonate with a horseshoe kidney presented with an abdominal mass detected by routine ultrasonography at 37 weeks gestation. Tumorectomy with right nephrectomy at 20 days of age showed an immature teratoma. Intrarenal teratoma is extremely rare, and this is believed to be the first reported immature teratoma arising in a horseshoe kidney. The authors note the diagnostic difficulty and recommend including such tumors in the differential diagnosis of neonatal renal masses.

pmid-16819328.summary_ja: 未治療で精巣摘除された精巣胚細胞腫瘍42例の検討で、完全または50%超の瘢痕化を示した。瘢痕部のリンパ形質細胞浸潤やゴースト精細管、非分類型精細管内胚細胞腫瘍などが特徴的所見である。転移巣はセミノーマが多かった。退縮した原発巣（burnt-out）を認識するための組織学的基準を示している。
pmid-16819328.summary_en: This study analyzed 42 testicular germ cell tumors showing complete or extensive scarring, none treated before orchiectomy, and most with metastases. Scar features included lymphoplasmacytic infiltrates, ghost tubules, and intratubular germ cell neoplasia, unclassified, or coarse calcifications. Metastases were mostly seminoma, with mixed, embryonal carcinoma, teratoma, and yolk sac tumor types also present. The authors define histologic criteria that permit recognition of regressed (burnt-out) primary tumors.

pmid-16820096.summary_ja: ヒト精巣における上皮内癌(CIS)からセミノーマへの進展過程で、コネキシン43(Cx43)の発現を検討した。CISに侵された精細管のセルトリ細胞と胚細胞でCx43 mRNAの発現低下がみられ、浸潤性セミノーマでは完全に消失していた。早期の細胞間連絡の障害がセミノーマの進展に関与すると示唆された。
pmid-16820096.summary_en: This study investigated connexin 43 (Cx43) expression during progression from carcinoma in situ to seminoma in human testis. Using microarray analysis, in situ hybridization, and RT-PCR on microdissected tubules, the authors found Cx43 mRNA downregulated in Sertoli and germ cells of tubules infiltrated by carcinoma in situ, with complete loss in invasive seminoma cells. The findings suggest that early disruption of intercellular communication between Sertoli cells and preinvasive tumor cells contributes to seminoma progression.

pmid-16820195.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者で、腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清(L-RPLND)と開腹手術(O-RPLND)の術後QOLと回復を比較した研究です。腹腔鏡群では軽微な術後合併症が少なく、入院期間が短く、QOLスコアが高く、早期に日常生活へ復帰できました。両群とも再手術を要する重大な合併症はありませんでした。L-RPLNDは安全で有効な術式と結論づけられています。
pmid-16820195.summary_en: This comparative study evaluated quality of life and recovery after laparoscopic (L-RPLND) versus open retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (O-RPLND) in patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Twenty-one laparoscopic patients were matched against 29 open-surgery patients. Laparoscopic surgery was associated with significantly fewer minor postoperative complications, shorter hospitalization, higher quality-of-life scores, and faster return to normal activities. No major complications requiring revision occurred in either group. The authors conclude that L-RPLND is a safe and efficacious option with faster recovery and better postoperative quality of life.

pmid-16820912.summary_ja: 本研究では、正常性腺と51例の性腺性索間質腫瘍および胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、リアルタイムPCRと免疫組織化学を用いてガレクチン-3の発現を検討した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍ではガレクチン-3が上昇しており、非セミノーマ性腫瘍および細胞株では正常精巣やセミノーマより有意にmRNA量が多かった。一方、悪性精巣セルトリ細胞腫瘍では発現が低下し、卵巣の顆粒膜細胞腫瘍では認められなかった。著者らは、ガレクチン-3が胚細胞腫瘍の非セミノーマ性分化に関与する可能性を提唱している。
pmid-16820912.summary_en: This study investigated galectin-3 expression in normal gonads and in 51 gonadal sex cord-stromal and germ cell tumors, using real-time PCR and immunohistochemistry. Galectin-3 was up-regulated in testicular germ cell tumors, with significantly higher mRNA levels in non-seminomatous tumors and cell lines than in normal testes and seminomas. In contrast, it was down-regulated in malignant Sertoli cell tumors and absent in ovarian granulosa cell tumors. The authors propose that galectin-3 may play a role in non-seminomatous differentiation of germ cell tumors and in the development of aggressive sex cord-stromal tumors.

pmid-16822086.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍におけるWnt/β-カテニンシグナルを検討した研究です。マイクロアレイ解析により、卵巣のディスジャーミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍を区別できました。83例の組織マイクロアレイでは、卵黄嚢腫瘍と未熟奇形腫で核内β-カテニンの蓄積が見られました。Wnt/β-カテニンシグナルの活性化が両組織亜型の発生に関与していると結論づけられています。
pmid-16822086.summary_en: This study examined Wnt/beta-catenin signaling in human germ cell tumors. Microarray analysis distinguished dysgerminomas from ovarian endodermal sinus tumors based on Wnt pathway genes, with differential expression of Wnt13 and beta-catenin confirmed by RT-PCR. Tissue microarrays of 83 patients showed nuclear beta-catenin accumulation in most endodermal sinus tumors and immature teratomas, but not in germinomas, embryonal carcinomas, or choriocarcinomas. The authors conclude that activation of Wnt/beta-catenin signaling contributes to the pathogenesis of two histologic subtypes, endodermal sinus tumor and immature teratoma. These findings may inform the molecular understanding of germ cell tumor subtypes.

pmid-16825818.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣セミノーマ100例を後方視的に解析し、リンパ節転移の臨床病理学的予測因子と治療戦略の成績を検討した。91例が臨床病期I、9例が病期IIであった。最大腫瘍径と術前血清LDHは、病期IIおよびリンパ節転移の有意な予測因子であった。補助放射線療法は、監視療法と比較して5年生存率を有意に改善しなかった。病期IIの症例は、精巣摘除術後の化学療法で良好に治療された。著者らは、現行の戦略のもとでセミノーマの予後は良好であると結論づけている。
pmid-16825818.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study of 100 patients with testicular seminoma assessed clinicopathological predictors of nodal metastasis and the outcomes of the treatment strategy. Ninety-one patients had clinical stage I disease and nine had stage II. Maximum tumor diameter and preoperative serum LDH were significant predictors of stage II disease and nodal metastasis. Adjuvant radiotherapy did not significantly improve five-year survival compared with surveillance, which was 95 percent in the surveillance group. All stage II patients were successfully treated with chemotherapy after orchiectomy. The authors conclude that seminoma has a good prognosis under the current strategy, even with nodal metastasis.

pmid-16825823.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する白金製剤による化学療法後、再発した後腹膜腫瘤内に軟骨肉腫が生じた37歳男性の症例報告です。奇形腫成分の悪性転化は、症状、腫瘍マーカーの上昇、既切除標本の異型成分なしに起こりました。転移性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後には、このような悪性転化の可能性があります。腫瘍マーカーが正常でも、画像による綿密なフォローアップが推奨されています。
pmid-16825823.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old man who developed chondrosarcoma within a recurrent retroperitoneal mass after platinum-based chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumor. The malignant transformation of the retroperitoneal teratomatous mass occurred without symptoms, elevated serum tumor markers, or atypical elements in prior resected specimens. The authors note that teratomas with malignant transformation are a recognized but uncommon complication after chemotherapy for metastatic germ cell tumor, and that chondrosarcoma is a rarely reported second non-germ cell malignancy. They recommend close radiographic follow-up of such patients, even when tumor markers remain normal.

pmid-16827965.summary_ja: 正期産後に発生した産後絨毛癌の症例報告です。持続する原発性または続発性の産後出血で発症し、診断が遅れやすいことが指摘されています。適切な化学療法で治癒の可能性があるため、早期の認識が重要です。本症例はメトトレキサートと手術により良好に治療されました。持続する産後出血では絨毛癌を鑑別に挙げるべきと述べられています。
pmid-16827965.summary_en: This case report describes postpartum choriocarcinoma following a term pregnancy, a rare form of gestational trophoblastic disease. The patient presented with persistent primary or secondary postpartum hemorrhage, a presentation that often delays diagnosis. The authors emphasize that early recognition is important because the condition is potentially curable with appropriate chemotherapy. The patient was treated successfully with methotrexate and surgery. The report highlights the need to consider choriocarcinoma in the differential diagnosis of persistent postpartum bleeding, so that treatment can begin promptly.

pmid-16838188.summary_ja: 過去10年間に治療された小児の頸部および縦隔奇形腫を後方視的に検討した研究です。奇形腫66例中11例が頸部から縦隔に及び、6例が縦隔奇形腫でした。頸部奇形腫は胎児疾患や新生児の気道閉塞を起こすため、出生前診断と計画的な多職種管理が必要です。全例で全摘により生存が得られました。未熟性の奇形腫では所属リンパ節転移の可能性もあると述べられています。
pmid-16838188.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed teratomas of the neck and mediastinum treated in children over ten years. Eleven of 66 children with teratoma had cervicomediastinal lesions, and six others had mediastinal teratoma. Cervical teratomas could cause fetal disease and neonatal airway obstruction, so prenatal diagnosis and planned multidisciplinary management were essential. Mediastinal teratomas were less often symptomatic, and all patients survived with total surgical removal. The authors note that benign-appearing teratomas may be immature and metastasize to regional lymph nodes, and that thyroid insufficiency can occur after cervical teratoma surgery.

pmid-16841265.summary_ja: ノルウェーの男性約60万人を対象とした大規模コホート研究で、身長・BMIと精巣がんリスクの関連を検討した。成人期のBMIが高いほど精巣がんリスクはわずかに低下し、思春期のBMIは関連しなかった。一方、成人身長が高いとセミノーマのリスクがやや上昇し、180cm以上の男性では170～179cmの男性に比べ相対リスクが1.17であった。
pmid-16841265.summary_en: This Norwegian cohort study followed about 600,000 men aged 14-44 years, whose height and weight were measured during 1963-2001. Among them, 1,357 testicular cancers were registered. Higher adult BMI was associated with a slightly lower risk of testicular cancer, with a relative risk of 0.97 per unit increase. Adolescent BMI showed no association. Greater adult height was associated with a modest increase in seminoma risk. Men 180 cm or taller had a relative risk of 1.17 compared with men 170-179 cm.

pmid-16848096.summary_ja: 新生児に生じた、後頭頸部正中の破裂性病変の症例報告である。上部頸部の髄膜瘤に似た臨床像を示したが、病理学的には奇形腫と診断された。後頭頸部奇形腫は極めて稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍で、報告例は少ない。新生児の正中部腫瘤では鑑別に含める必要があると論じている。
pmid-16848096.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a ruptured posterior midline occipitocervical lesion that clinically mimicked an upper cervical myelomeningocele. Pathological examination confirmed a teratoma. Occipitocervical teratoma is an extremely rare extragonadal germ cell tumor, and only a few cases have been reported. The authors emphasize that such lesions should be included in the differential diagnosis of midline masses in newborns, since their appearance may suggest a neural tube defect.

pmid-16856085.summary_ja: 高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTT)に対する併用化学療法の有効性と安全性を検討したCochraneシステマティックレビューである。対象は42例を含む1件の試験のみで、MAC療法はCHAMOCA療法より毒性が低いと報告された。メタ解析は実施できず、方法論的限界から最適レジメンについての確定的結論は得られず、質の高い研究が必要とされている。
pmid-16856085.summary_en: This Cochrane systematic review assessed combination chemotherapy for high-risk gestational trophoblastic tumour (GTT). Searches identified one randomized or quasi-randomized trial with 42 participants, comparing the MAC regimen with CHAMOCA. MAC showed lower toxicity than CHAMOCA. Meta-analysis was not possible, so the review was narrative. Methodological limitations prevent firm conclusions about the best regimen, and the authors call for high-quality trials.

pmid-16863828.summary_ja: 縦隔奇形腫内に発生したウィルムス腫瘍を有する18歳男性の症例報告である。ウィルムス腫瘍は通常、幼児期の腎原発腫瘍であり、腎外発生や高齢者の発症は極めて稀で治療指針も確立していない。胚細胞腫瘍成分と腎芽腫成分が併存するこの稀な病変の治療と、非定型例での過少治療のリスクについて考察している。
pmid-16863828.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old man with Wilms' tumor arising within a mediastinal teratoma. Wilms' tumor usually presents as a renal tumor in young children, and extrarenal or older-patient presentations are extremely rare with no established guidelines. The authors discuss the risk of undertreatment in such atypical cases and the management of this exceptionally rare lesion, which combines germ cell tumor and nephroblastoma components.

pmid-16863829.summary_ja: 単絨毛膜双胎の一方に充実性・高血管性の仙尾部奇形腫と胎児水腫が合併した症例報告である。連続的な超音波検査で評価し、分娩時期を適切に設定したことで非罹患児の生存が得られた。妊娠早期に診断された充実性奇形腫は胎児水腫や胎児死亡の頻度が高く、その管理の要点を論じている。
pmid-16863829.summary_en: This case report describes a monochorionic twin pregnancy in which one twin had a solid, highly vascular sacrococcygeal teratoma complicated by hydrops fetalis. Serial ultrasound evaluations guided the timing of delivery. Timely delivery optimized outcome and allowed survival of the unaffected co-twin. The authors note that solid, vascular sacrococcygeal teratomas diagnosed early in gestation carry higher rates of hydrops and fetal demise, whereas late-gestation diagnosis generally has a favorable outcome.

pmid-16867864.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫26例を対象に、サイトケラチン、E-カドヘリン、CD30、ビメンチンの免疫組織化学染色を行った研究である。CAM5.2で19.2%、AE1/AE3で7.7%の症例において腫瘍細胞の10%超がサイトケラチン陽性であった。CD30は全例で陰性であった。上皮分化能を示しうることから、卵巣原発腫瘍の鑑別診断にこれらのマーカーパターンを考慮すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-16867864.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined 26 ovarian dysgerminomas for cytokeratins, E-cadherin, CD30 and vimentin. Cytokeratin positivity in more than 10% of tumor cells was found in 19.2% of cases for CAM5.2 and 7.7% for AE1/AE3. E-cadherin was weakly positive in 2 cases, and CD30 and cytokeratin 20 were negative throughout. The authors conclude that dysgerminomas can show epithelial differentiation and that these marker patterns should inform the differential diagnosis of primary ovarian tumors.

pmid-16870033.summary_ja: 前頸部から縦隔に腫瘤があり気管を圧迫した生後9か月男児の症例報告である。超音波検査、MRI、CTではリンパ管奇形(嚢胞性リンパ管腫)が疑われたが、切除標本は成熟奇形腫であった。画像のみでは両者を鑑別できず、誤診に基づく硬化療法は不適切な治療となるため、外科的切除が必要であると論じている。
pmid-16870033.summary_en: This case report describes a 9-month-old boy who presented acutely with an anterior neck and mediastinal mass compressing the trachea. Ultrasound, MRI and CT suggested a lymphatic malformation (cystic hygroma), but excision revealed a mature teratoma. The authors caution that imaging cannot reliably distinguish these entities, and that sclerotherapy for a misdiagnosed teratoma risks mismanagement, so surgical excision is the necessary treatment.

pmid-16871385.summary_ja: 著者らは、ホルマリン固定されたセミノーマのアーカイブ用パラフィン標本を用いてモノクローナル抗体5G9を作製した。この抗体は、抗原賦活化を行わなくても原始生殖細胞、精原細胞、各種の胚細胞腫瘍を染色し、胚細胞系譜で露出するエピトープを持つミトコンドリアのgC1qRを認識した。siRNAによるgC1qRのノックダウンは、胚細胞腫瘍細胞株でアポトーシスを増加させ、胚細胞における抗アポトーシス作用が示された。本研究は、アーカイブ用パラフィン標本が立体構造特異的な抗体の免疫原源になり得ることを示唆している。
pmid-16871385.summary_en: The authors generated a monoclonal antibody, 5G9, using a formalin-fixed seminoma specimen from an archival paraffin block. It stains primordial germ cells, spermatogonia and various germ cell tumors without antigen retrieval, and recognizes gC1qR, a mitochondrial protein whose epitope appears exposed in the germ cell lineage. Knockdown of gC1qR by siRNA increased apoptosis in germ cell tumor cell lines (ITO-II, TCam-2), indicating an antiapoptotic role in germ cells. The study suggests archival paraffin specimens can serve as immunogen sources for conformation-specific antibodies.

pmid-16877228.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された軟口蓋原発の巨大奇形腫の症例報告である。帝王切開下のEXITが途中で中止となり、緊急気管切開の後に腫瘍を切除した。病理組織学的にはグレードII奇形腫であった。5歳時点で神経学的後遺症はない。EXIT中止時の緊急気管切開と、多職種連携による気道閉塞予防の重要性を強調している。
pmid-16877228.summary_en: A huge teratoma arising from the soft palate was detected prenatally in a female neonate weighing 715 g. Planned EXIT was abandoned during delivery because cord blood flow became unstable, so an emergency tracheotomy was performed, and the 1,591 g tumor was excised four hours later. Histopathology showed grade II teratoma. The child remained free of neurological sequelae at age 5. The authors emphasize urgent tracheotomy when EXIT is abandoned and the need for multidisciplinary coordination to prevent airway obstruction at birth.

pmid-16879525.summary_ja: 先天性頸部奇形腫の新生児3例における気道管理の経験を報告している。出生前診断例のEXIT/OOPS、出生直後の緊急気道確保、待機的切除後の気道障害への対応を示した。多様な手技を紹介し、小児麻酔科医が各段階に備える必要性を述べる。多くは組織学的に良性だが、上気道閉塞による致死的な状況を招きうる。
pmid-16879525.summary_en: This report describes airway management in three neonates with congenital cervical teratoma. It covers antenatal planning for EXIT or OOPS procedures, urgent postpartum airway securing when no prenatal diagnosis was made, and airway compromise after elective excision. The authors present the range of techniques used across these scenarios and highlight the need for pediatric anesthetists to be prepared for difficulties at each stage. The tumors, derived from all three germ cell layers, were mostly histologically benign but could cause life-threatening upper airway obstruction.

pmid-16879677.summary_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍1405例のうち、転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発(完全寛解後2年超)20例を解析した。多くは無症状で、中央値約9年で再発した。外科的切除のみを受けた症例の多くが生存し、化学療法単独では効果が低かった。可能な限りの外科的切除が治癒に不可欠と結論している。
pmid-16879677.summary_en: This study from Southampton reviewed 20 patients with late relapse, more than 2 years after complete remission, of metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumour among 1405 patients with testicular GCTs treated from 1980 to 2004. Most relapses were asymptomatic, detected by imaging or tumour markers, with a median interval of about 9 years. Fifteen patients underwent surgery alone, and 14 of them survived. Chemotherapy alone showed low response and poor outcome. The authors conclude that surgical resection where possible is essential for cure.

pmid-16880503.summary_ja: 精巣がん、絨毛癌、侵入奇胎の患者試料から精製したhCGβを質量分析で解析した。がん由来のhCGβでは三分岐型N型糖鎖やAsn-13のフコース化が増加していた。遊離hCGβの糖鎖は無傷のhCGより大きく、レクチンを用いた腫瘍マーカーとしての検出に応用しうると示唆している。
pmid-16880503.summary_en: The authors analyzed site-specific glycan structures of the hCG beta-subunit purified from testicular cancer patients, a choriocarcinoma patient, an invasive mole patient, pregnant women and a choriocarcinoma cell line, using liquid chromatography and electrospray mass spectrometry. Cancer-derived hCGbeta carried more triantennary N-glycans at Asn-30 and more fucosylation at Asn-13, and core-2 O-glycans were enriched at Ser-127 and Ser-132. Free hCGbeta glycans were larger and more fucosylated than intact hCG. These malignancy-associated glycoform differences may enable lectin-based detection of hyperglycosylated hCG as a tumor marker.

pmid-16882268.summary_ja: 久留米大学病院で1986年から2004年に治療した卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍35例の症例研究である。大多数が温存手術と補助化学療法を受け、全生存期間(全生存率)は97.1%だった。妊娠を試みた12例中8例(66.7%)が妊娠に至った。病期にかかわらず、温存手術と補助化学療法は良好な生存と妊孕性をもたらすと結論づけている。
pmid-16882268.summary_en: This Kurume University case series of 35 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (1986-2004) examined whether fertility preservation affects clinical outcome. Most patients underwent conservative surgery and received adjuvant chemotherapy, and overall survival was 97.1%. Of 12 women who attempted conception, eight achieved at least one pregnancy (66.7%). The authors conclude that conservative surgery plus adjuvant chemotherapy yields favorable survival and fertility outcomes regardless of stage.

pmid-16882432.summary_ja: 16歳女性が1年間の進行性腹部膨満と体重減少で受診し、CTで40.5cm大の巨大多房性卵巣嚢腫を認めた。ミニ開腹で15リットルの液体を減圧後、腹腔鏡下左卵巣摘出術を施行した。術後1日目に退院し、病理診断は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。腫瘍マーカーと画像が良性を示す場合、巨大卵巣嚢腫は腹腔鏡下治療が可能と結論している。
pmid-16882432.summary_en: A 16-year-old girl with a year of progressive abdominal distension and weight loss had a giant multiseptated ovarian cyst measuring up to 40.5 cm on CT, causing hepatic duct dilatation and right hydronephrosis. The mass was decompressed through a mini-laparotomy, removing 15 liters of fluid, and then a laparoscopic left oophorectomy was performed. Recovery was uneventful, with discharge on postoperative day 1. Pathology showed a mature cystic teratoma. The authors conclude giant ovarian cysts can be managed laparoscopically when tumor markers and imaging suggest benign disease.

pmid-16883461.summary_ja: 8歳女児の左卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。開腹時に腫瘍が茎を軸に捻転していた。組織学的に高分化腺癌、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、未熟奇形腫、乳頭状漿液性嚢胞腺腫の4成分が認められた。卵巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍は極めてまれで、小児の捻転例はさらに稀であると指摘している。
pmid-16883461.summary_en: This case report describes an 8-year-old girl with a left ovarian mixed germ cell tumor that had twisted around its pedicle at surgical exploration. Histology showed four components: well-differentiated adenocarcinoma, dysgerminoma, immature teratoma, and a focus of papillary serous cystadenoma. The authors note that ovarian mixed germ cell tumors are rare, particularly with a twisted presentation in a child, and that such tumors have been documented in the literature since 1950. The report highlights the histologic heterogeneity typical of these ovarian neoplasms.

pmid-16890643.summary_ja: 小児の精巣および精巣傍腫瘍について、診断、病期分類、治療をMEDLINEの文献検索に基づきレビューした。卵黄嚢腫瘍が依然多いが、奇形腫は良性経過のため過少報告の可能性がある。超音波検査と腫瘍マーカーで評価し、精巣温存手術の適応が広がっている。追加治療は病期と組織型により決定される。
pmid-16890643.summary_en: This review addresses diagnosis, staging, and management of testicular and paratesticular neoplasms in prepubertal boys, based on a MEDLINE literature search. Yolk sac tumors remain the predominant histology, although teratomas may be more common but underreported because of their benign course. Presentation is typically a painless palpable scrotal mass, which prompts scrotal ultrasound and tumor markers. Many benign tumors can now be treated with testis-sparing surgery, while radiation, chemotherapy, or retroperitoneal lymph node dissection depend on stage and histology.

pmid-16893544.summary_ja: 腹腔鏡手術で卵管内に発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。月経困難症、性交痛、不妊を主訴とする患者に対し、腫瘍を卵管に付着させる茎を焼灼し、線状卵管開窓術と類皮嚢腫の摘出を行った。卵巣外に生じた良性胚細胞腫瘍というまれな部位の報告である。
pmid-16893544.summary_en: This case report describes a mature cystic teratoma arising within the fallopian tube, found during laparoscopy performed for dysmenorrhea, dyspareunia, and infertility. A linear salpingostomy was performed, with fulguration of the pedicle attaching the mass to the tube, and the dermoid cyst was removed. The report documents an unusual extraovarian location of a benign germ cell tumor, presenting with nonspecific gynecologic symptoms. The mass was identified and managed surgically at the time of diagnostic laparoscopy.

pmid-16894300.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療における主要な論点をまとめたレビューである。妊娠中の再発マーカーとしてのAFP-L2、成熟奇形腫の悪性転化の予測因子、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の診断におけるOCT4免疫組織化学などが取り上げられている。シスプラチン併用化学療法は心血管リスク因子の増加と関連する。病期I・非ディスジャーミノーマ性腫瘍に対する補助化学療法の是非が議論されている。
pmid-16894300.summary_en: This review outlines key controversies in managing ovarian germ cell tumors, which are rare but curable at all stages. Recent findings include AFP-L2 as a promising relapse marker during pregnancy, preoperative squamous cell antigen and tumor size as predictors of malignant transformation in mature teratomas, and OCT4 immunohistochemistry for diagnosing dysgerminomas. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy raises cardiovascular risk. Evidence is limited, and many clinicians still favor adjuvant chemotherapy for stage I nondysgerminomatous tumors of grade 2 and above despite surveillance being safe.

pmid-16896894.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍89例（混合型を含む）において、オンコフェタル蛋白GPC3を免疫組織化学的に評価し、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)-β、OCT3/4と比較した。GPC3は卵黄嚢腫瘍で広範に陽性となり、AFPより広い領域で染色された。奇形腫や絨毛癌の一部でも陽性であったが、セミノーマや胎児性癌では陰性であった。胚体外組織へ分化した胚細胞腫瘍、特に卵黄嚢腫瘍の免疫組織化学的マーカーとして有用と結論づけられている。
pmid-16896894.summary_en: This study evaluated the oncofetal protein glypican-3 (GPC3) by immunohistochemistry across 89 primary testicular germ cell tumors, including mixed tumors, and compared it with AFP, hCG-β, and OCT3/4. GPC3 was strongly expressed in yolk sac tumors, with diffuse staining over a larger area than AFP. It was also seen in some teratomas, syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells, and choriocarcinoma, but not in seminomas or embryonal carcinomas. The authors conclude GPC3 is a useful immunohistochemical marker for germ cell tumors with extraembryonic differentiation, especially yolk sac tumor.

pmid-16897744.summary_ja: 小児および成人の胚細胞腫瘍31例について、マイクロサテライト解析と高解像度比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションを併用し、染色体1p腕の欠失を検討した。小児の悪性胚細胞腫瘍9例中8例で1pのLOHがみられ、小児の奇形腫では認められなかった。思春期・成人では頻度は低かった。共通欠失領域は遠位1p36-pterにあり、同部位に腫瘍抑制遺伝子の存在が示唆された。小児では予後への影響は乏しいが、思春期後の患者では予後因子となりうる可能性がある。
pmid-16897744.summary_en: Using combined microsatellite analysis and high-resolution comparative genomic hybridization in 31 pediatric and adult germ cell tumors, the authors examined loss of chromosome arm 1p. Loss of heterozygosity at 1p was found in 8 of 9 childhood malignant germ cell tumors, but in none of the childhood teratomas, and was rare in adolescent and adult tumors. The commonly deleted region lay at distal 1p36-pter, suggesting a tumor suppressor gene there. Because childhood germ cell tumors generally have favorable outcomes, the prognostic impact of 1p loss in children seems unlikely, though it may matter in postpubertal patients.

pmid-16898441.summary_ja: セミノーマに対する傍大動脈照射およびdog-leg照射の際に、精巣線量を直接計算するためのデータを提供した。人体型男性ファントムと人工精巣を用いて線量を測定し、9例の患者では熱ルミネッセンス線量計で散乱線量を測定した。照射野サイズや照射野端からの距離、患者の厚さと精巣線量の関係を回帰式で示し、クラムシェル型鉛遮蔽の効果も検討した。提案法は測定値と25%未満の差で推定でき、個々の患者の精巣線量推定に有用と考えられる。
pmid-16898441.summary_en: This study provided data for directly calculating testicular dose during paraaortic and dog-leg radiotherapy for seminoma. Measurements were performed on an anthropomorphic male phantom with an artificial testicle, and scattered dose was also measured in nine patients using thermoluminescent dosimeters. Regression formulas relating testicular dose to field size, distance from the field edge, and patient thickness were derived, and clamshell lead shielding was evaluated. Bland-Altman analysis indicated the proposed method may differ from measured values by less than 25%, offering reasonable individualized testicular dose estimates.

pmid-16899185.summary_ja: 3か月間続く無痛性の両側精巣腫大を呈した高齢男性の、同時性両側精巣腫瘍の症例を報告している。臨床評価の後、精巣腫瘍の暫定診断のもと両側精巣摘除術が行われた。病理組織学的検査で両側セミノーマと確認された。本症例は、まれな病態の提示、精査、外科的治療を記録した症例報告である。
pmid-16899185.summary_en: The paper describes a case of synchronous bilateral testicular tumors, a rare entity, in an elderly man presenting with painless bilateral testicular swelling for three months. After clinical workup, bilateral orchidectomy was performed on a provisional diagnosis of testicular tumors. Histopathological examination confirmed bilateral seminoma. As a brief case report, it documents the presentation, workup, and surgical management of this uncommon condition.

pmid-16900525.summary_ja: メトトレキサートに不応となった低リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)に対する救援療法として、パルス療法ダクチノマイシンの第II相試験を行った。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の上昇または低下不十分を示す患者に、2週ごとに1.25 mg/m2を投与した。評価可能な38例中28例(74%)が完全奏効に達し、重篤な毒性は少なかった。治療不応例は後続の化学療法で奏効した。メトトレキサート後の救援療法として有効と結論づけられている。
pmid-16900525.summary_en: This phase II Gynecologic Oncology Group trial evaluated pulse dactinomycin as salvage therapy for low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia that failed methotrexate. Patients with rising or plateaued serum hCG received dactinomycin 1.25 mg/m2 every two weeks until complete response or treatment failure. Of 38 evaluable patients, 74% achieved complete response, with a median of four cycles and minimal severe toxicity. Treatment failures responded to subsequent chemotherapy. The authors conclude pulse dactinomycin is an active salvage regimen after methotrexate failure.

pmid-16903926.summary_ja: 進行性または不応性の男性胚細胞腫瘍に対する大量化学療法(HDCT)の歴史、現状、将来を総説している。初期の自家骨髄移植を併用したHDCTは予後が悪く治療関連死亡も多かったため、末梢血幹細胞移植を伴う方法が主流となった。持続無病生存率は不応例で32～65%、初回治療として43～73%と報告されている。一方、無作為化試験では標準用量化学療法を上回る利点は示されず、進行中の試験で役割が明らかになる見込みである。
pmid-16903926.summary_en: This review traces the history, current status, and future of high-dose chemotherapy (HDCT) for advanced or refractory male germ cell tumors. Early HDCT with autologous bone marrow transplantation had poor outcomes and high treatment-related mortality, so peripheral blood stem cell transplantation became preferred, with durable remission rates of 32-65% in refractory disease and 43-73% as first-line therapy. A recent randomized trial showed no benefit over standard-dose chemotherapy, and ongoing trials will clarify its role. New paclitaxel-containing regimens are also discussed.

pmid-16904461.summary_ja: 本住民ベースの研究は、米国SEERデータ(1973〜2000年)を用い、0〜14歳の男児の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を検討した。131例のうち、全体の発生率は100万人年あたり1.6例であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍が最も多く、次いで奇形腫であり、絨毛癌とセミノーマはまれであった。腫瘍は乳児期早期の白人男児で最も多く認められた。成人の精巣がんとは異なり、発生率の経年的上昇は認められず、成人の発生率上昇の要因は思春期前のリスクを説明しないことが示唆された。
pmid-16904461.summary_en: This population-based study used US SEER data (1973-2000) to examine testicular germ cell tumors in boys aged 0-14 years. Among 131 cases, the overall incidence was 1.6 per million person-years. Yolk sac tumor was the most common histology, followed by teratoma, while choriocarcinoma and seminoma were rare. Tumors occurred most often in white boys in early infancy. Unlike adult testicular cancer, no secular increase in incidence was observed, suggesting that the factors behind rising adult rates do not explain prepubertal risk.

pmid-16904474.summary_ja: 31歳男性の腹腔内精巣に発生した混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。同側には異所性の形成異常腎を認めた。精巣摘除術と部分的嚢胞切除、単純腎摘除術が施行された。フォローアップ16か月の時点で再発の所見はなかった。停留精巣に伴う腎形成異常と精巣腫瘍の合併は比較的まれで、胚発生の異常を反映すると考えられる。
pmid-16904474.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old man with a mixed germ cell tumor arising in an intra-abdominal testis. The ipsilateral kidney was an ectopic dysplastic kidney, suggesting maldevelopment during embryogenesis. He underwent orchiectomy with partial cystectomy and simple nephrectomy. At 16 months of follow-up, there was no evidence of recurrence. The authors note that a testicular tumor in a cryptorchid testis associated with renal dysplasia is relatively uncommon and reflects abnormal embryonic development.

pmid-16907861.summary_ja: 正常および腫瘍性の精巣におけるCDH1（E-カドヘリン）のmRNAとタンパク質発現を解析した。上皮内がん（CIS）と胎児性癌ではmRNAが高発現していたが、CISではタンパク質はほとんど検出されず、翻訳レベルの抑制が示唆された。血清中のCDH1断片は病期II/IIIの進行例で、病期Iの症例や健常者より高値であった。血清CDH1は病期分類の血清マーカーとなる可能性がある。
pmid-16907861.summary_en: This study examined CDH1 (E-cadherin) mRNA and protein in normal and neoplastic testes. CDH1 mRNA was highly expressed in carcinoma in situ (CIS) and embryonal carcinoma, but protein was largely absent in CIS, suggesting translational suppression. Serum CDH1 fragment levels were higher in patients with advanced (stage II/III) testicular germ cell tumors than in stage I patients and healthy controls. The authors propose that serum CDH1 may serve as a serological marker for staging TGCT.

pmid-16908459.summary_ja: XY間性と孤立性停留精巣の小児の精巣を、免疫組織化学を用いて比較した後方視的研究である。未熟胚細胞のマーカーであるPLAPとCD117を検討した。PLAP陽性の胚細胞は間性で15.7%、停留精巣で5.1%に認められ、有意差はなかった。CD117陽性細胞は全体の94%に認められた。未熟な胚細胞の増加だけでは、XY間性における悪性腫瘍リスクの上昇は説明できず、他の病因因子の関与が示唆される。
pmid-16908459.summary_en: This retrospective immunohistochemistry study compared the germ cell markers PLAP and CD117 in testes from children with XY intersex (19 cases) and isolated cryptorchidism (39 cases). PLAP-positive germ cells were found in 15.7% of intersex and 5.1% of cryptorchid cases, while CD117-positive cells were found in 94% of all cases, with no significant differences between groups. The findings suggest that increased numbers of immature germ cells do not fully explain the elevated malignancy risk in XY intersex, and that additional pathogenic factors are likely involved.

pmid-16910585.summary_ja: 1996〜2002年に神戸大学病院で大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞移植を受けた難治性精巣腫瘍の男性24例を対象とした臨床研究である。化学療法レジメンはカルボプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミドを含み、計50コースが施行された。全コースで白血球の最低値は1,000/mm3未満となった。重篤な敗血症や治療関連死は認められず、十分な感染予防により安全に実施できると結論された。
pmid-16910585.summary_en: This clinical study reviewed supportive care for high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation (PBSCT) in 24 men with refractory testicular tumors treated at Kobe University Hospital from 1996 to 2002. The chemotherapy regimen included carboplatin, etoposide and ifosfamide, with 50 courses in total. Severe leukopenia occurred in all courses, but no patient developed critical sepsis, DIC, or treatment-related death. The authors conclude that high-dose chemotherapy with PBSCT can be given without serious infectious complications when infection prophylaxis is thorough.

pmid-16910883.summary_ja: グレーブス病と555gの卵巣甲状腺腫（奇形腫の一種）を合併した28歳女性の症例報告である。甲状腺機能亢進症と眼症状を呈し、治療後に再発した。超音波検査で発見された左卵巣腫瘤を摘出したところ、術後に甲状腺機能低下症となった。免疫組織化学で卵巣甲状腺腫のTSH受容体が確認され、TSH受容体刺激抗体も陽性であった。循環するこの抗体が、卵巣甲状腺腫の増殖と機能を促進する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-16910883.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old woman with Graves' disease and a coexisting 555 g struma ovarii, presenting with hyperthyroidism and ophthalmopathy. Her disease relapsed after treatment, and a left ovarian mass found incidentally was surgically removed. Postoperative hypothyroidism developed. Immunohistochemistry confirmed TSH receptors in the struma ovarii, and TSH receptor stimulating antibodies were positive. The authors suggest that circulating stimulating antibodies may augment the growth and function of struma ovarii.

pmid-16912491.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、妊娠20週に分類I型の胎児仙尾部奇形腫と診断された症例を報告する。腫瘍への栄養血管が目立っていた。妊娠23週に超音波検査で新たな分葉状腫瘤が突然出現し、腫瘍の子宮内自然破裂と判断された。出生前の経時的な超音波モニタリングの重要性を示している。
pmid-16912491.summary_en: This case report describes a fetus diagnosed at 20 weeks with Type I sacrococcygeal teratoma showing a prominent feeding vessel. At 23 weeks, ultrasonography revealed a sudden additional lobular mass, consistent with spontaneous intrauterine rupture of the tumor. The report highlights how serial prenatal ultrasound monitoring can detect tumor-related complications and inform counseling and planned delivery for neonatal surgery.

pmid-16916715.summary_ja: 妊娠中期末の胎児に仙尾部奇形腫と著明な全身性浮腫が合併した症例報告である。腫瘍内の動静脈シャントによる胎児水腫は予後に影響する重要な合併症である。本症例の特徴的なMRI所見を提示し、出生前評価におけるMRIの有用性を示している。本報告は、出生前の鑑別と評価にMRIが寄与する点を強調している。
pmid-16916715.summary_en: This case report describes a fetus in the late second trimester with a sacrococcygeal teratoma complicated by marked generalized edema (anasarca). Fetal hydrops is a recognized complication caused by arteriovenous shunting within the tumor, and it strongly influences prognosis. The authors present distinctive MRI morphological findings in this case, illustrating the value of magnetic resonance imaging for prenatal assessment of anasarca associated with sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-16918976.summary_ja: 性腺外セミノーマと転移性セミノーマの検出に有用な免疫組織化学マーカーを比較した研究である。M2AとAP-2γは全てのセミノーマで安定して陽性となり、感度が最も高かった。c-KITは非胚細胞腫瘍でも発現するため特異性が最も低かった。M2AとAP-2γの併用が高い特異性を与えると結論している。
pmid-16918976.summary_en: This study compared several immunohistochemical markers for detecting metastatic and primary extragonadal seminomas, including pineal germinomas, metastatic seminomas and testicular primaries. M2A and AP-2gamma stained all seminomatous tumors consistently and were most sensitive. c-KIT showed the lowest specificity, being expressed in many non-germ cell malignancies. PLAP and OCT3/4 staining was variable, and serum PLAP did not correlate with tissue expression. The authors recommend combining M2A and AP-2gamma for highly specific detection.

pmid-16925746.summary_ja: 予後不良・再発または難治性の胚細胞腫瘍33例に対し、造血幹細胞支持を伴う大量化学療法を施行した後方視的研究である。完全奏効率は58%、治療関連死は2例であった。5年全生存率は57%、無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)は56%であった。適切に選択された患者では有用な救済療法となり得るが、その役割の確立には無作為化比較試験が必要と結論している。
pmid-16925746.summary_en: This retrospective study reports 33 patients with poor-risk, relapsed or refractory germ cell tumors treated with high-dose carboplatin and etoposide chemotherapy plus hematopoietic stem-cell support. The complete response rate was 58%, with two treatment-related deaths. At a median follow-up of 72 months, 5-year overall and progression-free survival were 57% and 56%. The authors suggest the approach may be useful salvage therapy in selected patients, while calling for randomized trials to define its role.

pmid-16927637.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の鑑別診断に用いられる新しい免疫組織化学マーカーを概説した総説である。AFP、hCG、OCT3/4、NANOG、c-kit、CD30、グリピカン-3など多数のマーカーの役割を取り上げている。胚細胞腫瘍の発生率が過去40年で倍増していることも背景として示される。
pmid-16927637.summary_en: This review summarizes recently introduced immunohistochemical markers used to distinguish testicular tumors, a field where germ cell tumor incidence has roughly doubled over 40 years. It covers the diagnostic roles of alpha-fetoprotein, human chorionic gonadotropin, OCT3/4, NANOG, placental-like alkaline phosphatase, c-kit, CD30, glypican-3, p63, cytokeratin AE1/3, topoisomerase II and VASA in differential diagnosis. The authors emphasize that immunostaining is increasingly valuable as more novel markers become available.

pmid-16932017.summary_ja: 縦隔原発の胚細胞腫瘍46例と胸腺腫22例におけるOCT4免疫染色を検討した後方視的研究である。セミノーマは全例OCT4陽性であったが、胸腺腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫は陰性であった。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマと胎児性癌の同定にOCT4免疫染色が有用と結論している。
pmid-16932017.summary_en: This retrospective study examined OCT4 immunostaining in 46 primary mediastinal germ cell tumors and 22 mediastinal thymomas. All seminomas, one embryonal carcinoma and one mixed tumor containing seminoma were OCT4-positive, whereas thymomas, yolk sac tumors, teratomas and other mixed tumors were negative. The authors conclude that OCT4 immunostaining is a useful diagnostic tool for identifying seminomas and primary embryonal carcinomas among mediastinal germ cell tumors.

pmid-16933739.summary_ja: 原発性無月経と二次性徴不良を呈した19歳女性の症例報告である。左側の線条性性腺に性腺芽腫、右側卵巣に腫瘍を認め、病理組織学的検査で対側にディスジャーミノーマが確認された。性腺芽腫は性腺異形成に伴うことが多い。稀少例であるが予後は良好であり、認識の重要性を強調している。
pmid-16933739.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old woman with primary amenorrhea, poor secondary sexual characteristics, a left streak gonad and a right ovarian tumor. Histopathology showed gonadoblastoma in the streak gonad with a contralateral dysgerminoma. Gonadoblastoma is typically associated with gonadal dysgenesis. The authors note that such cases are rare and that recognizing them is clinically important because the prognosis is excellent.

pmid-16933742.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の稀な一型である胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の症例報告である。転移は稀で化学療法に抵抗性を示すが、完全切除後の予後は良好である。非腫瘍性の腹水で発症し、リンパ節転移が判明した。治療計画とその後の管理のため、腫瘍の正確な特徴づけが重要と述べている。
pmid-16933742.summary_en: This case report describes placental site trophoblastic tumor, a rare form of gestational trophoblastic disease that seldom metastasizes and is chemoresistant. Despite this, prognosis is excellent after complete tumor resection. The patient presented with non-neoplastic ascites and was found to have lymph node metastasis. The authors stress that accurate characterization of the tumor is essential for treatment planning and subsequent management.

pmid-16935862.summary_ja: 26歳男性の転移性精巣がん症例で、病理学的には絨毛癌を伴うセミノーマと診断された。急速に進行する肝・肺転移に対しBEP化学療法を開始したが、腫瘍崩壊症候群と転移巣からの大量出血(絨毛癌症候群)を合併した。集中治療と放射線科的インターベンションにより救命された。急速進行性の大量絨毛癌では、これらの合併症への注意が必要であると報告している。
pmid-16935862.summary_en: A 26-year-old man with metastatic testicular cancer, pathologically diagnosed as choriocarcinoma with seminoma, presented with rapidly progressing bulky liver and lung metastases. Shortly after starting BEP chemotherapy, he developed tumour lysis syndrome and massive haemorrhage at metastatic sites, known as choriocarcinoma syndrome. Intensive care and radiological intervention prevented a fatal outcome. The authors emphasize that urologic oncologists should recognize these complications in rapidly progressive, high-volume choriocarcinoma.

pmid-16941749.summary_ja: 54歳女性の鼻腔未熟奇形腫(神経芽腫様成分優位)症例である。21か月後に気管支鏡下生検で小細胞肺癌と診断され、新規原発として同時化学放射線療法を施行された。完全奏効後に脂肪濃度を有する病変が緩徐に増大したため、鼻腔奇形腫由来の転移と結論された。性腺外奇形腫の転移による診断の落とし穴を示す症例報告である。
pmid-16941749.summary_en: A 54-year-old woman had an immature teratoma of the nasal cavity with a predominant neuroblastomatous component. Twenty-one months later, a small cell lung cancer was found by bronchoscopic biopsy and treated with concurrent radiochemotherapy as a new primary. Because a recurrent fat-containing lesion grew slowly on serial CT after complete response, the authors concluded the lung lesion was likely metastatic neuroblastomatous tissue from the nasal teratoma. The case illustrates diagnostic pitfalls of metastatic extragonadal teratoma.

pmid-16944534.summary_ja: 病期IIAまたはIIIの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた236例の後方視的研究である。切除標本中の生存腫瘍の有無を臨床因子で予測できるかを検討した。IGCCCリスク分類間で生存腫瘍の頻度は同程度だったが、術前の血清AFP高値と後腹膜腫瘤の大きさが予測因子であった。臨床パラメータが術前の予測に役立つ可能性を示した。
pmid-16944534.summary_en: This retrospective study of 236 patients who underwent post-chemotherapy RPLND for stage IIA or III NSGCT examined whether viable tumor in the resected specimen could be predicted. Viable tumor was found at similar rates across IGCCC risk groups (about 15 to 18 percent), although risk groups predicted survival. Multivariate analysis showed that elevated pre-operative serum AFP and larger retroperitoneal mass size on pathology were predictive. The authors suggest these clinical parameters may help anticipate viable tumor.

pmid-16944983.summary_ja: 7歳男児が背部痛で受診し、T5-T6椎体に溶骨性・硬化性病変と傍椎体腫瘤を認めた。組織学的に成熟神経組織に浸潤する扁平上皮癌で、椎体内・傍椎体の奇形腫に生じたと診断された。免疫組織化学では上皮系マーカー陽性、成熟神経組織はGFAP陽性であった。小児奇形腫からの扁平上皮癌への悪性転化という稀な症例を報告する。
pmid-16944983.summary_en: A 7-year-old boy presented with back pain and a mixed lytic and sclerotic lesion at T5 to T6 with paravertebral extension. Histology showed invasive squamous cell carcinoma infiltrating mature neural tissue within an intravertebral and paravertebral teratoma. Immunohistochemistry confirmed epithelial origin with cytokeratin and EMA positivity, and mature neural elements were GFAP positive. The authors diagnosed squamous cell carcinoma arising in a pediatric teratoma, documenting this rare malignant transformation.

pmid-16946208.summary_ja: 純粋型または混合型の卵巣未熟奇形腫103例のうち、growing teratoma syndromeを12例(12%)に認めた解析である。多くは診断から中央値9か月で発症し、腹膜が最も多い初発部位であった。8例で完全な外科的切除が行われた。5年以上経過後に再発した症例もあり、長期のフォローアップの必要性を強調している。
pmid-16946208.summary_en: This series reports 12 patients with growing teratoma syndrome among 103 women with pure or mixed ovarian immature teratoma, an incidence of 12 percent. Most occurred within a median of 9 months, and the peritoneum was the most common first site. Complete surgical resection was performed in eight cases. Some patients had very late recurrences more than five years later. The authors recommend complete resection and prolonged follow-up for ovarian immature teratoma.

pmid-16951785.summary_ja: 36歳女性が腹部膨満と骨盤・腹部の巨大腫瘤で来院。超音波検査で腹水のない巨大な嚢胞性卵巣腫瘤を認めた。開腹左卵巣摘出術が行われ、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に低悪性度粘液性嚢胞腺癌を認めた。両者の合併は稀であると報告している。
pmid-16951785.summary_en: A 36-year-old woman presented with abdominal distension and a large pelvic/abdominal mass. Ultrasound showed a huge cystic ovarian mass without ascites. She underwent laparotomy and left oophorectomy. Histology revealed a mucinous cystadenocarcinoma of low malignant potential arising within a mature cystic teratoma. The report notes that this combination is rare and that teratomas can harbor mucinous neoplastic components.

pmid-16952583.summary_ja: 英国の単施設で1977～2001年に治療された仙尾部奇形腫33例を検討。良性79%、悪性18%。新生児期以降の受診は悪性と予後不良に関連した。全生存率は94%で、長期フォローアップ中の20例中7例に神経因性膀胱または腸の障害を認めた。
pmid-16952583.summary_en: This 25-year single-center UK study reviewed 33 patients treated for sacrococcygeal teratoma between 1977 and 2001. Histology was benign in 79% and malignant in 18%. Presentation after the neonatal period was associated with malignancy and poorer outcome. Overall survival was 94%. Neuropathic bladder or bowel dysfunction occurred in 7 of 20 patients on long-term follow-up, supporting continued multidisciplinary follow-up despite benign histology.

pmid-16952584.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された仙尾部奇形腫44例のカルテを検討し、大きさ、血流、増大速度、嚢胞性かどうかで3群に分類した。大きく急速に増大し血流が豊富なB群は周産期死亡が多く、21例中11例が死亡した。A群とC群では周産期死亡はなかった。
pmid-16952584.summary_en: This study reviewed charts of 44 fetuses with prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratoma and proposed a prognostic classification into three groups based on size, vascularity, growth rate, and cystic character. Large, fast-growing, highly vascular tumors (group B) had higher perinatal mortality, with 11 of 21 dying in the perinatal period. Groups A and C had no perinatal deaths. Shunting or drainage was performed in 6 of 10 group C cases.

pmid-16952649.summary_ja: 精巣摘除後にサーベイランスを受けた臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍211例の後方視的研究。31.3%が再発し、多くは1年以内であった。血管侵襲が最も強い再発予測因子であった。リスクに応じた治療方針の見直しを提案している。
pmid-16952649.summary_en: This retrospective study of 211 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors under surveillance after orchiectomy found relapse in 31.3%, mostly within the first year. Vascular invasion was the strongest predictor of relapse (OR 16.35), and embryonal carcinoma over 50% was also associated. Relapse was 6.1% with no risk factors and 75.7% with both risk factors. The authors suggest chemotherapy for patients with vascular invasion and surveillance for low-risk patients.

pmid-16954931.summary_ja: 右下腹部に触知可能な腫瘤を有する65歳男性。マルチディテクターCTで「精巣血管茎」徴候を確認し、停留精巣由来のセミノーマを術前に診断できた。本報告ではこの徴候のCT所見を記述している。
pmid-16954931.summary_en: A 65-year-old man presented with a palpable right lower quadrant mass. Multidetector CT allowed preoperative diagnosis of a seminoma arising from an undescended testis by identifying the "testicular vascular pedicle" sign. The report describes the CT findings of this sign, which may help distinguish testicular origin of abdominal or inguinal masses before surgery.

pmid-16958151.summary_ja: 本報告は、仙尾部奇形腫が子宮内で自然破裂し、急性胎児貧血をきたした胎児例である。妊娠33週の心拍変動消失、ドプラでの中大脳動脈血流速度上昇、ヘモグロビンFの高い血性羊水により胎児出血が確認された。緊急帝王切開後、新生児は輸血と翌日の腫瘍切除を受け、良好に回復した。胎児の仙尾部奇形腫は子宮内出血により急性貧血を生じうるため、より早期の適切な管理が必要と著者らは述べている。
pmid-16958151.summary_en: This report describes a fetus with a sacrococcygeal teratoma that developed acute anemia after spontaneous intrauterine rupture of the tumor. Findings at 33 weeks included loss of fetal heart rate variability, elevated middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity on Doppler, and bloody amniotic fluid with high fetal hemoglobin F, confirming fetal bleeding. Emergency cesarean section was performed. The neonate received transfusion and tumor resection the next day and recovered well. The authors suggest that fetal sacrococcygeal teratomas can cause acute fetal anemia through intrauterine hemorrhage, supporting earlier and more appropriate management.

pmid-16959714.summary_ja: 肺原発の純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍（性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の極めてまれな型）の症例報告である。腫瘍はCDX2が強く瀰漫性に陽性で、血清の腸型アルカリホスファターゼも上昇していた。根治的手術と補助化学療法の後、9か月時点で再発や転移なく生存し、酵素値も正常範囲にある。病理医は肺の卵黄嚢腫瘍を念頭に置くべきであり、腸型アルカリホスファターゼは追加の血清マーカーとなりうると著者らは提案している。
pmid-16959714.summary_en: This case report describes a primary pure yolk sac tumor of the lung, an exceptionally rare extragonadal germ cell tumor. The tumor showed intense, diffuse CDX2 immunoreactivity, a marker of intestinal differentiation, and the patient had elevated serum intestinal-type alkaline phosphatase. After radical surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy, the patient remained alive without recurrence or metastasis nine months later, with normal enzyme levels. The authors recommend that pathologists consider yolk sac tumor of the lung and suggest intestinal alkaline phosphatase as a possible additional serum marker.

pmid-16961573.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫に対して右根治的精巣摘除術を受けた患者で、術後も腫瘍マーカーが高値を持続した症例である。残存精巣由来かを判定するために精巣静脈サンプリングが施行された。その結果、残存精巣への不必要な処置を避け、以後の治療方針の決定に役立った。著者らは、この状況において精巣静脈サンプリングが有用な診断手段であると結論づけている。
pmid-16961573.summary_en: This report describes a patient who underwent right radical orchidectomy for testicular teratoma and had persistently elevated tumor markers afterward. Testicular venous sampling was used to determine whether the markers originated from the remaining testis. The procedure identified the source, helped avoid unnecessary procedures on the remaining testis, and guided further treatment. The authors conclude that testicular venous sampling is a useful diagnostic tool in this setting.

pmid-16962490.summary_ja: 精巣がんの症例で、画像診断のみに依存する危険性を示す症例報告である。26歳男性は精巣摘除術後に化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、成熟奇形腫と診断された。3年後のCTで肺病変と肺門リンパ節腫大が見られ、腫瘍マーカーは正常ながら再発が疑われた。二次化学療法を行っても変化がなく、CTガイド下生検でサルコイドーシスと判明した。画像所見が臨床像と合わない場合は、治療前に組織診断を得るべきだと著者らは強調している。
pmid-16962490.summary_en: This case report shows the risk of relying on imaging alone in testicular cancer. A 26-year-old man had mature teratoma on orchidectomy, then received chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, with mature teratoma found on histology. Three years later, CT showed lung lesions and hilar lymphadenopathy despite normal tumor markers, and relapse was suspected. Two cycles of second-line chemotherapy did not change the lesions, and CT-guided biopsy revealed sarcoidosis. The authors emphasize obtaining histology before treatment when imaging does not fit the clinical picture.

pmid-16967638.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎が疑われた20歳女性の症例報告である。不適切な医療、服薬不遵守、誤解により掻爬術を3か月遅らせた間に、病態は自然退縮した。著者らは、流産等と誤認された胞状奇胎が、既知の奇胎に続発しないように見える一部の絨毛癌の原因となりうると指摘する。妊娠性栄養膜疾患では、適時の除去と患者への十分な説明が重要であることを強調している。
pmid-16967638.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old woman with a presumed hydatidiform mole who delayed dilation and curettage for three months because of poor medical care, noncompliance, and misunderstanding. During that time, the condition regressed spontaneously. The authors note that hydatidiform moles presenting as miscarriages or other pregnancy outcomes may account for some choriocarcinomas that do not appear to follow a recognized mole. The report highlights the importance of timely evacuation and clear patient education in gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-16968241.summary_ja: 混合精巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する36歳男性が、上顎歯肉への転移性純粋絨毛癌として初発した症例報告である。病変は左第一小臼歯から左第二大臼歯に及び、良性の歯肉腫瘤様であった。歯肉転移はまれで、通常は広範な疾患と予後不良を示し、反応性歯肉病変と誤認されやすい。非典型的な所見を伴う歯肉病変は、播種性転移の初発徴候である可能性があるため、慎重な評価が必要と著者らは強調している。
pmid-16968241.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with mixed testicular germ cell tumor whose first presentation was a metastatic pure choriocarcinoma of the maxillary gingiva. The lesion extended from the left first premolar to the second molar and resembled a benign gingival mass. The authors note that gingival metastases are uncommon, usually indicate widespread disease with a poor prognosis, and can be mistaken for reactive gingival lesions. They emphasize careful evaluation of gingival lesions with atypical features, since they may be the first sign of disseminated disease.

pmid-16972218.summary_ja: 卵巣の嚢胞性奇形腫の中に脂肪性の浮遊球が認められた、まれな症例の報告です。超音波検査と断層画像による所見が提示されています。単一症例に基づくため一般化には限界がありますが、こうした所見の認識は、卵巣腫瘤の画像診断で嚢胞性奇形腫を他の嚢胞性病変と鑑別する一助になると考えられます。
pmid-16972218.summary_en: This case report describes a rare ovarian cystic teratoma containing a floating fat ball, a finding that is unusual on imaging. The authors present ultrasonographic and tomographic findings from one patient, showing how a free-floating fat globule within the cystic mass can be recognized. Because the lesion is a germ cell tumor of the ovary, recognizing this sign may help radiologists and gynecologists characterize adnexal masses and distinguish mature teratoma from other cystic lesions. The report is brief and based on a single case, so its generalizability is limited.

pmid-16972625.summary_ja: 32歳男性の後腹膜原発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告です。反復性の発熱と腹痛で受診し、AFPとhCGが著明に上昇していました。陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)で腫瘍に強い集積を認めましたが、BEP療法3コース後には集積が消失し腫瘍マーカーも正常化しました。その後2年間無病で経過し、PETによる治療効果判定の有用性を示す症例です。
pmid-16972625.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man with a retroperitoneal primary non-seminomatous germ cell tumor, presenting with recurrent fever and abdominal pain. AFP and hCG were markedly elevated. PET showed intense uptake in the tumor, and after three cycles of BEP chemotherapy, PET showed no uptake and tumor markers normalized. The patient remained disease-free for two years without further chemotherapy or lymph node dissection. The case illustrates the usefulness of PET in assessing response and residual disease in retroperitoneal non-seminomatous germ cell tumor.

pmid-16972631.summary_ja: 23歳男性の性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告です。肺と肝臓の多発転移および後腹膜の巨大腫瘤を認め、LDH、AFP、β-hCGが著明に上昇していました。BEP療法、大量化学療法、TIN療法と段階的に治療を行った結果、腫瘍マーカーは正常化し画像上も著明に縮小しました。後腹膜リンパ節郭清では壊死組織のみで生存腫瘍細胞は認めず、治療後18か月間再発なく経過しています。
pmid-16972631.summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old man with an extragonadal non-seminomatous germ cell tumor showing multiple lung and liver metastases, bulky retroperitoneal masses, and markedly elevated LDH, AFP, and beta-hCG, with normal testes. Because pulmonary lesions progressed rapidly, chemotherapy began without biopsy, including BEP, high-dose chemotherapy, and TIN. Tumor markers normalized and imaging showed marked regression. Retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy revealed only necrosis. The patient has remained recurrence-free for 18 months.
