pmid-16972632.summary_ja: 11歳時に精巣固定術を受けた36歳男性の、左精巣腫瘍の症例報告です。左鼠径部の疼痛を伴う腫瘤で受診し、精巣摘除術でセミノーマと鼠径リンパ節転移が確認されました。術後に腫瘍マーカーは正常化し、補助療法としてブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を2コース実施しました。術後11か月で再発はなく、国内の報告例は本例を含め47例とされています。
pmid-16972632.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with a left testicular tumor arising after orchiopexy at age 11. He presented with a painful left inguinal mass. Orchiectomy revealed seminoma with an inguinal lymph node metastasis. After surgery, tumor markers normalized, and he received two cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. He had no recurrence at 11 months. The authors note that 47 cases, including theirs, have been reported in Japan.

pmid-16978270.summary_ja: 1976年から2005年にウィーンの単施設で手術を受けた精巣腫瘍の病理組織学的報告を解析した研究です。セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の割合は安定していましたが、pT3・pT4は減少し、pT2は増加しました。1997年のTNM分類への脈管浸潤の導入後はpT1が減少しています。著者らは、pT1の多くの患者は現行のガイドラインでは術後の補助療法が不要と考えられると述べています。
pmid-16978270.summary_en: This single-center study from Vienna reviewed histopathology reports of testicular tumors surgically treated from 1976 to 2005, comparing seminomas and NSGCTs by pT stage across six five-year periods. The overall distribution of seminoma and NSGCT remained stable. pT3 and pT4 tumors declined in both groups, while pT2 increased. After vascular invasion was added to the TNM classification in 1997, pT1 incidence fell and pT2 rose. The authors suggest many pT1 patients may not need adjuvant treatment under current guidelines.

pmid-16979518.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍34例を対象に、p63の免疫組織化学染色を検討した研究です。絨毛癌の細胞性栄養膜細胞と奇形腫の扁平上皮分化部位で強陽性でした。胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍では限局的に陽性を示し、セミノーマと精細管内胚細胞腫瘍は陰性でした。p63陽性の多能性幹細胞様の細胞巣の存在が示唆され、セミノーマの陰性は胚性前駆細胞様の表現型を反映すると考察されています。
pmid-16979518.summary_en: This study examined p63 immunohistochemistry in 34 archival testicular germ cell neoplasia cases, including seminomas, teratomas, embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumors, mixed germ cell tumors, and one choriocarcinoma. p63 was strongly positive in choriocarcinoma cytotrophoblasts and in squamous areas of teratoma. Focal positivity appeared in embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor, while seminomas and intratubular germ cell neoplasia were negative. The authors suggest p63-positive stem-like nests may exist in some tumors, and that seminoma negativity reflects an embryonic precursor-like phenotype.

pmid-16979721.summary_ja: 日本人男性969例を超音波検査で評価した研究です。精巣微小石灰化は精巣腫瘍患者で17.4%と最も高く、不妊症患者は5.6%でした。片側の胚細胞腫瘍患者で反対側精巣に微小石灰化がある場合、上皮内癌の割合が高く、リスク指標となり得ることが示唆されました。
pmid-16979721.summary_en: This study used ultrasonography to assess testicular microlithiasis (TM) in 969 Japanese men referred for andrologic symptoms. TM prevalence was highest in patients with unilateral testicular germ cell tumor (17.4%), compared with infertility (5.6%) and other conditions (1.9%). In tumor patients, carcinoma in situ was found in the contralateral testis in 2 of 8 with TM versus 0 of 32 without. No new testicular tumors developed during follow-up. The authors suggest TM in the contralateral testis may increase the risk of carcinoma in situ.

pmid-16979844.summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマ191例に対し、鼠径部精巣摘除術後の低線量放射線療法を後方視的に評価しました。20〜30Gyの4種類の分割照射と照射野縮小を比較しています。5年全生存率と無イベント生存率は各群で95〜100%と良好で、重篤な晩期毒性は少なく、傍大動脈領域のみへの照射でも予後は悪化しませんでした。
pmid-16979844.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated low-dose radiotherapy in 191 patients with Stage I seminoma after inguinal orchiectomy. Four fractionation schedules (20 to 30 Gy) and gradually reduced target volumes were compared. Five-year overall and event-free survival were 95% to 100% across all groups. Acute side effects were mild, and long-term toxicity was uncommon. Dose, fractionation, and target volume had no prognostic significance on multivariate analysis, supporting reduced doses and paraaortic-only irradiation.

pmid-16980665.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、腹部膨満を主訴とした22歳の患者で、原発性性腺外後腹膜奇形腫を呈した症例を記述している。画像検査で後腹膜腫瘤が認められ、開腹手術により切除された。病理検査で良性嚢胞性奇形腫と確認された。患者はフォローアップで良好な経過をたどっている。著者らは、原発性後腹膜奇形腫が成人では稀で、特徴的な画像所見を示すことを強調している。
pmid-16980665.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old patient with abdominal distension and a primary extragonadal retroperitoneal teratoma. Imaging revealed a retroperitoneal mass, which was resected by laparotomy. Pathology confirmed a benign cystic teratoma. The patient was doing well at follow-up. The authors highlight that primary retroperitoneal teratoma is rare in adults and has a distinctive imaging appearance.

pmid-16981947.summary_ja: 妊娠34週の子宮内胎児死亡から10週後に右片麻痺を発症した20歳女性の症例です。MRIで左中大脳動脈領域の梗塞が、CTで播種性肺転移が判明しました。血清β-hCGの著明高値から転移性絨毛癌と診断されました。若年女性の脳卒中では血清β-hCG測定が有用と結論づけています。
pmid-16981947.summary_en: A 20-year-old woman presented with right hemiplegia ten weeks after intrauterine fetal death at 34 weeks. MRI showed a left middle cerebral artery infarct, and CT revealed disseminated pulmonary metastases. Pelvic imaging showed a uterine mass with bilateral theca lutein cysts. Markedly elevated serum beta-hCG confirmed metastatic choriocarcinoma. The authors recommend measuring serum beta-hCG in young women presenting with stroke.

pmid-16982812.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜転移31例を対象に、成熟奇形腫と他の胚細胞腫瘍成分のクローン性を検討しました。レーザー捕捉マイクロダイセクションと7つのマイクロサテライトマーカーによるLOH解析を用いています。94%の症例で対立遺伝子欠失が認められ、転移巣と原発巣の成分が共通のクローン起源を持つことが示されました。
pmid-16982812.summary_en: This study examined 31 patients who underwent primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for metastatic testicular germ cell tumor, all with metastatic mature teratoma plus other components. Using laser-assisted microdissection and loss of heterozygosity analysis of seven microsatellite markers, the authors assessed clonality. Allelic loss was found in 94% of cases. Concordant patterns linked mature teratoma with other metastatic components and with primary tumor components, supporting a common clonal origin.

pmid-16984555.summary_ja: 日本人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者68例と、年齢を合わせた健常男性対照104例を対象に、Y染色体の3つのバイナリマーカーから複合ハプログループを判定して比較した症例対照研究である。ハプログループと腫瘍発生率との間に有意な関連は認められず、Y染色体の系統による感受性の差は示されなかった。Y染色体の関与は依然として不確実であり、さらなる検証が必要とされる。
pmid-16984555.summary_en: This case-control study of 68 Japanese patients with testicular germ cell tumors and 104 matched healthy male controls genotyped three Y-chromosome binary markers to assign combined haplogroups. No association was found between haplogroup and tumor incidence, so the authors conclude that Y-lineage does not measurably influence susceptibility to testicular germ cell tumors. They note that the proposed role of the Y chromosome remains uncertain and requires further verification.

pmid-16984568.summary_ja: 70歳男性が2年間にわたる無痛性の左陰嚢内硬結を訴えた症例である。CTとMRIでは腫瘍壁のみが増強され、良性を疑わせた。その後、精巣の著明な縮小がみられ、左鼠径精巣摘除術を施行したところ、大部分を占める広範な壊死を伴うセミノーマと診断された。長期経過を伴う精巣サイズの変化は、悪性腫瘍の十分な精査を要すると著者らは強調している。
pmid-16984568.summary_en: A 70-year-old man presented with a two-year history of a painless hard left scrotal mass. Pelvic CT and MRI showed enhancement only in the tumor wall, suggesting a benign lesion. After the testis shrank markedly, left inguinal orchiectomy revealed seminoma with extensive necrosis occupying most of the tumor. The authors emphasize that changes in testicular size over a long history warrant thorough evaluation for malignancy.

pmid-16984618.summary_ja: 未経妊の33歳女性に生じた原発性純粋卵巣絨毛癌の症例である。通常の組織学的検討では妊娠性と非妊娠性の鑑別が困難なため、マイクロサテライトDNA多型解析で腫瘍と子宮筋層を比較し、非妊娠起源を確認した。手術と併用化学療法4コース後、17か月時点で無病生存している。子宮外絨毛癌の起源決定に有用とされるが、臨床的意義はさらなる検討が必要である。
pmid-16984618.summary_en: A 33-year-old nulligravid woman had primary pure ovarian choriocarcinoma. Routine histology cannot easily distinguish gestational from non-gestational origin, so microsatellite DNA polymorphism analysis compared the tumor with the patient's myometrium. Identical profiles supported a non-gestational origin, which carries worse prognosis and resistance to single-agent chemotherapy. After surgery and four cycles of combination chemotherapy, she had no evidence of disease at 17 months. The authors suggest the method helps determine the origin of extrauterine choriocarcinoma.

pmid-16985105.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の胎児22例を対象に、出生前超高速MRIが超音波検査に比べて追加情報をもたらすかを検討した。MRIは腫瘍の広がり、結腸の偏位、尿路拡張、脊柱管内進展をより正確に描出し、特にII型とIII型で頭側への進展範囲を良好に示した。胎児開放手術を受けた3例のうち2例が生存し、MRIは出生前カウンセリングと術前計画の改善に有用とされる。
pmid-16985105.summary_en: This study evaluated whether prenatal ultrafast MRI adds information beyond prenatal sonography in 22 fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma. MRI assigned AAP types and better showed tumor extent, colon displacement, urinary dilatation, intraspinal extension and cephalic extent, particularly for types II and III. Diagnoses matched postnatal findings in all cases. Three fetuses underwent open fetal resection, with two surviving. MRI was found to improve prenatal counseling and surgical planning.

pmid-16990705.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の分類と病理学的特徴の近年の進展を、必要に応じて精巣胚細胞腫瘍と比較しながらまとめたレビューである。シスプラチン併用化学療法と、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)やヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)などの腫瘍マーカーの発見が臨床経過を大きく変えたと述べている。最終章では発生機序を論じ、過去10年の文献を重視している。
pmid-16990705.summary_en: This review summarizes recent developments in the classification and pathology of ovarian germ cell tumors, comparing them with testicular germ cell tumors where appropriate. It highlights how cisplatin-based chemotherapy and tumor markers including AFP and hCG transformed clinical outcomes. The final section discusses pathogenesis. The emphasis is on literature from the past decade.

pmid-16990709.summary_ja: 42年前に虫垂切除を受けた女性が卵巣腫瘍で受診しました。免疫組織化学と奇形腫との関連から、腹膜偽粘液腫は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の粘液性腫瘍の破裂に起因すると考えられました。虫垂起源という従来の見解に一石を投じる症例です。
pmid-16990709.summary_en: This case report describes a woman who had an appendectomy 42 years earlier and later presented with a unilateral ovarian tumor. Immunohistochemical phenotyping and the association with a teratoma suggested that the pseudomyxoma peritonei originated from a ruptured mucinous tumor arising within a mature cystic teratoma. The authors challenge the widely accepted view that pseudomyxoma peritonei arises only from appendiceal low-grade mucinous tumors, showing that an ovarian mature cystic teratoma can be the primary source.

pmid-16990711.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の嚢胞内ボールについて、新たな2症例と文献上の1症例を報告し、過去の報告例をレビューしています。吸収面が内容物の大部分を吸収し、残った物質が固まって形成されるという仮説を提示しています。発生機序は未解明の点が多いとしています。
pmid-16990711.summary_en: This report presents two new cases and a third case from the literature of mature ovarian cystic teratomas containing intracystic balls, together with a review of the 11 previously reported cases since 1946. The authors propose that balls form because secretory and absorptive lining surfaces absorb most cyst contents, leaving the remaining material to solidify and mould into balls. They acknowledge that many questions about the pathogenesis remain unanswered.

pmid-17001179.summary_ja: 日本の単施設で、男性胚細胞腫瘍34例に大量イホスファミド・カルボプラチン・エトポシド療法と末梢血幹細胞移植を行いました。全例で血液毒性を認めましたが治療関連死はありませんでした。平均45か月の追跡で67.6%が無病生存しました。
pmid-17001179.summary_en: This single-institution Japanese study reports outcomes of high-dose ifosfamide, carboplatin, and etoposide with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation in 34 men with germ cell tumors, 27 as first-line therapy and seven for relapse. All patients experienced grade 4 hematotoxicity, but leukocyte counts recovered within 8 to 11 days and no treatment-related deaths occurred. After a mean follow-up of 45 months, 67.6% remained disease-free, suggesting the regimen is feasible and an effective option for advanced or refractory male germ cell tumors.

pmid-17001907.summary_ja: 45歳女性の右側腹部痛と腫瘤の症例。画像では壁在結節を伴う多房性嚢胞性卵巣腫瘍が認められ、開腹手術で摘出された。病理組織学的検査で、同一の右卵巣内に成熟奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)と粘液性嚢胞腺癌が共存していた。左卵巣と子宮に異常はなく、腫瘍の進展や大網播種も認めなかった。術後経過は順調だった。
pmid-17001907.summary_en: A 45-year-old woman presented with right-sided abdominal pain and a mass. Imaging showed a multiloculated cystic ovarian tumor with mural nodules. Laparotomy was performed, and histopathological examination revealed a mature teratoma (dermoid cyst) coexisting with mucinous cystadenocarcinoma within the same right ovary. The left ovary and uterus were normal, with no tumor extension or omental deposits. The postoperative course was uneventful. The report highlights the rare coexistence of these two histologies in one ovary.

pmid-17003635.summary_ja: 生後10日の女児の後頭部頭皮腫瘤の症例。成熟奇形腫と診断され、頭蓋内進展はなく生後14日で完全切除された。頭皮欠損は局所皮弁で再建された。術後3か月で再発は認めなかったが、6か月時の定期フォローアップに来院せず、後に突然死したことが判明した。剖検は行えなかった。新生児の頭皮奇形腫の稀少性と長期フォローアップの重要性が示された。
pmid-17003635.summary_en: A 10-day-old female newborn presented with a mass on the occipital scalp. The lesion was diagnosed as a mature teratoma without intracranial extension and was completely excised at 14 days of age. The scalp defect was reconstructed with local flaps. No recurrence was seen at 3 months. The infant did not return for routine follow-up at 6 months, and was later reported to have died suddenly; no necropsy was available. The authors note the rarity of neonatal scalp teratomas and emphasize the importance of long-term surveillance.

pmid-17005243.summary_ja: 正期産胎盤内に発生した絨毛癌の症例で、母体と乳児の双方に転移を認めた。胎盤病変は古い梗塞様に見えた。母子ともに積極的な化学療法を受け、1年後も無病生存を維持した。母子双方への転移の報告は本例で2例目であり、転移性疾患には積極的な化学療法が推奨される。
pmid-17005243.summary_en: A term placenta contained an intraplacental choriocarcinoma that appeared as an old infarct, with malignant trophoblasts infiltrating the intervillous spaces. Both the mother and the infant developed metastases. Both received chemotherapy and remained disease-free at one year. The authors review the literature, noting that dual maternal and infantile metastasis has been reported only once previously. They recommend aggressive chemotherapy for metastatic disease.

pmid-17005471.summary_ja: 1979年から2004年に精巣腫瘍で精巣摘除術を受けた98例を対象とした後方視的研究である。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が65.3%と最も多く、次いでセミノーマが27.6%であった。NSGCT患者はより若年で診断された。病期Iが最も多い提示様式で、セミノーマは病期Iで提示される割合が高かった。生存は組織型と病期により有意に異なったが、病期IとIIの間では差がなかった。著者らは、NSGCTが若年成人で最も多い精巣腫瘍であると結論づけている。
pmid-17005471.summary_en: This retrospective study of 98 patients who underwent orchiectomy for testicular tumors between 1979 and 2004 found that NSGCTs were most common (65.3%), followed by seminomas (27.6%). NSGCT patients were diagnosed at a younger age. Stage I was the most frequent presentation, and seminomas presented at stage I more often. Survival differed significantly by histology and stage, but not between stages I and II. The authors conclude that NSGCTs are the most frequent testicular tumors in young adults.

pmid-17007914.summary_ja: 持続性の膣出血と血中hCG高値を示した29歳女性で、拡張掻爬術後に胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と診断された。妊孕性温存を希望したため、EMA-EP併用化学療法を施行し完全奏効が得られた。その後正期産児を出産した。通常は子宮摘出術が選択されるが、慎重なカウンセリングを経た患者では化学療法も選択肢となり得る。
pmid-17007914.summary_en: A 29-year-old woman with persistent vaginal bleeding and an elevated hCG was diagnosed with placental site trophoblastic tumor after dilation and curettage. Because she desired future fertility, she received combination chemotherapy with EMA-EP and achieved a complete response. She later delivered a term infant. The authors note that PSTT is generally chemoresistant and usually treated with hysterectomy. Combination chemotherapy may be considered in carefully counseled patients who want to preserve fertility.

pmid-17009634.summary_ja: 32歳女性が3.5 cmの大陰唇腫瘤で受診し、切除生検で原発性外陰部卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。片側半側外陰切除術と両側鼠径リンパ節郭清術を受けたが、6か月後に再発した。BEP化学療法を3コース実施されたが、放射線療法を含むそれ以上の治療は拒否した。血清AFPは初診時に正常で、再発時に上昇した。初回提示から42か月後も病勢を伴って生存している。外陰部卵黄嚢腫瘍の報告としては10例目である。
pmid-17009634.summary_en: A 32-year-old woman presented with a 3.5 cm labial mass, which excisional biopsy showed to be a primary yolk sac tumor of the vulva. She underwent hemivulvectomy with bilateral inguinal lymphadenectomy, and recurred six months later. Three cycles of BEP chemotherapy were given, but she declined further treatment, including radiotherapy. Serum AFP was normal at diagnosis and elevated at recurrence. She remained alive with disease 42 months after first presentation. This is the tenth reported vulvar yolk sac tumor.

pmid-17009992.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍30例(胞状奇胎24例、絨毛癌3例、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍3例)で、テロメラーゼ、ER、PgRを免疫組織化学的に検討した。テロメラーゼ陽性は妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)の発症と関連した。テロメラーゼ陰性の胞状奇胎9例は、排出後に自然寛解した。テロメラーゼ陰性は自然寛解を強く予測し、長期フォローアップを省略できる可能性が示された。
pmid-17009992.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined telomerase, estrogen receptor, and progesterone receptor in 30 gestational trophoblastic tumors and six control samples. Telomerase was positive in most tumors and was associated with development of GTN. Among molar pregnancies, all nine telomerase-negative cases regressed spontaneously after evacuation. Telomerase-negative status strongly predicted spontaneous regression, suggesting that long-term follow-up could be omitted. Estrogen and progesterone receptor patterns did not clearly differ between tumors and controls.

pmid-17010019.summary_ja: 36歳女性に発生した原発性後腹膜奇形腫で、主に印環細胞癌と腸型腺癌からなる腺癌成分への悪性転化を認めた。成人の後腹膜奇形腫は稀で、悪性転化はきわめて稀である。文献上の成人例16例に続き、印環細胞癌成分が優位な悪性奇形腫の初報告である。
pmid-17010019.summary_en: A 36-year-old woman had a primary retroperitoneal teratoma with adenocarcinomatous transformation, predominantly signet ring cell carcinoma and intestinal-type adenocarcinoma. Retroperitoneal teratoma is rare in adults, and malignant change is exceptionally uncommon. The authors describe the clinical, radiologic, laboratory, and pathologic features. Based on a literature review of 16 prior adult cases, they report the first malignant teratoma with a prominent signet ring cell carcinoma component.

pmid-17016588.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍42例を対象に、サイクリンEとp27の免疫組織化学的発現を検討した。p27の標識指数はKi-67と負の相関を示し、サイクリンEは卵黄嚢腫瘍でディスジャーミノーマより有意に高値であった。p27プロモーターのメチル化は42例中2例と稀であった。サイクリンEの染色は組織型の鑑別に有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-17016588.summary_en: This study immunohistochemically evaluated cyclin E and p27 expression in 42 malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, correlating results with the Ki-67 proliferation index and clinicopathologic features. The p27 labeling index inversely correlated with Ki-67. Cyclin E was significantly higher in yolk sac tumors than in dysgerminomas. p27 promoter methylation was rare, found in 2 of 42 cases. The authors conclude that cyclin E immunostaining may help differentiate these tumor subtypes and that both proteins participate in cell cycle regulation.

pmid-17018302.summary_ja: 転移を有する非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発を、完全奏効後2年以上経過してからの再発として論じている。初発時の典型的な進展様式に加え、晩期再発時の多様な画像所見を図示した。奇形腫分化成分の特徴や長期画像サーベイランスの意義も検討している。晩期再発の好発部位と画像像の対応を示す総説である。
pmid-17018302.summary_en: This review examines late relapse, defined as recurrence more than two years after complete response, in metastatic non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours. It describes typical patterns of initial disease spread and the more variable imaging findings at late relapse, including teratoma differentiated components. The authors also discuss long-term imaging surveillance in patients with NSGCT and illustrate the spectrum of potential late relapse sites with corresponding imaging appearances.

pmid-17018887.summary_ja: 1990年から2005年の文献を検討し、セミノーマと非セミノーマの両方を含む臨床病期Iの精巣がんに対する治療選択肢を比較したレビューである。複数の治療法で有効性は同程度だが、罹患率、コスト、生活の質、患者の希望を考慮すべきと著者らは強調している。低リスク患者には綿密なサーベイランス、高リスク患者には補助化学療法を含む、リスクに応じた戦略が予防的照射や後腹膜リンパ節郭清の代替として提案されている。治癒率は100%に近い。
pmid-17018887.summary_en: This review of 1990–2005 literature compares treatment options for clinical stage I testicular cancer, covering both seminoma and non-seminoma. Although several approaches achieve similar efficacy, the authors emphasize weighing morbidity, cost, quality of life, and patient preference. Risk-adapted strategies, including surveillance for low-risk patients and adjuvant chemotherapy for high-risk patients, are proposed as alternatives to prophylactic irradiation and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Cure rates approach 100%.

pmid-17020968.summary_ja: 精巣の類表皮嚢胞と純粋成熟奇形腫の鑑別に、12p染色体異常(i(12p)および12p過剰存在)の間期FISH解析を検討した。類表皮嚢胞16例では異常がなく、奇形腫17例の88%で異常が検出された。日常的な手術検体に適用できる有用な補助診断法と結論づけている。奇形腫は悪性で転移しうるため、鑑別の意義は大きい。
pmid-17020968.summary_en: This study tested interphase FISH for isochromosome 12p and 12p overrepresentation to distinguish testicular epidermoid cysts from pure mature teratomas. None of the 16 epidermoid cysts showed 12p abnormalities, whereas 88% of 17 teratomas did, with i(12p) in 76%. The authors conclude that this FISH assay is a useful ancillary tool for routinely processed surgical specimens. The distinction matters because teratomas are malignant and may metastasize, while epidermoid cysts are benign.

pmid-17023832.summary_ja: 17歳男性の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が胎児性横紋筋肉腫へ悪性転化した症例報告である。組織学的には胚細胞成分を認めなかった。イソクロモソーム12pとα-フェトプロテインの上昇から、胚細胞由来と推定された。集中治療にもかかわらず患者は死亡した。奇形腫の悪性転化はまれで予後不良と述べられている。
pmid-17023832.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old male whose nonseminomatous germ cell tumor underwent malignant transformation into embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma, with no residual germ cell elements on histology. A germ cell origin was supported by isochromosome 12p and elevated alpha-fetoprotein. Despite intensive therapy the patient died. The authors note that malignant transformation of teratoma is rare and carries a poor prognosis.

pmid-17025213.summary_ja: 26歳男性の精巣腫瘍（卵黄嚢腫瘍と成熟奇形腫、IIIA期）。化学療法後も血清マーカーは正常化したが、縦隔・後腹膜腫瘤が増大し続けた。切除で成熟奇形腫のみが認められ、growing teratoma syndromeと診断された。30か月後の縦隔再発腫瘤も成熟奇形腫で、精巣摘除から49か月間、癌の再発なく生存している。
pmid-17025213.summary_en: A 26-year-old man with a right testicular germ cell tumor (yolk sac tumor and mature teratoma, stage IIIA) received BEP, nedaplatin-irinotecan, and TIP chemotherapy. Serum markers normalized, but mediastinal and retroperitoneal masses kept enlarging. Biopsy showed no malignancy. Resection with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection revealed only mature teratoma, consistent with growing teratoma syndrome. A recurrent mediastinal mass 30 months later was again mature teratoma. The patient remained alive and free of carcinoma 49 months after orchiectomy.

pmid-17025215.summary_ja: 32歳男性の精巣セミノーマ（臨床病期IIA期）。化学療法後に寛解しLDHは正常化したが、血清β-hCGは低値陽性を示し続けた。尿中β-hCGは検出限界以下で、異好性抗体遮断剤を用いた希釈試験では対照血清と平行して低下し、偽陽性と判断された。尿中測定と希釈試験の有用性を提案している。
pmid-17025215.summary_en: A 32-year-old man with clinical stage IIA testicular seminoma had mildly elevated serum beta-hCG after orchiectomy and chemotherapy, despite complete remission and normalized LDH. Serum levels stayed low-positive without recurrence. Urinary beta-hCG was undetectable. Serial dilution with a heterophilic antibody-blocking agent showed a decline parallel to control sera, indicating a false-positive result. The authors propose urinary beta-hCG measurement and dilution testing as useful methods for identifying false-positive serum beta-hCG.

pmid-17026960.summary_ja: 胎盤性絨毛癌におけるDickkopf-1(Dkk-1)の役割を検討した基礎研究。正常栄養膜細胞では発現するが、絨毛癌細胞株JARとJEG3では発現が消失していた。Dkk-1の導入により両細胞株の増殖が抑制され、JARではアポトーシスが誘導された。作用はJNK経路を介し、標準的なWntシグナルの関与は小さいとされた。治療応用の可能性を示唆している。
pmid-17026960.summary_en: This study examined Dickkopf-1 (Dkk-1) in placental choriocarcinoma. Dkk-1 was strongly expressed in normal cytotrophoblasts but absent in the choriocarcinoma cell lines JAR and JEG3. Exogenous Dkk-1 suppressed proliferation in both lines and induced apoptosis in JAR cells, indicating tumor-suppressive effects. These effects were mediated through JNK signaling rather than the canonical Wnt pathway. The findings suggest that Dkk-1 may have potential therapeutic applications in placental choriocarcinoma.

pmid-17029216.summary_ja: 精細管内胚細胞腫瘍と精巣胚細胞腫瘍55例を対象に、10遺伝子のプロモーターメチル化をMSPで評価し、脱メチル化剤を用いた網羅的解析で新規候補遺伝子を同定した。非セミノーマはセミノーマより有意にメチル化が多く、SCGB3A1、RASSF1A、HOXA9が高頻度でメチル化されていた。発生関連遺伝子のエピジェネティックな不活化が関与すると結論している。
pmid-17029216.summary_en: This study analyzed promoter methylation of ten candidate genes in intratubular germ cell neoplasia and 55 primary testicular germ cell tumours. A demethylating agent and microarray analysis were used to identify additional epigenetic targets. Non-seminomas were methylated significantly more often than seminomas. SCGB3A1, RASSF1A, and HOXA9 were the most frequently methylated genes in non-seminomas. The authors conclude that epigenetic silencing of developmental genes, including homeobox genes and SCGB3A1, contributes to testicular germ cell tumour development.

pmid-17031243.summary_ja: 良性卵巣腫瘍（漿液性嚢胞腺腫、粘液性嚢胞腺腫、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫）の嚢胞液中M-CSF濃度を比較した。M-CSF濃度は組織型により有意に異なり、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で最も低く、漿液性嚢胞腺腫で最も高かった。血清濃度は群間で差がなかった。M-CSFの抗腫瘍作用は組織型ごとに異なる可能性を示唆している。
pmid-17031243.summary_en: This study measured macrophage colony-stimulating factor (M-CSF) levels in the cyst fluid of benign ovarian tumors, including serous cystadenoma, mucinous cystadenoma, and mature cystic teratoma. M-CSF levels differed significantly by histologic type, lowest in mature cystic teratoma and highest in serous cystadenoma. Serum M-CSF levels did not differ among the benign tumor groups. The authors suggest that the antitumor activity of M-CSF varies by histologic type.

pmid-17031378.summary_ja: 本総説は、14か国41集団のがん登録データを用いて、精巣セミノーマと非セミノーマの発生率の推移を比較した。1920年頃以降、連続する出生コホートで発生率は上昇していた。セミノーマと非セミノーマのコホート別推移は類似しており、両者は疫学的および病因学的に同等であることが示唆された。知見は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の決定因子に関する現在の理論と関連づけて考察されている。
pmid-17031378.summary_en: This review analyzed cancer-registry data from 41 populations in 14 countries to compare incidence trends of testicular seminoma and nonseminoma. Incidence rose across successive birth cohorts from about 1920. Seminoma and nonseminoma cohort trends were similar, suggesting that the two subtypes are epidemiologically and etiologically comparable. The findings are discussed in relation to current theories on the determinants of testicular germ cell cancer.

pmid-17033219.summary_ja: 膀胱に生じた原発性類皮嚢腫の症例報告。膀胱鏡で診断され、病理組織学的検査で確定した。内視鏡的に完全切除できた。インド亜大陸およびアジアからの報告としては3例目とされる。尿路に生じる良性の奇形腫性病変として、まれな発生部位であることを文献的に概観している。
pmid-17033219.summary_en: This case report describes a primary bladder dermoid, a rare extragonadal mature teratoma, diagnosed cystoscopically and confirmed histopathologically. The lesion was completely excised endoscopically. The authors note that this is only the third reported case from the Indian and Asian subcontinent. The report briefly reviews the literature on this uncommon presentation of a benign teratomatous lesion in the urinary bladder.

pmid-17033220.summary_ja: 19歳の男性が、7年間続く精巣内嚢胞性腫瘤で受診した。超音波検査で大きな低エコー性充実性病変が認められ、AFP、β-hCG、LDHは陰性であった。精巣温存下の核出術が施行され、14か月の時点で再発はなかった。著者らは、精巣類皮嚢腫は稀な嚢胞性奇形腫の一型であるとレビューしている。ホルモン、心理、生殖の観点から、精巣摘除術よりも核出術が望ましいと論じている。
pmid-17033220.summary_en: A 19-year-old man presented with a seven-year history of an intratesticular cystic mass. Sonography showed a large hypoechoic solid lesion, while AFP, beta-hCG, and LDH were negative. Testis-sparing enucleation was performed, with no recurrence at 14 months. The authors review dermoid cysts of the testis, a rare form of cystic teratoma. They argue that enucleation is preferable to orchiectomy for hormonal, psychological, and reproductive reasons.

pmid-17034602.summary_ja: 本後方視的検討では、陰嚢超音波検査1,544件から、観察に適した1 cm未満の偶発的精巣内病変12件が同定された。触知可能例、腫瘍マーカー上昇例、播種性悪性腫瘍例は手術対象とし、それ以外は連続超音波検査で経過観察した。3件の無エコー性嚢胞は変化しなかった。8件の低エコー性病変は平均34か月追跡され、1件のみ増大し、1.0 cmのセミノーマと診断された。著者らは、慎重に選択された小さな精巣内病変は安全に観察できると結論づけている。
pmid-17034602.summary_en: This retrospective review of 1,544 scrotal ultrasound scans identified 12 incidental intratesticular lesions under 1 cm suitable for observation. Lesions were managed with serial ultrasonography unless they were palpable, had elevated tumour markers, or showed disseminated malignancy. Three anechoic cysts remained stable. Eight hypoechoic lesions were followed for a mean of 34 months, and only one grew, proving to be a 1.0-cm seminoma. The authors conclude that carefully selected small intratesticular lesions can be safely observed.

pmid-17035387.summary_ja: 兵役者の精巣腫瘍環境・内分泌決定因子研究（754例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍症例と928例の対照）を用いた症例対照研究。母親・父親の喫煙、妊娠中・授乳中の母親の喫煙はいずれもリスクと関連しなかった。非親の喫煙者との同居で軽度の関連が見られたが、用量・期間との関係はなかった。セミノーマと非セミノーマで結果に差はなく、受動喫煙はリスク因子ではないと結論づけられた。
pmid-17035387.summary_en: A case-control study using data from 754 testicular germ cell tumor cases and 928 controls in the Servicemen's Testicular Tumor Environmental and Endocrine Determinants study. Maternal and paternal smoking, and maternal smoking during pregnancy or breastfeeding, showed no meaningful association with risk. Living with a non-parent smoker was marginally associated with risk. Results did not differ by seminoma or non-seminoma histology. The authors conclude passive smoking does not appear to be a risk factor, though other early-life exposures may explain familial clustering.

pmid-17040060.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対するBEP療法（ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン）の第3コース9日目に、急性心筋梗塞を発症した30歳の喫煙者の症例報告。右冠動脈の血栓による完全閉塞に対し、冠動脈アテローム切除術で血栓を除去した。化学療法の心血管毒性と、特に喫煙者でのリスク評価の重要性が示された。
pmid-17040060.summary_en: A 30-year-old smoker with no prior ischaemic heart disease developed acute myocardial infarction on day nine of his third course of combined bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy for testicular cancer. ECG showed inferior ST elevation, and emergency coronary angiography revealed total occlusion of the right coronary artery by thrombus. Coronary atherectomy removed the thrombus. The report highlights cardiovascular toxicity as a potential complication of BEP regimens and the need for cardiovascular risk assessment, particularly in smokers.

pmid-17040584.summary_ja: 乳児の鼻咽腔と頸部にわたる多発性二胚葉性成熟奇形腫の症例報告。深部頸部感染症を併発し、上部気道・消化管の機能障害を来した。頭頸部の奇形腫、類皮嚢腫、有毛性ポリープは稀な先天性腫瘍で、組織分類や発生起源について議論がある。本症例の臨床病理学的特徴を検討している。
pmid-17040584.summary_en: A case report of an infant with a multifocal bigerminal mature teratoma involving the nasopharynx and neck. The lesion caused a deep neck infection that impaired the upper aerodigestive tract. The authors review the clinicopathological features of head and neck teratomas, dermoids and hairy polyps, which are rare congenital tumours often confused with single masses. They discuss the histological classification, origin and embryological basis of these lesions.

pmid-17041225.summary_ja: 健常精巣とセミノーマを含む生殖系列組織で、ヒト特異的HERV-K(HML-2)のLTRのプロモーター活性を全ゲノム規模で比較した研究。LTRの少なくとも50%がプロモーター活性を持ち、多くはセミノーマで発現が増減していた。活性はLTRの種類と遺伝子に対する位置に主に依存した。
pmid-17041225.summary_en: The first genome-wide comparison of in vivo promoter activity of human-specific HERV-K (HML-2) LTRs, measured in healthy and cancerous germ line tissues including seminoma. At least half of these LTRs showed promoter activity, and many were up- or downregulated in seminoma relative to normal tissue. Promoter strength depended mainly on LTR type and genomic position, with 5' proviral LTRs being the strongest. LTRs in gene-rich regions were more often active, and transcription was selectively suppressed in introns.

pmid-17048439.summary_ja: 17歳女性の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍(IIIc期)患者が、シスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン(PVB)療法5コース後に一過性皮質盲と重篤な高血圧を発症した。画像所見は後頭葉白質脳症症候群に合致した。降圧薬などの支持療法により数日で視力と血圧は回復し、後遺症は残らなかった。原因としてはシスプラチンが有力視される。
pmid-17048439.summary_en: A 17-year-old girl with stage IIIc ovarian endodermal sinus tumor developed transient cortical blindness and severe hypertension after five cycles of PVB chemotherapy (cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin). Imaging was consistent with posterior leukoencephalopathy syndrome. Vision and blood pressure recovered within days with antihypertensive treatment and supportive care, without lasting sequelae. The authors note that cisplatin is the most implicated agent, that the mechanism is incompletely understood, and that prompt blood pressure control and withdrawal of immunosuppressive agents may aid reversal.

pmid-17051903.summary_ja: 12歳女児が交通事故による腹部外傷後に急性腹症を呈した。超音波検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、大きな多房性の充実性骨盤内腫瘤と骨盤内液体貯留を認めた。緊急開腹術で出血する腫瘍血管を止血し、腫瘍が大きすぎて切除できなかったため生検を行った。小児の急性腹症では卵巣未分化胚細胞腫を鑑別診断に含めるべきと結論づけている。
pmid-17051903.summary_en: A 12-year-old girl with ovarian dysgerminoma presented with an acute abdomen after abdominal trauma from a traffic accident. Ultrasound and CT showed a large, multilobulated, predominantly solid pelvic mass with pelvic fluid. Emergency laparotomy revealed an actively bleeding tumor vessel, which was controlled. The tumor was too large for resection, so a biopsy was performed. The authors conclude that ovarian dysgerminoma should be included in the differential diagnosis of acute surgical abdomen in girls with a solid mass on ultrasonography.

pmid-17054798.summary_ja: 38歳男性に生じた肺内成熟奇形腫の症例を報告する。奇形腫は複数の胚細胞系列由来の組織からなる腫瘍と定義される。性腺や他の性腺外原発巣を除外し、肺内に起源をもつことを確認している。肺奇形腫はまれで、左肺上葉に多いが理由は不明である。関連文献の総説も行っている。
pmid-17054798.summary_en: A 38-year-old man presented with an intrapulmonary mature teratoma, a rare entity that commonly involves the upper lobe of the left lung. The authors confirmed pulmonary origin by excluding gonadal and other extragonadal primary sites. Teratomas are defined as tumors containing tissues derived from more than one germ cell line. The paper reports this case and reviews the relevant literature on lung teratomas, whose predilection for the left upper lobe remains unexplained.

pmid-17058315.summary_ja: 1970年から2003年に治療されたオランダの173人の仙尾部奇形腫の小児を対象とした全国規模の後方視的研究で、再発と転移に関連する因子を検討した。手術後3年以内に11%で再発が認められた。病理学的な不完全切除、未熟な組織像、悪性の組織像が再発の独立したリスク因子であった一方、腫瘍の大きさ、Altman分類、年齢はリスク因子ではなかった。再発の約3分の1は未熟性または悪性への移行を示した。著者らは、成熟奇形腫も悪性化しうるため、長期フォローアップが必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-17058315.summary_en: This Dutch national retrospective study of 173 children with sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) treated from 1970 to 2003 examined factors linked to recurrence and metastasis. Recurrence occurred in 11% within three years of surgery. Pathologically incomplete resection, immature histology, and malignant histology were independent risk factors for recurrence, while size, Altman classification, and age were not. Nearly one-third of recurrences showed a shift toward immaturity or malignancy. The authors conclude that mature teratoma can become malignant, so long-term follow-up is warranted.

pmid-17062277.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群と思春期早発を合併し、AFPとβ-hCGを産生する縦隔未熟奇形腫の小児例の症例報告である。腫瘍のホルモン活性により、クラインフェルター症候群の典型的徴候が隠された。手術切除のみで治療したが局所再発をきたした。未熟奇形腫に対する補助化学療法の役割は定まっておらず、小児では予後が比較的良好とされる。
pmid-17062277.summary_en: This report describes a child with Klinefelter syndrome and precocious puberty who had a mediastinal immature teratoma secreting alpha-fetoprotein and beta-hCG. The tumor's hormonal activity masked the usual signs of Klinefelter syndrome. Treated with surgical excision alone, the child developed a local recurrence. The authors review the uncertain role of neoadjuvant and adjuvant chemotherapy for immature teratoma and note that age-related prognosis tends to be better in children.

pmid-17063084.summary_ja: 不妊症や停留精巣など悪性腫瘍以外の理由で精巣生検や精巣摘除術を受けた157例に対し、OCT4免疫組織化学の有用性を検討した。OCT4陽性は6例で、いずれも精巣胚細胞腫瘍の危険因子を持っていた。しかし精細管内胚細胞腫瘍を確認できたのは1例のみであった。危険因子のない不妊症例は全例陰性であり、高リスク例での前浸潤性病変の検出に有用と考えられる。
pmid-17063084.summary_en: This study tested OCT4 immunohistochemistry as a screening tool for intratubular germ cell neoplasia in 157 testicular biopsies or orchiectomy specimens obtained for non-malignant indications such as infertility and cryptorchidism. OCT4-positive germ cells appeared in six patients, all with risk factors for testicular germ cell tumors, but intratubular neoplasia was confirmed in only one. Negative staining in infertility patients without other risk factors argues against routine OCT4 staining in infertility biopsies, while its use in high-risk patients may identify preinvasive disease.

pmid-17066627.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍と傍大動脈リンパ節転移の治療中だった40歳男性が、血栓溶解療法後に突然死した症例報告である。剖検では腫瘍細胞が肺動脈内膜へ浸潤し、解離と血栓形成を伴っていた。深部静脈血栓からの塞栓ではなく、腫瘍の直接浸潤による肺動脈閉塞が死因であった。精巣腫瘍による肺腫瘍塞栓での突然死は稀とされる。
pmid-17066627.summary_en: A 40-year-old man with testicular tumor and para-aortic lymph node metastasis died suddenly after pulmonary embolism treated with thrombolysis. Autopsy revealed tumor cells invading the intima of the pulmonary artery, with dissection and thrombosis. The case shows that testicular tumor can cause fatal pulmonary artery obstruction by direct intravascular tumor invasion rather than by embolization from deep veins. The authors note that sudden death from pulmonary tumor embolism of testicular origin is rare.

pmid-17067585.summary_ja: 妊娠22週で卵巣の嚢胞が急速に増大した32歳女性の症例報告である。超音波で嚢内に浮遊する脂肪性の球状構造が見られ、20cmを超えたため妊娠28週で右付属器切除術を行った。病理学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。通常は緩徐に増大する類皮嚢腫が妊娠中に速く増大した理由として、エストロゲンやプロゲステロン受容体発現の異常が考えられている。
pmid-17067585.summary_en: A 32-year-old pregnant woman had a rapidly enlarging ovarian cyst at 22 weeks' gestation, with ultrasound showing mobile echogenic 'fat balls' within the mass. Right adnexectomy was performed at 28 weeks because the cyst exceeded 20 cm. Pathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma. The authors note that dermoid cysts usually grow slowly, and suggest that altered estrogen and progesterone receptor expression in the teratoma may explain the fast growth during pregnancy.

pmid-17072726.summary_ja: 左卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に対する卵巣摘除術の34年後に、左横隔膜下で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が見つかった45歳女性の症例報告である。その1年前には右横隔膜の腫瘍も切除されていた。すべての病理像は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。卵巣腫瘍の再発の可能性もあるが、性腺と性腺外に多中心性の奇形腫病巣が異時性に生じたと結論づけている。
pmid-17072726.summary_en: A 45-year-old woman developed a mature cystic teratoma below the left diaphragm, 34 years after oophorectomy for a left ovarian mature cystic teratoma and one year after excision of a right-sided diaphragmatic tumor. All specimens showed mature cystic teratoma. Although it could be a recurrence of the ovarian tumor, the authors conclude that multicentric teratomatous foci developed metachronously in gonadal and extragonadal sites. Mature cystic teratomas in the diaphragm are rare, with only seven prior reports.

pmid-17078858.summary_ja: 1955〜2002年にアイスランドで診断された精巣胚細胞腫瘍214例を検討した全国規模の研究です。罹患率は約4倍に増加し、セミノーマは55%を占めました。非セミノーマは診断時の病期が高い傾向があり、壊死や血管浸潤は転移性疾患と有意に関連していました。病期Iの腫瘍は研究期間中に増加しました。
pmid-17078858.summary_en: This nationwide Icelandic study reviewed all testicular germ cell tumors diagnosed from 1955 to 2002 in 214 patients. Incidence rose nearly fourfold, and seminoma accounted for 55 percent of cases. Non-seminomas were more often diagnosed at higher stage than seminomas. Necrosis and vascular invasion were significantly associated with metastatic disease at diagnosis. Stage I tumors increased over the study period, and tumor size decreased.

pmid-17080330.summary_ja: 本総説は、奇形腫の生物学的挙動が年齢、性別、腫瘍部位、組織型によりどう異なるかを検討する。思春期前の精巣奇形腫は一般に良性で細胞遺伝学的異常を示さない一方、思春期後の腫瘍は12p等長染色体を示すことがある。キール登録の541検体を用いて、部位分布と成熟奇形腫および未熟奇形腫の頻度を示す。さらに、卵黄嚢腫瘍の微小病巣と、体細胞型悪性腫瘍を伴う悪性転化についても論じている。
pmid-17080330.summary_en: This review examines how teratoma biology varies with age, sex, tumor site, and histology. Prepubertal testicular teratomas are generally benign and lack cytogenetic aberrations, while postpubertal tumors may show isochromosome 12p. Using the Kiel registry of 541 specimens, the authors describe site distribution and the frequency of mature versus immature teratomas. They also discuss yolk sac tumor microfoci and malignant transformation with somatic-type malignancy.

pmid-17080331.summary_ja: 本ドイツの小児研究は、MAKEIプロトコルのもとで治療された641例の頭蓋外非精巣性純粋奇形腫を検討し、悪性転化を伴う奇形腫9例を同定した。癌腫が最も多く、患者の多くは卵巣奇形腫の思春期後の女児であった。限局性腫瘍では完全切除が適切とみなされ、R1またはR2切除の場合には化学療法が考慮された。シスプラチン系レジメンは再発例に有効であったが、標準的なレジメンはまだ確立されていない。
pmid-17080331.summary_en: This German pediatric study reviewed 641 extracranial nontesticular pure teratomas treated under MAKEI protocols and identified nine cases of teratoma with malignant transformation. Carcinoma was most common, and most patients were postpubertal girls with ovarian teratoma. Complete resection was adequate for localized tumors, while chemotherapy was considered for R1 or R2 resection. Cisplatin-based regimens were effective in relapsed patients, though no standard regimen has been established.

pmid-17080332.summary_ja: 非精巣性小児奇形腫の535例を、MAKEI 83/86/89とMAKEI 96で比較した研究です。完全切除後の無イベント生存率は両期間とも約96%でした。不完全切除が主な再発因子で、再発率は13.9%から9.5%に低下しました。未熟性を理由に補助化学療法を行うと、再発時に卵黄嚢腫瘍は認められませんでした。
pmid-17080332.summary_en: This German pediatric study compared MAKEI 83/86/89 with MAKEI 96 in 535 evaluable children with non-testicular teratoma. Event-free survival after complete resection was about 96 percent in both periods, and incomplete resection was the main relapse risk. Relapse declined from 13.9 to 9.5 percent. Early treatment-related deaths decreased. Yolk sac tumor was absent at recurrence when adjuvant chemotherapy was given for immaturity, but common after observation alone.

pmid-17082218.summary_ja: 日本の1施設で、1981年から2003年に治療された転移性胚細胞腫瘍の74人の患者を対象とした後方視的研究である。全体の5年および10年の無増悪生存率はそれぞれ79%および74%であった。IGCC分類では予後良好、中間、不良の群が区別されたが、中間群と不良群の間に有意差はなかった。Indiana University分類は、無増悪生存期間の独立した予後因子であった。
pmid-17082218.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study in Japan analyzed 74 patients with metastatic testicular germ cell tumors treated from 1981 to 2003. Overall five- and ten-year progression-free survival was 79 and 74 percent. The International Germ Cell Cancer Consensus classification separated good, intermediate, and poor prognosis groups, though intermediate and poor groups did not differ significantly. The Indiana University classification was an independent prognostic factor for progression-free survival.

pmid-17084372.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍21例に対し、導入化学療法後に大量化学療法(HDCT)を単回施行した後方視的研究。HDCT施行の9例中8例が無病生存を維持した一方、早期病勢進行のためHDCTを受けられない例が多く、その12例は2年時点で全員死亡した。HDCT後の残存病変切除により3例が病理学的完全寛解を得た。
pmid-17084372.summary_en: This study evaluated early high-dose chemotherapy (HDCT) with carboplatin, etoposide, and cyclophosphamide plus stem cell support in 21 patients with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Nine patients received HDCT, and eight remained disease-free at a median follow-up of 52 months. Patients who did not receive HDCT, mostly due to progressive disease, had no survivors at two years. Residual surgery after HDCT yielded pathologic complete remissions in three patients. The authors conclude that single-shot HDCT after induction chemotherapy was feasible but largely inapplicable because of early progression.

pmid-17086802.summary_ja: 1996年から2004年にベネズエラの一施設で子宮外妊娠に合併した妊娠性絨毛性疾患6例の症例集積。全例が腹痛を訴え、多くで血腹と付属器腫瘤を認めた。病理は部分奇胎5例、絨毛癌1例。4例はフォローアップから脱落した。子宮外妊娠の検体には厳密な組織学的基準の適用と、注意深いhCGのフォローアップが重要と結論づけている。
pmid-17086802.summary_en: This case series describes six women with gestational trophoblastic disease arising in ectopic pregnancy at a Venezuelan hospital between 1996 and 2004. All presented with abdominal pain, most with hemoperitoneum and adnexal masses on ultrasound. Histology showed partial mole in five and choriocarcinoma in one. Four patients were lost to follow-up. The authors emphasize strict histologic criteria when reviewing ectopic pregnancy specimens and careful hCG monitoring, because the condition can mimic ordinary ectopic pregnancy.

pmid-17086805.summary_ja: 1986年から2005年に高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍でEMA-CO療法を受けた50例のうち24例が、計28件の術後補助手術を受けた。子宮摘出、肺切除、止血処置が中心であった。手術を受けた患者の87.5%が生存し、化学療法抵抗性病変に対する子宮摘出と肺切除、出血対策が管理上重要と結論づけている。
pmid-17086805.summary_en: This study of 50 patients with high-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia treated with EMA-CO chemotherapy between 1986 and 2005 examines the role of adjuvant surgery. Twenty-four patients underwent 28 procedures, including hysterectomy, lung resection, and procedures to control bleeding. Among patients who underwent surgery, 87.5% survived. The authors conclude that hysterectomy and pulmonary resection for chemotherapy-resistant disease, along with hemorrhage control, are important components of management.

pmid-17086806.summary_ja: ニューメキシコ州およびSEER登録(1973-2003年)を用い、妊娠性絨毛性疾患と絨毛癌の罹患動向を解析した。絨毛癌の罹患率は全体で37.7%低下し、州内の人種間格差は縮小した。一方、直近10年では黒人の罹患率と遠隔転移性疾患の増加が認められ、絨毛性疾患センターの減少がその一因と考察されている。
pmid-17086806.summary_en: Using New Mexico and SEER registry data from 1973 to 2003, this study analyzed three decades of trends in gestational trophoblastic disease and choriocarcinoma incidence. Age-adjusted incidence of choriocarcinoma fell by 37.7% overall, and racial disparities narrowed in New Mexico. However, incidence among Black women and cases with distant disease rose during the most recent decade. The authors suggest that fewer regional trophoblastic centers may partly explain the rise in distant-stage diagnoses.

pmid-17086810.summary_ja: 1977年から2005年にSheffield妊娠性絨毛性疾患センターで治療された産褥期絨毛癌35例の後方視的検討。多くは持続する産後出血で発症し、婦人科管理下でも診断が遅れることがあった。低リスク例はメトトレキサート単剤で奏効した。平均生存期間は7.8年で、症候性脳転移は致死的となりうると報告している。
pmid-17086810.summary_en: This study reviewed 35 women treated for postpartum choriocarcinoma at the Sheffield Trophoblastic Disease Centre between 1977 and 2005. Most presented with persistent postpartum bleeding, and diagnosis was often delayed despite gynecologic care. Twenty patients had metastatic disease, and low-risk patients responded to methotrexate alone. Mean survival was 7.8 years, with two disease-related deaths. The authors note that symptomatic brain metastases can be fatal, and that awareness of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia is essential.

pmid-17086812.summary_ja: 1978年から2001年にQueen Mary Hospitalで治療された再発妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍18例の検討。全生存期間(全生存率)は77.8%で、死亡4例はいずれも初診時に低リスクとされた症例であった。再発例は救済可能であり、治療失敗は治療やフォローアップの中断、あるいは大量病変での遅い受診と関連すると結論づけている。
pmid-17086812.summary_en: This review examines 18 patients with relapsed gestational trophoblastic neoplasia treated at Queen Mary Hospital between 1978 and 2001. Most were initially classified as low or high risk, and treatment included single-, dual-, or multiple-agent chemotherapy. Overall survival was 77.8%. All four deaths occurred in patients initially classified as low risk. The authors conclude that relapsed disease is salvageable, and that treatment failures were linked to abandoned treatment or follow-up and presentation with massive disease.

pmid-17089317.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対しシスプラチン併用化学療法後、残存胸部病変の肺切除を受けた52例を検討した。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は75.8%。多変量解析では、腫瘍マーカーが正常で完全切除された症例で予後が良好であった。切除検体に生存腫瘍を認めた例は予後不良だった。肺切除は安全かつ有効と結論づけている。
pmid-17089317.summary_en: This study analyzed 52 patients who underwent pulmonary resection of residual thoracic masses after cisplatin-based chemotherapy for metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. The 5-year overall survival was 75.8%. Normal serum AFP and/or hCG levels and complete resection predicted longer survival on multivariate analysis. Patients with viable tumor in the resected specimen fared worse than those with necrosis, fibrosis, or teratoma alone. The authors conclude that pulmonary resection is safe and effective, while incomplete resection and elevated markers indicate poorer outcomes.

pmid-17090201.summary_ja: 初診時に性交痛を主訴とした23歳の未経妊女性における胎児様奇形腫(ホムンクルス)の症例報告。奇形胎児様の外観を呈する稀な卵巣奇形腫で、英語文献での報告は極めて少ない。臨床・病理学的特徴をまとめ、胎児内胎児や子宮外妊娠との鑑別を考察している。
pmid-17090201.summary_en: This report describes a 23-year-old nulligravid woman with a fetiform teratoma (homunculus), a rare ovarian teratoma resembling a malformed fetus, who presented with dyspareunia. The authors describe the clinical and pathologic features and review the sparse English-language literature. They also discuss how this entity differs from the more developed fetus-in-fetu and from ectopic pregnancy.

pmid-17094445.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株Tera-2を用いたin vitro研究で、FGF-19とFGF-20の細胞増殖および遊走への影響を検討した。両因子とも増殖を促進したが、FGF-20は低用量から有効で、FGF-19は高用量を要した。運動能を高めたのはFGF-20のみで、高用量の場合に限られた。両者は細胞生存と遊走に質的に異なる作用を持つと結論づけている。
pmid-17094445.summary_en: In vitro study of FGF-19 and FGF-20 effects on Tera-2, a human embryonal carcinoma cell line. Both growth factors promoted cell multiplication; FGF-20 did so at low doses, whereas FGF-19 required high doses. Only FGF-20 promoted cell motility, and only at high doses. Cell numbers and migration were assessed at the clonal level by light microscopy. The authors conclude the two factors exert qualitatively different effects on cell survival and locomotion, suggesting distinct roles in embryonal carcinoma biology.

pmid-17094553.summary_ja: 子宮癌の術前CTで前縦隔に見つかった64歳女性の巨大成熟奇形腫の症例報告。子宮癌の根治術と化学療法後に腫瘍が増大し、正中胸骨切開下に肺および左腕頭静脈と癒着したまま合併切除された。嚢胞内には毛髪と脂様液体が含まれ、骨や消化管上皮などを有していた。良性奇形腫でも隣接臓器へ浸潤し得るため、合併切除の可能性を念頭に置くべきだと述べている。
pmid-17094553.summary_en: Case report of a 64-year-old woman with a large anterior mediastinal mature teratoma, found on chest CT during evaluation for uterine cancer. After radical surgery and chemotherapy for the uterine cancer, the tumor enlarged and was resected via median sternotomy. It was densely adherent to the right lung and left brachiocephalic vein, requiring combined resection. The 9 x 8 cm mass contained cream-like fluid and hair, and histology showed bone, gut and bronchial epithelium. The authors advise considering combined resection when surgery is planned.

pmid-17095845.summary_ja: 52歳男性に生じた、症状を伴う3cmの膵臓嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。膵臓の類皮嚢腫はきわめて稀で、術前評価では確定できず、診断は術中に得られた。既報18例の文献レビューを行い、同様の患者の診断評価への認識向上を目指している。
pmid-17095845.summary_en: Case report of a 52-year-old man with a symptomatic 3 cm cystic pancreatic mass diagnosed as cystic teratoma, an exceptionally rare dermoid-type lesion of the pancreas. Preoperative evaluation was uncertain, and definitive diagnosis came intraoperatively. The authors reviewed the world literature, identifying 18 previously documented cases, and aim to raise awareness of diagnostic evaluation for such patients.

pmid-17100156.summary_ja: カナダの放射線腫瘍医78名(回答率74%)を対象とした病期Iセミノーマの治療選好に関する電子調査。56%が経過観察を最善とし、31%が補助放射線療法を選択した。補助化学療法を選んだのは1%だった。以前の調査では放射線療法が主流であったが、現在は経過観察を支持する医師が大多数であると報告している。
pmid-17100156.summary_en: Electronic survey of Canadian radiation oncologists (78 of 105 responded, 74%) on management of stage I seminoma. Most (56%) preferred surveillance, 31% favored adjuvant radiotherapy, 1% chose adjuvant chemotherapy, and 12% were unsure. Most would choose surveillance for themselves. The authors note that a previous survey found radiotherapy was most often preferred, indicating a shift toward surveillance in Canada.

pmid-17101338.summary_ja: WT1遺伝子変異を伴うフレイジャー症候群の17歳女性の症例報告。異形成性性腺に対する予防的腹腔鏡下両側卵管卵巣摘出術で、対側の萎縮卵巣にそれぞれ性腺芽腫とセミノーマが見つかった。著者らは、胚細胞悪性腫瘍の予防のため、異形成性性腺の早期予防的切除が必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-17101338.summary_en: Case report of a 17-year-old phenotypic female with Frasier syndrome (46,XY karyotype, WT1 mutation, renal failure after transplant, dysgenetic gonads). Prophylactic laparoscopic bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy found gonadoblastoma and seminoma in the opposite atrophic ovaries, with a hypoplastic uterus. The authors conclude that early prophylactic resection of dysgenetic gonads is indicated in Frasier syndrome to prevent germ cell malignancy.

pmid-17101342.summary_ja: 出生直後に呼吸停止を起こし挿管された新生児で、口から突出した隆起性腫瘤の症例報告。舌の腫瘤は完全切除され、組織学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された。頭頸部奇形腫は稀で、多くは成熟型であり、切除が最も有効な治療であることを述べている。
pmid-17101342.summary_en: Case report of a neonate with a polypoid mass protruding from the mouth, who had respiratory arrest at birth and required intubation. The tongue mass was completely excised and histologically identified as a mature teratoma. The authors review that head and neck teratomas are rare, typically mature, present in neonates with feeding or airway problems, and are best treated by excision.

pmid-17102543.summary_ja: 1992〜2002年に治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍83例の研究。化学療法後に残存腫瘤を認めた29例で開腹術を行い、3例に生存腫瘍、10例に奇形腫成分、16例に壊死または線維化のみを認めた。初発時に奇形腫成分がない、残存病変が5cm未満、2コース後にマーカーが正常化したなどの場合は手術を省略できる可能性があると結論している。
pmid-17102543.summary_en: Study of 83 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated 1992 to 2002 in Chennai. Of 29 patients with residual masses who underwent laparotomy after cisplatin-based chemotherapy, 3 had viable tumor, 7 immature and 3 mature teratoma, and 16 only necrosis or fibrosis. Absence of teratoma in the primary tumor, residue under 5 cm, or marker normalization after two cycles predicted absence of viable disease, so surgery may be avoidable in those patients.

pmid-17109641.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株NTERA-2 cL.D1の増殖期と分化期を分子・細胞レベルで解析した。胚様体に似た細胞凝集体を形成させ、外胚葉・中胚葉・内胚葉への分化能を評価した。ヒト胚性幹細胞の発生研究に有用な簡便なモデルとなることを示した。
pmid-17109641.summary_en: This study characterized the NTERA-2 cL.D1 human embryonal carcinoma cell line during expansion and differentiation. Because embryonal carcinoma cells are the malignant counterparts of human embryonic stem cells, the authors assessed their pluripotency at molecular and cellular levels. Differentiation was induced by forming embryoid-body-like aggregates, and the cells' ability to give rise to ectoderm, mesoderm, and endoderm derivatives was examined. The authors propose that this well-defined line offers a robust and simple model for studying cell fate determination and early embryogenesis.

pmid-17111082.summary_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術後に腫瘍マーカーのみ上昇した臨床病期IS非セミノーマ患者15例に、EP療法3サイクルを実施した。全例で腫瘍マーカーは正常化し、中央値85か月の観察で再発は認めなかった。標準的な3剤化学療法群と比べ、グレードIVの白血球減少が少なかった。
pmid-17111082.summary_en: Fifteen patients with clinical stage IS nonseminomatous testicular cancer, whose only evidence of persistent disease after radical orchiectomy was elevated serum tumor markers, received three cycles of etoposide and cisplatin. Markers normalized after one or two cycles in all patients. One patient required surgery for a recurrent retroperitoneal mature teratoma. With a median follow-up of 85 months, all remained disease-free. Grade IV leukopenia was less frequent than in a control group receiving standard three-drug chemotherapy. The authors conclude that EP may be a reduced-toxicity option, though more evidence is needed.

pmid-17111085.summary_ja: 1997〜2002年に、高リスクの病期Iおよび病期IIAのセミノーマ14例に神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った。リンパ節転移は病期I例の3/10、病期IIA例の全例で認められた。平均56か月の観察で再発はなく、順行性射精は全例で温存された。放射線療法の晩期合併症を考慮すると、手術が選択肢となりうる。
pmid-17111085.summary_en: Fourteen patients with pure seminoma, ten with high-risk clinical stage I and four with stage IIA, underwent primary nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection between 1997 and 2002. Pathology showed lymph node involvement in three of ten stage I patients and all four stage IIA patients. Minor complications occurred in two patients, and antegrade ejaculation was preserved in all. No retroperitoneal or distant recurrence was seen over a mean follow-up of 56 months. The authors suggest that surgery may become a preferred option over radiotherapy for low-stage seminoma, given concerns about late radiation complications.

pmid-17111392.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性または性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に残存腫瘍切除を受けた68例を後方視的に解析した。軽度のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)上昇は、必ずしも予後不良を示すわけではなかった。残存生存性悪性腫瘍を有する26例では、術前AFP陽性例の生存期間がβ-hCG陽性例より有意に良好だった。
pmid-17111392.summary_en: This retrospective review of 68 patients undergoing residual tumor resection after chemotherapy for metastatic nonseminomatous or extragonadal germ cell tumor examined whether preoperative serum AFP predicts residual histology and survival. Residual malignancy was found at similar rates in patients with normal AFP and mildly elevated AFP. Among 26 patients with residual viable malignancy, those with positive preoperative AFP had significantly better survival than those with positive beta-hCG. The authors conclude that mild AFP elevation after chemotherapy does not always indicate poor prognosis and should be interpreted individually.

pmid-17112390.summary_ja: 頸部腫瘤で発症した25歳男性で、外科的切除により縦隔絨毛癌と診断された。その後、超音波検査で見つかった精巣結節は精巣セミノーマであった。ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・白金製剤による化学療法4サイクルで完全寛解を維持している。同時性発生の機序について考察している。
pmid-17112390.summary_en: A 25-year-old man presented with a left cervical mass initially suspected to be a thyroid disorder. Complete surgical resection revealed a mediastinal choriocarcinoma. Ultrasound then identified a small testicular nodule, and left radical inguinal orchiectomy confirmed a seminoma. He received four cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and platinum chemotherapy with mild toxicity and remains in complete clinical and biochemical remission. The authors discuss whether these synchronous tumors arose from shared genetic instability in pluripotent germ cells or from metastasis of a less differentiated primary, and stress careful pathological diagnosis in mixed germ cell tumors.

pmid-17114963.summary_ja: 性腺摘出後に生じた混合型悪性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。14歳、性分化疾患、45,X/46,X,derYモザイクの患者。腫瘍の核型では部分トリソミー1qや8qの異常、過二倍体が認められた。性染色体異常やY染色体を含む細胞系では、性腺摘出後も腫瘍発生リスクが高いことを示している。
pmid-17114963.summary_en: A 14-year-old with ambiguous genitalia and 45,X/46,X,derY mosaicism developed an abdominally located mixed malignant germ cell tumor five years after removal of dysgenetic gonads. Tumor karyotyping revealed partial trisomy 1q, a derivative chromosome 8q, and hyperdiploidy with several additional chromosomes. The report highlights the increased risk of germ cell tumor in patients with sex chromosome abnormalities and Y-chromosome-bearing cell lines, even after gonadectomy, and documents the genomic changes in the tumor. Such cases underscore the need for surveillance in patients with dysgenetic gonads.

pmid-17114968.summary_ja: 膣出血と膣腫瘤、AFP上昇を呈した乳児の膣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。化学療法5サイクルのみで治療し、AFPは正常化した。残存を疑った生検でも悪性所見はなかった。性機能と生殖機能の温存のため、化学療法単独治療も考慮すべきとしている。
pmid-17114968.summary_en: This report describes an infant with vaginal bleeding, a vaginal mass, and elevated alpha-fetoprotein, diagnosed by examination under anesthesia and biopsy as endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor of the vagina. Treatment consisted of five cycles of chemotherapy alone, without radical surgery or adjuvant radiation. AFP normalized, and repeat biopsy for suspected residual disease showed no malignancy. The authors suggest that chemotherapy as sole therapy should be considered for these tumors to preserve sexual and reproductive function, since historical approaches relied on radical surgery.

pmid-17115296.summary_ja: 成人の精巣類皮腫瘍2例を報告する。現行では成熟奇形腫として扱われ、放射線学的検査を含む長期のフォローアップが行われている。1例では思春期前に精巣腫瘤の既往があり、成人の類皮腫瘍の一部は思春期前奇形腫が持続したものである可能性が示唆された。再発・転移の報告がないことから、分類の見直しにより不要な画像検査と被ばくを減らせると著者らは主張する。
pmid-17115296.summary_en: This report describes two adult patients with testicular dermoid tumours, which are classified as mature teratomas and managed with lifelong surveillance including repeated radiological studies. In one case there was a history of a testicular lump arising before puberty, suggesting that some adult dermoid tumours may be prepubertal teratomas persisting into adulthood. The authors note these tumours have no reported potential for recurrence or metastasis and question the current classification. Separate classification could avoid unnecessary follow-up imaging and reduce radiation exposure for patients.

pmid-17119045.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者269例と対照797例を用いた症例対照研究である。思春期の牛乳摂取量が多いほど精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスクが上昇し（月20杯あたりRR 1.37）、その大部分はセミノーマによるものであった。乳脂肪およびガラクトース摂取もセミノーマのリスクと関連した。乳製品と精巣がんの関連を、乳脂肪やガラクトースが説明する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-17119045.summary_en: A population-based case-control study of 269 testicular cancer cases and 797 controls examined adolescent dairy intake and risk. Higher milk consumption in adolescence was associated with increased testicular cancer risk (RR 1.37 per 20 servings per month), mainly driven by seminoma. Milk fat and galactose intake were also associated with seminoma risk. The authors suggest milk fat and/or galactose may explain the link between dairy consumption and seminomatous testicular cancer. Dietary data were collected through food frequency questions completed by participants and their mothers.

pmid-17120609.summary_ja: 妊娠19週で診断された巨大な口咽頭奇形腫による先天性高気道閉塞症候群の症例である。胎盤循環を維持したままEXIT手技で娩出され、気管支鏡検査と気管切開により気道を確保した。多職種チームと出生前の超音波診断が鍵であった。腫瘍は巨大で頭蓋内進展を伴い切除不能で、児は出生6日後に死亡した。胎児頸部腫瘤として発症した性腺外奇形腫の管理を示す症例である。
pmid-17120609.summary_en: This report describes a fetus at 19 weeks' gestation with a large oropharyngeal teratoma causing congenital high airway obstruction syndrome. The fetus was delivered using the ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure while still on placental support, allowing time for bronchoscopy and tracheostomy. A multidisciplinary team and accurate prenatal fetal ultrasound diagnosis were key to securing the airway. The tumor was unresectable because of its large size and intracranial extension, and the baby died six days after birth. The case highlights management of an extragonadal teratoma presenting as a fetal neck mass.

pmid-17121955.summary_ja: 生殖年齢の骨盤内腫瘤患者5例の超音波所見をまとめた症例集積である。大きな嚢胞内に多数の浮遊する高エコー性の球が見られ、悪性の充実性結節に似ていた。球には血流がなく良性と考えられ、病理学的にはいずれも悪性成分を伴わない成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。カラードプラ超音波検査が良性と悪性の鑑別に有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-17121955.summary_en: This case series of five patients of reproductive age with pelvic masses describes a distinctive sonographic pattern of mature cystic teratoma: a large cystic tumor containing multiple floating echogenic balls. Three patients had larger balls (1 to 4 cm), and two had numerous small balls (about 0.5 cm) that mimicked malignant solid nodules. The balls lacked vascularity on color Doppler, suggesting a benign nature. All five were pathologically confirmed as mature cystic teratoma without malignant components. The authors conclude this finding is highly specific for mature teratoma and that color Doppler helps distinguish benign balls from malignant tumors.

pmid-17122498.summary_ja: 乳房付近の皮下腫瘤として発症した44歳男性の症例である。病理学的に未熟奇形腫90%と胎児性癌10%からなる皮下原発の混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。精巣超音波検査、CT、腫瘍マーカーは正常であった。追加切除後、7年間無病生存している。皮膚原発の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の文献的考察を含み、成人例はこれまで2例のみと報告されている。
pmid-17122498.summary_en: A 44-year-old man presented with a painful subcutaneous breast mass that proved to be a primary mixed nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, composed of 90% immature teratoma and 10% embryonal carcinoma. Testicular ultrasound, CT of the chest, abdomen, pelvis and brain, and serum tumor markers were normal. After further surgical excision, he remained free of disease for seven years. The authors review the literature, noting that primary cutaneous extragonadal germ cell tumors usually present as solitary nodules and are mostly mature teratomas in children, with only two adult cases previously reported.

pmid-17122513.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍71例の各組織成分でGPC3を免疫組織化学的に評価した研究である。卵黄嚢腫瘍と絨毛癌では全例陽性、未熟奇形腫では38%、胎児性癌では8%に発現した。セミノーマや成熟奇形腫では陰性であった。GPC3は組織型ごとに異なる発現を示し、卵黄嚢腫瘍と絨毛癌の病理診断に有用な新規マーカーとなる可能性が示された。
pmid-17122513.summary_en: This study examined glypican 3 (GPC3) immunohistochemistry across histologic components of testicular germ cell tumors from 71 patients. GPC3 was expressed in all yolk sac tumor and choriocarcinoma components, in 38% of teratomas with immature elements, and in 8% of embryonal carcinomas. It was absent in seminomas, teratomas with mature elements, and benign testis. The authors propose GPC3 as a novel immunohistochemical marker for testicular germ cell tumors, particularly useful for diagnosing yolk sac tumor and choriocarcinoma, and suggest a possible role in tumor cell differentiation.

pmid-17125642.summary_ja: 精巣原発絨毛癌の症例報告である。血便と喀血を初発症状として受診し、精巣腫大は家族に伝えられていなかった。精巣摘除後、胃転移による胃穿孔から大量吐血をきたした。診断時の精巣は約12×7cmと大きく、非典型的であった。診断後1か月以内に合併症で死亡しており、急速な進行が特徴である。
pmid-17125642.summary_en: This case report describes a man with testicular choriocarcinoma who presented with blood-mixed stools and hemoptysis, without having told his parents about testicular swelling. After orchidectomy, he developed massive hematemesis from gastric perforation caused by gastric metastasis. The testis measured about 12 x 7 cm at diagnosis, which is unusually large, since testicular choriocarcinoma typically presents as a small mass. The patient died of complications within one month of diagnosis. The case illustrates the atypical presentation and rapid progression of testicular choriocarcinoma.

pmid-17126259.summary_ja: 剖検で発見された左卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じた扁平上皮癌の症例報告である。壁肥厚部の中等度分化型扁平上皮癌が、小腸や結腸、肝臓に転移していた。FIGO IV期と診断され、転移に伴う化膿性腹膜炎により死亡した。嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌は極めてまれであり、腸管を含めたフォローアップの有用性が示唆されている。
pmid-17126259.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old cachectic woman with a left ovarian mature cystic teratoma found at autopsy. A focal wall thickening harbored moderately differentiated squamous cell carcinoma, which had metastasized to the jejunum, ileum, transverse colon, left colonic flexure, and liver. The tumor was staged FIGO IV, and suppurative peritonitis from the metastatic spread caused the patient's death. The authors note that metastatic squamous cell carcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma is very rare, and suggest that follow-up including the intestine may be useful.

pmid-17139992.summary_ja: 49歳女性の難治性転移性絨毛癌症例。子宮摘出術と副腎転移巣の外科的切除に加え、異なるプロトコルによる多剤併用化学療法を15コース実施した。治療5年、フォローアップ7年の時点で再発は認められていない。外科的切除と複数の化学療法レジメンの組み合わせにより、化学療法抵抗性の転移例でも長期の病勢制御が得られた可能性を示す症例報告である。
pmid-17139992.summary_en: A 49-year-old woman with refractory metastatic choriocarcinoma underwent hysterectomy and resection of suprarenal gland metastases, and received 15 courses of polychemotherapy with different protocols. After five years of treatment and seven years of follow-up, there was no evidence of recurrence. The report illustrates that combining surgical resection with multiple chemotherapy regimens can achieve long-term disease control in chemorefractory metastatic choriocarcinoma.

pmid-17139997.summary_ja: 閉経前の女性で、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の浸潤性扁平上皮癌と、同時性の浸潤性小葉癌が認められた。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化は稀で術前診断が困難であり、攻撃的な経過は外科的管理上の難しさを伴う。本症例のような二重悪性腫瘍は極めて稀であることを示す症例報告である。
pmid-17139997.summary_en: A premenopausal woman had invasive squamous cell carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, together with a synchronous invasive lobular breast carcinoma. The authors note that malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma is rare, that preoperative diagnosis is difficult, and that the aggressive behavior poses surgical management dilemmas. The report highlights the rarity of this dual malignancy.

pmid-17143159.summary_ja: 11歳の女児が、卵巣奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎による緊張病様状態を呈した。悪性カタトニーに対し電気けいれん療法が奏効した。傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎は記憶障害、混乱、人格変化、精神病症状を来しうる。本報告は、非中枢神経系の胚細胞腫瘍が神経精神症状として現れた小児例である。
pmid-17143159.summary_en: An 11-year-old girl presented with a catatonic state associated with paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis caused by an ovarian teratoma. Electroconvulsive therapy was successfully used to treat the malignant catatonia. Paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis can cause memory loss, confusion, personality change, and psychosis. The report describes a pediatric case in which a non-CNS germ cell tumor manifested as a neuropsychiatric syndrome.

pmid-17146747.summary_ja: 37歳女性の骨盤腹腔内の大きな嚢胞性腫瘤内に多数の球状構造が認められ、術前は包虫嚢胞の娘嚢胞が疑われた。切除標本の病理診断は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であり、球状構造は皮脂性嚢胞と角化物によるものであった。卵巣奇形腫は超音波所見でエキノコックス症と類似しうることを示す症例報告である。
pmid-17146747.summary_en: A 37-year-old woman had multiple spherical structures within a large pelvic-abdominal cystic mass on ultrasound, initially suspected to be echinococcal daughter cysts. Surgical excision showed the structures were spherules of a mature ovarian cystic teratoma, consisting of sebaceous cysts and desquamative keratin formations. The report emphasizes that ovarian teratoma can mimic echinococcosis on sonography. Teratoma is described as a germ cell tumor accounting for about 15-20% of ovarian cancers.

pmid-17147287.summary_ja: 当施設における縦隔原発胚細胞腫瘍の外科的治療成績を報告する。成熟奇形腫は切除が基本だが、巨大腫瘍や癒着例では肺全摘術を要することがある。10年生存率はセミノーマで91.7%、非セミノーマで53.0%であった。胸膜播種や転移を有する症例は予後不良で、中央生存期間は5か月と報告されている。
pmid-17147287.summary_en: The authors review surgical outcomes for primary mediastinal germ cell tumors at their institution. Mature teratoma is primarily treated by resection, which may require pneumonectomy for large tumors with severe adhesions. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy is central for seminoma and nonseminoma. The 10-year survival rates were 91.7% for seminoma and 53.0% for nonseminoma. Nonseminoma, and patients with pleural dissemination or metastasis, had worse prognosis, with a median survival of 5 months in the latter group.

pmid-17147288.summary_ja: 縦隔原発胚細胞腫瘍の現在の治療戦略を概説し、自施設の悪性例30例の成績を報告する。成熟奇形腫は切除のみで治癒しうる。シスプラチン併用化学療法導入後は18例中17例が生存し、導入前は12例中3例であった。非セミノーマ性腫瘍では化学療法後に外科的切除を行い、腫瘍マーカーの正常化を目指して大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞移植を行う。
pmid-17147288.summary_en: This review summarizes current management of mediastinal germ cell tumors. Mature teratoma can be cured by resection alone, while malignant forms are treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy combined with resection and radiation. The authors report 30 malignant cases: 17 of 18 patients treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy and surgery survived, compared with 3 of 12 before cisplatin was introduced. For nonseminomatous tumors, chemotherapy is followed by surgery, with high-dose chemotherapy and stem cell transplantation to normalize tumor markers.

pmid-17149967.summary_ja: 類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍は、絨毛型中間栄養膜細胞に由来する稀な妊娠性絨毛性疾患で、主に妊娠後の生殖年齢女性に発症します。組織学的には硬化性基質内に単調な類上皮様細胞が結節状に増殖し、扁平上皮癌との鑑別が問題になります。多くは切除後に良好な経過をたどりますが、転移の可能性もあり、臨床経過の予測は困難です。
pmid-17149967.summary_en: This review describes epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, a rare neoplasm derived from chorionic-type intermediate trophoblast that typically arises in women of reproductive age after a previous gestation. Its histology shows nodular monomorphic epithelioid cells in a hyaline matrix, with necrosis and variable mitoses. p63 and cytokeratin positivity, and inhibin-alpha expression, can mimic squamous cell carcinoma. Most cases behave benignly after resection, but metastatic disease is possible, making clinical behavior difficult to predict.

pmid-17158533.summary_ja: 本総説は臨床病期I精巣がんの管理法を比較したものです。監視療法と根治的治療はいずれも98～99%の治癒率を示します。後腹膜リンパ節郭清と監視療法は地域によって選好が異なります。セミノーマでは放射線療法やカルボプラチンが、非セミノーマではシスプラチン併用化学療法が再発リスクを低減します。有効性は同等とみられ、有害事象の違いが選択の鍵になります。
pmid-17158533.summary_en: This review compares management options for clinical stage I testicular cancer, where surveillance and definitive treatments achieve 98-99% cure rates. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and surveillance are favored in different regions, reflecting surgical expertise and access to follow-up. For stage I seminoma, radiotherapy or carboplatin reduces relapse risk, while cisplatin-based chemotherapy is used for nonseminoma. The authors conclude that all options appear equally effective, but adverse effect profiles differ.

pmid-17158535.summary_ja: 本論文は、初期治療後2年以上経過して生じる悪性胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発を検討しています。発生率はセミノーマで1.4%、非セミノーマで3.2%で、後腹膜が主な再発部位です。初回治療が再発リスクと部位に影響します。治療は再発前生検、根治的手術、救援化学療法が中心で、5年癌特異的生存率は50%超、単一部位の奇形腫では100%に達します。
pmid-17158535.summary_en: This review examines late relapses of malignant germ cell tumors, defined as recurrence two or more years after successful treatment. Pooled incidence is 1.4% in seminoma and 3.2% in nonseminoma patients, most often in the retroperitoneum. Initial treatment influences late relapse risk and location. Management centers on presalvage biopsy, radical surgery, and salvage chemotherapy. Five-year cancer-specific survival exceeds 50% and reaches 100% for single-site teratoma, supporting referral to high-volume centers.

pmid-17160775.summary_ja: 1971～2001年に治療された小児縦隔胚細胞腫瘍7例を後方視的に検討しました。成熟奇形腫の4例は完全切除で治癒しました。悪性3例は卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌、悪性奇形腫で、化学療法を併用し、2例が転移性疾患で死亡しました。白金製剤併用化学療法により悪性例の生存率は改善しています。
pmid-17160775.summary_en: This retrospective review of seven children treated for mediastinal germ cell tumors between 1971 and 2001 describes presentation, treatment, and outcomes. Four had mature teratoma and were cured by complete surgical excision. Three malignant tumors (yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, malignant teratoma) received biopsy or debulking with chemotherapy, and two died of metastatic disease. The authors conclude that platinum-based combination chemotherapy has improved survival in malignant cases.

pmid-17163843.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍71例で、バーシカンとデコリンの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討しました。デコリンは臨床病理学的因子と関連しませんでした。一方、バーシカンの蓄積はセミノーマと非セミノーマの両方で、脈管浸潤、リンパ節転移、病期と関連しました。さらに血管新生とも相関し、悪性度マーカーとしての可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-17163843.summary_en: This study examined versican and decorin in 71 testicular germ cell tumors. Decorin showed no relation to clinicopathological variables, but versican accumulation correlated with vascular and lymphatic invasion, nodal metastasis, and stage in both seminomas and nonseminomatous tumors. In nonseminomas, it also related to tumor size and distant metastasis. Versican also correlated with stromal microvessel density, suggesting it may serve as a marker of testicular malignancy.

pmid-17165435.summary_ja: 1997～2004年にカラカス大学病院で診療された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍25例を後方視的に検討しました。有病率は出産1,000件あたり0.70例でした。多くは胞状奇胎後で、約半数は病期Ib、単剤化学療法で治療され、21例が寛解しました。絨毛癌の性器出血は他の婦人科疾患と紛らわしいことがあり、早期診断と化学療法が良好な予後につながります。
pmid-17165435.summary_en: This medical record review of 25 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia cases at Hospital Universitario de Caracas from 1997 to 2004 found a prevalence of 0.70 per 1,000 deliveries. Most cases followed hydatidiform mole, and about half were stage Ib, treated mainly with single-agent chemotherapy. Twenty-one patients achieved remission. The authors note that vaginal bleeding in choriocarcinoma can mimic other gynecologic diseases, and that early diagnosis and chemotherapy yield a good prognosis.

pmid-17165436.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、絨毛癌など妊娠性絨毛性疾患54例で、HASH2(ASCL2)遺伝子の発現を検討しました。正常胎盤と悪性例では発現がみられ、完全胞状奇胎では発現がみられませんでした。悪性例では3'UTRに制限酵素耐性の大きな産物も検出されています。良性と悪性の差は遺伝子の不活化と再活性化によると考察されています。
pmid-17165436.summary_en: This study examined HASH2 (ASCL2) expression in 54 gestational trophoblastic disease samples, including complete moles, invasive moles, a placental site trophoblastic tumor, and choriocarcinomas. HASH2 was expressed in normal placenta and malignant forms but absent in all complete hydatidiform moles. Malignant samples also showed a larger 3'UTR product resistant to SacII digestion. The authors suggest HASH2 is inactivated in complete moles and reactivated in malignant disease.

pmid-17165437.summary_ja: 2症例の絨毛癌において、従来の画像検査では判断が困難だった病変を18F-FDG PET/CTで評価した報告。1例は子宮頸部腺扁平上皮癌と誤診されていた。hCG値が持続的に低値で、CTで転移が明らかでなかった症例でも、PET/CTで肺結節が検出された。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の転移検出に有用である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-17165437.summary_en: This report describes two women with gestational choriocarcinoma, one initially misdiagnosed as cervical adenosquamous carcinoma, in whom conventional imaging was inconclusive. In both cases, 18F-FDG PET/CT detected multiple pulmonary nodules. In the second patient, hCG remained persistently low two years after therapy and CT showed no evident metastasis. The authors suggest FDG PET/CT may reveal metastases missed by standard imaging used in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia protocols, particularly when hCG remains elevated.

pmid-17165440.summary_ja: 本研究は、hCGの糖鎖変異体であるhyperglycosylated hCG（hCG-H）と、妊娠初期の着床、妊娠性絨毛癌、精巣悪性腫瘍における浸潤との関係を検討している。通常のhCGと異なり、hCG-Hは生体内および生体外で浸潤と腫瘍形成を促進する。抗hCG-H抗体の投与により、これらの過程は完全に阻害された。著者らは、hCG-Hを着床と悪性腫瘍に共通する浸潤の調節因子として提唱しており、治療上の意義がある可能性を示唆している。
pmid-17165440.summary_en: This study examines hyperglycosylated hCG (hCG-H), a carbohydrate variant of hCG, and its role in invasion across early pregnancy implantation, gestational choriocarcinoma, and testicular malignancies. Unlike regular hCG, hCG-H promotes invasion and tumor formation both in vitro and in vivo. Antibody blockade of hCG-H completely inhibited these processes. The authors propose hCG-H as a cytokine-like modulator of invasion shared by implantation and these malignancies, suggesting potential therapeutic relevance.

pmid-17167184.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍17例、前駆病変、胎児性癌細胞株を用いたアレイCGHと遺伝子発現の統合解析。12p染色体の増加が最も頻繁で、NANOGなどが過剰発現していた。新規の癌遺伝子候補と癌抑制遺伝子候補を同定し、精巣発癌の全ゲノム的理解に寄与する。
pmid-17167184.summary_en: Array-CGH and expression profiling were performed on 17 testicular germ cell tumors, precursor lesions, and two embryonal carcinoma cell lines. Gain of 12p was the most common aberration, with CCND2, CD9, GDF3, NANOG, and TEAD4 overexpressed. Integrating copy number with expression identified candidate oncogenes (BRCC3, FOS, MLLT11, NES, RAC1) and putative suppressor genes (DDX26, ERCC5, FZD4, NME4, OPTN, RB1). The study provides a genome-wide integrated view of testicular tumorigenesis.

pmid-17168212.summary_ja: 当初良性と診断された卵巣甲状腺腫が10年後に遠隔転移として現れ、病理再検で浸潤性濾胞癌と判明した症例。機能性転移に対し複数回の放射性ヨウ素治療を要した。腫瘍崩壊による甲状腺中毒症や脳脊髄液鼻漏も経験された。専門的な多職種による管理の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-17168212.summary_en: A patient with struma ovarii initially diagnosed as benign presented ten years later with distant metastases, and pathological review revealed invasive well-differentiated follicular carcinoma. The course included delayed recurrence diagnosis, functioning metastases requiring multiple radioactive iodine treatments, tumour lysis-induced thyrotoxicosis, and cerebrospinal fluid rhinorrhea. The authors emphasize management by an expert multidisciplinary team and consideration of radioactive iodine for metastatic disease.

pmid-17168438.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の男性に、診断時に同時性の単発性恥骨転移を認めた症例報告。全身化学療法と局所放射線療法で制御された。文献上の類似3例を検討し、単発骨転移は化学療法と放射線療法に感受性がある可能性を指摘。有症状例では骨シンチや PET による病期分類を推奨している。
pmid-17168438.summary_en: A man with testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor presented with a symptomatic, synchronous solitary pubic bone metastasis, which is uncommon at diagnosis. Systemic chemotherapy and locoregional radiation therapy controlled the lesion. The authors review three similar prior cases and suggest that solitary bone metastases may be chemosensitive and radiosensitive. They recommend bone scintigraphy or PET during staging for symptomatic patients and a combined cytotoxic approach.

pmid-17168446.summary_ja: 生後3か月の男児が、巨大な縦隔奇形腫による上縦隔症候群を呈した症例報告。重篤な心肺障害があり緊急治療を要した。乳児期の縦隔奇形腫は生命を脅かしうる。小児腫瘍医、外科医、麻酔科医、集中治療医、放射線科医の密接な連携が治療に不可欠であると結論づけている。
pmid-17168446.summary_en: A three-month-old male infant presented with superior mediastinal syndrome caused by a large mediastinal teratoma, resulting in severe cardiorespiratory compromise that required emergency treatment. The report emphasizes that mediastinal teratomas in infancy can be life-threatening. Management requires close coordination among pediatric oncologists, surgeons, anesthesiologists, intensivists, and radiologists. The authors describe this rare case to illustrate the urgency of these tumors and the need for coordinated care.

pmid-17172084.summary_ja: 小児卵巣腫瘍53例(59腫瘍)を対象に、DePriestおよびUelandの超音波形態学的指標による良悪性の鑑別能を検討した。両指標は良性腫瘍の判別に高い感度と正確度を示した。腫瘍マーカーの上昇は17例にみられ、そのうち4例は内分泌症状を伴っていた。未熟奇形腫を含む症例を含め、24例で卵巣温存が可能であった。
pmid-17172084.summary_en: This study of 53 girls with 59 pediatric ovarian tumors evaluated whether ultrasonographic morphological indexes (DePriest's and Ueland's) could distinguish benign from malignant lesions. Both indexes performed well for identifying benign tumors. Tumor markers were elevated in 17 patients, and four had endocrine manifestations. Ovaries were preserved in 24 patients, including two with immature teratoma in dermoid cysts. The authors conclude that morphological ultrasound assessment, together with tumor markers and endocrine evaluation, is useful preoperatively.

pmid-17174830.summary_ja: 9歳未経初潮の女児が急性腹症で受診し、両側付属器捻転と診断された。緊急腹腔鏡手術で捻転を解除し、両側嚢腫切除により両側卵巣を温存した。病理学的に両側成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。若年女児での両側捻転は極めてまれであり、将来の妊孕性温存のため腹腔鏡手術が望ましいと報告している。
pmid-17174830.summary_en: A 9-year-old premenarchal girl presented with acute abdomen and was found to have bilateral adnexal torsion. Emergency laparoscopy allowed detorsion and bilateral cystectomy, preserving both ovaries. Pathology confirmed bilateral mature cystic teratoma. The report emphasizes that bilateral adnexal torsion is extremely rare in premenarchal girls, that clinicians should recognize its presentation for prompt diagnosis, and that laparoscopy is preferable in young patients to preserve fertility.

pmid-17175475.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の2例で、開腹および腹腔鏡下手術中に腫瘍の破綻が生じた。術後病理で扁平上皮癌への悪性転化が確認された。再手術の病期分類時に両例で腫瘍播種が認められ、術後の急速な進行が問題となった症例報告である。術中破綻と予後不良の関連から、腫瘍を破綻させずに摘出すべきと強調している。
pmid-17175475.summary_en: Two patients with mature cystic teratoma had intraoperative tumor spillage, one during laparotomy and one during laparoscopic cystectomy. Postoperative pathology revealed malignant transformation to squamous cell carcinoma. Both developed tumor dissemination at secondary staging surgery, performed 3 months and 8 days after the initial operation. The authors stress that mature cystic teratomas should be removed intact, since intraoperative rupture may be associated with rapid postoperative progression and poor prognosis.

pmid-17183856.summary_ja: 先天性奇形腫の2例に対し手術が行われた。腫瘍には肢芽、腸管、脳様組織、肺組織などの高度な臓器様分化がみられ、胎児内胎児との鑑別が困難であった。文献的検討を踏まえ、胎児内胎児は高度に分化した奇形腫であり、両者は別個の疾患単位ではない可能性があると論じている。
pmid-17183856.summary_en: Two cases of congenital teratoma were surgically treated. The tumors showed a high degree of organoid differentiation, containing rudimentary limbs, intestine, brain-like and pulmonary tissue, making them difficult to distinguish from fetus-in-fetu. Based on these findings and a literature review, the authors argue that fetus-in-fetu and teratoma may not be unrelated entities, and suggest that fetuses in fetu represent highly differentiated teratomas. The report is useful for understanding the pathogenesis and classification of congenital teratoma.

pmid-17187015.summary_ja: 1996年から2005年に卵巣類皮嚢腫を疑われて手術を受けた95例(17～49歳)を検討した。97.9%の嚢腫が腹腔鏡下に摘出され、嚢腫核出術が最も多く行われた。全例で病理学的に成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。腹腔鏡手術は安全で利点が多いが、術前の適切な適応判断が重要と結論している。
pmid-17187015.summary_en: This study reviewed 95 women aged 17-49 who underwent surgery for suspected ovarian dermoid cyst between 1996 and 2005. Most were treated laparoscopically, with 97.9% of cysts removed by this approach.
