pmid-12576247.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の86例を対象に、妊孕性温存手術と化学療法後の生殖機能を検討した症例集積です。妊娠を試みた38例中29例(76%)が妊娠に至りました。進行期例を含め、化学療法を併用した妊孕性温存治療は生殖機能の維持に有効と結論づけています。
pmid-12576247.summary_en: This case series of 86 women with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated with fertility-preserving surgery and chemotherapy assessed long-term reproductive outcomes by questionnaire, with median follow-up of 122 months. Of 38 women who attempted conception, 29 (76%) achieved at least one pregnancy. Most patients who conceived had FIGO stage I disease. The authors conclude that fertility-preserving surgery followed by chemotherapy, even in advanced stages, preserves reproductive function.

pmid-12576448.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍56例の腫瘍検体で、アポトーシス、細胞周期、薬剤排出に関わるタンパクの発現を免疫組織化学的に解析しました。野生型p53はアポトーシス指数と相関しましたが、群間で有意差は認められませんでした。成熟奇形腫ではp21やRBが強く発現しており、化学療法抵抗性との関連が示唆されています。
pmid-12576448.summary_en: This study examined protein markers of apoptosis, cell-cycle control, and drug resistance in 56 germ cell tumor samples from three clinically defined groups, including mature teratoma components. Wild-type p53 correlated with apoptotic index, and no marker differed significantly among groups. Mature teratomas showed high p21 and RB expression and were often positive for drug-export and detoxification proteins. The authors propose a multifactorial basis for cisplatin sensitivity in germ cell tumors and for the intrinsic chemoresistance of mature teratomas.

pmid-12576901.summary_ja: 73歳男性の原発性大腸絨毛癌の症例報告です。剖検でも隣接する腺癌は認められませんでした。これまでの報告例の多くは腺癌を伴っており、脱分化による発生が示唆されていました。本例は、大腸絨毛癌が既存腫瘍によらず発生しうることを支持し、既報例も文献的にレビューしています。
pmid-12576901.summary_en: The authors describe a 73-year-old man with primary choriocarcinoma of the colon, in whom no associated adenocarcinoma was found even on postmortem examination. Most previously reported cases were associated with adjacent adenocarcinoma, suggesting dedifferentiation as the origin. This case supports the hypothesis that primary colonic choriocarcinoma can arise without a preexisting tumor. The paper also reviews the six previously reported cases in the literature.

pmid-12580154.summary_ja: 2000分娩中に妊娠中の持続性付属器腫瘤14例が認められ、そのうち13例を手術的に治療した検討です。良性が多く成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が最多でしたが、未熟奇形腫を含む悪性3例がありました。超音波検査では良悪性の鑑別が困難でした。妊娠24週以降、特に緊急手術では予後が不良でした。
pmid-12580154.summary_en: This review of patients with persistent adnexal masses during pregnancy identified 14 cases among 2000 deliveries, 13 of which were treated surgically. Most masses were benign, with mature cystic teratoma the most common, but three were malignant, including one immature teratoma. Ultrasound could not distinguish malignant from benign masses. Surgery after 24 weeks' gestation, especially when performed as emergency surgery, was associated with preterm delivery and poorer outcomes.

pmid-12585035.summary_ja: 36歳女性の左卵巣肝様癌の症例報告です。画像検査で卵巣腫瘍を認め、外科的切除標本の病理組織学的検査で診断されました。腫瘍タッチ標本では多形性細胞と目立つ核小体を認めました。腫瘍細胞はAFPに陽性、hCGに陰性であり、細胞診が診断に有用と結論づけています。
pmid-12585035.summary_en: Describes a 36-year-old woman with a left ovarian hepatoid carcinoma, diagnosed by histopathology of surgically resected tissue after imaging showed a left ovarian mass. Tumor touch-preparation cytology showed pleomorphic cells with prominent nucleoli and multinucleation, with a sinusoidal pattern resembling hepatocellular carcinoma. Tumor cells were positive for AFP, CA-125 and CEA but negative for hCG. The authors conclude that cytopathology is valuable for diagnosing ovarian hepatoid carcinoma.

pmid-12592240.summary_ja: 1973～1997年のニューメキシコ州の腫瘍登録と人口動態データを用い、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発生率の民族差を解析しました。アメリカ先住民女性では年齢調整発生率が有意に高く、侵入奇胎や絨毛癌のリスクも上昇していました。25年間でリスクは56%増加しました。年齢調整標準化の手法は他の登録システムにも応用可能と考察されています。
pmid-12592240.summary_en: Population-based analysis of gestational trophoblastic disease in New Mexico from 1973 to 1997, using tumor registry and vital statistics data. American Indian women had markedly higher age-adjusted incidence (11.16%) than non-Hispanic or Hispanic white women, with elevated risk for partial mole, invasive mole, and choriocarcinoma. The relative risk rose 56% over 25 years. The authors suggest the age-adjusted standardization approach may be applicable to other registries.

pmid-12596115.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫に対する胎内高周波焼灼術後に生じた合併症の症例報告です。出生時に後側方股関節が開放性に脱臼し、坐骨神経機能が失われ、寛骨臼と大腿骨頭に奇形を認めました。16か月時点で左下肢は弛緩性麻痺を呈し、股関節は低形成でした。胎内治療の整形外科的・神経学的リスクを示し、慎重な適応選択と説明の重要性を指摘しています。
pmid-12596115.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn who sustained an open posterior hip dislocation, sciatic nerve injury, and acetabular and femoral head malformation after intrauterine radiofrequency ablation of a sacrococcygeal teratoma. The soft tissue defect exposed the disarticulated hip joint at birth, and the complication caused lasting flaccid paralysis of the left lower limb. At 16 months, the infant had a hypoplastic hip and persistent neurological deficit. The authors highlight orthopaedic and neurological risks of intrauterine ablation for this tumor, underscoring the need for careful patient selection and counseling before fetal intervention.

pmid-12597349.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対する化学療法の現状をまとめたレビューです。良性の胞状奇胎から悪性の絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍までを扱います。多くは吸引掻爬とhCGのフォローアップで治癒しますが、一部は化学療法を要します。転移例でも大半は治癒すると述べ、予後因子に基づく層別化治療の重要性を強調しています。
pmid-12597349.summary_en: This review summarizes current standards for chemotherapy in gestational trophoblastic disease, which spans benign hydatidiform moles to malignant choriocarcinoma and placental site trophoblastic tumors. Most patients are cured by suction curettage with hCG follow-up, but some require chemotherapy. The authors note that most patients achieve cure even with metastatic disease. They emphasize stratifying treatment by prognostic factors to eliminate disease while minimizing long-term treatment-related complications. The article provides a concise overview for clinicians managing these rare trophoblastic disorders.

pmid-12597960.summary_ja: 抗がん剤治療前に無精子症の患者から精巣精子採取を行う有用性を検討した研究です。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の14例と悪性リンパ腫の17例で対側精巣生検を実施しました。精子は胚細胞腫瘍の6例で得られ、創傷治癒の問題や治療遅延はありませんでした。無精子症のがん患者における妊孕性温存の選択肢として推奨されています。
pmid-12597960.summary_en: This study evaluated pretreatment testicular sperm extraction in azoospermic patients before cytotoxic therapy. Contralateral testicular biopsies were taken from 14 patients with testicular germ cell tumors and 17 with lymphoma. Sperm were recovered in 6 of the germ cell tumor patients and 8 of the lymphoma patients. Histology showed Sertoli cell-only syndrome or maturation arrest in the rest. No wound healing complications or treatment delays occurred. The authors conclude that cryopreserving testicular tissue is a feasible option for fertility preservation in azoospermic cancer patients.

pmid-12598855.summary_ja: 成人胚細胞腫瘍に対する大量化学療法の役割をレビューした論文です。進行例の約80%はシスプラチン併用化学療法で治癒しますが、予後不良例は約50%、初回再発例は約25%です。救援療法では第III相試験で生存上の利益が示されていません。一次治療として3件の無作為化試験が進行中で、成熟したデータが必要とされています。
pmid-12598855.summary_en: This review examines high-dose chemotherapy (HDC) in adults with germ cell tumors. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy cures about 80% of advanced cases, but poor-prognosis patients achieve only 50% cure and those with first relapse have roughly 25% long-term survival. Phase II studies suggested benefit in recurrent disease, but a phase III trial showed no survival advantage for HDC in salvage therapy. Three randomized trials are testing HDC as first-line treatment. The authors conclude that mature randomized data are needed to define its role.

pmid-12598912.summary_ja: 精巣の管内性胚細胞腫瘍（上皮内癌）の同定にRBMとPLAPの二重免疫染色を用いた検討です。RBMは分化した男性胚細胞で発現し、腫瘍性胚細胞では消失します。PLAPは未分化な胚細胞を標識します。両マーカーの併用により、浸潤前病変の診断精度が向上すると報告しています。
pmid-12598912.summary_en: This study evaluates double immunolabeling with RBM and PLAP to identify intratubular germ cell neoplasia (carcinoma in situ) of the testis. RBM, a Y-chromosome-encoded protein, is expressed in differentiated male germ cells but absent in neoplastic cells. PLAP marks undifferentiated germ cells. Combining both markers improves diagnostic accuracy for this preinvasive testicular lesion, which is diagnostically challenging. The approach aids pathologists in distinguishing neoplastic germ cells from normal differentiated spermatogenic cells.

pmid-12598996.summary_ja: 病理学的に卵巣未熟奇形腫と確定した10例のMR所見を後方視的に検討しました。全例で脂肪成分を含む多嚢胞性の充実性成分を認め、組織学的にも脂肪組織が確認されました。腹水は6例、腹膜播種は3例で認めました。充実成分の量と組織学的悪性度との相関は有意ではありませんでした。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫との鑑別に有用である可能性があります。
pmid-12598996.summary_en: This retrospective study reviews MR imaging of ten patients aged 12 to 29 with pathologically proven ovarian immature teratoma. All lesions contained fat and multicystic solid components, with punctate fat foci confirmed histologically. Ascites appeared in six and peritoneal dissemination in three. Fluid content resembled simple fluid in most, unlike the sebaceous fluid typical of mature cystic teratomas. The amount of solid tissue did not correlate with histologic grade. MR features may help distinguish immature from mature ovarian teratomas.

pmid-12605640.summary_ja: 精巣に生じる希少な精母細胞性セミノーマ25例で免疫染色を行った。Chk2、MAGE-A4、神経特異的エノラーゼは一貫して陽性で、p19INK4dは陰性、p53は80%で陽性だった。発現パターンは、成人精巣の減数分裂前の精原細胞に由来するという起源を支持する。
pmid-12605640.summary_en: This study examined immunohistochemical expression of Chk2, p53, p19INK4d, MAGE-A4, KIT, TRA-1-60, neurone-specific enolase, and placental-like alkaline phosphatase in 25 spermatocytic seminomas. Chk2, MAGE-A4, and neurone-specific enolase were consistently expressed, while the embryonic antigen TRA-1-60 and p19INK4d were absent. p53 was positive in 80% of cases. The profile supports origin from a premeiotic spermatogonium of the adult testis that has not yet passed the meiotic checkpoint.

pmid-12607247.summary_ja: 様々な悪性腫瘍の肺転移患者97例で切除後の転帰を解析した。生存は腫瘍の種類で有意に異なった。胚細胞腫瘍の患者は、肺外転移や呼吸器症状、無病期間に関わらず生存が良好だった。転移切除の適応は腫瘍の種類に応じて決めるべきとされた。
pmid-12607247.summary_en: The authors analyzed outcomes after pulmonary metastasectomy in 97 patients with various malignancies. Survival differed significantly by tumor type. Carcinoma patients did well with disease-free intervals of at least three years and no extrapulmonary disease. Sarcoma patients fared better with a solitary lesion. Germ cell tumor patients had superior survival, regardless of extrapulmonary metastases, respiratory symptoms, or disease-free interval length, suggesting that surgical indications should be tailored to tumor type.

pmid-12610174.summary_ja: ドイツのMAKEI 83/86およびMAKEI 89試験で治療された小児の仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍71例を前向きに解析した。5年無再発生存率は0.76だった。強力な白金製剤ベース療法では、病期、転移の範囲、骨浸潤、AFP値はいずれも予後的意義を持たなかった。
pmid-12610174.summary_en: This prospective analysis of 71 children with malignant sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors, treated in the German MAKEI 83/86 and MAKEI 89 protocols, evaluated metastases, bone extension, and AFP elevation as prognostic factors. The 5-year relapse-free survival was 0.76. Neither stage, metastatic extent, bone extension, nor AFP level had prognostic significance under an intensive, short-interval, platinum-based regimen.

pmid-12610187.summary_ja: 1989〜2000年に3施設で、予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)54例にCBOP/BEP強化導入化学療法を施行した。3年および5年の無再発生存率は83.2%、5年全生存期間(全生存率)は87.6%であった。縦隔原発例の3年全生存期間(全生存率)は77.1%で、精巣原発例の95.4%より低かったが有意差はなかった。既存の代替レジメンより良好で、第III相試験による検証が提案された。
pmid-12610187.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 54 men with poor-prognosis nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated at three centers with the CBOP/BEP intensive induction regimen between 1989 and 2000. Three- and five-year relapse-free survival was 83.2% overall, and five-year overall survival was 87.6%. Three-year overall survival was 77.1% for mediastinal primaries versus 95.4% for testicular primaries, a difference that was not statistically significant. The authors conclude these results compare favorably with historical regimens and recommend a phase III trial.

pmid-12611097.summary_ja: 51歳女性が腹水と嚢胞性骨盤内腫瘤、著明なCA-125高値を呈し、当初は卵巣癌が疑われた。術中迅速凍結切片で多嚢胞性の卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。嚢胞性卵巣甲状腺腫が腹水やCA-125高値を伴うことは極めて稀で、臨床的に卵巣癌と類似しうる。嚢胞性付属器腫瘤の鑑別診断として卵巣甲状腺腫を考慮すべきと示す。
pmid-12611097.summary_en: A 51-year-old woman presented with ascites, a cystic pelvic mass, and markedly elevated CA-125, initially suspected to be ovarian carcinoma. Frozen section identified a multicystic struma ovarii, a monodermal teratoma. The authors note that a cystic struma ovarii with ascites and high CA-125 is exceptionally rare and can mimic ovarian carcinoma clinically. The case highlights the importance of considering struma ovarii in the differential diagnosis of cystic adnexal masses.

pmid-12617452.summary_ja: 生後7か月の乳児が、会陰部の正中の腫瘤に加え、鎖肛、陰嚢部尿道下裂と転位を呈した。腫瘤は正中仙骨動脈から栄養され、後方矢状切開による直腸肛門形成術と同時に切除された。組織学的に分化良好な大腸組織を認め、直腸肛門奇形を伴う分化良好な仙尾部奇形腫と確定診断された。二つの先天異常の合併例である。
pmid-12617452.summary_en: A 7-month-old infant presented with imperforate anus, penoscrotal hypospadias with transposition, and a midline perineal mass. The mass was supplied by the median sacral artery and was excised during posterior sagittal anorectoplasty. Histology showed well-differentiated colonic tissue, leading to a final diagnosis of well-differentiated sacrococcygeal teratoma associated with anorectal malformation. The case illustrates the coexistence of these two congenital anomalies.

pmid-12620907.summary_ja: 精巣原発の播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍369例の20年間の経過を解析し、9例で化学療法後の残存または再発腫瘤に非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍を認めた。内訳は肉腫と腺癌が中心で、原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍も1例あった。完全な外科的切除は56%で達成され、9例中3例が原病死した。完全切除のみが根治的治療の選択肢であると結論づけられている。
pmid-12620907.summary_en: Among 369 patients with disseminated nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy over 20 years, nine developed a non-germ cell malignancy in residual or recurrent masses. Sarcoma and adenocarcinoma were most common, with one primitive neuroectodermal tumor. Complete surgical resection was achieved in 56% of cases. Median follow-up was 48 months, and three of nine patients died of disease. Complete resection is the only curative option.

pmid-12620992.summary_ja: 本マウス研究では、原始胚細胞において腫瘍抑制遺伝子PTENを条件付きで欠失させたところ、両側性の精巣奇形腫が生じた。病変は、有糸分裂停止の障害と未熟細胞の増殖から生じた。培養下のPTEN欠失胚細胞は増殖が亢進し、胚性胚細胞のコロニーを多く形成した。著者らは、PTENが胚細胞の分化に必須であり、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の形成に寄与すると結論づけている。PI3K経路のシグナル伝達と胚細胞腫瘍の発生を結びつける遺伝子モデルを提示している。
pmid-12620992.summary_en: In this mouse study, conditional deletion of the tumor suppressor PTEN in primordial germ cells caused bilateral testicular teratomas. The lesions arose from impaired mitotic arrest and expansion of immature cells. PTEN-null germ cells in culture showed higher proliferation and formed more embryonic germ cell colonies. The authors conclude that PTEN is essential for germ cell differentiation and contributes to testicular germ cell tumor formation, providing a genetic model that links PI3K pathway signaling to germ cell tumorigenesis.

pmid-12624554.summary_ja: 40歳女性の症例報告である。当初はAFPがわずかに上昇した病期Ia期の純粋ディスジャーミノーマと診断された。44か月後の骨盤内再発でAFPが著明に上昇し、生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍を認めた。初発腫瘍の再検討により混合型胚細胞腫瘍と確定した。化学療法7コースで22か月間の無病生存を得ている。AFPの軽度上昇でも混合型の可能性を考慮すべきと強調している。
pmid-12624554.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old woman initially diagnosed with stage Ia pure dysgerminoma with a slightly elevated AFP of 11 ng/ml. Forty-four months later, a pelvic recurrence showed markedly elevated AFP of 1,520 ng/ml, and needle biopsy revealed yolk sac tumor. Re-review of the original tumor led to a diagnosis of mixed germ cell tumor containing yolk sac elements. Seven courses of chemotherapy achieved 22 months of disease-free survival. The authors emphasize considering mixed germ cell tumor even when AFP is only modestly elevated.

pmid-12629333.summary_ja: 本総説は、胚細胞腫瘍に対する自家造血幹細胞支持を伴う大量化学療法を検討したものである。進行例の多くは標準化学療法で治癒可能である。再発患者では、大量カルボプラチンとエトポシドにシクロホスファミドまたはイホスファミドを加えたレジメンにより、新しい研究で40%から50%の持続的寛解が得られている。不良な反応と関連する予後因子も検討されている。著者らは、予後不良な初回治療における幹細胞支持の役割はいまだ証明されておらず、ランダム化試験の結果を待つ必要があると述べている。
pmid-12629333.summary_en: This review examines high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell support for germ cell cancer. Most advanced cases are curable with standard chemotherapy. In relapsed patients, regimens combining high-dose carboplatin and etoposide with cyclophosphamide or ifosfamide have produced durable remissions in 40 to 50 percent of patients in newer series. Prognostic factors for poor response are discussed. The authors note that the role of stem cell support in poor-risk initial therapy remains unproven and awaits randomized trials.

pmid-12629359.summary_ja: 本施設研究は、21年間に精巣がんで後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた417例のうち、反復後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた21例の男性を検討している。生存腫瘍は24%、奇形腫は67%、線維化または壊死のみは24%に認められた。合併症には遷延性イレウスや乳び腹水が含まれ、6例が死亡した。平均4.7年の追跡で71%が生存、67%が無病であった。著者らは、再発または遺残性の後腹膜腫瘤に対して反復手術は安全かつ有効であるが、血管合併症のリスクに対して慎重な計画が必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-12629359.summary_en: This institutional series reviews 21 men who underwent repeat retroperitoneal lymph node dissection among 417 patients who had RPLND for testis cancer over 21 years. Viable germ cell tumor was found in 24 percent, teratoma in 67 percent, and fibrosis or necrosis only in 24 percent. Complications included prolonged ileus and chylous ascites, and six patients died. At mean follow-up of 4.7 years, 71 percent were alive and 67 percent disease-free. The authors conclude that repeat dissection is safe and effective for recurrent or residual retroperitoneal masses, although vascular risks require careful planning.

pmid-12629412.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の細胞株4種と原発腫瘍20例を用い、X染色体数とXIST発現を検討した。XISTはセミノーマで多く、非セミノーマではまれであった。ただし両型ともX染色体の増加を認めた。複数のX染色体は多くが低メチル化で活性状態にあり、XISTの有無に関わらなかった。X連鎖がん遺伝子ARAF1とELK1の発現亢進も見られ、過剰な活性X染色体が発がんに寄与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-12629412.summary_en: This study examined X chromosome number and XIST expression in four testicular germ cell tumor cell lines and 20 primary tumors. XIST was common in seminomatous tumors but rare in nonseminomatous tumors, yet X chromosomal gain occurred in both types. Multiple X chromosomes were largely hypomethylated and transcriptionally active regardless of XIST status. Cell lines showed enhanced expression of X-linked oncogenes ARAF1 and ELK1, suggesting that excess active X chromosomes may contribute to testicular germ cell tumor oncogenesis.

pmid-12630648.summary_ja: 26歳女性の症例報告で、ネフローゼ域の蛋白尿、下腿浮腫、膣出血を呈した。子宮内容物の組織検査で絨毛癌と診断され、腎生検では膜性糸球体腎炎が認められた。子宮摘出後にネフローゼ症候群が寛解したため、腎病変は絨毛癌に続発したものと考えられている。絨毛癌が膜性糸球体腎炎を起こした初の報告としている。
pmid-12630648.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old woman with nephrotic-range proteinuria, pretibial edema, and vaginal bleeding. Uterine curettage established choriocarcinoma, and renal biopsy showed membranous glomerulonephritis. Because the nephrotic syndrome regressed after hysterectomy, the authors attribute the renal lesion to the choriocarcinoma. They present this as the first reported case of choriocarcinoma causing membranous glomerulonephritis, underscoring that renal disease may be secondary to an underlying malignancy.

pmid-12631514.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、CTおよび従来のMRで非特異的な嚢胞性腫瘤として描出された仙骨前部の類皮嚢腫を扱う。化学シフトMRでは少量の脂肪、拡散強調MRではケラチン様物質の豊富さが示唆され、術前診断に至った。外科的切除により診断が確認された。石灰化や脂肪に乏しい類皮嚢腫の診断において、化学シフトMRおよび拡散強調MRが有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-12631514.summary_en: This case report describes a presacral dermoid cyst that appeared as a nonspecific cystic mass on CT and conventional MRI, with little calcification or fat. Chemical shift imaging suggested a small amount of fat, and diffusion-weighted imaging suggested abundant keratinoid material, enabling a preoperative diagnosis. The tumor was surgically resected and the diagnosis was confirmed. The authors conclude that chemical shift and diffusion-weighted MRI are useful for diagnosing dermoid cysts that lack calcification and fat.

pmid-12632341.summary_ja: POG 9049/COG 8882共同試験に登録された、腹部または後腹膜原発の小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍25例を解析した研究である。標準用量または高用量のシスプラチン併用化学療法を受け、その後に遅延切除が行われた。6年無イベント生存率は82.8%、生存率は87.6%で、用量群間に有意差はなかった。多くが進行期であったにもかかわらず予後は良好であった。診断時の積極的切除ではなく、化学療法後の完全切除が推奨されている。
pmid-12632341.summary_en: This intergroup randomized study (POG 9049/COG 8882) evaluated 25 children with malignant germ cell tumors arising in the abdomen or retroperitoneum. Patients received standard-dose or high-dose cisplatin-based chemotherapy with etoposide and bleomycin, followed by delayed resection. Six-year event-free survival was 82.8% and overall survival 87.6%, with no significant difference between dose groups. Most patients had advanced stage yet a good prognosis. The authors recommend complete surgical removal after chemotherapy rather than aggressive resection at diagnosis.

pmid-12632342.summary_ja: CCG 8881/POG 9048共同研究に登録された小児の病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍63例を検討した。精巣摘除術を基本とし、手術ガイドラインの遵守状況と転帰を関連づけた。全ガイドライン遵守は69%にとどまった。6年無イベント生存率は78.5%、全生存率は100%であった。経陰嚢的損傷のあった4例では再発が有意に多かった。再発例はすべて追加の手術と化学療法で救済されている。
pmid-12632342.summary_en: This intergroup study (CCG 8881/POG 9048) examined 63 children with stage I testicular germ cell tumors treated primarily with orchiectomy, correlating outcomes with adherence to surgical guidelines. Only 69% of patients followed all guidelines. Six-year event-free survival was 78.5% and overall survival 100%. Surgical violations were not associated with worse EFS overall, but four patients with transscrotal violations had significantly higher recurrence. All relapses were salvaged with further surgery and chemotherapy, supporting orchiectomy-alone management in stage I disease.

pmid-12632365.summary_ja: 気道閉塞を来す巨大胎児頸部奇形腫の出生前管理を、7例の後方視的検討で報告した。水腫を伴う4例のうち2例は子宮内死亡、1例は選択的中絶となった。生存可能時期前の水腫例では胎児手術による切除が行われた。水腫のない3例はEXIT手技で気道確保を行い、手術群に死亡はなかった。水腫と気道の状態に応じた管理の選択が重要とされている。
pmid-12632365.summary_en: This retrospective review of seven cases describes prenatal management of giant fetal cervical teratoma causing airway obstruction. Four fetuses had hydrops; two died in utero and one was terminated. One previable hydropic fetus underwent fetal resection. Three nonhydropic fetuses underwent ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) for airway control via intubation, tracheostomy, or tumor resection on placental support. No deaths occurred in the surgical group. The authors conclude that management is chosen according to hydrops and airway status.

pmid-12632864.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理を総説したもので、治癒率は90～95%に近づいている。病期Iのセミノーマは精巣摘除術と補助的放射線療法が一般的である。病期Iの非セミノーマ性腫瘍では、精巣摘除術の後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清または積極的監視が選択される。転移性疾患ではシスプラチン併用化学療法が治療を一変させた。治癒可能な患者には、根治的治療の後に構造化されたフォローアップを行うことが重要とされる。
pmid-12632864.summary_en: This review summarizes management of testicular germ cell tumors, where cure rates approach 90-95%. Stage I seminoma is typically treated with orchiectomy and adjuvant radiotherapy. Stage I nonseminomatous tumors are managed with orchiectomy followed by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection or active surveillance. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy transformed treatment of metastatic disease, and risk stratification guides therapy. The authors emphasize delivering curative therapy and then structured follow-up to detect and manage complications promptly.

pmid-12634315.summary_ja: 性腺形成異常または真性半陰陽のため性腺摘出術を受けた間性患者46例を検討し、胚細胞の腫瘍化能を調べた。腫瘍性病変は部分性および混合性の性腺形成異常で多く、性染色体異常よりも性腺器官形成障害の重症度と関連していた。胚細胞腫瘍のスペクトラムは従来より広く、精細管内上皮内癌や性腺芽腫の巣なども含まれる。異形成性の精巣環境が胚細胞腫瘍の発生に重要な役割を果たすと考察されている。
pmid-12634315.summary_en: This study of 46 intersex patients who underwent gonadectomy for gonadal dysgenesis or true hermaphroditism examines the neoplastic potential of germ cells. Neoplastic lesions occurred most often in partial and mixed dysgenesis and related more to the severity of gonadal organogenesis disturbance than to sex chromosome aberrations. The spectrum includes germ cell carcinoma, intratubular carcinoma in situ, gonadoblastoma nests, and mixed germ cell-sex cord-stromal tumors. The authors propose that the dysgenetic testicular environment plays a key role in germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-12634968.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍46例で、CTと腫瘍マーカーが正常な症例に全身FDG-PETを施行した研究です。22%が再発し、PETの感度は70%、特異度は100%でした。小さな後腹膜転移の検出感度は88%で、陰性的中率は従来の病期分類(78%)を上回る92%でした。ただし差は統計的に境界域でした。
pmid-12634968.summary_en: This study evaluated whole-body FDG-PET in 46 patients with clinical stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumours whose standard staging with CT and tumour markers was normal. Ten patients (22%) relapsed, seven of whom had true-positive initial PET scans. PET showed 70% sensitivity, 100% specificity and 93% accuracy, with 88% sensitivity for small retroperitoneal metastases. Its negative predictive value (92%) exceeded that of standard staging (78%), suggesting PET may improve management, although the difference was borderline (P=0.06).

pmid-12635979.summary_ja: 新生児期に症状が始まった固形腫瘍123例を後方視的に検討した研究です。奇形腫が両群で最多でした。生後28日以内に診断された群は全生存期間(全生存率24.9%対51.6%)と無イベント生存率が有意に低く、予後不良でした。生後28日以降の診断には奇形腫以外の胚細胞腫瘍も含まれました。
pmid-12635979.summary_en: This retrospective study of 123 patients with solid tumours whose symptoms began in the first 28 days of life compared those diagnosed within 28 days with those diagnosed later. Teratoma was the most common neonatal tumour in both groups. Infants diagnosed within 28 days had markedly worse outcomes, with overall survival of 24.9% versus 51.6% and event-free survival of 14.7% versus 47.7%. Germ cell tumours other than teratoma also appeared among the diagnoses after day 28. The authors conclude that prognosis is worse when tumours are diagnosed in the first month of life.

pmid-12637477.summary_ja: 病期IIA/Bの精巣セミノーマに対し、縮小照射野による放射線療法の有用性を検討した前向き多施設試験です。87例の追跡(中央値70か月)で再発は4例のみで、いずれも救済化学療法で治療されました。6年無再発生存率は病期IIAで95.3%、IIBで88.9%でした。急性毒性は低く、晩期毒性は見られませんでした。
pmid-12637477.summary_en: This prospective multicentre German trial assessed reduced-portal radiotherapy for stage IIA and IIB testicular seminoma, delivering 30 Gy for IIA and 36 Gy for IIB to para-aortic and iliac nodes. Among 87 assessable patients with median follow-up of 70 months, there were only four relapses, all mediastinal or field-edge, and these were salvaged with platinum-based chemotherapy. Six-year relapse-free survival was 95.3% for IIA and 88.9% for IIB. Acute toxicity was low and no late toxicity was observed, supporting radiotherapy as first-line treatment.

pmid-12637478.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がん666例を対象に、BEP化学療法の4つのスケジュールが生活の質(QOL)に与える影響を前向きに検討した研究です。2年後に36%でQOLが改善し、13%が悪化しました。3日間レジメンでは急性消化管毒性と耳鳴りのリスクが高く、4サイクル実施時に顕著でした。4サイクル実施時は5日間レジメンが推奨されています。
pmid-12637478.summary_en: This prospective EORTC/MRC study examined global quality of life in 666 patients with metastatic testicular cancer treated with four BEP schedules that differed in cycle number and duration. At two years, 36% had improved quality of life relative to baseline and 13% had deteriorated. The 3-day regimen caused more acute gastrointestinal toxicity and a higher two-year risk of tinnitus, particularly with four cycles. Long-term neuropathy and Raynaud-like phenomena were unaffected by schedule. The authors recommend the 5-day regimen when four cycles are planned.

pmid-12644817.summary_ja: 精巣上皮内腫瘍(TIN)に対する放射線療法の線量減量試験の予備報告です。18Gy(14例)と16Gy(26例)を比較しました。16Gy群では2年後に微小浸潤セミノーマを伴うTIN再発が1例あり、精原細胞が残存した症例は16Gy群と18Gy群で各1例でした。16Gyは安全性に問題がありうるため使用すべきではないと結論づけています。
pmid-12644817.summary_en: This preliminary report from the German Testicular Cancer Study Group tested reduced-dose radiotherapy for testicular intraepithelial neoplasia (TIN), comparing 18 Gy in 14 patients with 16 Gy in 26 patients. Biopsies at 6 and 24 months assessed clearance. One patient treated with 16 Gy had TIN relapse with microinvasive seminoma at two years, and two patients showed persistent spermatogonia, one at each dose. The authors conclude that TIN is radiosensitive but 16 Gy is probably unsafe and should no longer be used, and they call for study of fractionation schedules.

pmid-12644825.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍56例で、多剤耐性関連タンパク質(Pgp、MRP1、BCRP、LRP)の発現と予後の関係を検討した研究です。LRP陽性例では無増悪生存期間と全生存期間が短く、他の因子で調整後も有意でした。LRP発現はβ-hCG高値や病期IVと関連しました。他の3種類は化学療法への反応や生存と関連しませんでした。
pmid-12644825.summary_en: This study examined expression of four multidrug-resistance proteins (Pgp, MRP1, BCRP, LRP) in 56 patients with metastatic testicular germ cell tumours treated with platinum-based chemotherapy after orchiectomy. Only LRP predicted outcome: patients with LRP-positive tumours had shorter progression-free and overall survival, and this remained significant after adjustment for associated variables. LRP expression correlated with high beta-hCG and stage IV disease. Pgp, MRP1 and BCRP did not correlate with response to chemotherapy or survival.

pmid-12649670.summary_ja: 本研究は、良性絨毛外栄養膜および妊娠性絨毛性病変におけるサイクリンEとKi-67の発現を免疫組織化学染色で検討したものである。良性病変や胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍では、サイクリンE陽性細胞の割合がKi-67より高く、比率は1を超えた。一方、絨毛癌では逆のパターンを示し、比率は1未満であった。この比率は良性と悪性の鑑別に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-12649670.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined cyclin E and Ki-67 expression in benign extravillous trophoblast and gestational trophoblastic lesions, including hydatidiform moles, exaggerated placental sites, placental site nodules, one placental site trophoblastic tumor, and eight choriocarcinomas. Cyclin E was expressed in a higher proportion of cells than Ki-67 in benign lesions and PSTT, giving a cyclin E/Ki-67 ratio above 1. Choriocarcinomas showed the opposite pattern, with ratios below 1. The authors propose this ratio may help distinguish malignant from benign trophoblastic lesions.

pmid-12649920.summary_ja: 17歳女性が前胸部痛で受診し、左肺中葉の腫瘤と胸水、血清CA19-9高値(58.5 U/ml)を認めた。腫瘍と隣接する肺を外科的切除したところ、膵組織や肝細胞、気管支上皮などを含む成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が肺内へ穿破していた。胸水のアミラーゼとCA19-9も高値であった。穿破の機序について考察している。
pmid-12649920.summary_en: A 17-year-old woman presented with sudden anterior chest pain. Imaging showed a left middle lung mass with pleural effusion and markedly elevated serum CA 19-9 (58.5 U/ml). Total resection with adjacent lung was performed. Histology revealed a mature cystic teratoma containing pancreatic tissue, hepatic cells, bronchial epithelium and serous glands, which had perforated into the lung. Fluid amylase and CA 19-9 were elevated. The authors discuss the mechanism of perforation.

pmid-12651203.summary_ja: 一次治療の大量化学療法と自家造血幹細胞支持療法後に再発した予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍58例を解析した。救済療法はシスプラチン併用化学療法、非シスプラチン化学療法、救済大量化学療法、外科的切除、放射線療法などで、38%が良好な反応を示した。救済大量化学療法、残存腫瘤の完全切除、良好な反応が生存率向上と関連した。推定2年全生存率は32%であった。
pmid-12651203.summary_en: This German analysis examined 58 patients with poor-prognosis germ cell cancer who relapsed after first-line high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell support. Salvage approaches included cisplatin-based conventional chemotherapy, non-cisplatin regimens, salvage high-dose chemotherapy, and surgery or radiation. Thirty-eight percent responded favorably. Salvage high-dose chemotherapy, complete resection of residual masses, and a favorable response were associated with improved survival. The estimated 2-year overall survival was 32%.

pmid-12653585.summary_ja: 23歳男性の精巣成熟奇形腫と後腹膜転移の症例である。転移巣は成熟奇形腫と高悪性度血管肉腫が混在し、胎児性癌と誤診されやすかった。胚細胞腫瘍内の肉腫成分は、奇形腫成分の悪性転化または放射線療法後に生じうる。攻撃的な経過と治療反応の違いから、その認識が重要であると述べている。
pmid-12653585.summary_en: A 23-year-old man had a mature testicular teratoma with a retroperitoneal metastasis. The metastasis contained mature teratoma intermingled with high-grade angiosarcoma, which had been mistaken for embryonal carcinoma. The authors describe this rare sarcomatous component within a germ cell tumor, which can arise from malignant transformation of teratomatous elements or after radiation therapy. Recognizing it matters because of its aggressive behavior and different therapy response.

pmid-12656895.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法後に残存胸部腫瘤の開胸術を受けた105例を解析した研究です。胸部と後腹膜所見の不一致は多く、残存奇形腫や残存がんは無病生存期間不良の独立因子でした。開胸術は予後情報をもたらし、多くの奇形腫患者で治療的意義があると結論づけています。
pmid-12656895.summary_en: This study of 105 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumours who underwent 130 postchemotherapy thoracotomies examines whether resecting residual thoracic masses is worthwhile. Discordance between thoracic and retroperitoneal findings was common, and residual teratoma or cancer predicted poorer disease-free survival. The authors conclude that thoracotomy provides important prognostic information and is therapeutic for most patients with teratoma, although current fibrosis criteria are not accurate enough to omit resection of residual thoracic masses.

pmid-12657130.summary_ja: 南アフリカの一施設で治療された妊娠性絨毛性疾患112例の後方視的監査です。胞状奇胎78例、絨毛癌34例で、胞状奇胎は掻把術、絨毛癌は化学療法が主に行われました。全体の治癒率は89%で、死亡例は主に診断の遅れと進行した転移性疾患によるものでした。
pmid-12657130.summary_en: This retrospective audit reviews 112 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease treated at a single South African hospital, comprising 78 hydatidiform moles and 34 choriocarcinomas. Vaginal bleeding was the commonest presentation, molar pregnancies were usually managed by suction curettage, and choriocarcinoma was treated mainly with chemotherapy. Complete cure was achieved in 89% of patients, while twelve died, mainly from late presentation and advanced metastatic disease. Age, parity, uterine size, and initial beta-hCG did not predict persistent disease, and the reported incidence was lower than in Japan.

pmid-12657943.summary_ja: 24歳男性の前立腺に原発性卵黄嚢(内胚葉洞)腫瘍と限局性セミノーマが合併した症例を報告する。腫瘍は膀胱壁と尿道に浸潤した。卵黄嚢成分はαフェトプロテインとサイトケラチンに陽性であり、セミノーマ部分は胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼに陽性であった。根治的手術とシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けたが、患者は8か月後に死亡した。転移巣は卵黄嚢成分のみからなっていた。著者らは、前立腺でこの組み合わせが見られた初めての症例として報告している。
pmid-12657943.summary_en: The authors describe a 24-year-old man with a primary yolk sac (endodermal sinus) tumor of the prostate combined with a focal seminoma. The tumor infiltrated the bladder wall and urethra, and immunohistochemistry was positive for alpha-fetoprotein and cytokeratin in the yolk sac component and for placental alkaline phosphatase in the seminoma. Despite radical surgery and cisplatin-based chemotherapy, the patient died 8 months later with metastases to the lungs, liver, and brain, all composed of yolk sac elements. This is reported as the first case of this combination in the prostate.

pmid-12658908.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患36例を対象に、c-erbB-2の増幅と発現、DNA含量、XY染色体核型を解析した研究です。75%は自然退縮し、25%が持続性または転移性疾患となりましたが、化学療法や補助手術で全例完全寛解しました。c-erbB-2異常とDNA異数性の併存例は増殖能が高く、侵入奇胎や絨毛癌を含みました。
pmid-12658908.summary_en: This study analyzed 36 cases of gestational trophoblastic disease for c-erbB-2 amplification and protein expression, DNA content, and XY karyotype to identify factors predicting persistent disease. Spontaneous regression occurred in 75%, while 25% developed persistent or metastatic disease, and all of these achieved complete remission with chemotherapy or adjuvant surgery. Cases with c-erbB-2 abnormalities combined with DNA hyperploidy showed higher proliferation and more aggressive behavior, including invasive moles and a choriocarcinoma. The authors propose this combination as a possible marker for persistent disease.

pmid-12660273.summary_ja: 化学療法または放射線療法の前に精子を凍結保存した精巣がん232例とホジキン病110例の精液性状を比較した研究です。精巣がんでは35.5%に精子数の低下が見られ、セミノーマは他の組織型より良好でした。病的な血清β-hCG値は精液性状不良と関連しました。全体としてホジキン病の方が精液性状は良好でした。
pmid-12660273.summary_en: This study compared semen quality in 232 patients with testicular cancer and 110 with Hodgkin's disease who cryobanked sperm before chemo- or radiotherapy. Mean semen parameters in testicular cancer were within WHO norms, but 35.5% had impaired sperm counts, and seminoma patients showed better quality than other histologies. Pathological serum beta-hCG levels were associated with poorer semen parameters. Hodgkin's patients generally had normal spermatogenesis, although quality declined in advanced stages. Overall, semen quality appeared better in Hodgkin's disease than in testicular cancer.

pmid-12660824.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)で獲得されやすい12p染色体領域の遺伝子発現を、CESHおよびマイクロアレイで解析した。12p11.2-p12.1領域のMRPS35、LDHBなどが多くの腫瘍で過剰発現し、BCAT1は非セミノーマに特異的に高発現していた。増幅例ではCMAS、KRAS2などの発現上昇も認められ、TGCTの発生に関与する候補遺伝子と考えられた。
pmid-12660824.summary_en: This study used comparative expressed sequence hybridization and microarray analysis to profile genes on chromosome 12p in testicular germ cell tumors with i(12p) or 12p11.2-p12.1 amplification, compared with testis tissue and fibroblasts. Genes including MRPS35, LDHB, and EST595078 were overexpressed in most tumors, and BCAT1 was specifically elevated in nonseminomas. Overexpression of CMAS, EKI1, and KRAS2 correlated with amplification. These candidate genes may contribute to TGCT development.

pmid-12663994.summary_ja: 若年の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者で、術前化学療法4コース後に腹部大動脈下部に14cmの仮性動脈瘤が生じた。転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍による大動脈浸潤のため後腹膜リンパ節郭清が困難となった。術中に柔軟型大動脈グラフトで再建する新手技を報告し、下肢および骨盤の虚血を防ぎつつ腫瘍を外科的切除できた。
pmid-12663994.summary_en: A young man with testicular germ cell cancer developed a 14 cm pseudoaneurysm of the infrarenal aorta after four cycles of preoperative chemotherapy. Aortic invasion by metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor complicated retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The authors describe intraoperative floppy aortic graft reconstruction, which maintained lower-extremity and pelvic perfusion during aortic and retroperitoneal tumor resection while giving the urologic surgeon good exposure.

pmid-12673712.summary_ja: 286例の進行胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象に、BEPとVIPを各4サイクル実施したグループ間試験の最終解析である。中央値7.3年の追跡で、インディアナ病期分類ではPFSとOSが両群で同程度であった。IGCCCG分類では予後群により転帰が異なり、予後不良群ではOSとPFSに有意差はなかった。VIPは血液毒性がより多かった。著者らは、大多数の予後不良例と中間リスク例では、BEPが依然として標準療法であると結論づけている。
pmid-12673712.summary_en: This final analysis of an intergroup trial randomized 286 evaluable patients with advanced germ cell tumors to four cycles of BEP or VIP, with median follow-up 7.3 years. Using the Indiana staging system, PFS and OS were similar between VIP and BEP. Under the IGCCCG classification, good, intermediate, and poor-risk patients had differing outcomes, and OS and PFS did not differ significantly among poor-risk patients. VIP caused more hematologic toxicity, and BEP remains standard for most poor and intermediate-risk patients.

pmid-12677599.summary_ja: 巨大頸部奇形腫の乳児に対するEXIT手技中に、気管の同定を補助する目的で術中超音波検査を用いた。頸部奇形腫は気道圧迫により死亡率が高い、まれな乳児腫瘍である。EXIT手技は子宮胎盤系のガス交換を保ちつつ出生前に気道を確保する。超音波検査は気管の同定に有用であった。
pmid-12677599.summary_en: The authors describe intraoperative ultrasound guidance during an EXIT procedure for an infant with massive cervical teratoma. Cervical teratomas are rare infant tumors with high mortality from airway compression. The EXIT approach secures an airway before delivery while preserving uteroplacental gas exchange. Ultrasound helped identify the trachea, which aided airway securing.

pmid-12679648.summary_ja: 4歳半の男児が同性性早熟症と前縦隔腫瘤で受診し、外科的切除で奇形腫に悪性の混合型胚細胞腫瘍(ポリエンブリオーマ)成分を認めた。Klinefelter症候群も判明した。補助療法は行わず手術単独で治療し、2年のフォローアップで良好であった。この方針の根拠を考察した。
pmid-12679648.summary_en: A 4.5-year-old boy with isosexual precocious puberty and an anterior mediastinal mass underwent surgical resection, revealing a teratoma with foci of malignant mixed germ cell tumor elements of polyembryoma. He was diagnosed with Klinefelter syndrome. He was managed with surgical excision alone without adjuvant therapy and remained well at 2-year follow-up. The authors discuss the rationale for this approach.

pmid-12682681.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、停留精巣が精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスクを高めるかを検討したものである。対象は胚細胞癌の患者44例、停留精巣を有する不妊男性117例、30年間に停留精巣の手術を受けた2,919例である。停留精巣に腫瘍は発生せず、追跡可能な2,071例のいずれにも精巣腫瘍は認められなかった。腫瘍はすべて片側性で陰嚢内にあった。著者らは、停留精巣が一般集団より高い精巣がんリスクを示すという証拠はないと結論づけている。本研究は単施設で、診療録の検討に依拠している。
pmid-12682681.summary_en: This retrospective study examined whether undescended testis increases the risk of testicular germ cell tumors. It included 44 patients with testicular germ cell cancer, 117 infertile men with undescended testis, and 2919 patients operated on for undescended testis over 30 years. No tumors arose in undescended testes, and none of the 2071 traceable patients developed testicular tumors. All tumors were unilateral and scrotal. The authors conclude that undescended testis does not confer a higher risk of testicular cancer than the general population. The study is single-center and relies on record review.

pmid-12685961.summary_ja: 25歳男性が腹腔内停留精巣の捻転による急性腹症で受診した症例報告。病理組織学でセミノーマと判明し、精巣摘除後に放射線療法を施行された。9か月のフォローアップで再発や転移は認められなかった。停留精巣は悪性腫瘍のリスクが高く、捻転の診断も困難であると指摘している。
pmid-12685961.summary_en: A 25-year-old man presented with acute abdomen caused by torsion of an intra-abdominal cryptorchid testis. Histopathology showed seminoma, so the case involved cryptorchidism, torsion and tumor together. Orchidectomy followed by radiotherapy was performed, and nine months of follow-up showed no recurrence or metastases. The authors note that cryptorchid testes carry a substantially increased malignancy risk and that torsion is harder to diagnose than in normally descended testes. This case report highlights the diagnostic difficulty of undescended testis.

pmid-12686815.summary_ja: 1995〜2000年に臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の239例に神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した多施設研究。転移は28%に認められ、合併症は軽症14.2%、重症5.4%であった。順行性射精は93.3%で温存され、後腹膜再発は1.2%と少なかった。転移リンパ節が3個以下の症例では約70%が治癒すると結論づけている。
pmid-12686815.summary_en: A multicenter analysis by the German Testicular Cancer Study Group included 239 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who underwent primary nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection between 1995 and 2000. Metastases were found in 28% of patients, and most had pathological stage I disease. Minor and major complications occurred in 14.2% and 5.4%, respectively, and antegrade ejaculation was preserved in 93.3%. Retroperitoneal recurrence was rare at 1.2%. The authors conclude that the procedure remains valuable, with low morbidity and about 70% cure in clinical stage I nonseminoma with up to three positive nodes.

pmid-12689537.summary_ja: 38歳女性が胞状奇胎を7回連続で経験し、子宮摘出時に絨毛癌と診断された症例報告。妊娠性絨毛性疾患は極めてまれであり、反復する胞状奇胎から悪性の絨毛癌へ進展した例として示されている。胞状奇胎後のフォローアップの重要性を示唆する。
pmid-12689537.summary_en: A 38-year-old woman had seven consecutive molar pregnancies followed by choriocarcinoma, diagnosed at hysterectomy. The report illustrates how gestational trophoblastic disease can progress to malignant choriocarcinoma after repeated molar gestations. Because gestational trophoblastic disease is very rare, the authors describe this exceptional case. The report underscores the importance of long-term follow-up after molar pregnancy.

pmid-12691312.summary_ja: 続発性無月経と血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)高値を呈した20歳女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の症例。EMA/CO療法2コース後も子宮腫瘤が増大し、子宮全摘術が施行された。免疫組織化学では p53 の強い核染色が見られたが、エクソン5〜8に遺伝子変異は検出されなかった。p53解析は本疾患の発症機序の理解に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-12691312.summary_en: A 20-year-old woman with secondary amenorrhea and elevated serum hCG was diagnosed with placental site trophoblastic tumor after curettage and hysterectomy. She received two cycles of EMA/CO, but the uterine mass grew before surgery. Immunohistochemistry showed intense nuclear p53 staining, yet PCR-SSCP analysis of exons 5 to 8 detected no p53 mutation. The authors suggest that p53 gene analysis may help clarify the pathogenesis of this rare trophoblastic neoplasm.

pmid-12694672.summary_ja: 18歳女性の卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の腹腔内再発に多発神経根炎を合併した症例報告です。腫瘍切除と化学療法1コース後に感覚・運動異常が消失し、傍腫瘍症候群が示唆されました。5年後も神経症状なく完全寛解を維持しています。卵巣未分化胚細胞腫に多発神経根炎が合併した初の報告とされています。
pmid-12694672.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old woman with an abdominal relapse of an ovarian dysgerminoma accompanied by polyradiculoneuritis. Neurologic examinations were normal, and her sensory and motor abnormalities resolved after tumour ablation and one cycle of chemotherapy, supporting a paraneoplastic cause. She remained in complete remission without neurologic symptoms five years later. The authors describe this as the first reported association of polyradiculoneuritis with ovarian dysgerminoma.

pmid-12694793.summary_ja: 胎児期に心エコーで診断された心膜内腫瘍と心嚢液貯留の新生児2例を報告しています。両胎児は胎児水腫の治療として子宮内心膜穿刺を受けました。出生後に腫瘍を外科的切除し、組織学的に嚢胞性奇形腫と診断されました。両児とも術後経過は良好で、出生前診断と介入の有用性が示唆されています。
pmid-12694793.summary_en: The authors report two newborns with intrapericardial tumours and pericardial effusion, diagnosed in utero by echocardiography at 21 and 28 weeks of gestation. Both fetuses underwent intrauterine pericardiocentesis to treat hydrops fetalis. After birth, the tumours were surgically resected, and histology showed cystic teratoma. Both babies had favourable postoperative courses. The report suggests that prenatal diagnosis and intervention can lead to good outcomes in this rare condition.

pmid-12696624.summary_ja: 閉経後女性で、両側卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の一方から粘液性腺癌とストルマ性カルチノイドが生じ、同時性子宮頸癌も合併した症例報告です。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化では扁平上皮癌が最も多いと概説しています。子宮全摘術、化学療法、放射線療法の併用が提案されています。他の婦人科悪性腫瘍と併存する場合も悪性転化の認識が重要とされています。
pmid-12696624.summary_en: This case report describes a postmenopausal woman with synchronous mucinous adenocarcinoma and strumal carcinoid tumour arising from one of two ovarian mature cystic teratomas, along with synchronous cervical cancer. The authors review malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma, noting that squamous cell carcinoma is the most common associated cancer. They suggest treatment with hysterectomy, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy. The case highlights the need to recognize malignant transformation in mature teratomas that coexist with other gynaecological malignancies.

pmid-12697874.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者200例を前向きに登録し、再発危険因子を評価した多施設試験です。血管浸潤が病理学的病期II予測に最も有用でしたが、陽性的中率は52.7%にとどまりました。複数因子の組み合わせで陰性的中率は86.5%に達しました。低リスク例はサーベイランスで管理できる可能性があり、高リスク例では補助療法の縮小が必要とされています。
pmid-12697874.summary_en: This prospective German Testicular Cancer Study Group trial assessed risk factors for relapse in 200 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis treated with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Vascular invasion was the strongest predictor of pathologic stage II disease, but its positive predictive value was only 52.7%. Combining several risk factors raised the positive predictive value to 63.6% and the negative predictive value to 86.5%. Low-risk patients may be managed with surveillance, while high-risk patients need reduced adjuvant treatment.

pmid-12698156.summary_ja: 1981年から2000年に治療された268例を対象に、精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後の残存縦隔病変に対する外科的切除を検討した。最も多い残存病理は奇形腫(59%)であった。5年および10年生存率は86%および74%であった。術前β-hCG高値と残存病変の不良な病理学的特徴は、独立して予後不良と関連していた。著者らは、胸管に沿った予測可能な播種パターンを報告し、必要に応じた複数回の手術を含む積極的な外科的治療を支持している。
pmid-12698156.summary_en: This single-institution study of 268 patients treated between 1981 and 2000 examined surgical removal of residual mediastinal disease after cisplatin-based chemotherapy for metastatic testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumours. Teratoma was the most common residual pathology (59%). Five- and 10-year survivals were 86% and 74%. Elevated preoperative β-hCG and adverse pathologic features of residual disease independently predicted poorer survival. The authors describe a predictable dissemination pattern along the thoracic duct and support aggressive surgery, including multiple procedures when indicated.

pmid-12701979.summary_ja: 異型接合性の双生児2例が、それぞれ卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫を発症した症例を報告している。奇形腫は後天性の腫瘍と考えられ家族内発生の報告はないが、家族歴に基づくフォローアップにより早期診断が可能になりうると述べ、発症機序の分子生物学的理解への手がかりになる可能性を示唆している。
pmid-12701979.summary_en: This case report describes two heterozygotic twins, each with a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary. The authors note that teratomas are generally considered acquired neoplasms, with no reported familial incidence, and that only one prior case of teratoma in monozygotic twins exists in the literature. They suggest that structured familial follow-up may enable earlier diagnosis and could aid molecular understanding of teratoma pathogenesis.

pmid-12704752.summary_ja: 妊娠23週に診断された胎児エピグナトゥス（奇形腫）の症例報告である。さらにアカルディウス・アクラニウス様の胎児様構造を2つ併せ持っていた。出生前に寄生胎児を伴うエピグナトゥスが検出された初めての記述とされ、特殊な例では胎児奇形腫と多胎妊娠の境界が定義しにくいことを示している。
pmid-12704752.summary_en: This case report describes a fetal epignathus, a teratoma, detected at 23 weeks of gestation and followed by termination of pregnancy at 24 weeks. The fetus also had two fetus-like structures resembling acardius acranius. The authors state that this is the first description of epignathus with parasitic fetuses detected prenatally. The case shows that, in special situations, the boundary between fetal teratoma and multiple pregnancy may be difficult to define.

pmid-12704753.summary_ja: 膣類皮嚢腫の1症例を報告し、文献レビューにより本疾患が稀なのか、それとも誤称なのかを検討している。超音波像が表皮封入嚢腫と類似するため術前診断は困難であると指摘し、本症例の超音波所見を提示している。画像評価において他の膣嚢胞性病変との鑑別を明確にすることを目的としている。
pmid-12704753.summary_en: This case report describes a vaginal dermoid cyst and reviews the literature to assess whether such lesions are rare or a misnomer. The authors note that preoperative diagnosis is difficult because sonographic features resemble those of an epidermal inclusion cyst. They present the sonographic characteristics of the lesion in this case. The report aims to clarify how this uncommon finding should be recognized and distinguished from other vaginal cystic lesions during imaging evaluation.

pmid-12705339.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患72例と健常妊婦20例で血清アンジオゲニンを測定し、治療後1年間の推移を追跡した研究である。高リスクの絨毛癌では高値を示す例が多く、hCGβ値と正の相関を示した。アンジオゲニンは鑑別診断や治療効果、病勢の評価に有用な指標となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-12705339.summary_en: This study measured serum angiogenin in 72 patients with gestational trophoblastic diseases and 20 healthy pregnant controls, alongside serum hCG beta, with follow-up for one year after treatment. Abnormal angiogenin levels were seen in all postmolar high-risk cases, and levels were higher in choriocarcinoma patients than in controls, especially high-risk cases. Angiogenin correlated positively with hCG beta and tracked disease progression or remission. The authors suggest serum angiogenin may help differentiate GTD and indicate therapeutic response.

pmid-12705996.summary_ja: 生検で精巣上皮内腫瘍（TIN）陰性とされた後に精巣胚細胞腫瘍を発症した21例を解析した研究である。再検討で5例の生検にTINが認められ、精巣摘除術標本ではすべての例で腫瘍周囲にTINを認めた。偽陰性率は0.5%で、生検の感度は0.914だった。TINの非ランダムな分布が主因とされ、高リスク例では2か所生検が精度を高める可能性があると提案している。
pmid-12705996.summary_en: This study analysed 21 patients who developed testicular germ cell tumours despite a biopsy negative for testicular intraepithelial neoplasia. On re-examination, TIN was found in five biopsies and in all 15 orchiectomy specimens examined. The false-negative rate was 0.5%, and biopsy sensitivity was 0.914. Young age under 18 and intratubular microcalcifications should increase vigilance. The authors conclude that most false-negative biopsies reflect the non-random distribution of TIN in the testis, and suggest two-site biopsies may improve accuracy in high-risk cases.

pmid-12707196.summary_ja: 30年間に三次医療機関の小児センターで鼻類皮嚢腫と診断された42例を後方視的に検討した研究である。最も多い症状は鼻眉間部の腫瘤で、約4分の1に頭蓋内進展を示す所見があった。手術は頭蓋外切除から頭蓋内外併用切除まで行われ、再発は12%で多くは頭蓋外であった。術前評価により頭蓋内進展を除外することが不可欠と結論づけている。
pmid-12707196.summary_en: This retrospective study reviews 42 children treated for nasal dermoid over 30 years at a tertiary pediatric medical center. The most common presentation was a nasoglabellar mass. Most patients underwent preoperative imaging, and about a quarter showed a clinical or radiographic indication of intracranial extension. Treatment ranged from extracranial excision to combined intracranial-extracranial excision. Recurrence occurred in 12% of patients, mostly extracranially, with a mean follow-up of seven years. The authors conclude that preoperative evaluation is essential to rule out intracranial extension.

pmid-12709752.summary_ja: 新生児鼻咽頭奇形腫3例の画像所見をまとめた報告。重篤な呼吸窮迫を呈し、CTとMRIで下顎骨や翼突板の特徴的な異常を認めた。これにより他の新生児頸部腫瘤との鑑別が可能となる。出生前MRIは診断や腫瘍の範囲評価、計画的な分娩に有用とされる。
pmid-12709752.summary_en: This report describes cross-sectional imaging findings in three neonates with nasopharyngeal teratoma who presented with severe respiratory distress. CT and MRI showed characteristic mandibular and pterygoid plate abnormalities that help distinguish this rare tumor from other neonatal neck masses. The authors note that prenatal MRI can enable diagnosis, define tumour extent and guide planned delivery, thereby optimising management. The study is a small case series emphasizing the role of imaging in planning care.

pmid-12709759.summary_ja: 2歳男児に生じた膵臓の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。上腹部の巨大な嚢胞性腫瘤を主訴とし、腹部CTで大きな嚢胞性病変が描出された。病理学的に膵臓由来の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。小児でこの腫瘍のCT所見が示されたのは初めてとされる。
pmid-12709759.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old boy with a huge cystic mass in the upper abdomen, presenting as a palpable abdominal mass. Abdominal CT showed a large cystic lesion, and pathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma arising from the pancreas. The authors state this is the first demonstration of the CT appearance of such a tumour in a child. Cystic pancreatic tumours are rare in children, and mature cystic teratomas of the pancreas are rarer still, making this a notable imaging report.

pmid-12711331.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍由来のヒト胎児性癌(EC)幹細胞TERA2.cl.SP12から神経細胞を効率よく得る新手法を報告した研究。従来のレチノイン酸法では神経細胞は10〜15%にとどまり、数週間を要した。本研究では神経細胞の産生効率を大きく高める培養法を開発し、研究や創薬への応用が期待される。
pmid-12711331.summary_en: This methods study describes a new procedure to enhance neuron production from human TERA2.cl.SP12 embryonal carcinoma (EC) stem cells, which are derived from germ cell tumours. Conventional retinoic acid differentiation yields only 10-15% neurons and takes weeks. The authors report novel culture procedures that dramatically increase neuronal productivity and efficiency. The approach is intended for research and drug discovery use. The study focuses on EC stem cell biology and its experimental application.

pmid-12713570.summary_ja: 中絶術後3か月で子宮頸部に生じた成熟奇形腫の症例報告。組織学的に三胚葉由来の成分と豊富なリンパ組織を認めた。DNA型検査により胎児組織の着床は否定された。子宮の奇形腫性病変の鑑別には、妊娠直後でリンパ過形成を伴う例でも真の奇形腫を考慮すべきと結論された。性腺外奇形腫のまれな例である。
pmid-12713570.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with a mature teratoma of the uterine cervix that developed three months after an elective abortion. Histology showed ectodermal, mesodermal and endodermal derivatives with exuberant lymphoid elements. DNA typing excluded fetal tissue implantation as the cause. The authors conclude that a true teratoma should be included in the differential diagnosis of uterine teratomatous lesions, particularly after recent pregnancy with lymphoid hyperplasia. This is a rare extragonadal teratoma.

pmid-12714000.summary_ja: 転移を伴う高リスク絨毛癌の患者に、産後遅くに生じた妊娠性疱疹の症例報告。直接免疫蛍光法で診断された。ステロイドと抗ヒスタミン薬で掻痒は軽減したが、化学療法の再発コースによってのみ皮疹が完全に消失した。妊娠性疱疹が絨毛癌の傍腫瘍症候群である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-12714000.summary_en: This case report describes late postpartum herpes gestationis in a patient with metastatic high-risk choriocarcinoma. The diagnosis was confirmed by direct immunofluorescence. Corticosteroids and antihistamines alleviated pruritus, but only recurrent chemotherapy for the choriocarcinoma completely resolved the herpes gestationis. The authors suggest herpes gestationis may be a paraneoplastic syndrome of choriocarcinoma. The report highlights a rare link between this dermatosis and gestational malignancy, with treatment response supporting the association.

pmid-12714896.summary_ja: ダウン症候群を合併した古典型セミノーマの3例を報告した論文。いずれも進行例であった。文献上、ダウン症候群では精巣がんの発生頻度が高いとの報告があるが、確立された関連はない。3例の小規模な記述的報告であり、考えられる発症機序を簡潔に考察している。
pmid-12714896.summary_en: This report describes three patients with classic seminoma and Down syndrome, all presenting with advanced disease. The authors reviewed the literature and noted an increased occurrence of testicular cancer in Down syndrome, although no definitive association has been established. Possible pathogenic mechanisms are briefly discussed. The series is small and descriptive, so it generates a hypothesis rather than proving causation. It is relevant to clinicians caring for germ cell tumour patients with Down syndrome.

pmid-12717249.summary_ja: 本研究は、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じた破裂性粘液性腫瘍に関連する腹膜偽粘液腫の3症例を分析している。2例は低異型度の腺腫性病変、1例は粘液癌の領域を含んでいた。全腫瘍はサイトケラチン20陽性、サイトケラチン7陰性であり、消化管型の粘液性腫瘍に類似していた。著者らは、腫瘍は奇形腫の腸管成分に由来し、PMPの卵巣起源を示す唯一の症例である可能性があるとしている。再発の有無を判断するには追跡が必要である。
pmid-12717249.summary_en: This study analyses three cases of pseudomyxoma peritonei (mucinous ascites) associated with ruptured mucinous tumors arising within ovarian mature cystic teratomas. Two tumors were low-grade adenomatous lesions and one contained areas of mucinous carcinoma. All tumors were cytokeratin 20 positive and cytokeratin 7 negative, resembling gastrointestinal-type mucinous tumors. The authors propose the tumors arise from gut elements of the teratoma and may represent the only ovarian origin of PMP. Follow-up is needed to determine recurrence.

pmid-12721723.summary_ja: UKCCSGのレビューで、1989～1997年に治療された新生児の仙尾部奇形腫(SCT)51例を検討した。全例が手術のみで治療され、2例の死亡を除き予後は良好であった。成熟または未熟奇形腫の7例がその後数か月で卵黄嚢腫瘍の再発を来したが、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン、カルボプラチン(JEB)化学療法で良好に治療された。著者らは、SCTの長期的フォローアップの必要性を強調している。
pmid-12721723.summary_en: This UKCCSG review examines neonatal sacrococcygeal teratomas (SCT) treated between 1989 and 1997. Fifty-one neonates were registered, all treated with surgery alone, and prognosis was generally good apart from two deaths. Seven patients with mature or immature teratomas developed yolk sac tumour recurrence months later. These children were successfully treated with etoposide, bleomycin and carboplatin (JEB) chemotherapy. The authors emphasise the need for long-term oncological follow-up of SCT and the good response of malignant teratomas and yolk sac tumours to JEB.

pmid-12722093.summary_ja: 1951～2000年に当院で診療された縦隔腫瘍806例を後方視的に解析し、成人と小児を比較した。胚細胞腫瘍は成人で16%、小児で19%を占めた。成人では胸腺腫、小児では神経原性腫瘍が多かった。小児では呼吸困難や緊急手術が多く、年齢による臨床像の違いが示された。
pmid-12722093.summary_en: A retrospective review of 806 mediastinal tumour patients at a single Japanese institution (1951–2000) compared adults and children. Thymomas predominated in adults, whereas neurogenic tumours were most common in children. Germ cell tumours accounted for 16% of adult and 19% of pediatric cases. Children more often had dyspnea and required emergency surgery, while malignancy was less frequent in children. The findings highlight age-related differences in histology, location and presentation that should guide diagnostic and treatment planning.

pmid-12727846.summary_ja: 多能性制御因子POU5F1（OCT3/4）を免疫組織化学で検討した。上皮内癌・性腺芽腫、セミノーマ、胎児性癌で一貫して陽性であり、分化した非セミノーマ、乳幼児の胚細胞腫瘍、精母細胞性セミノーマでは陰性であった。化学感受性と化学抵抗性の成人胚細胞腫瘍で染色パターンに差はなく、多能性胚細胞腫瘍の診断マーカーとして有用とされる。
pmid-12727846.summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry to assess POU5F1 (OCT3/4), a regulator of pluripotency, across germ cell tumours and over 100 other tumour categories. POU5F1 was consistently detected in carcinoma in situ/gonadoblastoma, seminomas/germinomas/dysgerminomas and embryonal carcinoma, but not in differentiated nonseminomas, infant GCTs or spermatocytic seminomas. Expression was unchanged between chemosensitive and chemoresistant adult GCT. The authors conclude that POU5F1 immunohistochemistry is a useful diagnostic marker for pluripotent GCT.

pmid-12728528.summary_ja: 46歳男性が一過性の排尿困難で受診し、膀胱後部の腫瘍を画像検査で確認した。腫瘍切除術で隣接臓器との癒着はなく、病理学的に類皮嚢腫と診断された。経過観察中に重篤な合併症や再発はない。男性の膀胱後部類皮嚢腫としては世界で3例目の報告である。
pmid-12728528.summary_en: A 46-year-old man presented with transient dysuria, and a retrovesical tumour was identified by ultrasonography, CT, MRI and angiography. Resection was performed without adhesions to adjacent organs, and histopathology confirmed a dermoid cyst. A dermoid cyst is a mature teratoma-type germ cell tumour. The patient has been followed without severe complications or recurrence. The authors note this is only the third reported case of retrovesical dermoid cyst in a male worldwide, highlighting a rare location.

pmid-12732763.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫55例に対する腹腔鏡下切除術を前向きに評価し、水剥離と鈍的剥離を組み合わせた卵巣組織温存法を検討しています。術前と術後6〜12か月に経膣超音波検査で残存卵巣組織を測定しました。多くの症例で3cm3を超える組織が残り、卵巣皮質が見えない例も24卵巣にみられました。
pmid-12732763.summary_en: This prospective study of 55 women evaluated laparoscopic removal of ovarian dermoid cysts, combining hydrodissection with blunt dissection, with the aim of preserving ovarian tissue. Transvaginal ultrasound was performed before surgery and 6 to 12 months afterward to measure residual ovarian cortex. Residual tissue exceeded 3 cm3 in most ovaries, and in 24 ovaries no cortex was visible on ultrasound. The authors conclude that laparoscopic excision with maximal tissue sparing is appropriate even when the cyst appears to fill the ovary.

pmid-12735422.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対しブレオマイシンで治療された若年男性から、スキューバダイビングを再開してよいか相談を受けた症例の報告です。ブレオマイシンは活性酸素を生じ、潜水時の高濃度酸素が肺障害を悪化させる可能性があります。化学療法後にこのリスクが続く期間は不明であり、本症例では潜水を再開しないよう助言しました。
pmid-12735422.summary_en: This article describes advice given to a young man successfully treated with bleomycin for testicular cancer who asked whether he could resume scuba diving. Bleomycin can generate reactive oxygen species through iron chelation, and high oxygen exposure during diving may worsen pulmonary injury. The authors note that the duration of this risk after chemotherapy is unknown, and they discouraged scuba diving in this patient. The report is a clinical perspective on managing late pulmonary risk after bleomycin-containing chemotherapy in germ cell tumor survivors.

pmid-12743144.summary_ja: HIV陽性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者35例の多施設研究です。セミノーマが74%を占め、HIV陰性の対照群と比べ精巣セミノーマの相対リスクは5.4でした。非セミノーマの頻度は増加しませんでした。2年の全生存期間(全生存率)は81%で、死亡の多くはHIV感染によるものでした。治療はHIV陰性患者と同様に行うべきだとされています。
pmid-12743144.summary_en: This multicenter study of 35 men with HIV-related testicular germ cell tumors found that seminoma accounted for 74% of cases, and seminoma incidence was 5.4 times higher than in HIV-negative controls. Non-seminomatous tumors were not more frequent. Sixty percent presented with stage I disease and 14 patients had metastatic disease. Six relapsed and 2-year overall survival was 81%. The authors conclude that these patients should be treated like HIV-negative patients, and that most deaths were due to HIV rather than the tumor.

pmid-12743319.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌（EC）幹細胞を、レチノイン酸などによる培養条件の操作で神経細胞、星状膠細胞、未熟神経細胞へ分化誘導する方法を報告している。細胞型マーカーにより分化を確認し、培養EC幹細胞がヒト神経発生の再現性の高いモデル系になることを示した。腫瘍の臨床研究ではなく、基礎研究の論文である。
pmid-12743319.summary_en: This study describes culture procedures for inducing human embryonal carcinoma (EC) stem cells, the pluripotent cells derived from teratocarcinomas, to differentiate into pure populations of neurons, astrocytes, or immature neuronal cells. Retinoic acid and changes in the culture environment drove differentiation, and cell-type-specific markers confirmed the emergence of distinct neural subtypes. The authors propose cultured EC stem cells as a robust, reproducible model system for studying human neural development and embryogenesis, rather than as a clinical tumor study.

pmid-12744102.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍が左副腎に単発転移した症例の報告である。PSTTは以前は良性と考えられていたが、転移能を有することが認識されており、報告例の約30%が転移するとされる。本症例では左副腎摘除術に加えて化学療法が行われた。
pmid-12744102.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) that metastasized to a single left adrenal gland. The authors note that PSTT, once considered benign, has malignant potential, with about 30% of reported cases metastasizing. Treatment is primarily surgical, with chemotherapy added for metastatic disease. The patient was treated with left adrenalectomy followed by chemotherapy.

pmid-12745729.summary_ja: 小児期に発見され、50年以上未治療のまま経過した成熟型精巣奇形腫が悪性転化した症例の報告である。小児の精巣奇形腫は一般に良性とされるが、未治療で放置した場合の経過はほとんど知られていない。長期間にわたり良性と推定されていた奇形腫でも、悪性変化が起こり得ることを示している。
pmid-12745729.summary_en: This case report describes a patient whose testicular teratoma, presumed benign after childhood and left untreated for more than 50 years, showed malignant transformation. The authors note that pediatric testicular teratoma is generally regarded as benign, but little is known about the consequences of leaving it untreated. The report underscores that a teratoma presumed benign may undergo malignant change even after decades of apparent quiescence.

pmid-12745731.summary_ja: 腹腔内の停留精巣に発生したセミノーマの症例である。術前に腎腫瘍と誤診され、同側の腎無形成と精嚢欠損を伴っていた。停留精巣の悪性変性は稀であり、画像所見を理解することで術前診断や他臓器奇形の発見につながると述べている。
pmid-12745731.summary_en: A case of seminoma arising in an intra-abdominal undescended testis is reported, initially misdiagnosed as a kidney tumor. The patient also had ipsilateral renal agenesis and absence of the ipsilateral seminal vesicle. The authors emphasize that malignant degeneration of an intra-abdominal testis is rare, and that recognizing its radiologic appearance is important for preoperative diagnosis and for detecting associated malformations of other organs.

pmid-12748851.summary_ja: 1988〜1998年にハンガリーの専門施設で治療した精巣がん2,386例を解析し、両側性精巣がんを検討した。同時性は0.8%、異時性は2.2%で、両側性の全体の発生率は3%であった。異時性のセミノーマは非セミノーマより長い間隔で出現し、発症年齢も高かった。定期的なフォローアップにより早期発見が可能であり、長期フォローアップの重要性を強調している。
pmid-12748851.summary_en: A Hungarian referral-center review of 2,386 testicular cancer patients treated between 1988 and 1998, examining bilateral disease. Synchronous tumors occurred in 0.8% and metachronous tumors in 2.2%, for an overall bilateral incidence of 3%. Metachronous seminomas appeared at longer intervals and in older patients than nonseminomas. No clinical factor predicted metachronous cancer, but regular follow-up enabled early detection, and the authors stress self-examination and long-term follow-up.

pmid-12751863.summary_ja: 17〜50歳の5例で、原発の精巣病変が退縮し転移性胚細胞腫瘍として発見されたバーンドアウト精巣腫瘍を検討した。4例はリンパ節腫大で発見され、精巣超音波検査では全例に異常がみられた。転移巣を原発と誤認する危険があるため、陰嚢の異常所見は精巣摘除の適応とすべきと結論づけている。
pmid-12751863.summary_en: This report describes five patients aged 17 to 50 with burned-out testicular tumors, in which the primary testicular lesion had regressed and metastatic germ cell neoplasms presented first. Lymphadenopathy revealed the disease in four patients, mostly retroperitoneal, and scrotal ultrasound showed abnormalities in all cases. The authors note that metastatic lesions can be mistaken for primary tumors, so careful evaluation of the testis is essential. They conclude that any clinical or sonographic scrotal abnormality should prompt orchidectomy. The paper combines these cases with a review of prior reports.

pmid-12752231.summary_ja: 精巣摘除標本181例の腫瘍周囲精巣実質を、セミノーマ、非セミノーマ、混合型で比較した。セミノーマ周囲では精子形成の低下や管状萎縮、リンパ球浸潤が多く、宿主の反応を反映すると考えられた。管内非セミノーマは血管浸潤および小さい腫瘍と関連し、非セミノーマは血液精巣関門の背後で発生するとの仮説が示された。
pmid-12752231.summary_en: This study compared the morphology of testicular parenchyma adjacent to 181 orchidectomy specimens: 86 seminomas, 72 nonseminomatous tumors, and 23 combined tumors. Features scored included spermatogenesis, tubular atrophy, carcinoma in situ, intertubular tissue, lymphocytic infiltrates, and intratubular neoplasia. Parenchyma next to seminomas showed lower Johnsen scores, more tubular atrophy, and more lymphocytic infiltration, suggesting a host response. Intratubular nonseminoma was associated with angioinvasion and smaller tumors. The authors propose that nonseminomas arise from intratubular nonseminoma cells behind the blood-testis barrier.

pmid-12752235.summary_ja: 1975〜1996年に11施設で治療された性腺外胚細胞腫瘍635例を検討した。非セミノーマ性組織型、縦隔原発、非肺内臓器転移、β-hCG高値が予後不良因子であった。異時性精巣がんは16例(4.1%)に生じ、非セミノーマ性または後腹膜原発で危険性が高かった。
pmid-12752235.summary_en: This retrospective multicenter analysis included 635 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors treated at 11 centers between 1975 and 1996. Most had nonseminomatous histology, and mediastinal or retroperitoneal primaries were common. Adverse prognostic factors included nonseminomatous histology, non-pulmonary visceral metastases, mediastinal location, and elevated beta-hCG. Sixteen patients developed metachronous testicular cancer, with higher risk after nonseminomatous or retroperitoneal disease. Five-year survival was about 45% for mediastinal nonseminomas and 62% for retroperitoneal nonseminomas, while seminomatous tumors had about 88% overall survival.

pmid-12752238.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者295例の対側精巣から、5mmの生検を3か所ずつ採取してTINの検出率を評価した。TINは24例(8.1%)で確認され、そのうち6例は3検体中1〜2検体でしか検出されなかった。単回生検では見逃される可能性があるため、複数回生検の実施が推奨されている。
pmid-12752238.summary_en: This study evaluated whether multiple biopsies improve detection of testicular intraepithelial neoplasia (TIN) in the contralateral testis of men with testicular tumors. In 295 men, three 5 mm biopsies were taken from each contralateral testis and examined by morphology and placental alkaline phosphatase immunohistochemistry. Contralateral TIN was found in 24 men (8.1%), and in six of these it was detected in only one or two of the three specimens. Single random biopsies could therefore have missed TIN, so the authors recommend multiple biopsies.

pmid-12752240.summary_ja: 病期I精巣がん695例を監視療法で管理した結果を報告した。セミノーマ394例、非セミノーマ301例で、全体の22%に再発がみられ、非セミノーマで多かった(29%)。脈管侵襲は再発リスクを高め、再発の大半は2年以内に発生した。全生存率は98.6%、原病による死亡は認められなかった。
pmid-12752240.summary_en: This report describes treatment outcomes of 695 patients with stage I testicular cancer managed with surveillance, including 394 seminomas and 301 nonseminomas. Relapse occurred in 22% overall, more often in nonseminoma (29%) than seminoma (17%). Vascular invasion increased relapse risk, and most relapses occurred within the first two years. Ten patients died during follow-up, none from the germ cell tumor or its treatment. Overall survival at stage I was 98.6%, and cause-specific survival was 100%.

pmid-12752246.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍81例を対象に、新たな予後予測モデルを作成した。多変量解析では、IGCCC分類と血清LD-1のみが生存の予測因子として残った。新モデルは組織型、IGCCC、血清LD-1を組み合わせたもので、IGCCCによる分類を24%の患者で変更した。一般的な分類として用いるには、さらに検証が必要とされている。
pmid-12752246.summary_en: This study developed a new prognostic model for patients with metastatic testicular germ cell tumors, using 81 patients. In multivariate analysis, only the International Germ Cell Consensus Classification (IGCCC) and serum lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme 1 (S-LD-1) remained predictive of survival. The new model combines main histology, IGCCC, and S-LD-1, and it reclassified IGCCC risk for 24% of patients. It predicted five-year survival better than IGCCC or a modified TNM classification, judged by ROC curve area. The authors caution that the model needs validation before general use.

pmid-12752252.summary_ja: 家族性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の感受性遺伝子座を連鎖解析により検討したレビューである。兄弟では相対リスクが8〜10倍、父子では約4倍と高い。Xq27のTGCT1は両側発症や停留精巣と関連するが、全ての家系を説明するものではない。著者らは179家系を解析し、追加の候補領域を報告している。
pmid-12752252.summary_en: This review summarizes genetic linkage studies of familial testicular germ cell tumor. Family history is one of the strongest risk factors, with brothers of patients at an eight- to tenfold increased relative risk and fathers and sons at about fourfold. The TGCT1 locus at Xq27 is associated with bilateral disease and undescended testis but does not explain all pedigrees. The authors genotyped 179 TGCT pedigrees and identified additional candidate regions. The paper reviews current Xq27 data and presents evidence for several other candidate regions.

pmid-12752254.summary_ja: 本レビューは、精巣胚細胞腫瘍のゲノムを検討したものである。腫瘍は二倍体の原始胚細胞に由来する上皮内癌(CIS)から発生すると考えられている。CISは異数性を伴い、浸潤性腫瘍への進行には12p染色体の増加がしばしば関連する。セミノーマと非セミノーマは多くのゲノム破綻を共有するが、エピゲノムは異なる。マイクロアレイ研究により重要な遺伝子がいくつか同定されている。著者らは、ゲノムの理解が胚発生や化学療法への反応の解明にも役立つと述べている。
pmid-12752254.summary_en: This review examines the genome of testicular germ cell tumors, which are thought to develop from carcinoma in situ (CIS) arising from diploid primordial germ cells. CIS is initiated by aneuploidy with extensive chromosome instability, and progression to invasive tumors is associated with gain of 12p, often as isochromosome 12p. Seminomas and nonseminomas share many genomic disruptions but have distinct epigenomes, and seminomas are under-methylated. Microarray studies have identified several important genes. The authors suggest that understanding the genome may also clarify embryonic development and chemotherapy response.

pmid-12752256.summary_ja: 本レビューは、5歳未満の新生児および乳児における胚細胞腫瘍を検討したものである。対象には未熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍が含まれる。著者らは、乳児期腫瘍は成人腫瘍とは異なる成熟段階の原始胚細胞に由来する可能性を示唆している。乳児期腫瘍は1pおよび6qの反復的な欠失を示し、成人腫瘍とは異なる。2例に先天性12q13転座が認められ、候補遺伝子の同定に役立つ可能性がある。著者らは、乳児期胚細胞腫瘍が独立したサブグループを形成する可能性があると述べている。
pmid-12752256.summary_en: This review examines germ cell tumors in neonates and infants under five years, a group that includes immature teratomas and yolk sac tumors. The authors discuss clinical, histological, and cytogenetic features, and suggest that infantile tumors may arise from primordial germ cells at a different maturation stage than adult tumors. Infantile tumors show recurrent losses of 1p and 6q, differing from adult tumors. Two infantile cases had constitutional 12q13 translocations, which may help identify candidate genes. The authors suggest that infantile germ cell tumors may form a distinct subgroup.

pmid-12752258.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生における12p獲得の役割を検討したレビューである。浸潤性腫瘍では主に等染色体12p(i(12p))として12p獲得が認められる。著者らは12p11.2-p12.1増幅を検討し、12p獲得はアポトーシスを抑制しCIS細胞のセルトリ細胞非依存性を与えると提唱している。有力な候補遺伝子としてDAD-Rが挙げられ、N-グリコシル化を介して作用する可能性がある。
pmid-12752258.summary_en: This review examines the role of gain of chromosome 12p in testicular germ cell tumor development. Invasive seminomas and nonseminomas both show 12p gain, mostly as isochromosome i(12p), suggesting that increased copy number of one or more 12p genes contributes to clinical tumor development. Because 12p gains involve large regions, the authors studied a restricted 12p11.2-p12.1 amplification and its shortest region of overlap. They propose that 12p gain suppresses apoptosis and confers Sertoli cell independence on CIS cells. DAD-R is a leading candidate gene, possibly acting through N-glycosylation.

pmid-12752260.summary_ja: マウスの自然発生的な精巣胚細胞腫瘍の感受性遺伝子を、129/Svマウスモデルを用いてレビューした論文。複数の変異と感受性遺伝子の相互作用、約100個の遺伝子が関与する可能性を示す。ヒトの研究への応用も論じている。
pmid-12752260.summary_en: This review examines the genetic basis of susceptibility to spontaneous testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) in mice, focusing on the 129/Sv inbred strain as an experimental model. The authors describe approaches showing that several spontaneous and engineered mutations interact with 129/Sv-derived susceptibility genes to enhance or suppress tumor development. Linkage analyses with chromosome substitution strains suggest that as many as 100 genes influence susceptibility. The authors also note that bilateral TGCTs arise from the coincidental occurrence of unilateral tumors, and they argue that the model can inform human TGCT susceptibility research.

pmid-12752262.summary_ja: 精巣でGDNFを過剰発現させたトランスジェニックマウスでは、1年後に多くが精巣腫瘍を発症し、しばしば両側性である。腫瘍は丸い精原細胞様細胞からなり、胚細胞系列マーカーを発現し、異数性を示す。局所浸潤性だが転移はしない。組織学的・分子的特徴はヒトの古典的セミノーマに類似するが、前駆病変はマウスとヒトで異なるため、翻訳的意義は限定的であると著者らは指摘している。
pmid-12752262.summary_en: The authors describe transgenic mice overexpressing glial-cell-line-derived neurotrophic factor (GDNF) in the testis, which develop testicular tumors in most animals after one year, often bilaterally. The tumors consist of round spermatogonial or gonocytic cells, express germ line markers, and are aneuploid. They are locally invasive but do not metastasize. Their histological and molecular features resemble classical human seminomas. The authors note, however, that the precursor lesions appear to differ between mice and humans, which limits the model's translational relevance.

pmid-12752264.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生に関わる増殖因子やシグナル伝達分子をレビューした論文。セミノーマと非セミノーマで発現が異なる分子が複数示され、組織型の鑑別マーカーや将来の治療標的となりうると述べている。
pmid-12752264.summary_en: This review summarizes growth factors and signaling molecules implicated in testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) development. Findings include SMAD4 mutation in seminomas, VEGF as a predictor of metastasis in seminomas, HST-1 association with nonseminomatous tumors, C-KIT expression in seminomas, and RET expression limited to seminomas. Somatostatin receptor expression also differs between seminomas and nonseminomas. The authors propose that these molecules may serve as markers distinguishing histological types and as targets for future pharmacological therapies.

pmid-12752269.summary_ja: ヒトの精巣と精巣腫瘍におけるACEアイソフォームの局在と基質についてレビューした論文。体細胞型ACEは上皮内癌や古典的セミノーマに恒常的に発現し、胚細胞腫瘍の発生に傍分泌的な役割を果たす可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-12752269.summary_en: This review addresses angiotensin I-converting enzyme (ACE) and its potential substrates in human testis and testicular tumors. The testicular isoform is expressed during spermatogenesis, and the authors previously showed that the somatic isoform is also present in human germ cells. The somatic isoform appears constantly in carcinoma in situ and especially in classic seminoma, suggesting paracrine roles in the development of male germ cell tumors. The article summarizes localization, substrates, and knockout-mouse data relevant to the pathogenesis of germ cell tumors.

pmid-12752272.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変であるCIS細胞の表現型をまとめたレビューである。古典的セミノーマは胚細胞系譜に沿って増殖し、胎児性癌は胎生期の特徴を保持して奇形腫へ分化しうる。遺伝子発現解析は、CISが両腫瘍型の共通前駆細胞であることを支持する。著者らは、CIS細胞が原始胚細胞またはゴノサイトに由来し、分化と多能性の程度が進行先を左右すると提唱している。
pmid-12752272.summary_en: This review summarizes current knowledge of the phenotype of testicular carcinoma in situ (CIS) cells, the common precursor of testicular germ cell tumors. Classical seminoma follows the germ cell lineage, whereas embryonal carcinoma retains embryonic features and can differentiate into teratomas. Gene expression analyses support CIS as a common precursor for both tumor types. The authors propose that CIS cells originate from primordial germ cells or gonocytes, and that their degree of differentiation and pluripotency influences whether they progress to seminoma or nonseminoma.

pmid-12752274.summary_ja: 2002年に開催された第5回コペンハーゲン精巣上皮内癌・精巣がんワークショップの要点をまとめた総説。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症機序に関する主要テーマを批判的に議論し、今後の研究の展望を示している。新規の一次データは含まない。
pmid-12752274.summary_en: This review highlights the major contributions presented at the 5th Copenhagen Workshop on Carcinoma in situ and Cancer of the Testis, held in August 2002. The authors critically discuss the main themes that emerged at the meeting, including current understanding of testicular germ cell tumor pathogenesis. The article also outlines perspectives for future research in this field. It serves as a summary of recent developments rather than presenting new primary data.

pmid-12752302.summary_ja: 超音波検査で両側の精巣微小石灰化のみが認められた男性が、その後精巣腫瘍を発症した症例報告。精巣微小石灰化と精巣腫瘍の関連を文献から検討し、リスクは不明確であるとしたうえで、管理方法を論じている。
pmid-12752302.summary_en: This case report describes a man whose scrotal ultrasound showed only bilateral testicular microlithiasis but who later developed a testicular tumor. The authors review the published literature on the association between testicular microlithiasis and testicular malignancy. The relationship between microlithiasis and malignancy risk remains unclear. The paper also discusses appropriate management of testicular microlithiasis based on the literature.

pmid-12754734.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍がシスプラチンに極めて敏感である理由として、アポトーシスへの素因を論じた総説。p53経路の異常、Fas/FasL系、ミトコンドリア経路の関与を挙げ、他の腫瘍の化学療法抵抗性を克服する手がかりになると述べている。
pmid-12754734.summary_en: This review proposes that testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) cells are primed for apoptosis, which may explain their extreme sensitivity to cisplatin-containing chemotherapy. The authors discuss altered p53 pathway regulation, low expression of cell cycle regulators, and co-expression of Fas and FasL, which may activate both the Fas and mitochondrial death pathways. They hypothesize that deregulated G1-S checkpoint control and these death pathways together drive rapid apoptosis after cisplatin treatment, and suggest that understanding these mechanisms could help increase cisplatin sensitivity in other tumors.

pmid-12754735.summary_ja: 本研究は、免疫組織化学を用いて、ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)におけるRB経路を検討したものである。pRBは正常な成人の精子形成および奇形腫で発現しているが、上皮内癌、ほとんどのセミノーマ、胎児性癌では消失または減少している。pRBは胎児性性腺細胞にも欠如しており、その消失は腫瘍発生による選択ではなく発生学的制御を反映していることが示唆される。p16INK4aはTGCTの多くで減少している一方、p15INK4bは保持されている。これらの所見は、TGCTが胎児性性腺細胞に由来するという見解を支持する。
pmid-12754735.summary_en: This study examines the retinoblastoma (RB) pathway in human testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) using immunohistochemistry. pRB is expressed in normal adult spermatogenesis and teratomas but is absent or reduced in carcinoma in situ, most seminomas, and embryonal carcinomas. pRB is also absent from fetal gonocytes, suggesting that its loss reflects developmental control rather than tumorigenic selection. p16INK4a is reduced in many TGCTs, while p15INK4b is preserved. The findings support a gonocyte origin for TGCTs.

pmid-12755523.summary_ja: 45X/46XYモザイクでターナー徴候を示す女性表現型の患者の症例報告。予防的腹腔鏡下性腺摘出術で両側の性腺芽腫と、その内部の微小浸潤性セミノーマが見つかった。Y染色体を含む細胞株の存在から、早期の予防的摘出が重要と論じている。
pmid-12755523.summary_en: This report describes a patient with 45X/46XY mosaicism and a female phenotype with Turner stigmata. Prophylactic laparoscopic gonadectomy revealed mixed gonadal dysgenesis with bilateral gonadoblastomas. Microinvasive seminomas were detected within both gonadoblastomas. The authors emphasize that the presence of a Y-chromosome cell line prompted early prophylactic gonadectomy, which is life-saving for such individuals because of the risk of malignant germ cell tumor development.

pmid-12759534.summary_ja: 26歳女性の卵巣セルトリ・ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍に類内膜様卵黄嚢腫瘍が合併した症例を報告している。核型は46,XXで、1番染色体にY染色体物質の挿入が認められ、父親や姉妹など家族にも同じ変異が見られたが、がんは認めなかった。卵巣摘出後、卵黄嚢腫瘍成分は子宮壁に再発し、腹膜と肝臓に転移したが、複数の化学療法に反応せず、診断から54か月で死亡した。
pmid-12759534.summary_en: The authors report a 26-year-old woman with an ovarian Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor containing an endometrioid-like yolk sac tumor component. Karyotyping showed 46,XX with Y-chromosomal material inserted into chromosome 1, also present in the father, sister, and several paternal relatives without cancer.
