Histology showed features of both a mature cystic teratoma and a trabecular carcinoid, classified as ovarian carcinoid stage IA. Postoperative CA19-9 and CA125 were measured, and the report describes immunohistochemical features of a primary ovarian carcinoid coexisting with mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-14662028.summary_ja: 1992年から2002年に治療された日本人性腺外胚細胞腫瘍30例の後方視的解析。非セミノーマの5年全生存期間(OS)は71%、無増悪生存期間(PFS)は42%であった。治療7日目の一過性の腫瘍マーカー上昇は予後不良と関連した。国際研究と同等の成績で、民族差は示唆されなかった。
pmid-14662028.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 30 Japanese patients (25 nonseminomas, 4 pure seminomas) with extragonadal germ cell tumors treated from 1992 to 2002. Five-year overall survival and progression-free survival for nonseminoma were 71% and 42%. Transient elevation of AFP or beta-HCG on day 7 of treatment was significantly associated with poorer survival and progression-free survival. Outcomes appeared comparable to international series, and day-7 tumor marker changes may help identify patients needing more intensive treatment.

pmid-14662230.summary_ja: 妊娠28週で頭痛と意識消失を呈した症例。脳と肺の病変、高値のβ-hCGから絨毛癌の転移性病変と診断された。母体予後改善のため早産帝王切開を施行し、その後化学療法に反応した。母体は対麻痺を残したが、児に明らかな後遺症はなかった。妊婦の急性神経症状では絨毛癌を鑑別に入れるべきと強調している。
pmid-14662230.summary_en: A case report of a pregnant woman at 28 weeks' gestation who presented with headache and loss of consciousness. Imaging showed cerebral and pulmonary lesions, and a high beta-hCG level supported a diagnosis of metastatic choriocarcinoma. A premature cesarean delivery was performed to improve maternal prognosis before chemotherapy. Maternal outcome was favorable despite paraplegia, and the infant had no apparent sequelae. The authors emphasize considering choriocarcinoma when acute neurological signs arise in pregnant patients.

pmid-14662429.summary_ja: 早期精巣がんの管理を概説したレビュー（Part I）。根治的精巣摘除術が基本治療で、血管侵襲の有無によるリスク分類が補助療法やサーベイランスの選択を導く。高リスク例では補助化学療法により再発率を5%未満に抑えられる。低リスク例のサーベイランスは許容されるが、早期非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の管理には統一見解がない。
pmid-14662429.summary_en: This Lancet Oncology review (Part I) outlines management of early-stage testicular cancer. Radical orchidectomy is the primary intervention. Seminoma patients usually receive adjuvant radiotherapy, while non-seminomatous patients may choose surveillance, adjuvant chemotherapy, or retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection. Risk stratification by vascular invasion guides decisions: about half of high-risk patients relapse without adjuvant therapy, reduced to under 5% with it. Low-risk patients can be safely surveilled because metastatic recurrence remains curable. Management of early non-seminomatous disease lacks consensus given near-100% survival.

pmid-14662430.summary_ja: 進行精巣がん（転移性胚細胞腫瘍）を扱うLancet Oncologyレビューの第II部。従来のプラチナ併用化学療法で最大80%が治癒可能とされ、予後分類に基づく治療選択を論じる。再発例では救援化学療法や大量化学療法＋幹細胞移植が用いられ、予後不良例では初回からの用量強化療法や移植が検討される。
pmid-14662430.summary_en: Part II of the Lancet Oncology review addresses advanced testicular cancer. Up to 80% of metastatic germ-cell tumours are curable with cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide. Patients are stratified into good, intermediate and poor prognosis groups. Relapsed patients need salvage therapy, which may add ifosfamide or taxol or use high-dose chemotherapy with stem-cell transplantation. Poor-prognosis patients often fail conventional chemotherapy and may be candidates for dose-intensive protocols or transplantation as first-line treatment. The authors note that outcomes exceed other solid tumours but further improvement is needed.

pmid-14663834.summary_ja: 超音波で仙尾部奇形腫が検出された胎児の出生前診断例を報告。7q末端欠失と2p部分トリソミーが確認され、FISHでCurrarino症候群に関連するHLXB9のハプロ不全が示された。新生児は術後合併症により生後7日で死亡した。奇形腫はCurrarino症候群の部分型である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-14663834.summary_en: Case report of prenatal diagnosis of a fetus with sacrococcygeal teratoma and facial dysmorphism. Cytogenetic analysis revealed a constitutional terminal 7q deletion and 2p partial trisomy, likely from a de novo balanced translocation. The teratoma was detected by sonography, prompting prenatal karyotyping, which was confirmed at birth. The newborn died of postoperative complications at seven days. FISH showed HLXB9 haploinsufficiency, a gene linked to Currarino syndrome. The authors suggest the fetal teratoma may represent a partial, atypical Currarino syndrome presentation without other triad features.

pmid-14665362.summary_ja: 1989〜1998年に純粋精巣奇形腫29例に後腹膜リンパ節郭清（初回または化学療法後）を施行した後方視的検討。79%に後腹膜病変があり、62%は進行病期で発症していた。化学療法後の切除標本では奇形腫9例、線維化8例、卵黄嚢腫瘍1例が認められた。低病期でも後腹膜転移が多く再発リスクも高く、純粋奇形腫の転移能の高さが示された。
pmid-14665362.summary_en: Retrospective review of 29 patients with pure testicular teratoma who underwent primary (n=11) or postchemotherapy (n=18) retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy between 1989 and 1998. Retroperitoneal disease was present in 79%, and 62% presented with advanced disease. Postchemotherapy specimens showed teratoma in 9, fibrosis in 8, and yolk sac tumour in 1. Despite complete resection or favourable histology, a substantial relapse risk persisted, supporting the metastatic potential of pure testicular teratoma even at low clinical stage.

pmid-14666633.summary_ja: 精巣の高リスク臨床病期I・病期IMの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍52例に対し、CEB90（カルボプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン）2サイクルを補助療法として用いた前向き試験。96%が無病生存し、忍容性は良好だった。病期IM患者の2例は再発し、救援化学療法後も腫瘍により死亡した。シスプラチン併用レジメンと同等の有効性が期待できる治療選択肢と考察されている。
pmid-14666633.summary_en: Prospective HECOG trial of two cycles of carboplatin, etoposide and bleomycin (CEB90) as adjuvant therapy for 52 patients with high-risk clinical stage I or stage IM non-seminomatous germ cell tumours. High-risk features included vascular invasion, embryonal carcinoma, and absent yolk sac tumour, or marker positivity after orchidectomy. At median 112 months follow-up, 96% were alive and disease-free. Two stage IM patients relapsed with disseminated disease and died despite salvage therapy. Two cycles were well tolerated, with myelotoxicity and alopecia as main toxicities. The authors suggest it may be an equally effective option to cisplatin-based regimens.

pmid-14667497.summary_ja: Cancer Cell誌の論説で、Oct-4がPOUクラスのホメオボックス遺伝子として精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生に重要な役割を果たすという知見を紹介。多くの固形腫瘍で見られるホメオボックス遺伝子の発現異常が発がんに機能的に関わることを論じ、他のがん促進遺伝子との違いを解説している。
pmid-14667497.summary_en: A Cancer Cell editorial commenting on Gidekel et al., which shows that Oct-4, a POU-class homeobox transcription factor, is a critical player in the genesis of testicular germ cell tumours. The commentary places this within the broader theme that deregulated homeobox gene expression, common in many solid tumours, is functionally relevant to carcinogenesis. It highlights features that distinguish homeobox genes from other cancer-promoting genes, using the Oct-4 finding as the central example.

pmid-14667503.summary_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍の全検体（前がん病変を含む）でOct-3/4の発現を確認。ES細胞モデルでは、Oct-3/4の発現量に依存して腫瘍形成能が変化し、不活性化により悪性成分は退縮した。Oct-3/4はGCTの特徴的な免疫組織化学マーカーであるとともに、発生に重要な役割を果たすと結論づけられている。
pmid-14667503.summary_en: Study showing that Oct-3/4, a transcription factor sustaining embryonic stem cell self-renewal, is expressed in all human testicular germ cell tumours tested, including premalignant components. In embryonic stem cell models, Oct-3/4 dose-dependently determines oncogenic potential: high levels increase malignancy, while inactivation causes regression of malignant components. Ectopic expression transforms non-tumorigenic cells and confers tumorigenicity in nude mice. The authors propose Oct-3/4 as both a distinctive immunohistochemical marker for GCTs and a critical driver of their genesis.

pmid-14668599.summary_ja: 胚細胞分化を伴う直腸腺がんで血清AFPが単独上昇した26歳男性の症例報告。プラチナ製剤、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法でAFPの低下と腫瘍縮小が得られたが、肝転移を生じ診断後20か月で死亡した。胚細胞分化成分が胚細胞腫瘍向けの治療に反応しうることを示す一方、予後は不良だった。
pmid-14668599.summary_en: Case report of a 26-year-old man with colorectal adenocarcinoma showing germ-cell differentiation and an isolated elevation of serum AFP. He received platinum/etoposide/bleomycin chemotherapy, with decreasing AFP and tumour shrinkage. Switching to concurrent 5-FU chemotherapy and radiation therapy maintained the marker response. He underwent palliative diversion at 10 months, developed liver metastasis at 12 months, and died at 20 months. The case suggests germ-cell-differentiated components may respond to germ cell regimens, although prognosis was poor.

pmid-14669091.summary_ja: 45歳男性の空腸原発絨毛癌の症例報告。免疫組織化学で診断されたが、全身化学療法にもかかわらず術後5か月で肝転移により死亡した。文献レビューでは大量消化管出血と血清hCG上昇が特徴とされ、早期診断と速やかな化学療法の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-14669091.summary_en: Case report of primary choriocarcinoma of the jejunum in a 45-year-old man, diagnosed by immunohistochemistry on a resected specimen. Despite combined systemic chemotherapy, he died of progressive liver metastases five months after surgery. Serum hCG rose dramatically as the liver tumour progressed. A review of 13 small-intestinal choriocarcinoma cases in the English literature through 2001 identified massive gastrointestinal bleeding and elevated serum hCG as characteristic features. The authors emphasise early diagnosis and prompt chemotherapy as the only route to improving the poor prognosis.

pmid-14670177.summary_ja: 279例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍から作製した組織マイクロアレイを用い、JUP、GRB7、CCND2、MGMT、FHITの発現を免疫組織化学で解析。JUP、GRB7、CCND2は腫瘍で高発現し、前がん病変はすべてJUP陽性だった。MGMTとFHITは腫瘍で発現が低下し、CCND2以外は組織型と有意に関連した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍のマーカー評価を行う高スループットツールが提示されている。
pmid-14670177.summary_en: Tissue microarray study of 510 testicular tissue cores from 279 patients with TGCT, evaluating candidate genes JUP, GRB7, CCND2, MGMT and FHIT by immunohistochemistry. JUP, GRB7 and CCND2 were rarely expressed in normal testis but frequently highly expressed in TGCT, and all premalignant intratubular neoplasias were JUP-positive. MGMT and FHIT were expressed in normal testis but less often in tumours. Except for CCND2, marker expression correlated with TGCT subtypes. The authors present this as a high-throughput tool for validating TGCT markers.

pmid-14672002.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の治療後に肺転移が出現した23歳男性の症例である。救援化学療法（VIP療法）は腫瘍縮小効果が得られず、胸腔鏡下切除により3病変すべて横紋筋肉腫と診断された。その後CYVADIC療法と経口シクロホスファミドを行い、切除後1年時点で再発は認められていない。
pmid-14672002.summary_en: A 23-year-old man with a testicular mixed germ cell tumor (seminoma, yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma) and mature teratoma in a lymph node had undergone orchiectomy, PEB chemotherapy, and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. When pulmonary metastases appeared, two courses of VIP salvage chemotherapy failed to shrink them. Video-assisted resection revealed rhabdomyosarcoma in all three nodules. Subsequent CYVADIC chemotherapy and oral cyclophosphamide were given, and no recurrence was evident one year later.

pmid-14672473.summary_ja: SEERデータを用い、1973年から1999年の妊娠性絨毛癌450例の動向を解析した研究。発生率は約50%低下し、生存率は改善していた。黒人女性で発生率が高く、生存率が低かった。進行期や高齢でも生存率は低下していた。5年相対生存率は89.5%であった。
pmid-14672473.summary_en: This population-based study used SEER data to analyze trends in gestational choriocarcinoma among 450 cases recorded from 1973 to 1999. Incidence declined by nearly 50 percent over the period, and survival improved. Incidence was higher among Black women and in women aged 20 to 39, while survival was lower among Black patients, those with advanced stage, and older patients. The 5-year relative survival rate was 89.5 percent.

pmid-14672474.summary_ja: 腹腔内出血と子宮内妊娠を認めない妊婦で、血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値は317,735mIU/mLであった。左前腹壁の出血性腫瘤を腹腔鏡下に切除し、妊娠性絨毛癌と診断された。FIGO IV期:4で、併用化学療法により臨床的寛解が得られた。原発性腹部妊娠性絨毛癌の初めての報告である。
pmid-14672474.summary_en: A pregnant woman presented with vaginal spotting, a serum hCG of 317,735 mIU/mL, and hemoperitoneum without an intrauterine pregnancy. A friable bleeding mass on the left anterior abdominal wall was laparoscopically resected and identified as gestational choriocarcinoma. The disease was staged as FIGO IV:4, and she achieved clinical remission with combination chemotherapy. The authors note that primary abdominal gestational choriocarcinoma had not been previously described, and that it can mimic a ruptured ectopic pregnancy.

pmid-14672475.summary_ja: 最終月経から40日後に巨大な卵巣腫瘤を呈した女性の症例である。DNAマイクロサテライト解析で、腫瘍は母由来1本・父由来2本の対立遺伝子を示した。部分胞状奇胎に由来する卵巣妊娠による卵巣絨毛癌と考えられ、このような報告は初めてである。遺伝子解析は治療方針の決定に有用である。
pmid-14672475.summary_en: A woman presented with a huge ovarian mass 40 days after her last menstrual period. DNA microsatellite analysis of the tumor showed a single maternal and two paternal alleles at several independent loci. These findings are consistent with the tumor arising from an ovarian pregnancy of a partial hydatidiform mole. The authors describe this as the first reported case of ovarian choriocarcinoma derived from an ovarian pregnancy of a partial mole. Genetic analysis helps determine whether a choriocarcinoma is gestational or nongestational, guiding treatment.

pmid-14675327.summary_ja: HIV感染女性12例と非感染女性29例の妊娠性絨毛性疾患を後方視的に比較した研究。CD4値が200を超える患者には標準的化学療法が行われ、全体の93%が治癒した。CD4値が低く化学療法を受けなかった2例は死亡した。HIV感染者でも標準治療が適切と提案されている。
pmid-14675327.summary_en: This retrospective study compared 12 HIV-infected women with 29 non-HIV-infected women who had gestational trophoblastic disease. Patients with CD4 counts above 200 cells/microl received standard chemotherapy, and 93 percent of all patients were cured. Two HIV-infected women with very low CD4 counts did not receive chemotherapy and died of their disease. None of the HIV-infected patients who received chemotherapy died. The authors suggest that standard therapy is appropriate for HIV-infected women with choriocarcinoma and CD4 counts above 200.

pmid-14675328.summary_ja: 本研究は、免疫組織化学法を用いて、正常胎盤、胞状奇胎および絨毛癌におけるE-カドヘリンとカドヘリン-11の発現を検討し、胞状奇胎のフォローアップと対比した。初期胎盤では、E-カドヘリンのメチル化も評価された。E-カドヘリンの免疫反応性は絨毛癌と完全胞状奇胎で低下し、完全胞状奇胎3例では高メチル化がみられた。カドヘリン-11は完全胞状奇胎で高く、絨毛癌では低かった。いずれのマーカーも遷延性栄養膜細胞疾患との関連は認められなかった。
pmid-14675328.summary_en: This study examined E-cadherin and cadherin-11 expression in normal placentas, hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas using immunohistochemistry, and correlated findings with mole follow-up. E-cadherin methylation was assessed in first-trimester placentas and molar tissue. E-cadherin immunoreactivity was reduced in choriocarcinoma and complete moles, with hypermethylation in three complete moles. Cadherin-11 was higher in complete moles but lower in choriocarcinoma. Neither marker was associated with persistent trophoblastic disease.

pmid-14676454.summary_ja: 23歳女性に生じた良性卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告です。三胚葉由来の組織を含む嚢胞内に、胎児様構造(ホムンクルス)が認められました。頭蓋冠の一部欠損から大脳皮質などの組織が突出しており、まれな所見として報告されています。
pmid-14676454.summary_en: This case report describes a benign ovarian mature cystic teratoma from a 23-year-old woman that contained a homunculus, a partial fetus-like structure. The cyst included tissues derived from all three germ layers. The homunculus had a distinct cranial structure with one upper limb and a partially developed osteocartilaginous skeleton. Cerebral cortex, retinal pigment, and leptomeninges were extruded through a partially disrupted calvarium. The report documents this rare anatomical finding within a common benign germ cell tumor of the ovary.

pmid-14677093.summary_ja: 頭蓋外の非精巣性胚細胞腫瘍を含む小児・思春期患者39例を対象とした第II相試験です。イホスファミド、エトポシド、シスプラチンを併用した温熱化学療法を実施しました。完全奏効は20例でした。5年全生存期間(OS)は0.52、無イベント生存期間(EFS)は0.39でした。初回再発時に施行した場合に効果が最も高いと報告されています。
pmid-14677093.summary_en: This phase II study evaluated thermochemotherapy (TCH) combining ifosfamide, etoposide, and cisplatin with regional deep hyperthermia in 39 children and adolescents with unresectable or relapsed tumors, including 24 with extracranial non-testicular germ cell tumors. Twenty patients achieved complete response. Five-year event-free and overall survival were 0.39 and 0.52. Most relapse patients achieved sustained remission with multimodal treatment, and the effect was greatest when TCH was given at first relapse.

pmid-14680316.summary_ja: セミノーマの再発管理とフォローアップ戦略をまとめた総説です。病期Iで監視療法中に後腹膜に限局して再発した場合は放射線療法、大きな腫瘤や全身転移ではシスプラチン併用化学療法が必要とされます。救援化学療法にはイホスファミドとシスプラチンを含むレジメンを用い、難治例には大量化学療法と幹細胞救援を行います。
pmid-14680316.summary_en: This review outlines management of recurrence and follow-up for seminoma, including selected high-risk groups. Seminoma is highly sensitive to radiation and chemotherapy. Localized retroperitoneal recurrence after surveillance for stage I disease can be treated with radiotherapy, while bulky or systemic recurrence requires cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Salvage chemotherapy uses ifosfamide- and cisplatin-containing regimens, and refractory cases need high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell rescue. Long-term follow-up is needed for late recurrence and second primary tumors.

pmid-14680317.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)の再発時の臨床像と治療選択肢をまとめた総説です。腫瘍マーカーや画像診断の進歩、シスプラチン併用化学療法の改善、外科的切除の丁寧な実施により治癒率が大幅に向上しました。再発は過去20年で減少しており、救援率の向上には専門施設での治療が推奨されています。
pmid-14680317.summary_en: This review describes clinical features and management options for most recurrence situations in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCTs) of the testis. Reliable serum tumor markers, improved imaging, effective cisplatin-based regimens, and meticulous surgical technique have markedly improved cure rates and reduced recurrence incidence over the past two decades. Because recurrence is now rare, the authors emphasize that patients should be managed at centers with extensive NSGCT experience to optimize salvage rates.

pmid-14682439.summary_ja: 1960～1995年にカリフォルニアで生まれた男性を対象とした症例対照研究で、精巣がんと親・出生時因子の関連を検討しました。症例1,645例に対し、対照を各症例3例ずつ設定しました。母親の年齢の上昇や初産・経産回数の少なさはリスク上昇と関連しました。セミノーマでは出生体重1500～2499gの正期産児でリスクが高い傾向がありました。
pmid-14682439.summary_en: This California birth-certificate-linked case-control study examined parental and birth characteristics in relation to testicular cancer risk among males born 1960-1995, using 1,645 cases and three matched controls per case. Higher maternal age and primiparity or low multiparity were associated with increased risk. Among seminomas, term infants with birth weights of 1500-2499 g had elevated risk. Findings suggest that maternal estrogen exposure and fetal growth factors may influence testicular cancer, especially seminoma.

pmid-14685907.summary_ja: 10か月の乳児に生じた眼窩奇形腫の症例報告で、肉腫様変化を伴う悪性奇形腫でした。当初は肉腫と診断され化学療法と放射線療法を受けましたが、進行性の眼球突出と頭蓋内進展が疑われたため眼窩内容除去術が行われました。3年間のフォローアップで再発はありません。新生児の眼窩腫瘤の鑑別診断に奇形腫を含めるべきと結論づけています。
pmid-14685907.summary_en: This retrospective case report describes a 10-month-old child with an orbital teratoma showing malignant sarcomatous change. Initial fine needle aspiration suggested sarcoma, and the child received chemotherapy and radiotherapy before exenteration because of progressive proptosis and suspected intracranial extension. Histopathology confirmed a teratoma with malignant sarcomatous elements. The child remained free of recurrence at 3 years of follow-up. The authors recommend including orbital teratoma in the differential diagnosis of neonatal orbital masses and note that FNAB is unhelpful for diagnosis.

pmid-14686733.summary_ja: HIV陽性の男性に生じた精巣セミノーマの頭蓋内転移の症例報告です。CTとMRIの所見は髄膜腫や悪性リンパ腫に類似していました。AIDS患者では精巣セミノーマのリスクが高いと指摘されています。外科的切除後には放射線療法を検討し、全身病変がある場合は化学療法も組み込むべきとしています。
pmid-14686733.summary_en: This case report describes what appears to be the first intracranial metastasis from testicular seminoma in an HIV-positive man. Imaging of the lesion mimicked meningioma or lymphoma. The authors note an increased risk of testicular seminoma in AIDS patients and suggest that intracranial metastases may occur when lymph node involvement is present at diagnosis. After surgical removal of the intracranial lesion, radiotherapy should be considered, and chemotherapy should be included when systemic disease is present.

pmid-14686754.summary_ja: 27歳男性の性腺外後腹膜胎児性癌で、肺転移を伴う症例報告です。胸部X線で多発陰影を認め、腹部に6cmの硬い腫瘤を触知しました。胸腔鏡下手術で切除した肺腫瘍が胎児性癌と診断されました。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法3コースで完全寛解に至り、その後の手術では悪性細胞は認められませんでした。
pmid-14686754.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old Japanese man with multiple lung shadows on chest X-ray and a palpable 6 cm hard abdominal mass. Video-assisted thoracoscopic resection of a lung tumor revealed embryonal carcinoma, leading to a diagnosis of extragonadal retroperitoneal embryonal carcinoma with lung metastases. He received three courses of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin and achieved complete remission. Subsequent surgery found no malignant cells in the lung lesions or primary site, showing a favorable response to chemotherapy.

pmid-14691298.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、絨毛癌（8例）、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（3例）でP-LAPとA-LAPの発現を解析した研究です。両酵素は胎盤形成期の浸潤性絨毛外栄養膜細胞で発現し、絨毛癌や胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍ではさらに強く発現していました。ペプチド基質の分解を介して、栄養膜細胞の浸潤性に関与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-14691298.summary_en: The authors examined placental leucine aminopeptidase (P-LAP) and adipocyte-derived leucine aminopeptidase (A-LAP) in normal placenta, gestational choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumor. Both enzymes were expressed in invasive extravillous trophoblasts during placentation and were more strongly expressed in all choriocarcinomas and placental site trophoblastic tumors, localized to invasive tumor cells. Findings suggest involvement in trophoblast invasiveness through degradation of peptide substrates.

pmid-14692229.summary_ja: 2歳男児の思春期前精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例です。隣接する精巣組織の精細管外に同心円状の層状石灰化があり、残存精巣の超音波検査でも微小石灰化が確認されました。両側精巣微小石灰化と卵黄嚢腫瘍の併存は初めての報告で、先天的なセルトリ細胞機能異常や性腺の胚発生異常が示唆されています。
pmid-14692229.summary_en: A 2-year-old boy had a prepubertal testicular yolk sac tumor. Concentrically laminated microliths were located outside the seminiferous tubules in adjacent testicular tissue, and ultrasonography revealed microlithiasis in the remaining testis, indicating bilateral testicular microlithiasis. The authors note that microlithiasis has been associated with cryptorchidism, intratubular germ cell neoplasia and germ cell tumors. This combination has not been reported previously, and early-onset microlithiasis suggests congenital Sertoli cell dysfunction or abnormal gonadal embryogenesis.

pmid-14694979.summary_ja: 性腺や正中線上に多い胚細胞腫瘍と類似した組織像を示す、正中線外に生じる腫瘍をまとめた総説です。体細胞性腫瘍の中に胚細胞様成分として見られる場合と、純粋な形で生じる場合があります。各胚細胞腫瘍型に対応する形態学的・免疫組織化学的特徴が整理されています。
pmid-14694979.summary_en: This review examines germ cell tumor-like neoplasms arising outside the anatomic midline, which typically occur in gonads or midline extragonadal sites. Such lesions may represent germ cell-like components within somatic neoplasms or occur as pure forms. The authors review the morphologic and immunohistochemical features of these proliferations, organized by the type of germ cell tumor each recapitulates.

pmid-14709841.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株を用い、EGFがα2インテグリン発現を誘導して浸潤能を高めることを示した研究です。コラーゲンへの接着能は変化せず、化学運動性活性が増加しました。hCG分泌も増加し、正常栄養膜細胞に類似した分化を示しました。抗α2インテグリン抗体で効果は抑制されました。
pmid-14709841.summary_en: Using BeWo choriocarcinoma cells, the authors show that epidermal growth factor (EGF) induces alpha2 integrin expression at mRNA and protein levels. EGF increased human chorionic gonadotropin secretion, suggesting functional trophoblast-like differentiation, and dose-dependently enhanced invasiveness and chemokinetic activity, without altering collagen adhesion. An anti-alpha2 integrin antibody blocked these effects, suggesting EGF may promote trophoblast invasion into endometrium through integrin-mediated motility.

pmid-14710278.summary_ja: 1988〜1998年にリヤドの病院で6万4千例以上の妊娠を後方視的研究として調べ、胞状奇胎59例と絨毛癌2例を確認しました。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発生率は期間中に有意に低下し、現在はヨーロッパと同程度です。適切な管理には迅速な診断、リスク分類、化学療法や外科的管理が重要とされています。
pmid-14710278.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed records of 64,762 pregnancies at a Riyadh hospital from 1988 to 1998, identifying 59 hydatidiform moles and 2 choriocarcinomas. Incidence of gestational trophoblastic disease declined significantly over the period and is now comparable to Europe. The authors emphasize that optimal management depends on prompt diagnosis, correct risk stratification, and appropriate chemotherapy and surgery.

pmid-14710279.summary_ja: 1999年〜2002年にオマーンの大学病院で良性付属器腫瘍の手術を受けた110例を対象とした後方視的研究です。腹痛が最も多い症状（65%）で、多くは開腹下の卵巣嚢腫摘出術を受けていました。最も多い組織型は成熟奇形腫（28%）で、再発は少数でした。良性付属器腫瘍の臨床像と組織型の傾向を示す報告です。
pmid-14710279.summary_en: This retrospective study of 110 patients who underwent surgery for benign adnexal tumors at Sultan Qaboos University Hospital between 1999 and 2002 describes clinical presentation and histopathology. Abdominal pain was the most common symptom (65%). Most patients underwent laparotomy and ovarian cystectomy. Benign mature teratoma was the most frequent histologic type (28%), and recurrences were few.

pmid-14710290.summary_ja: 5か月女児と4か月男児に発生した成熟型の腸間膜奇形腫の2例を報告しています。出生前診断例を除けば、文献上最も若い年齢の症例です。腸間膜奇形腫は極めて稀な性腺外奇形腫で、三胚葉性または二胚葉性の組織を含みます。診断法、鑑別診断、治療についても考察されています。
pmid-14710290.summary_en: The authors describe two cases of mature mesenteric teratoma, in a 5-month-old girl and a 4-month-old boy. Excluding a recently reported prenatally diagnosed case, these are the youngest reported in the literature. Mesenteric teratoma is an extremely rare extragonadal tumor arising from totipotent primordial cells and containing tridermal or bidermal tissues. The paper also discusses diagnostic tools, differential diagnosis and management.

pmid-14712896.summary_ja: 若年男性3例の精巣腫瘍に対し精巣温存手術を施行した報告。良性2例（ライディッヒ細胞腫、良性奇形腫）では精巣を温存できた。セミノーマの1例では、術前超音波検査で指摘されなかった浸潤性の別病変が残存精巣に認められ、根治的精巣摘除術へ移行した。
pmid-14712896.summary_en: This report describes testis-sparing surgery in three young men with testicular tumours. Two lesions were benign (a Leydig cell tumour and a benign teratoma), and testicular preservation succeeded in these patients. The third patient had a seminoma diagnosed by frozen section. A separate invasive, poorly differentiated nodule was found in the residual testis, which preoperative ultrasound had not detected, so he was converted to radical orchidectomy. The case shows the technique's feasibility while highlighting the risk of occult disease in malignant cases.

pmid-14738579.summary_ja: 新生児の胃奇形腫2例を報告した論文。1例は低出生体重の早産児で、巨大な未熟奇形腫を認めた。新生児に生じる稀な良性腫瘍であり、完全切除が適切な治療であると結論づけている。
pmid-14738579.summary_en: This report describes two neonates with gastric teratoma. One was a low-birthweight premature infant with a massive immature teratoma. The report emphasises the rarity of this benign tumour in neonates and its unusual gastric location. The authors conclude that complete surgical excision is the appropriate treatment. The brief report offers a clinical description of two cases to inform recognition and management of this rare entity.

pmid-14738635.summary_ja: 336例の卵巣類皮嚢腫について手術記録を評価した観察研究。右卵巣が有意に多く、片側性病変の56.4％が右側であった。両側例を含めても右側優位であった。年齢や嚢腫径は左右で差がなく、卵巣類皮嚢腫は右側に生じやすいと結論づけている。
pmid-14738635.summary_en: This observational study evaluated operative reports from 336 women with ovarian dermoid cysts. The mean cyst diameter was 5.6 cm. Cysts were found in the right ovary (48.8%), the left ovary (37.8%) and bilaterally (13.4%). Among unilateral cysts, right-sided lesions were significantly more frequent than the expected 50%, and this right-sided predominance persisted when bilateral cases were included. Age and cyst size did not differ by side. The authors conclude that dermoid cysts show a predisposition to a right lateral location.

pmid-14743329.summary_ja: 出生時に重篤な呼吸窮迫を呈し緊急手術を要した新生児の縦隔未熟奇形腫の症例報告。切除後にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)値は正常化したが、生後4か月で再上昇し再発が判明した。カルボプラチンを基盤とした化学療法で良好な反応を得て、42か月の観察期間中も良好に経過した。
pmid-14743329.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with a mediastinal teratoma who had severe respiratory distress at birth and required emergency surgery. Histopathology showed an immature teratoma. After excision, the elevated AFP normalised, but it rose again at 4 months and a recurrence was detected. Treatment with carboplatin-based chemotherapy produced a favourable response, and the child was well at 42 months' follow-up. The authors review the literature on this clinical rarity and note that none of the similar reported patients had recurrence or malignancy.

pmid-14743567.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、1987年から1997年に単施設で精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断された60例を検討した。病期I患者は精巣摘除術のみで治療され、再発は認められなかった。シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた47例のうち、部分奏効の31例で後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)が施行され、一部の標本で生存腫瘍が認められた。手術死亡は0%、全生存率は98%であった。両側リンパ節郭清は片側切除に比べ長期の性機能障害と関連していた。
pmid-14743567.summary_en: This retrospective review analysed 60 patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumour of the testis treated at one centre between 1987 and 1997. Patients with stage I disease were managed by orchiectomy alone and none recurred. Among 47 patients treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, 31 with partial response underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND), and viable tumour was found in some specimens. Operative mortality was zero and overall survival was 98%. Bilateral lymphadenectomy was associated with more long-term sexual problems than unilateral resection.

pmid-14986592.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された巨大な心膜内奇形腫の新生児例を報告する。正常分娩後に外科的切除を行い、心膜液貯留や心臓圧迫を防ぐことで救命につながった。生後11か月以上のフォローアップが行われている。これらのまれな性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍は通常良性であるが、速やかな切除が重要である。
pmid-14986592.summary_en: This report describes a newborn with a large intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed prenatally. After normal delivery, the infant underwent surgical resection, which is curative and potentially lifesaving because such lesions can cause massive pericardial effusion and cardiac compression. Clinical follow-up exceeded eleven months. The authors emphasize prompt excision of these usually benign congenital tumors, which are rare extragonadal germ cell tumors.

pmid-15011989.summary_ja: 両側の精巣微小石灰化と片側の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を合併した男性の症例報告である。超音波検査で見つかる微小石灰化は胚細胞腫瘍と関連し、胚細胞腫瘍例では最大40%に認められるとされ、一般集団の0.05～0.6%より高い。両者の関係についての文献的考察を加え、微小石灰化を認めた際の注意点を示している。
pmid-15011989.summary_en: This case report describes a man with bilateral testicular microlithiasis who also had a unilateral testicular germ cell tumor. The paper notes an important association between ultrasound-detected microlithiasis and germ cell tumors, with reported concordance up to 40%, compared with 0.05 to 0.6% in the general population. It reviews the relationship between microlithiasis and germ cell tumors, which is relevant to surveillance of patients with this finding. The clinical significance of microlithiasis is highlighted.

pmid-15022916.summary_ja: 左卵巣の巨大卵巣浮腫と右卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を併存した16歳未婚女性の症例報告である。巨大卵巣浮腫はまれな偽腫瘍であり、病因、形態学的特徴、鑑別診断が検討されている。正しい治療のためにこの病態の認識が重要とされ、ネパールからの初報例である。
pmid-15022916.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old unmarried girl with massive ovarian edema of the left ovary, a rare pseudotumour, coexisting with a mature cystic teratoma of the right ovary. The paper discusses etiopathological concepts, morphological changes, and differential diagnosis. Recognizing this entity is important for correct treatment. The authors note it is the first reported case from Nepal. The mature cystic teratoma is an ovarian germ cell tumor component of this unusual combination.

pmid-15025307.summary_ja: 16歳男性の小網奇形腫の症例報告である。未熟成分を含むにもかかわらず良性の経過をとった。小網奇形腫は極めてまれで、既報はすべて成熟組織のみであった。外科的切除後7年間無病で経過している。未熟成分があっても性腺外奇形腫が必ず悪性として振る舞うわけではないことを示す。
pmid-15025307.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old male with a teratoma of the lesser omentum that behaved benignly despite containing immature elements. Such teratomas are extremely rare, and prior reports described only mature tissue. The patient remained disease-free for seven years after surgical resection. The report highlights that immature components do not always predict aggressive behavior in extragonadal teratomas, which are extragonadal germ cell tumors relevant to this site.

pmid-15025312.summary_ja: 女児に生じた先天性良性頸部奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘍は無症状であった点が特徴的で、甲状腺との関係が注目されている。先天性頸部奇形腫はまれな性腺外胚細胞腫瘍である。頸部の他の腫瘤と誤認されうるため、この提示様式を認識することが正確な診断に重要とされる。
pmid-15025312.summary_en: This case report describes a female infant with a congenital benign cervical teratoma. The tumor was unusual because it was asymptomatic, and its relationship with the thyroid gland is highlighted. Congenital teratomas of the neck are rare extragonadal germ cell tumors. Because neck teratomas can be mistaken for other cervical masses, awareness of this presentation matters for accurate diagnosis and appropriate management.

pmid-15025371.summary_ja: 2歳半の男児に生じた肝原発混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告です。卵黄嚢腫瘍と成熟奇形腫の成分からなり、乳児での報告は初めてです。左肝葉切除と化学療法後にAFPは低下したものの、肝内に広範な転移が出現し、術後6か月で肝機能不全により死亡しました。
pmid-15025371.summary_en: This case report describes a 2.5-year-old boy with a primary mixed malignant germ cell tumor of the left liver lobe, comprising yolk sac tumor and mature teratoma, the first such case reported in an infant. He presented with abdominal distension, upper abdominal pain, and weight loss, and serum alpha-fetoprotein was elevated. After left lobectomy and chemotherapy, AFP levels fell rapidly, but widespread intrahepatic metastases developed, and the patient died of liver dysfunction six months after surgery.

pmid-15072495.summary_ja: 未下降精巣を伴う36歳男性で、傍大静脈部の腫瘤に対し後腹膜リンパ節郭清が行われました。精巣腫瘍や性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を疑いましたが、切除組織は非悪性でした。未下降精巣の最も高い位置は鼠径輪であるため、このような腫瘤が必ずしも腫瘍を示すわけではないと考察しています。
pmid-15072495.summary_en: A 36-year-old man with an undescended right testicle and a paracaval/pararenal mass on CT underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for suspected testicular tumor, metastasis, or extragonadal germ cell tumor. The resected tissue was non-malignant. The authors note that the highest possible location of an undescended testicle is the internal inguinal ring, so paracaval masses in such patients do not necessarily represent testicular tumor, metastasis, or EGT, and they call for further study.

pmid-15244193.summary_ja: 直腸後方に生じた良性嚢胞性奇形腫が膿瘍形成を伴い、高位直腸傍膿瘍と誤診された症例です。診断と治療上の困難点を検討し、文献的考察を加えています。直腸後腔腫瘍は奇形腫が最多の群であり、特殊な部位ゆえに誤診されやすいと述べています。
pmid-15244193.summary_en: A case of a retrorectal benign cystic teratoma complicated by abscess formation was initially misdiagnosed as a high-lying pararectal abscess. The authors describe the diagnostic and therapeutic difficulties and review the literature. Teratomas, chordomas, and dermoids form the largest group of retrorectal tumors, and the unusual location of cystic teratomas can lead to misdiagnosis.

pmid-15745557.summary_ja: 精子保存後に2段階で両側の根治的精巣摘除術を受けた32歳男性のセミノーマ症例です。病理学的に両側の古典型セミノーマで、両側に放射線療法が行われました。腫瘍学的には良好な経過でしたが、心理的フォローアップが必要でした。両側同時性の精巣腫瘍は極めて稀です。
pmid-15745557.summary_en: A 32-year-old man with no children underwent staged bilateral radical orchiectomy after prior sperm banking, with silicone testicular prostheses implanted. Pathology showed bilateral classical seminoma (pT2 on the right, T1 on the left). He received bilateral complementary radiotherapy at 2,500 cGy per side and had a good oncologic outcome, though psychological follow-up was needed. Bilateral synchronous testicular neoplasia is very rare, at about 0.17% of germ cell tumors.

pmid-16210827.summary_ja: 69歳女性の右卵巣類皮嚢腫で、扁平上皮癌(肉腫様形質を伴う)へ悪性転化した症例です。術前に行われたMRI所見を報告しています。卵巣類皮嚢腫の悪性転化は稀であり、MRIによる術前診断の報告も少ないため、画像診断の参考になると考察しています。
pmid-16210827.summary_en: A 69-year-old woman had a right ovarian dermoid cyst that had undergone malignant transformation to squamous cell carcinoma with sarcomatoid features. Preoperative MRI findings are reported. The authors note that malignant transformation of ovarian dermoid cysts is uncommon and that preoperative MRI diagnosis has rarely been described, so the case may serve as an imaging reference.

pmid-16276945.summary_ja: 出生時に破裂した仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告で、文献レビューを併記しています。胎児水腫、水腎症、難産、出血、死亡などの合併症が知られています。出生前診断には超音波検査が第一選択であり、早期診断は臨床判断と予後改善に寄与すると述べています。
pmid-16276945.summary_en: This case report describes a sacrococcygeal teratoma that ruptured at birth, one of its potential complications, and includes a literature review. Other complications include fetal hydrops, hydronephrosis, cervical dystocia, bleeding, and death. Prenatal ultrasonography is the diagnostic method of choice, and early diagnosis guides clinical decisions and improves outcomes.

pmid-17472250.summary_ja: 生後2か月の男児に発生した胃奇形腫の症例報告。出生時から哺乳後の嘔吐が続き、当初は肥厚性幽門狭窄症が疑われた。画像検査により診断が確定したが、劇症の敗血症性髄膜炎を合併し、診断から5日後に死亡した。小児奇形腫の2%未満という極めて稀な腫瘍であり、文献も乏しいため症例として報告された。
pmid-17472250.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-month-old boy with a gastric teratoma, an extremely rare neoplasm accounting for under 2% of pediatric teratomas. He presented with persistent postfeeding vomiting since birth, initially suspected to be hypertrophic pyloric stenosis. Imaging studies established the diagnosis. He also developed fulminant septic meningitis and died five days after the diagnosis was made. The authors report the case because of its rarity and the sparse literature on gastric teratomas in children.

pmid-17472251.summary_ja: フランスの泌尿器科医Chevassu（1877–1957）の業績を紹介する歴史的論文。1906年に128例の精巣腫瘍の組織学的検討に基づき、セミノーマと混合型腫瘍に分ける初の包括的分類を提示した。単純精巣摘除術に疑問を呈し、血管茎を含む精巣摘除とリンパ節郭清を提唱した。この術式は現在も精巣がんの標準治療として用いられている。
pmid-17472251.summary_en: This historical article profiles Maurice Chevassu (1877-1957), a French urologist and surgeon who pioneered the study and treatment of testicular neoplasms. In 1906, based on histological analysis of 128 testicular tumors, he proposed the first comprehensive classification, distinguishing seminomas from mixed tumors. He questioned simple orchiectomy and advocated removal of the testis with its vascular stem plus lymph node dissection. His surgical technique became the standard therapy for testicular cancer and remains in use today.

pmid-17670043.summary_ja: 27歳女性の頸部軟性腫瘤の症例。術前検査で甲状腺に達する上縦隔の嚢胞性病変がみられ、胸腺または前腸嚢胞と診断された。襟状切開で腫瘍を摘除したところ、病理学的に良性の成熟奇形腫と確定した。成人の頸部奇形腫は稀であり、縦隔奇形腫が頸部へ進展する例はさらに稀であるため報告された。
pmid-17670043.summary_en: A 27-year-old woman presented with a soft cervical mass. Preoperative imaging revealed a cystic upper mediastinal lesion extending to the thyroid, initially diagnosed as a thymic or foregut cyst. The mass was removed through a collar incision. Histology confirmed a benign mature teratoma. The authors report this case because cervical teratomas are rare in adults, and mediastinal teratomas extending into the neck are rarer still.

pmid-12476449.summary_ja: 大家系で46,XY性腺異形成を解析し、表現型は女性型外性器から尿道下裂まで多様だった。4例に性腺腫瘍が発生し、性腺芽腫、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、未熟奇形腫が含まれた。男性から男性への伝達がみられ、常染色体優性遺伝が示唆された。非症候性の46,XY性腺異形成に、少なくとも1つの常染色体遺伝子が関与すると結論づけている。
pmid-12476449.summary_en: This study describes a large kindred with 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis, with phenotypes ranging from female external genitalia to hypospadias. Four affected individuals developed gonadal tumors, including gonadoblastoma, dysgerminoma, and immature teratoma. Pedigree analysis showed male-to-male transmission, supporting autosomal dominant inheritance rather than purely X-linked transmission. The findings suggest that at least one autosomal gene contributes to non-syndromic 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis.

pmid-12509630.summary_ja: 重症複合免疫不全マウスの膝関節と皮下にES細胞を移植した研究です。両部位で奇形腫が形成され、関節内のものは関節組織を破壊しました。現時点ではES細胞による関節組織の修復は困難であり、腫瘍増殖を抑えるためのドナー細胞の最適化が必要と結論づけています。
pmid-12509630.summary_en: This study transplanted embryonic stem (ES) cells into the knee joints and subcutaneous spaces of severe combined immunodeficient mice. Teratomas formed at both sites, and those in joints grew and destroyed the joint tissue. Cartilage formation occurred at a similar frequency in both locations, but the cartilage-to-teratoma ratio was higher in the joint. Neomycin-resistance gene detection confirmed that the teratomas originated from the transplanted ES cells. The authors conclude that ES cells cannot currently be used to repair joint tissue and that donor cell optimization is needed to limit tumour growth.

pmid-12511603.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンβ(hCGβ)遺伝子の転写を担う近位Ets-2結合エンハンサーを同定した。絨毛癌由来のJAr・JEG-3細胞などを用い、Ets-2の活性がRas/MAPK経路とT72のリン酸化に依存することを示した。cAMP応答もこの近位エンハンサーを介することを確認し、Ets-2が栄養外胚葉分化関連遺伝子の一般的制御因子である可能性を提唱している。
pmid-12511603.summary_en: This study identifies a proximal Ets-2 binding enhancer that drives human chorionic gonadotropin beta (hCGbeta) gene transcription. Experiments in JAr and JEG-3 human choriocarcinoma cells and NIH3T3 cells show that Ets-2 activity depends on the Ras/MAPK pathway and phosphorylation at threonine 72. The cAMP response of the hCGbeta promoter is also mediated through this proximal enhancer. The authors propose Ets-2 as a general regulator of trophectoderm-associated gene expression. The work is mechanistic and uses choriocarcinoma lines as experimental models rather than clinical patients.

pmid-12514308.summary_ja: 本総説は、レチノイドによる腫瘍細胞分化のモデルとして、ヒト胎児性癌細胞を取り上げている。レチノイド処理により胎児性癌細胞は神経系への終末分化を示し、悪性形質が逆転する。ヒト胚性幹細胞の補完モデルとしての有用性や、レチノイド受容体の下流標的遺伝子を同定する手法も紹介される。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍治療ではなく、細胞分化機構に焦点を当てた内容である。
pmid-12514308.summary_en: This review describes human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells as a model of retinoid-induced tumor cell differentiation. Retinoids can reverse the malignant phenotype of EC cells by inducing terminal neuronal differentiation. The authors explain why EC cells are a practical complement to human embryonic stem cells for studying early development. They also summarize de novo and candidate-gene approaches used to identify downstream retinoid receptor targets during differentiation. The paper addresses chemoprevention and drug resistance concepts in general. Its focus is on cellular differentiation mechanisms rather than clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-12543180.summary_ja: 24歳女性の口腔底に生じた巨大な類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。口腔内アプローチによる指先を用いた摘出術で切除され、整容面で有用とされた。類皮嚢腫を胚細胞腫瘍としてどう位置づけるかには議論があるため、関連性は不確かと判断した。
pmid-12543180.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman with a large dermoid cyst of the floor of the mouth. The cyst was removed by surgical excision through an intra-oral approach using finger-end enucleation. The authors note that the intra-oral approach is useful for cosmetic outcome. The report reviews variations in the surgical management of large floor-of-mouth dermoid cysts. Whether a dermoid cyst counts as a germ cell tumor is debatable, so relevance is uncertain.

pmid-12584204.summary_ja: マウスF9胎児性癌細胞でS1PリアーゼであるSPL遺伝子を破壊すると、細胞内S1Pが増加し、レチノイン酸による原始内胚葉への分化が加速しました。S1P合成阻害で効果は抑えられ、細胞外S1Pには効果がありませんでした。臨床的な腫瘍や患者を対象とした研究ではなく、基礎的な発生生物学研究です。
pmid-12584204.summary_en: Shows that disrupting the sphingosine-1-phosphate lyase (SPL) gene in mouse F9 embryonal carcinoma cells raises intracellular S1P and accelerates retinoic acid-induced differentiation into primitive endoderm. Inhibiting S1P synthesis reversed this effect, while extracellular S1P had none, indicating an intracellular role. SPL expression rises during primitive endoderm differentiation. The work is basic developmental biology using a teratocarcinoma-derived cell line, with no clinical tumor or patient-based component.

pmid-12614775.summary_ja: 7歳男児が外側眼窩と側頭下窩に腫瘤を呈し、手術で2つの独立した類皮嚢腫と判明した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で外側眼窩壁の骨欠損はみられなかった。両病変とも完全に切除された。眼窩領域での複数類皮嚢腫の初報告であり、骨欠損のない別個の嚢胞性病変では複数病変を疑うべきと提言する。
pmid-12614775.summary_en: A 7-year-old boy presented with a lateral orbital mass and an infratemporal fossa mass, which were found at surgery to be two separate dermoid cysts. CT showed no bony defect in the lateral orbital wall. Each lesion was completely excised. The authors describe this as the first reported case of multiple dermoid cysts in the orbital region and suggest that separate cystic lesions without a bony defect should prompt suspicion of multiple lesions.

pmid-12632344.summary_ja: 1988年以降に当施設で扱った小児卵巣腫瘤240例を後方視的に検討した研究である。腫瘍性病変117例のうち、胚細胞腫瘍が79例と最多で、上皮性腫瘍は19例であった。上皮性腫瘍の大半は嚢胞腺腫で、境界悪性や悪性例も含まれた。主題は上皮性腫瘍であり、胚細胞病変との生物学的・臨床的な違いの理解が強調されている。
pmid-12632344.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution review of 240 pediatric ovarian masses focuses on epithelial tumors, which made up 19 of 117 neoplastic cases. Germ cell tumors were the largest group, with 79 cases. Most epithelial tumors were serous or mucinous cystadenomas, with some borderline or malignant lesions; one patient died of ovarian adenocarcinoma. Presentations included abdominal pain or an asymptomatic mass. The authors emphasize that surgeons must understand how epithelial lesions differ biologically and clinically from germ cell lesions.

pmid-12637792.summary_ja: 妊娠由来と腫瘍由来のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の糖鎖アイソフォーム22種を解析した基礎研究です。すべてのアイソフォームは受容体アゴニストとして作用し、糖鎖の違いによって診断用免疫測定が偏ることは示されませんでした。hCG産生悪性腫瘍のモニタリングにも関連しますが、胚細胞腫瘍を個別に扱ってはいません。
pmid-12637792.summary_en: This study characterised 22 urinary pregnancy-derived and tumour-derived hCG glycosylation isoforms, examining their immunoreactivity with 14 monoclonal antibodies, receptor binding and cAMP-based bioactivity. All isoforms retained intact epitopes and acted as receptor agonists, and glycosylation did not cause antibody bias that would exclude isoforms from immunoassays. The findings matter for diagnostic hCG measurement in pregnancy and in monitoring hCG-secreting malignancies. Germ cell tumours are not specifically studied.

pmid-12657513.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JArを用いて、レプチンとグルコース濃度が細胞増殖に与える影響を調べた研究です。高グルコース条件ではレプチンが血清と同程度に増殖を促進し、IRS1とMAPKのリン酸化が増強されました。MAPK阻害剤はこの効果を抑制しました。疾患の臨床像ではなく細胞実験が中心です。
pmid-12657513.summary_en: This study uses the JAr human choriocarcinoma cell line to examine how leptin and glucose concentrations affect cell proliferation. Under high glucose, leptin stimulated proliferation and thymidine incorporation to a level comparable with serum, and this was accompanied by enhanced IRS1 and MAPK phosphorylation. Blocking MAPK with PD98059 inhibited glucose- and leptin-dependent proliferation. Neither glucose nor leptin changed total leptin receptor content. The authors conclude that leptin promotes placental cell proliferation through an IRS1/MAPK pathway in a glucose-dependent manner.

pmid-12694706.summary_ja: 成人の舌に生じたまれな発生性病変の症例を報告し、臨床・病理学的特徴を示しています。皮様嚢胞、奇形腫、choristomaのいずれに分類すべきかという用語の混乱を論じています。単一症例の報告であり、胚細胞腫瘍の観点からは悪性腫瘍ではなく発生異常性病変である点に留意が必要です。
pmid-12694706.summary_en: This report describes a rare developmental lesion of the tongue in an adult, with its clinical and histopathological features. The authors focus on confusing terminology for tongue developmental lesions, specifically whether the lesion should be classified as a dermoid, a teratoma, or a choristoma. The paper presents a single case and discusses how these terms are used. Its relevance to germ cell tumours is limited, because the lesion is a developmental rather than a neoplastic germ cell lesion.

pmid-12724286.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARおよびJEG-3がNK細胞による溶解に抵抗する機序を検討した。NK細胞をCD16、CD244/2B4、レクチンで活性化すると、これらの細胞は溶解された。CD244/2B4のリガンドであるCD48が欠如しており、NK細胞の活性化障害が抵抗性の主因と考えられた。トロフォブラストがNK細胞の攻撃を避ける仕組みの理解に役立つ。
pmid-12724286.summary_en: This study investigated why choriocarcinoma cell lines (JAR and JEG-3) resist natural killer (NK) cell lysis. The authors show that these cells can be killed when NK cells are activated through CD16, CD244/2B4 or lectin stimulation, indicating defective triggering rather than HLA class I expression. The cells lack CD48, the ligand for CD244/2B4. The resistance therefore arises mainly from impaired NK cell activation, partly due to missing triggering ligands such as CD48. These insights help explain how trophoblast avoids NK-mediated attack.

pmid-12749857.summary_ja: F9マウス胎児性癌細胞に、ドキシサイクリンで誘導可能なHNF-4αを導入した基礎研究である。HNF-4αの誘導により細胞が極性を持つ上皮細胞へ分化し、タイトジャンクション蛋白が頂端側に局在した。オクルーディンやクローディン等の発現が用量・時間依存的に増加し、タイトジャンクションのフェンス機能が確立された。腫瘍学的研究ではない。
pmid-12749857.summary_en: Researchers generated F9 murine embryonal carcinoma cells with doxycycline-inducible hepatocyte nuclear factor (HNF)-4α, a nuclear receptor. Induction drove differentiation into polarized epithelial cells, with tight-junction proteins occludin, claudin-6, claudin-7, and ZO-1 concentrated at the apical lateral membranes. HNF-4α increased occludin, claudin-6, and claudin-7 in a dose- and time-dependent manner, and the fence function of tight junctions was established. The study is a basic cell biology study of epithelial morphogenesis rather than a tumor study.

pmid-12760378.summary_ja: 胚細胞癌細胞株NTERA2とヒト胚性幹細胞株H7において、WntおよびNotchシグナル経路遺伝子の発現を比較した。NTERA2ではレチノイン酸処理により多くの遺伝子発現が変化し、神経分化に関与する経路が変動した。両細胞の遺伝子レパートリーはほぼ類似していた。著者らは、これらの経路が胚細胞癌と幹細胞の状態維持や分化制御に関与するモデルを提案し、診断・治療への応用を示唆している。
pmid-12760378.summary_en: The authors compare expression of Wnt and Notch pathway genes in the pluripotent human embryonal carcinoma line NTERA2 and the human embryonic stem cell line H7. Retinoic acid treatment of NTERA2 cells altered transcription of many frizzled, frizzled-related protein, and Notch pathway genes, mirroring neurogenesis. Pathway gene repertoires were largely similar between EC and ES cells. The authors propose a model in which Wnt and Notch signaling maintain EC/ES stem cell states and control their differentiation. They suggest that understanding these mechanisms could aid diagnostic and therapeutic approaches, since EC cells are malignant while their differentiated derivatives are not.

pmid-12782451.summary_ja: 1992年から1997年にかけて米国の26の登録データを用い、思春期・若年成人のがん26,010例の発生パターンを解析した研究である。15〜19歳では卵巣癌の54.6%が胚細胞腫瘍であり、20〜24歳では精巣がんが多い上位のがんの一つであった。年齢とともに小児型から成人型の組織型へ移行することが示された。
pmid-12782451.summary_en: This US population-based study analyzed 26,010 cancer cases among adolescents and young adults from 1992 to 1997. Germ cell tumors accounted for 54.6% of ovarian cancers at ages 15-19, while testicular cancer was among the most common cancers at ages 20-24. Incidence patterns shifted from pediatric to adult histologic subtypes with advancing age.

pmid-12827714.summary_ja: 生後7か月の男児の舌下腫瘤に対し、超音波検査と穿刺吸引細胞診を行った。細胞は良性の扁平上皮で、異型細胞は認められなかった。切除後の病理組織学的検査で皮膚付属器、成熟軟骨、呼吸上皮が確認され、先天性舌下奇形腫様嚢胞と確定した。穿刺吸引細胞診は安全で費用対効果が高く、手術法の選択に有用とされる。
pmid-12827714.summary_en: A 7-month-old boy with a sublingual mass underwent ultrasonography and fine-needle aspiration, which showed benign squamous cells without atypia. Complete oral excision and histopathology revealed skin appendages, mature cartilage and respiratory epithelium, confirming a congenital sublingual teratoid cyst. The authors suggest aspiration cytology is safe, cost-effective and useful for selecting the surgical approach, although it is less informative than CT and MRI in this location.

pmid-12875963.summary_ja: 初期・後期妊娠の胎盤、正期の細胞性栄養膜細胞、絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3およびJarにおけるアポトーシス阻害因子(IAP)の発現を検討した。すべての試料でIAP遺伝子のmRNAが検出され、正常と形質転換した栄養膜細胞では蛋白レベルが異なっていた。IAPは胎盤細胞および形質転換した栄養膜細胞を細胞死から守る役割を持つ可能性が示唆された。主題は正常胎盤の生物学であり、絨毛癌細胞株は比較対象として用いられている。
pmid-12875963.summary_en: This study examined expression of inhibitor of apoptosis (IAP) family members in early and late gestation human placentas, term cytotrophoblasts, and two choriocarcinoma cell lines, JEG-3 and Jar. RT-PCR detected mRNAs for all known IAP genes in all samples. Immunoblotting showed IAP proteins in placentas and differing levels between normal and transformed trophoblast cells. Immunohistochemistry revealed expression patterns varying by cell lineage and differentiation stage. The authors suggest IAPs protect placental and transformed trophoblast cells from apoptosis. The main focus is normal placental biology rather than germ cell or gestational trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-12956793.summary_ja: 胸部へ進展した横隔膜脚後方の腫瘤に対し、胸腹部切開を要するはずだった手術を、手補助腹腔鏡下に行った手技を報告する。転移性胎児性癌のリンパ節転移を完全切除した1例が示されている。開腹手術より合併症が少ない可能性があると結論づけている。
pmid-12956793.summary_en: This report describes a hand-assisted laparoscopic technique for dissecting a retrocrural mass that extended into the chest and would otherwise have required a thoracoabdominal incision. The technique combines laparoscopic and open approaches to improve tactile and visual feedback. It was used to completely resect a nodal metastasis of embryonal carcinoma that had been considered inaccessible to surgical resection. The authors conclude that the approach allows complex dissection with less morbidity than open surgery.

pmid-12968032.summary_ja: EHS腫瘍と、壁側内胚葉様細胞へ分化させた胎児性癌細胞F9の遺伝子発現を網羅的に比較した研究である。両者の類似性から、EHS腫瘍は壁側内胚葉由来と示唆された。基底膜構成成分とその産生機構、転写因子が両者で高発現していた。F9は比較モデルとして用いられ、胚細胞腫瘍の臨床研究ではない。
pmid-12968032.summary_en: The authors profiled gene expression in Engelbreth-Holm-Swarm (EHS) tumors and F9 embryonal carcinoma cells differentiated into parietal endoderm-like cells. Hierarchical clustering showed that EHS and F9 parietal endoderm cells were the most similar among 49 mouse tissues, suggesting EHS tumor is parietal endoderm-derived. Basement membrane components and their production machinery were highly expressed in both. The F9 cells serve as a comparison model rather than a germ cell tumor study.

pmid-13130447.summary_ja: 妊娠中に急速に増大した巨大な舌下類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。嚥下障害と呼吸器症状を呈した。妊娠前の摘出を推奨している。頭頸部の嚢胞性病変であり、典型的な胚細胞腫瘍とは言い難い。
pmid-13130447.summary_en: This case report describes a giant sublingual dermoid cyst that grew rapidly during pregnancy. The patient developed dysphagia and mild respiratory symptoms. Dermoid cysts are epithelium-lined cystic masses with adnexal structures, most commonly in the ovaries and sacrum. The authors suggest that cervical dermoid cysts may enlarge during pregnancy, posing risks to mother and fetus. They recommend removing sublingual dermoid cysts before conception to prevent severe symptoms. The report addresses a head and neck lesion rather than a classic germ cell tumor.

pmid-14523568.summary_ja: 国際作業部会による新生児腫瘍の疫学報告。出生約12,500～27,500例に1例とされ、奇形腫と神経芽腫が主要な組織型である。先天異常との関連(約15%)、遺伝学的・細胞遺伝学的特徴、環境因子が検討された。良性腫瘍でも生命を脅かすことがあり、スクリーニングは全体の予後を明確には改善していないとされる。
pmid-14523568.summary_en: An international working group reviewed the epidemiology of neonatal tumours, which occur in roughly 1 in 12,500-27,500 live births. Teratoma and neuroblastoma are the two most common histological types, often detected on antenatal ultrasound. The authors discuss associations with congenital anomalies (about 15%), genetic and cytogenetic features, and environmental exposures. Benign tumours may be life-threatening, and histologic malignancy does not always correlate with clinical behavior. Screening has not clearly improved overall prognosis.

pmid-14534723.summary_ja: 小児腫瘍58例（神経芽腫、奇形腫、横紋筋肉腫など）でAxin遺伝子の変異を解析した。検出された変異の多くは対照組織にも認められ多型と判断された。腫瘍関連変異は稀であった。奇形腫は複数の腫瘍種の一つであり、胚細胞腫瘍に特化した研究ではない。
pmid-14534723.summary_en: Researchers screened the whole coding region of the Axin gene by PCR-SSCP and sequencing in 58 pediatric neoplasms, including neuroblastomas, teratomas, and rhabdomyosarcomas, against 48 normal control tissues. Six exonic variants and four intronic substitutions were found in tumors, but most were also present in controls and considered polymorphisms. Only a rare codon 98 variant was tumor-specific. The authors conclude that Axin mutations are a rare event in this pediatric series. Teratomas are one of several tumor types, so germ cell content is limited.

pmid-14595189.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、4歳児に生じた両側同時性の前頭頬骨部類皮嚢腫の症例を報告するもの。両病変は上眼瞼溝切開より同時に摘出された。類皮嚢腫の病因、自然経過、治療および予後について文献的考察がなされている。顔面の類皮嚢腫が主題であり、胚細胞腫瘍としての位置づけは明確でない。
pmid-14595189.summary_en: This case report describes a 4-year-old child with bilateral, synchronous frontozygomatic dermoid cysts, a presentation not previously reported in the literature. Both lesions were excised concurrently through upper eyelid crease incisions. The authors review the etiology, natural history, management, and prognosis of dermoid cysts. The paper concerns craniofacial dermoids rather than gonadal or other germ cell tumors, so its relevance to the site's germ cell scope is unclear.

pmid-14625608.summary_ja: 台湾の医療センターで1995〜2001年に診断された14〜17歳の悪性腫瘍320例を腫瘍登録から解析した。17歳では卵巣胚細胞腫瘍が固形腫瘍の上位3位に入った。頭蓋内胚細胞腫瘍は男性優位（91%）、性腺胚細胞腫瘍は女性優位（75%）であった。
pmid-14625608.summary_en: A tumor registry review of 320 adolescents aged 14 to 17 years at a Taiwanese medical center (1995 to 2001) classified cancers into ICCC groups. Leukemia was most common. Among solid tumors in 17-year-olds, ovarian germ cell tumor ranked among the three most common. Intracranial GCT showed the greatest male predominance (91%), and gonadal GCT was female-predominant (75%). Findings are framed as intermediate between childhood and adult cancer patterns.

pmid-14628885.summary_ja: 直腸膨満感と痛みを呈した48歳男性の直腸後腔の非石灰化単房性嚢胞性腫瘤の症例を報告。MRIで嚢胞内の非依存性脂肪球を認め、卵巣類皮嚢腫と同様の所見であり、類皮嚢腫に特異的な画像所見である可能性を提唱している。
pmid-14628885.summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old man with rectal fullness and pain caused by a noncalcified unilocular cystic mass behind the rectum. MRI and CT showed well-defined borders and nondependent fat spheres inside the cyst. The authors note that this fat-sphere pattern has also been described in ovarian dermoid cysts and suggest it may be specific for dermoid cysts. The lesion is a retrorectal dermoid cyst, a lesion within the teratoma spectrum of uncertain origin.

pmid-14672031.summary_ja: 原発巣が特定できなかった57歳女性の縦隔リンパ節癌の症例である。術中迅速診断で転移性と判明した。上大静脈と右肺動脈に接着する約40mmの腫瘤を正中切開下に切除し、術後に放射線療法を行った。著者らは、極めてまれな肺癌（T0N2M0）か原発性縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍のいずれかと考察している。
pmid-14672031.summary_en: A 57-year-old woman presented with a 40 mm mediastinal mass adherent to the superior vena cava and right pulmonary artery, with no primary tumor identified on imaging or postoperative examination. Intraoperative frozen section showed metastatic lymph node carcinoma, and the mass was resected via median sternotomy. Postoperative radiotherapy was given. The authors considered two possibilities: a very rare T0N2M0 lung cancer or primary mediastinal yolk sac tumor.

pmid-14684991.summary_ja: Y染色体上の性腺芽腫候補遺伝子TSPYの前立腺組織における発現を検討した研究です。TSPYは正常上皮や良性前立腺肥大では低く、前立腺がん細胞では高く発現していました。精巣組織との比較も行われています。精巣セミノーマや性腺芽腫との関連が推測されていますが、主題は前立腺がんです。
pmid-14684991.summary_en: This study examined expression of TSPY, a gonadoblastoma candidate gene on the Y chromosome, in prostate specimens using in situ hybridization and immunohistochemistry. TSPY was expressed at low levels in normal epithelium and benign hyperplasia but at elevated levels in prostate cancer cells, and abbreviated transcripts were more frequent in cancer. Testicular tissue was used for comparison. The authors suggest TSPY may contribute to prostate oncogenesis in addition to its putative roles in gonadoblastoma and testicular seminoma.

pmid-14733752.summary_ja: マウスの胎児性癌細胞（P19）が体細胞の初期化（レプログラミング）因子の供給源となり得ることを示した研究。PEG融合によりヒトT細胞株との種間ハイブリッドを作成し、多能性マーカーOct-4とSox-2の発現を確認した。腫瘍生物学や臨床の胚細胞腫瘍を扱ったものではなく、幹細胞研究の文脈である。
pmid-14733752.summary_en: This study shows that mouse embryonal carcinoma (P19) cells can serve as donors of reprogramming factors. PEG-mediated fusion with a human T-lymphoma line produced inter-species hybrids. These hybrids re-expressed the human pluripotency transcription factors Oct-4 and Sox-2 and some human differentiation markers, while CD45 was down-regulated in some hybrids. The embryonal carcinoma cells are used as a stem-cell model and a reprogramming source rather than as a study of tumour biology or clinical germ cell tumours.

pmid-11740618.summary_ja: 妊娠に合併した未熟奇形腫の症例報告である。未熟奇形腫は若年女性に多い原始的な胚細胞腫瘍である。腹膜神経膠腫症を伴っており、特徴的なMRI所見を病理所見と対比して示している。妊娠中の未熟奇形腫のまれな報告として臨床的に意義があり、画像診断の重要性を示す報告である。
pmid-11740618.summary_en: This case report describes an immature teratoma associated with pregnancy, a primitive germ cell tumor that usually affects young women. The tumor was accompanied by gliomatosis peritonei, a rare peritoneal condition with implants of glial tissue. The authors describe unique MR findings and correlate them with pathologic features. The report highlights that immature teratoma is rarely reported in association with pregnancy, and that MRI can provide useful diagnostic information in such cases.

pmid-11740619.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の超音波検査での液液面所見を後方視的に検討した研究である。付属器腫瘤805例を解析し、奇形腫27例で液液面が認められた。各層のエコー輝度により3型に分類した。液液面は奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）を強く示唆するが、確定診断にはならないと結論している。
pmid-11740619.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated ultrasonographic features of ovarian teratomas containing fluid-fluid levels. Reviewing 805 masses, including 370 benign teratomas and 435 nonteratomatous adnexal masses, the authors identified fluid-fluid levels in 27 teratomas and 8 nonteratomatous masses. Teratomas were classified into three types by the echogenicity of each layer, and floating nodules at the interface were seen in 30 percent of teratomas. The authors conclude that fluid-fluid levels strongly suggest but are not pathognomonic of dermoid tumors, while certain patterns may be pathognomonic of benign ovarian teratomas.

pmid-11743283.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜リンパ節郭清で精索に転移を認めた症例を検討した。685例中34例で精索転移がみられ、他施設でRPLNDを受けた後に傍結腸部再発をきたした4例も報告された。精索と周囲リンパ組織の不完全切除が再発の原因となり得るため、郭清時には精索を広範に切除すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-11743283.summary_en: This report analyzes spermatic cord involvement at retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in 34 of 685 patients with testicular germ cell tumors, and four patients who developed paracolic recurrence after RPLND elsewhere. Spermatic cord disease was found in primary and post-chemotherapy RPLND specimens, often without involvement of the primary landing zone or gonadal vessels. The authors conclude that incomplete excision of the spermatic cord and surrounding lymphatic tissue can cause recurrence, and recommend wide excision during RPLND to prevent paracolic relapse.

pmid-11743358.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の異種移植SCIDマウスモデルで、カルボプラチン単剤療法の効果を検討した。カルボプラチン60mg/kgを2回投与すると腫瘍は消失し、6か月間無腫瘍を維持した。一方、エトポシド単剤は無効であった。シスプラチン関連の有害事象を減らすため、高リスク病期I症例での臨床試験が提案されている。
pmid-11743358.summary_en: This study tested carboplatin and etoposide monotherapy in SCID mice bearing human testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor xenografts. Two cycles of 60 mg/kg carboplatin eradicated tumors and reduced vascular density and VEGF-A mRNA, with tumor markers normalizing and animals remaining tumor-free for six months. Single-dose 120 mg/kg carboplatin also eradicated tumors but caused high mortality. Etoposide alone failed at all doses tested. The authors suggest carboplatin monotherapy may be evaluated in high-risk clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell cancer to reduce cisplatin-related morbidity.

pmid-11748644.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を比較し、腫瘍浸潤細胞傷害性T細胞とアポトーシスを検討した。セミノーマでは細胞傷害性マーカー陽性細胞が有意に多かった。胎児性癌ではアポトーシス指数が最も高かった。セミノーマでは活性化グランザイムB陽性細胞数とアポトーシスに強い相関がみられ、良好な予後に関与する宿主免疫機構が示唆された。
pmid-11748644.summary_en: This study compared tumor-infiltrating cytotoxic T lymphocytes and apoptosis in 20 pure testicular seminomas and 20 non-seminomatous germ cell tumors, including 16 mixed tumors. Seminomas had markedly more CD3, CD8, TIA-1 and granzyme B positive cells than non-seminomatous tumors. The apoptotic index was highest in embryonal carcinoma. In seminomas, the number of activated granzyme B positive cells strongly correlated with apoptosis. The authors propose that cytotoxic lymphocyte activity may contribute to the favorable prognosis of seminoma.

pmid-11748992.summary_ja: 32歳女性の卵巣腫瘍は線維肉腫と良性嚢胞性奇形腫からなっていた。奇形腫は三胚葉成分を含み未熟成分はなかった。線維肉腫は奇形腫に直接連続しており、比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションで9、12、16番染色体の不均衡が認められた。1年のフォローアップで再発はなかった。卵巣線維肉腫と良性奇形腫の合併としては2例目の報告である。
pmid-11748992.summary_en: A 32-year-old woman had a 7-cm ovarian tumor composed of fibrosarcoma and benign cystic teratoma. The teratoma contained all three germ layers without immature components, and the fibrosarcoma was directly connected to it. Immunohistochemistry showed vimentin reactivity only, and comparative genomic hybridization revealed chromosomal imbalances of 9, 12 and 16. After one year of follow-up, there was no recurrence or systemic disease. The authors describe this as only the second report of this association and the first including cytogenetic analysis.

pmid-11748994.summary_ja: 産褥期絨毛癌が播種した41歳女性で、左房内に浮遊する腫瘍による肺高血圧が出現した。右下肺静脈を閉塞していた絨毛癌の転移性血栓を心臓手術で切除した。その後、大量化学療法を行い、1年のフォローアップで完全寛解を維持している。稀な部位の転移性絨毛癌でも、腫瘍減量手術と大量化学療法の併用が有用となり得ると述べている。
pmid-11748994.summary_en: A 41-year-old woman with disseminated postpartum choriocarcinoma developed a floating left atrial tumor causing pulmonary hypertension. The mass, a metastatic thrombus of choriocarcinoma obstructing the right inferior pulmonary vein, was resected by intracardiac surgery. She then received high-dose chemotherapy and remained in full remission at one-year follow-up. The authors suggest that tumor reductive surgery followed by high-dose chemotherapy may be a useful approach for metastatic choriocarcinoma, even at rare sites.

pmid-11748999.summary_ja: 腹腔鏡下に摘出した類皮嚢腫から扁平上皮癌が見つかった。摘出時の内容物漏出により、開腹病期分類術で腹膜播種が確認され、FIGO病期Iaから病期IIcに上方修正された。強力な補助療法により妊孕性の喪失を含む有意な合併症が生じた。良性と考えられる卵巣腫瘤を腹腔鏡で扱う際の、予期せぬ悪性腫瘍のリスクが論じられている。
pmid-11748999.summary_en: A dermoid cyst removed laparoscopically was found to contain squamous cell carcinoma, and spillage during removal led to peritoneal implants at staging laparotomy. The disease was upgraded from FIGO stage Ia to IIc. Aggressive adjuvant therapy was given, causing significant morbidity including loss of fertility. The authors discuss the prognostic significance of upstaging and the risk of unexpected malignancy when managing presumed benign ovarian masses laparoscopically, noting that cyst spillage rates are higher with laparoscopy.

pmid-11750968.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴い腹腔内に粟粒状のグリア組織が播種する稀な疾患、腹膜神経膠腫症の2症例を報告した。1例は子宮内膜症を合併していた。両症例は5年以上追跡され、生物学的態度と予後に関するデータが提供された。既報86例のレビューも行われ、腹膜癌腫症と誤診されやすい点が指摘されている。
pmid-11750968.summary_en: This report describes two patients with gliomatosis peritonei, a rare condition in which miliary glial tissue implants in the peritoneal cavity in association with ovarian teratomas. One case coexisted with endometriosis, and both were followed for more than 5.5 years, providing data on the biological behavior and prognosis of this entity. The authors also reviewed the 86 previously reported cases to summarize current knowledge, noting that the condition is easily mistaken for peritoneal carcinomatosis.

pmid-11756117.summary_ja: 産科超音波で発見された仙尾部奇形腫の胎児12例を対象に、MRIの診断・評価上の有用性を検討した。超音波とMRIの計測は完全に一致し、1例では超音波で見逃された脊柱管内進展がMRIで確認された。MRIにより出生前評価や両親へのカウンセリング、治療方針が変更された症例もあり、産科超音波検査の有用な補助手段と結論づけられた。
pmid-11756117.summary_en: This study evaluated the usefulness of MRI in the prenatal diagnosis and assessment of fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma in 12 pregnant women referred after obstetric ultrasound. Sonographic and MRI measurements agreed completely, and MRI revealed a spinal canal extension in one fetus that ultrasound missed. Postnatal findings confirmed MRI in 10 patients. MRI changed prenatal evaluation in some cases and influenced parental counseling and treatment, and the authors conclude that it is a valuable adjunct to obstetric sonography.

pmid-11773182.summary_ja: 進行性純粋セミノーマで初回白金製剤治療後に進行した27例を対象とした研究。従来用量のシスプラチン・イホスファミドまたは自家幹細胞救援を伴う大量化学療法を実施し、56%が完全奏効を得た。残存病変が壊死・線維化のみの患者は良好で、生存セミノーマを認めた例は原病死した。再発例の約半数で持続的寛解が得られた。
pmid-11773182.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 27 patients with progressive advanced pure seminoma who received salvage chemotherapy after first-line platinum-based treatment. Fifteen received conventional-dose cisplatin and ifosfamide, and twelve received high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell rescue. Overall, 56% achieved complete response, and 52% remained alive and disease-free at a median follow-up of 72 months. Patients whose residual masses showed only necrosis or fibrosis generally did well, whereas viable seminoma at surgery predicted death. Roughly half of relapsed pure seminoma patients achieved durable remission.

pmid-11781518.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫5例（成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、未熟奇形腫、混合型胚細胞腫瘍を含む）で、神経組織に伴う顕著な良性血管増生を報告。免疫組織化学により内皮由来を確認した2例を含む。血管内皮増殖因子による二次的な血管新生と考えられ、血管性腫瘍や未熟奇形腫との誤診を避けるうえで重要と述べている。
pmid-11781518.summary_en: This report describes five ovarian teratomas, including mature cystic, immature, and mixed germ cell tumor types, showing prominent benign vascular proliferation associated with neural tissue. The vascular changes, thin-walled curved vessels or glomeruloid structures, were confirmed as endothelial by immunohistochemistry in two cases. The authors interpret this as a secondary angiogenic reaction, likely driven by vascular endothelial growth factor, similar to that seen in high-grade gliomas. Recognizing this benign pattern is important to avoid misdiagnosing a vascular neoplasm or immature teratoma. One patient had widespread metastatic immature teratoma.

pmid-11781529.summary_ja: 34歳女性の卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。主体はポリエンブリオーマで、絨毛癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫の成分を伴っていた。同一組成の既報は見当たらないとし、文献レビューを加えている。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍における組織学的多様性を示す症例である。
pmid-11781529.summary_en: This is a case report of a 34-year-old woman with an ovarian mixed germ cell tumor. The predominant component was polyembryoma, with foci of choriocarcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and immature teratoma. The authors note that no previous cases with this identical composition had been found in the literature, and the report includes a literature review. The case highlights the histologic diversity possible within ovarian germ cell tumors and the importance of recognizing polyembryoma as a component.

pmid-11781530.summary_ja: 6歳女児の卵巣未熟奇形腫の症例。原発巣の横紋筋肉腫成分はわずかだったが、卵巣摘出、化学療法、放射線療法後も骨盤内再発を繰り返し、横紋筋肉腫様に変化した。3年後に全身病変で死亡した。横紋筋肉腫様の再発を伴う場合の予後は不良と結論している。
pmid-11781530.summary_en: A 6-year-old girl with an ovarian immature teratoma containing a minor rhabdomyosarcomatous component developed recurrences that became increasingly rhabdomyosarcomatous despite oophorectomy, chemotherapy, and radiation. She died of systemic disease three years after presentation. The authors describe this as the first such case in a child. Combined with prior reports, they indicate that prognosis with rhabdomyosarcomatous recurrence is poor, similar to primary ovarian rhabdomyosarcoma.

pmid-11788149.summary_ja: 口蓋裂と同側耳管の先天的な置換または欠損を伴う鼻咽腔奇形癌肉腫の1例を報告した。先天性胚細胞腫瘍は仙尾部に多く、頭頸部の奇形腫はさらに稀で、鼻咽腔発生はまれであることを示した。臨床的および組織病理学的特徴を検討し、本症例の位置づけを論じている。
pmid-11788149.summary_en: This case report describes a nasopharyngeal teratocarcinosarcoma associated with a cleft palate and with congenital replacement or absence of the ipsilateral Eustachian tube. The authors note that congenital germ cell tumors most often arise in the sacrococcygeal region, while teratomas of the head and neck are uncommon and nasopharyngeal lesions are rarer still. They review the clinical and histopathological features of this unusual extragonadal presentation, which is generally considered benign when it occurs as a teratoma alone.

pmid-11796908.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍と腫瘍様病変の画像所見と病理所見を対比して解説した。精巣腫瘍の約95%は胚細胞腫瘍で、セミノーマは均一な境界明瞭な病変として描出される。非セミノーマ性腫瘍は多様な画像所見を示し、表皮嚢腫などの良性病変は不要な精巣摘除を避ける手がかりとなる。
pmid-11796908.summary_en: This AFIP teaching review correlates imaging and pathology in testicular tumors and tumor-like lesions. Germ cell tumors account for about 95% of testicular tumors and show varied imaging appearances: seminomas are typically well-defined and homogeneous, while nonseminomatous types such as embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, teratoma, and mixed germ cell tumor appear more heterogeneous. The review describes lymphatic spread to retroperitoneal nodes and hematogenous spread of choriocarcinoma. It also covers benign mimics, such as epidermoid cysts and dilated rete testis, that can avoid unnecessary orchiectomy.

pmid-11799147.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍において、セミノーマと胎児性癌の鑑別にCD30とCD117の免疫染色を併用する有用性を検討した。セミノーマの多くはCD117陽性・CD30陰性、胎児性癌の多くはCD30陽性・CD117陰性であった。両者の併用は高い識別能を示した。
pmid-11799147.summary_en: This study evaluates CD30 and CD117 (c-kit) immunohistochemistry, alone and in combination, to distinguish embryonal carcinoma from seminoma in testicular germ cell tumors. The authors examined 25 pure seminomas, 7 pure embryonal carcinomas, and 7 mixed tumors. Most seminomas were CD117-positive and CD30-negative, while most embryonal carcinomas were CD30-positive and CD117-negative. The combined panel was highly discriminating, and the authors propose it as a valuable differential diagnostic tool.

pmid-11800659.summary_ja: 30歳男性の盲腸に生じた成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）を報告した。細針吸引細胞診で角化物質と無核扁平上皮細胞を認め、右結腸切除術後の組織で診断を確定した。消化管発生の奇形腫は稀であり、結腸周囲嚢胞性病変の鑑別診断を論じている。
pmid-11800659.summary_en: This report describes a mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst) of the cecum in a 30-year-old man who presented with right upper quadrant abdominal pain and a palpable mass. Fine-needle aspiration showed keratinous material and anucleated squamous cells, and histology after right colectomy confirmed a cystic lesion lined by squamous epithelium with sebaceous glands. The authors note that only four prior cecal teratomas had been reported in English literature. They review the clinical, cytologic, and pathologic features and discuss the differential diagnosis of pericolic cystic masses.

pmid-11801470.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する大量化学療法と造血幹細胞移植の現状をレビューした。予後不良例の一次治療や、良好な予後の症例の救援療法として、高い完全寛解率と長期無病生存が報告されている。ただし無作為化試験による検証が必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-11801470.summary_en: This review summarizes the status of high-dose chemotherapy with hematopoietic stem cell transplantation for germ cell tumor patients. Prognostic factors identify patients who may benefit from dose-intensive therapy. High-dose chemotherapy as first-line treatment for poor-risk disease, based on IGCCCG classification, and as salvage therapy for good-risk disease, based on the Beyer prognostic index, is associated with high complete response rates and long-term disease-free survival. The authors note that randomized trials are needed to confirm these findings, and that refractory patients require new strategies.

pmid-11801874.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対する化学療法の現在の標準をレビューした。大多数は吸引掻爬術とhCG監視で治癒するが、一部は化学療法を要する。転移例でも多くは治癒し、予後因子に基づく治療層別化により長期的な治療合併症の軽減が期待される。
pmid-11801874.summary_en: This review covers chemotherapy standards for gestational trophoblastic disease, which ranges from benign complete and partial hydatidiform moles to malignant choriocarcinoma and placental site trophoblastic tumors. Most patients are cured by suction curettage followed by hCG monitoring, but some require chemotherapy. The authors note that most patients are cured even with metastatic disease. Treatment should be stratified by prognostic factors to eliminate disease while minimizing long-term treatment toxicity.

pmid-11809703.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍62例で3p染色体領域の対立遺伝子不均衡と染色体3のコピー数を解析し、FHIT遺伝子およびタンパク質の発現を検討した。FHIT転写産物の異常は41%、Fhitタンパク質の発現低下は62%で認められ、奇形腫の非上皮成分で発現低下が特に強かった。FHIT異常が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-11809703.summary_en: This study analyzed 62 primary testicular germ cell tumors for allelic imbalance at 3p loci and FHIT copy number, and examined FHIT mRNA and protein expression. FHIT transcripts lacking exon 3 were found in 41% of analyzed tumors, and reduced Fhit protein in 62%. Reduced expression was strongest in nonepithelial components of teratomas and showed a non-significant trend toward association with metastasis at diagnosis. The findings suggest FHIT alterations may contribute to testicular germ cell tumorigenesis.

pmid-11810253.summary_ja: インターセッパーズリピートを含むRNAを選択的に増幅し並列表示するSDDIR法を開発した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍と正常精巣組織を比較し、HERV-K由来LTR配列を含む転写産物を解析した。多数のLTR転写産物が検出され、その多くは腫瘍と正常組織で発現量が異なっていた。胚細胞腫瘍ではHERV-K LTRの転写パターンが変化していることが示唆された。
pmid-11810253.summary_en: The authors developed Selective Differential Display of RNAs containing Interspersed Repeats (SDDIR), a method that selectively amplifies RT-PCR products from transcripts carrying a given repeat type and displays them side by side on gels. They applied it to HERV-K LTR-containing transcripts in testicular germ cell tumors versus matched normal testis. Many LTR transcripts were detected, and the levels of numerous transcripts differed between tumor and normal tissue, suggesting altered HERV-K LTR transcription in germ cell tumors.

pmid-11825120.summary_ja: ゴースト様の腫瘍細胞を含む、壊死が広範な精巣腫瘤を報告した。Masson trichrome染色により核や細胞の詳細が明瞭となり、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼの膜陽性所見からセミノーマと確定診断された。壊死性腫瘍の診断に有用な手法として提案されている。
pmid-11825120.summary_en: This report describes a necrotic testicular mass with ghost-like neoplastic cells, initially suspicious for neoplasm. Masson trichrome staining improved nuclear and cytologic detail, supporting the diagnosis. Placental alkaline phosphatase immunostaining showed specific membrane staining, establishing the diagnosis of seminoma. The authors propose that Masson trichrome combined with selected immunostains is a useful approach for diagnosing certain necrotic neoplasms.

pmid-11827596.summary_ja: 17歳女性の急速に増大する顔面腫脹の原因となった、側頭下窩の類皮嚢腫の症例を報告した。類皮嚢腫は最も単純な奇形腫であり、頭頸部の約7%に発生するとされる。Medlineによる検索では同部位の類似報告はなかった。外側アプローチにより完全摘出された。
pmid-11827596.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old girl with a rapidly growing facial swelling caused by a dermoid cyst in the infratemporal fossa. The authors note dermoid cysts represent the simplest form of teratoma and occur in about 7% of head and neck cases. A Medline review found no prior reports of similar infratemporal fossa lesions. The lesion was completely excised through a lateral approach.

pmid-11832725.summary_ja: 思春期後の停留精巣では胚細胞腫瘍のリスクが高いため、精巣摘除術の適応が議論されてきました。本研究は最新の米国データを用いて、胚細胞腫瘍による死亡リスクと周術期死亡率を比較しました。周術期死亡率の低下が大きいことから、健康な男性では50歳までの精巣摘除術を推奨しています。
pmid-11832725.summary_en: This analysis revisits the management of postpubertal cryptorchidism, in which the testis carries a markedly elevated germ cell tumor risk. Using contemporary US mortality data and a relative risk of 9.7, the authors estimated lifetime germ cell cancer death risk and compared it with perioperative orchiectomy mortality by ASA class. Because perioperative mortality has fallen more than germ cell cancer mortality, orchiectomy now carries less risk than previously estimated. The authors therefore advocate orchiectomy in healthy males with postpubertal cryptorchidism until age 50 years, rather than observation after age 32.

pmid-11832775.summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の13例で、末梢血幹細胞移植に用いる採取物に腫瘍細胞が混入しているかをネステッドRT-PCRで調べました。β-hCG mRNAが7例で検出され、いずれも治療前の血清β-hCG値が高値でした。混入があった患者は予後が不良であり、移植用細胞の純度が転帰に影響する可能性が示されました。
pmid-11832775.summary_en: This study tested whether peripheral blood stem cells (PBSCs) collected from patients with advanced testicular germ cell tumors were contaminated with tumor cells. Using nested RT-PCR for beta-hCG and AFP transcripts in 13 patients undergoing PBSC transplantation, the authors detected beta-hCG mRNA in 7 patients but AFP mRNA in none. All patients with detectable beta-hCG mRNA had elevated pretreatment serum beta-hCG levels. Four of these 7 patients eventually died of cancer, whereas patients without contamination survived without disease. Tumor cell contamination was associated with poor prognosis, suggesting that graft purity may influence outcome.

pmid-11834687.summary_ja: 42歳女性の絨毛癌症例で、肺動脈塞栓に対して心肺バイパス下での緊急肺動脈塞栓摘除術が行われました。摘出された腫瘍塞栓の検体で絨毛癌と確定し、6か月の化学療法で完全寛解に至りました。まれではあるが、妊孕年齢の女性の肺塞栓では絨毛癌を鑑別診断に含めるべきと述べています。
pmid-11834687.summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma who presented with pulmonary embolism requiring emergency pulmonary embolectomy under cardiopulmonary bypass. Examination of the tumor emboli specimens confirmed choriocarcinoma. She achieved complete remission with chemotherapy over six months. The authors highlight that choriocarcinoma, although rare, should be considered in the differential diagnosis of fertile women presenting with pulmonary embolism.

pmid-11836719.summary_ja: 母親と生後4か月の息子に転移性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）が発生した症例で、乳児期のPSTTの初報告です。息子は急速に進行し、多臓器に転移した後、入院後5週間で多臓器不全により死亡しました。母親は化学療法と子宮摘出術で治療され、26か月後も病変は認められていません。
pmid-11836719.summary_en: This report describes metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) in a mother and her 4-month-old son, the first reported PSTT in infancy. The infant's disease was aggressive, with widespread metastases to liver, lungs, pleura, kidney, mesentery, and lymph nodes, and he died of multiorgan failure within five weeks of admission. The mother had a uterine tumor and lung metastases, and was treated with chemotherapy and hysterectomy, with no evidence of disease at 26 months. The authors conclude that PSTT can metastasize in both mother and child.

pmid-11842377.summary_ja: 縦隔の上皮性、リンパ性、胚細胞腫瘍の細胞診所見を組織所見と対比して解説している。縦隔の穿刺吸引細胞診は甲状腺や乳腺に比べ普及が遅れており、文献が乏しい。胚細胞腫瘍は主要な3群の一つとして扱われている。
pmid-11842377.summary_en: This review focuses on the cytopathologic features of mediastinal neoplasms, including epithelial, lymphoid, and germ cell tumors. Mediastinal fine-needle aspiration cytology has seen limited adoption compared with thyroid or breast sampling, so the literature is sparse. The authors correlate cytomorphology with corresponding histologic features across tumor categories, with germ cell tumors as one of three main groups. Thymoma is noted as a controversial entity. The paper is relevant as it addresses mediastinal germ cell neoplasms among other types.

pmid-11845934.summary_ja: 縦隔原発の性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で骨髄浸潤を認めた症例報告である。骨髄浸潤はまれな所見であり、文献レビューも併せて行われている。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の転移形式の理解に資する。抄録には治療や転帰の詳細は示されていない。
pmid-11845934.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a primary mediastinal extragonadal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor showing bone marrow involvement, a rare finding. The authors review the literature on this presentation. Bone marrow spread in mediastinal germ cell tumors is uncommon, and the report adds to limited data on metastatic patterns of extragonadal disease.
