pmid-12092011.summary_ja: hCGおよびその関連分子の構造と、胞状奇胎、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患、絨毛癌などにおける出現様式を整理した総説。市販の血清hCG検査がどの分子を検出するかを評価し、偽陽性の多い検査を特定した。妊娠も悪性腫瘍もないのに低値が持続する例にも言及している。不要な治療を避けるためのhCG検査選択指針を示す。
pmid-12092011.summary_en: This review examines the structure of hCG and its related molecules and their occurrence in normal pregnancy, hydatidiform mole, persistent gestational trophoblastic disease, choriocarcinoma and other malignancies. It evaluates which commercial serum hCG assays detect these molecules, identifies assays prone to false-positive results, and discusses persistent low hCG without pregnancy or malignancy. Guidelines for selecting an hCG test are proposed to avoid unnecessary treatment of gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-12092013.summary_ja: 高リスク転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対する集学的治療の総説です。多剤化学療法と補助放射線療法・外科的切除により治癒率は80～90%に達します。一方、患者の25～30%は初回治療に不応または再発し、絨毛癌や多発転移例に多く見られます。救援化学療法により大半は治癒し、新規薬剤や大量化学療法の役割も示唆されています。
pmid-12092013.summary_en: This review summarizes multimodality management of high-risk metastatic gestational trophoblastic tumors. Combination chemotherapy with etoposide, high-dose methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide and vincristine, plus adjuvant radiotherapy and surgery, achieves cure rates of 80-90%. However, 25-30% of high-risk patients respond incompletely or relapse, typically those with choriocarcinoma, multisite metastases and prior failed chemotherapy. Salvage regimens with cisplatin/etoposide, usually with bleomycin or ifosfamide, plus resection of resistant disease, cure most patients. Colony-stimulating factors, newer agents and high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell support may play future roles.

pmid-12092014.summary_ja: チャリング・クロス病院での25年間の後方視的解析で、妊娠性絨毛性疾患1,685例中34例の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）を検討しています。性器出血が主症状で、肺転移と最終妊娠から4年以上の経過が死亡の危険因子でした。子宮限局例は手術単独で治癒することが多く、WHOスコアは予後と相関しませんでした。
pmid-12092014.summary_en: This retrospective series from Charing Cross Hospital describes 34 cases of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) among 1,685 gestational trophoblastic disease patients treated over 25 years. Most presented with vaginal bleeding, and hCG levels were typically low. Lung metastases and an interval of four years or more since the antecedent pregnancy were associated with death. Patients with disease confined to the uterus were often cured by surgery alone. The WHO scoring system did not correlate with outcome, and the authors recommend managing PSTT separately from other types of GTD.

pmid-12092743.summary_ja: 予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍に対する高用量カルボプラチン併用療法を受けた29例で、全白金と限外濾過白金の薬物動態を比較しています。全白金の半減期は限外濾過白金の約4倍と長く、長期残留が示されました。限外濾過白金の濃度とAUCは、クレアチニン上昇や高用量治療に伴う毒性と有意に相関し、臨床での測定が推奨されています。
pmid-12092743.summary_en: This pharmacokinetic study of 29 patients receiving high-dose carboplatin for poor-risk germ cell tumors compares total and ultrafiltered platinum. Total platinum had a terminal half-life over five days, about four times longer than ultrafiltered platinum, indicating long-term retention. Ultrafiltered platinum concentrations and AUC correlated with creatinine rise and high-dose toxicities, whereas total platinum did not. Low ultrafiltered levels did not impair hematologic recovery. The authors recommend measuring ultrafiltered concentrations in high-dose treatment.

pmid-12094965.summary_ja: KK Women's and Children's Hospitalによる本後方視的レビューは、13年間に治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の49例を対象とする。未熟奇形腫が49%で最も多い組織型であり、81.6%は病期Iであった。多くの患者は手術の後に補助化学療法を受け、その割合は67.3%であった。平均約52か月のフォローアップで87.8%が生存して無病であり、再発は1例のみであった。その後に複数の患者が先天異常のない妊娠に成功した。著者らは、卵巣機能と妊孕性を保つため、温存的手術と併用化学療法を重視している。
pmid-12094965.summary_en: This retrospective review from KK Women's and Children's Hospital covers 49 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated over 13 years. Immature teratoma was the most common histology at 49%, and 81.6% had stage I disease. Most patients underwent surgery followed by adjuvant chemotherapy, given to 67.3%. With mean follow-up of about 52 months, 87.8% remained alive and disease-free, with a single recurrence. Several patients later had successful pregnancies without congenital anomalies. The authors emphasize combination chemotherapy with conservative surgery to preserve ovarian function and fertility.

pmid-12095560.summary_ja: 本研究は、健康な男性100名から得たユーティリティ値を用い、病期Iセミノーマに対する補助放射線療法の生活の質における価値を評価した。参加者は、再発リスク5%の補助RTや再発リスク20%の精巣摘除術のみなど5つの健康状態を、標準ゲンブル法で評価した。再発がない状態のユーティリティが最も高く、化学療法で救済された再発が最も低かった。参加者は、RTによる再発リスクの15%の絶対的低下を重視しなかった。著者らは、費用対効果分析にこれらのユーティリティを用いる予定である。
pmid-12095560.summary_en: This study uses utility measurements from 100 healthy men to assess the quality-of-life value of adjuvant radiotherapy for stage I seminoma. Participants rated five health states using the standard gamble technique, including adjuvant RT with 5% recurrence risk, orchiectomy alone with 20% risk, and recurrences salvaged with either RT or chemotherapy. Non-recurrent states had the highest utilities, and recurrence salvaged with chemotherapy had the lowest. Participants did not value the 15% absolute reduction in recurrence risk from RT. The authors plan to use these utilities for cost-effectiveness analysis.

pmid-12099564.summary_ja: 外科的に確定した縦隔奇形腫28例を後方視的に解析し、超音波所見の3つの型（不均一な複雑腫瘤、均一な高エコー腫瘤、嚢胞内の浮遊球）を提示した。いずれも脂肪・毛髪・皮脂などの成熟組織成分の組み合わせを反映していた。超音波検査は縦隔奇形腫の診断向上に有用だが、感度と特異度の検証には前向き研究が必要とされる。
pmid-12099564.summary_en: This retrospective study of 28 surgically confirmed mediastinal teratomas describes three sonographic patterns: a complex heterogeneous mass with internal fat, hair, and mineralized elements; a homogeneous hyperechoic solid mass chiefly containing hair and sebaceous material; and floating spherules within a cystic mass. Pathologic correlation showed these features reflect varying combinations of mature tissue components. The authors conclude that sonography can improve diagnosis of mediastinal teratoma, while noting that prospective studies are needed to establish sensitivity and specificity.

pmid-12100938.summary_ja: 全身化学療法後の残存後腹膜腫瘤に対し、腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った7例を後方視的に検討した。7例中5例で完遂され、重篤な合併症は42.8%に認めたが死亡例はなかった。実施は可能だが難易度が高く、経験豊富な施設で適応を絞るべきとされる。
pmid-12100938.summary_en: This retrospective review of seven patients describes laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection performed after systemic chemotherapy, mostly for nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Laparoscopic RPLND was completed in 5 of 7 patients, with two conversions to open surgery. Complications occurred in 57.1 percent, with major complications in 42.8 percent, and no deaths. Pathology showed mature teratoma in three nodal specimens. The authors conclude the approach is feasible but challenging and should be limited to selected patients at experienced centers.

pmid-12101854.summary_ja: 17歳男児に生じた縦隔腫瘤が上大静脈閉塞と心タンポナーデを来した症例を報告する。生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され、心膜への浸潤が認められた。手術と補助化学療法後、20か月間再発は認めなかった。まれな病変であり、心膜原発卵黄嚢腫瘍のMRI所見の認識に寄与する。
pmid-12101854.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old boy with a mediastinal mass causing superior vena cava obstruction, cardiac tamponade, and pleural effusion. Imaging and biopsy identified a yolk sac tumor that had involved the pericardium, a rare site. After surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy, the patient remained free of recurrence over 20 months of follow-up. The report focuses on the magnetic resonance imaging characteristics of this pericardial yolk sac tumor, which may help recognition of this uncommon presentation.

pmid-12102165.summary_ja: 成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、テロメア長とDNAポリメラーゼβの発現を解析した。ポリメラーゼβの発現は低かった。その結果、セミノーマと非セミノーマは、形質転換した胎児原始細胞から独立して生じることが示唆された。胎児性腺細胞由来説の検討に寄与する研究であり、発生機序の理解に重要である。
pmid-12102165.summary_en: This study examines telomere length and DNA polymerase beta expression in adult testicular germ cell tumours, which show low polymerase beta expression. The authors propose models of pathogenesis and suggest that seminoma and nonseminoma derive independently from transformed fetal primordial cells. These findings bear on the fetal gonocytic origin theory and address how the two main histological types may arise.

pmid-12106750.summary_ja: Frasier症候群（XY性腺異形成と腎不全）の16歳女性に生じた性腺芽腫と限局性ディスジャーミノーマの症例報告である。免疫組織化学では性腺芽腫のみインヒビンが陽性であった。アンドロゲン受容体遺伝子に変異は認められなかった。インヒビン陽性は内分泌活性を示し、思春期早発に関与しうると考えられる。
pmid-12106750.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old female with Frasier syndrome, XY gonadal dysgenesis, and chronic renal failure who developed gonadoblastoma with focal dysgerminoma in a dysgenetic gonad. Bilateral gonadectomy was performed. Immunohistochemistry showed inhibin positivity in gonadoblastoma but not in dysgerminoma. No androgen receptor gene mutations were found. The authors suggest that inhibin expression in the gonadal stroma may reflect hormonal activity contributing to advanced puberty in such patients.

pmid-12111588.summary_ja: 68歳男性が心窩部痛とめまいで受診し、腫瘍マーカー高値、画像検査、生検の免疫組織化学染色から術前に原発性胃絨毛癌と領域リンパ節転移と診断された。胃全摘術と術後化学療法を施行され、切除標本では典型的な絨毛癌と腺癌成分を認めた。血清hCGが経過評価に有用であり、患者は術後4年6か月間再発なく生存した。
pmid-12111588.summary_en: A 68-year-old man presented with epigastric pain, abdominal fullness, and dizziness and was diagnosed preoperatively with primary gastric choriocarcinoma with regional lymph node metastases, based on elevated tumor marker levels, radiography, and immunohistochemistry of biopsy specimens. He underwent total gastrectomy with Roux-en-Y reconstruction and postoperative chemotherapy. Histology showed typical choriocarcinoma with adenocarcinomatous elements. He survived 4 years and 6 months without recurrence, and serum hCG proved a useful marker for reassessment.

pmid-12114751.summary_ja: 57歳女性の副腎腫瘤が成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と判明した症例報告である。病変は主に副腎傍部に存在したが、副腎皮質を部分的に破壊しており、副腎内起源は否定できなかった。極めて稀な病変で、ホルモン非産生性副腎腫瘍の鑑別診断に含めるべきとされる。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)での辺縁の輪状石灰化と脂肪濃度が診断の助けとなる。
pmid-12114751.summary_en: A 57-year-old woman presented with an adrenal mass that proved to be a mature cystic teratoma. The lesion was predominantly paraadrenal but focally interrupted the adrenal cortex, so an intraadrenal origin could not be excluded. The authors note such lesions are extremely rare and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of hormonally silent adrenal tumors. Rim-like calcification and fatty density on computed tomography may aid diagnosis.

pmid-12115576.summary_ja: 播種性胚細胞腫瘍34例、病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍28例、病期I純粋セミノーマ40例で血清TRA-1-60を評価した。化学療法前の播種性胎児性癌陽性の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の約78%で上昇し、治療後に有意に低下した。一方、病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の約3分の1は再発なく上昇を示し、偽陽性が多いため現時点では有用な腫瘍マーカーとは言えないと結論された。
pmid-12115576.summary_en: This study evaluated serum TRA-1-60 as a tumor marker in 34 patients with disseminated germ cell tumors, 28 with stage I NSGCT, and 40 with stage I pure seminoma. TRA-1-60 was elevated in about 78% of disseminated EC-positive NSGCT before chemotherapy and fell significantly afterward. However, about a third of stage I NSGCT patients had elevations without relapse, and false positives limit its clinical reliability. The authors conclude TRA-1-60 is not presently useful as a tumor marker.

pmid-12118269.summary_ja: 62歳女性が卵巣甲状腺腫の切除6日後に甲状腺機能低下症を発症した症例報告です。TSHの上昇と甲状腺ホルモンの低値を認め、サイロキシン補充療法で症状は消失しました。切除後の甲状腺機能評価の重要性を示しています。
pmid-12118269.summary_en: A 62-year-old woman developed clinical hypothyroidism six days after resection of a right ovary containing struma ovarii. Laboratory tests showed elevated TSH and low thyroxine, and thyroxine replacement made her asymptomatic. The authors note that malignant struma ovarii has been linked to hyperthyroidism, but this is the first reported case of hypothyroidism after struma ovarii resection in a previously asymptomatic woman. The report highlights the need to monitor thyroid function after such surgery.

pmid-12119442.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の免疫組織化学的解析で、カベオリン3はセミノーマの12/16例で陽性でした。正常精巣や非セミノーマ成分では陽性所見は認められず、腫瘍浸潤免疫細胞数との相関傾向も示されました。胚細胞腫瘍へのカベオリン3の関与を示した初めての報告です。
pmid-12119442.summary_en: This study examined caveolin-1 and caveolin-3 expression by immunohistochemistry in 16 seminomas, 10 nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, and normal testis. Caveolin-3 was expressed in 12 of 16 seminomas but not in normal tissue or nonseminomatous components, except muscle within teratoma. iNOS was not detected. Caveolin-3 expression tended to correlate with more tumor-infiltrating immune cells, though not significantly. The authors report the first evidence linking caveolin-3 to germ cell tumors.

pmid-12123344.summary_ja: 9歳男児が思春期早発症と一過性のβ-hCG上昇を繰り返し、2年後にMRIで縦隔腫瘍が確認されました。繰り返す血清β-hCG上昇を伴う縦隔絨毛癌の初例とされています。自然に低下するβ-hCG変動の原因は不明です。
pmid-12123344.summary_en: A 9-year-old boy presented with sexual precocity and recurrent transient elevations of serum beta-hCG over two years. Repeated imaging of the mediastinum did not reveal a lesion until magnetic resonance imaging identified a mediastinal tumor. The authors describe this as the first case of mediastinal choriocarcinoma diagnosed with recurrent serum beta-hCG elevation. The factors responsible for the repeated spontaneous beta-hCG declines remain unknown.

pmid-12124830.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性の胚細胞腫瘍22例で、c-KITおよびEGFRファミリーの発現とERBB2遺伝子増幅を解析し、化学感受性の12例と比較しました。両群に差はなく、大半の難治例は分子標的薬の対象にはならないと結論しています。
pmid-12124830.summary_en: This study assessed c-KIT and EGFR family receptors by immunohistochemistry and ERBB2 gene amplification by FISH in 22 cisplatin-resistant germ cell tumors, comparing them with 12 chemosensitive advanced tumors. No differences were found between the groups. c-KIT was present in one pure seminoma and in seminomatous components, while EGFR was restricted to trophoblastic elements of nonseminomas. Only one choriocarcinoma showed ERBB2 amplification. The authors conclude that most refractory tumors would not qualify for these targeted agents.

pmid-12124831.summary_ja: 1986年から2000年の間に救済療法として大量化学療法を受けた胚細胞腫瘍84例の解析です。全体の33%が無病生存し、予後良好群では69%でした。予後不良群では無病生存例はなく、治療関連死は中間リスク群と不良リスク群のみで認められました。
pmid-12124831.summary_en: This Italian series reviewed 84 patients with germ cell tumors, aged 15 to 50, who received 105 courses of high-dose chemotherapy with hematopoietic stem cell support as salvage therapy between 1986 and 2000. Patients were classified by a validated prognostic index. Overall, 33% remained continuously disease-free. Among good-risk patients, 69% were disease-free, compared with 13% of intermediate-risk patients and none of the poor-risk patients. Treatment-related mortality occurred only in intermediate- and poor-risk groups.

pmid-12128117.summary_ja: 病期I–II精巣セミノーマ166例を対象とした後方視的研究で、精巣摘除術と横隔膜下照射後の身体イメージと性機能を質問票で評価した。再発は3例のみだった。性的関心や勃起機能は健常対照と差がなかったが、治療後は勃起困難が増加していた。治療は有効で忍容性も良好と結論された。
pmid-12128117.summary_en: A retrospective Dutch study of 166 patients with Stage I-II testicular seminoma treated with orchiectomy followed by infradiaphragmatic radiotherapy. Questionnaires sent about 51 months after treatment (78% responded) assessed body image and sexual function. Relapse occurred in only 3 patients. Sexual interest and erectile function were comparable to age-matched healthy controls, although erectile difficulties increased after treatment and correlated with age. Twenty percent expressed fertility concerns, and 52% felt their body had changed. The authors conclude the regimen is effective and well tolerated.

pmid-12131159.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の各病変でHLA-G免疫染色を検討し、全トロホブラスト病変で陽性、非トロホブラスト性子宮腫瘍では陰性だった。染色パターンは中間型トロホブラストの亜型と対応し、絨毛癌は絨毛型由来が示唆された。HLA-Gは鑑別診断に有用なマーカーと結論された。
pmid-12131159.summary_en: Immunohistochemistry with the HLA-G antibody 4H84 was tested on gestational trophoblastic disease lesions, including 14 choriocarcinomas, 14 placental site trophoblastic tumors, 13 epithelioid trophoblastic tumors, 16 placental site nodules, and nine exaggerated placental sites. Thirty-four nontrophoblastic uterine neoplasms served as controls. HLA-G was positive in all trophoblastic lesions and negative in nontrophoblastic neoplasms. Staining patterns matched different intermediate trophoblast subtypes, and choriocarcinoma appeared related to villous-type intermediate trophoblast. The authors conclude that HLA-G is a useful marker for differential diagnosis.

pmid-12131350.summary_ja: 単一施設で治療した膣原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の小児3例を後方視的に検討した。無痛性の出血が共通の初発症状だった。初回化学療法で2例のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は速やかに正常化し、無病生存中である。残る1例は救済治療後に無病生存を得た。化学療法を第一選択とし、骨髄移植は救済療法として検討すべきと結論された。
pmid-12131350.summary_en: A retrospective review of three children with vaginal endodermal sinus tumor treated at a single institution. All presented with painless bleeding without an obvious source. Two received initial combination chemotherapy, with alpha-fetoprotein normalizing rapidly, and both remain disease-free. The third patient progressed after chemotherapy, then received salvage surgery, radiation, further chemotherapy, and autologous bone marrow transplant, and has been disease-free for 6.5 years. The authors recommend chemotherapy as primary treatment, endoscopic evaluation of the lower genitourinary tract, and bone marrow transplant only as a salvage option.

pmid-12137745.summary_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞をPMAで分化誘導し、形態変化とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌を確認した。PMAはNEP/CD10発現を用量・時間依存的に増加させ、PKC阻害剤およびMEK阻害剤で消失した。ERK1/2のリン酸化を伴い、PKC依存性MEK/ERK経路を介したNEP/CD10発現の亢進が示された。
pmid-12137745.summary_en: BeWo choriocarcinoma cells were induced to differentiate with phorbol ester (PMA), confirmed by morphological change and hCG secretion. PMA increased neutral endopeptidase (NEP/CD10) expression in a dose- and time-dependent manner. This effect was abolished by the PKC inhibitor Bis I and the MEK inhibitor PD98059, and PMA induced ERK1/2 phosphorylation. The authors conclude that NEP/CD10 is upregulated through a PKC-dependent MEK/ERK pathway and may play a functional role in trophoblast differentiation.

pmid-12137835.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iセミノーマ108例に、精巣摘除後の補助療法としてカルボプラチン2サイクルの単剤療法を行い、平均約60か月追跡した後方視的単施設研究。再発は2例(1.85%)のみで、いずれも救援化学療法により全例が無病生存。血液毒性は主に軽度で、放射線療法の代替として有望と結論づけている。
pmid-12137835.summary_en: This single-center retrospective study evaluated long-term outcomes of two adjuvant cycles of carboplatin monotherapy in 108 patients with clinical stage I seminoma treated after orchiectomy between 1990 and 2001. Over a mean follow-up of about 60 months, only two patients (1.85%) relapsed with retroperitoneal disease within the first year. Both received cisplatin-based salvage chemotherapy, and all patients were alive without evidence of disease. Hematologic toxicity was mostly mild, with no neutropenic fever. The authors conclude that carboplatin monotherapy is highly effective and well tolerated, offering an alternative to radiotherapy and surveillance.

pmid-12137839.summary_ja: 腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清において、交感神経幹と節後神経を温存する片側術式を4ポート経腹膜アプローチで報告した手技論文。右側では腰静脈の切離により大静脈を授動し、神経を確認する。技術的に実施可能で、合併症の軽減と治療的適応の拡大に寄与しうると結論づけている。
pmid-12137839.summary_en: This technical report describes a nerve-sparing technique for laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) performed through a four-port transperitoneal approach. Laparoscopic RPLND is currently used for diagnosis in clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor and for diagnosis and therapy in low-volume stage II disease after chemotherapy. The authors detail stepwise identification of the sympathetic trunk and postganglionic fibers, including division of the lumbar veins to mobilize the vena cava on the right side. They conclude that the technique is feasible and may reduce morbidity while expanding the therapeutic role of minimally invasive RPLND.

pmid-12144689.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌の母体と新生児の双方を救命しえた、2例目の成功例の報告。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の既往を持つ母体は白金製剤抵抗性であったが、パクリタキセルに奏効した。早期の疑いと診断により、母体と新生児の双方に速やかな治療を行うことができ、既往歴のある患者での高い警戒の重要性を示している。
pmid-12144689.summary_en: This report describes the second documented case of successful management of both a mother and her neonate with metastatic choriocarcinoma. The mother had a history of gestational trophoblastic disease and, after showing platinum-refractory disease, responded to paclitaxel. Early suspicion and diagnosis allowed prompt treatment of both mother and neonate. The report highlights the importance of a high index of suspicion for choriocarcinoma in patients with prior gestational trophoblastic disease and presents paclitaxel as an effective option for platinum-refractory disease.

pmid-12144834.summary_ja: 腹水・胸水・卵巣腫瘤・CA125高値を呈し、卵巣悪性腫瘍が疑われた65歳女性の症例報告。摘出標本は成熟甲状腺組織からなる卵巣甲状腺腫であった。偽Meigs症候群を呈し、CA125上昇を伴う本症例は英語文献で2例目と報告されている。卵巣甲状腺腫は腹水、胸水、CA125上昇の稀な原因であると結論づけている。
pmid-12144834.summary_en: This case report describes a 65-year-old woman who presented with ascites, hydrothorax, a right ovarian mass, and elevated CA 125, initially suspicious for ovarian malignancy. Surgical removal revealed struma ovarii, a specialized ovarian teratoma composed mainly of mature thyroid tissue. The combination of ascites and hydrothorax was classified as pseudo-Meigs' syndrome. The authors note this is only the second English-language report of pseudo-Meigs' syndrome with elevated CA 125 caused by struma ovarii, and conclude that struma ovarii is a rare cause of these findings.

pmid-12145137.summary_ja: 45歳女性の仙尾部奇形腫で、腺癌性転化を伴う稀な成人例の症例報告。CTとMRIで嚢胞性・充実性混在腫瘤と隣接構造との関係を明瞭に描出し、正確な術前計画に寄与した。予後は完全切除の可否に依存し、本部位の稀な症例における画像評価の有用性を示している。
pmid-12145137.summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old woman with sacrococcygeal teratoma showing adenocarcinomatous transformation, an uncommon presentation in adults. The authors present the clinical, histological, and imaging features of the tumour. CT and MRI showed a mixed cystic and solid mass, with its extent and relationships to adjacent structures clearly defined, enabling accurate preoperative planning. The report emphasizes that prognosis depends on complete excision and that imaging is valuable for surgical planning at this rare site.

pmid-12146015.summary_ja: 1970年代にシスプラチン併用化学療法が導入されて以降、転移性精巣がん患者の多くが治癒するようになった。若年発症のため長期生存者が多く、化学療法の晩期毒性の評価が重要となっている。本稿では文献に基づいて晩期有害事象を概観し、その軽減に向けたアプローチを検討している。
pmid-12146015.summary_en: This review summarizes the literature on long-term side effects of chemotherapy in testicular cancer patients. Since cisplatin-based chemotherapy was introduced in the 1970s, most metastatic patients are cured, but because they are young, many survive for decades and late toxicities become clinically important. The article reviews reported late effects and discusses approaches to ameliorating them.

pmid-12147838.summary_ja: 精巣超音波検査を受けた男性1,079例を前向きに解析し、精巣微小石灰化の有病率と合併する精巣腫瘍との関連を検討した。精巣微小石灰化は18.1%に認められ、腫瘍は古典型で8%、限局型で5.8%、石灰化がない例では0.3%にみられた。腫瘍例の多くは石灰化を伴っていたが、石灰化を有する患者の90%以上は初診時に腫瘍を認めず、腫瘍スクリーニングの指標としての価値は限定的であった。
pmid-12147838.summary_en: This prospective study of 1,079 men undergoing scrotal ultrasonography evaluated testicular microlithiasis (TM) and its association with testicular tumors using high-frequency transducers. TM was found in 18.1% of patients. Tumors were present in 8% with classic TM, 5.8% with limited TM, and 0.3% without TM, mostly seminomas. Although most patients with tumors had coexisting TM, over 90% of patients with TM had no tumor at presentation, indicating limited value for tumor screening.

pmid-12149716.summary_ja: 触知しない精巣に対して鼠径部探索術を受けた既往のある5歳男児で、腹腔内停留精巣に生じた成熟奇形腫を報告した。小児の腹腔内精巣腫瘍26例を文献的に検討し、1歳未満では悪性奇形腫は認められなかったが未熟奇形腫が1例あった。手術時に腹腔内精巣を確認することの重要性が示され、成人の腹腔内悪性奇形腫の一部は乳児期の成熟奇形腫に由来する可能性が指摘された。
pmid-12149716.summary_en: This report describes a 5-year-old boy with a mature teratoma arising in an intraabdominal undescended testis, who had previously undergone inguinal exploration for an impalpable testis. The authors also review 26 pediatric intraabdominal testicular tumors from English and Japanese literature. No malignant teratomas were found in children under one year, although one immature teratoma occurred. The findings emphasize locating intraabdominal testes at surgery and suggest that some adult intraabdominal malignant teratomas may arise from infantile mature teratomas.

pmid-12151969.summary_ja: 27歳男性（マリファナ喫煙者）で、高位後腹膜リンパ節に転移した純粋未分化セミノーマの症例。精巣摘除術後、いかなる薬物療法も行わずに後腹膜転移が自然退縮した。純粋セミノーマ転移の自然退縮は稀であり、後腹膜の未分化型転移での報告は本例が初めてとされる。考えられる機序は提唱されているが、詳細は依然として不明である。
pmid-12151969.summary_en: The authors report a 27-year-old man with metastatic pure anaplastic seminoma involving high retroperitoneal lymph nodes. After orchiectomy alone, without any further medication, the retroperitoneal metastases spontaneously regressed. Spontaneous regression of pure seminoma metastases is rare, and this is the first reported regression of anaplastic pure seminoma metastases in the retroperitoneum. Several mechanisms are proposed, but the phenomenon remains unexplained.

pmid-12161941.summary_ja: 1977年から2000年に治療された臨床病期Iの精巣純粋セミノーマ42例を報告し、文献をレビューした。41例に補助放射線療法を施行し、1例はサーベイランスとした。再発率は4.7%、全生存率は97%であった。補助放射線療法は後腹膜の微小病変に対する安全な標準治療とされ、再発リスクに応じてサーベイランスや単剤カルボプラチンによる補助化学療法が代替として検討される。
pmid-12161941.summary_en: This study reviews 42 patients with clinical stage I pure testicular seminoma treated between 1977 and 2000, most of whom received adjuvant radiotherapy and one of whom was managed with surveillance. Relapse occurred in 4.7%, and overall survival was 97%. Classic histology was seen in 98% and small vessel invasion in 19%. The authors conclude that adjuvant radiotherapy is a safe standard for microscopic retroperitoneal disease, while surveillance and single-agent carboplatin are reasonable alternatives depending on relapse risk factors.

pmid-12161942.summary_ja: 1977年から2000年に治療された臨床病期II精巣純粋セミノーマの14例を報告し、文献を概観した。病期IIA-IIBには放射線療法、病期IICには化学療法を行った。再発例はなく、最終フォローアップ時には全例が生存し無病であった。初回化学療法、救援化学療法、大量化学療法、残存腫瘤に対するサーベイランスの基準について検討されている。
pmid-12161942.summary_en: This report describes 14 men with clinical stage II testicular pure seminoma treated between 1977 and 2000, together with a review of the literature. Radiotherapy was used for IIA-IIB disease and chemotherapy for IIC. No relapses occurred, and all patients were alive and disease-free at last follow-up. The review covers cisplatin- and carboplatin-based first-line regimens, salvage chemotherapy with cisplatin, ifosfamide and vinblastine, high-dose chemotherapy with autologous transplantation, and surveillance criteria for residual masses.

pmid-12163388.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍24例を対象に、レーザーキャプチャーマイクロダイセクションでFas遺伝子変異を組織型ごとに解析しました。9例（37.5%）に変異があり、セミノーマと胎児性癌で多く認められました。変異は機能喪失型で、Fas遺伝子変異が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症に関与する可能性を示しています。
pmid-12163388.summary_en: The authors sequenced the Fas gene open reading frame in 24 testicular germ cell tumors and benign controls, using laser capture microdissection to assign mutations to specific histologic components. Mutations were found in 37.5% of cases, mostly missense changes in the death domain-encoding exon 9. They occurred in seminoma (27.8%) and embryonal carcinoma (62.5%) lesions but not in yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, or immature teratoma. Mutant genes conferred resistance to Fas-mediated apoptosis, indicating loss of function, and the findings suggest Fas mutations contribute to TGCT pathogenesis.

pmid-12163871.summary_ja: 出生時から呼吸窮迫を伴う大きな頸部腫瘤を有した新生児の症例報告です。画像で石灰化と嚢胞を伴う充実性腫瘤が認められ、剖検で未熟奇形腫と確定しました。小児頸部奇形腫の臨床的、病理学的特徴について考察しています。
pmid-12163871.summary_en: The authors describe a neonate with a large cervical mass and respiratory distress at birth. Imaging showed a predominantly solid lesion with calcifications and cysts, suggesting teratoma. The patient died before surgery could be performed, and autopsy confirmed an immature teratoma. The report discusses the clinical and pathological features of pediatric cervical teratomas. It is a case report illustrating how a neonatal cervical teratoma can cause life-threatening airway compromise.

pmid-12164687.summary_ja: 1985〜2000年に悪性胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移11例を全脳照射で治療しました。全体の中央生存期間は6.6か月でした。孤立性脳再発で切除と全脳照射を受けた3例が長期生存し、最長は194か月でした。切除と放射線療法により持続的な脳内制御が得られる可能性があると結論づけています。
pmid-12164687.summary_en: This Freiburg series reviewed 11 patients with malignant germ cell tumors metastatic to the brain, treated with whole-brain radiation therapy between 1985 and 2000. Median survival was 6.6 months overall. Three long-term survivors had isolated cerebral relapse after complete remission and underwent resection plus whole-brain radiotherapy. One survived 194 months, the longest reported for this setting. The authors conclude that advanced extracerebral disease and isolated cerebral relapse do not preclude long-term survival, and that resection with radiotherapy may give durable local control.

pmid-12165446.summary_ja: 仙骨奇形腫の乳児に、先天性の染色体転座t(12;15)(q13;q25)が認められ、同じ転座が血縁者4名にも見られました。12q13の欠失は胚細胞腫瘍で報告されているため、同部位近傍の遺伝子異常が関与すると仮説を立てています。切断点を覆うゲノムコンティグを構築しました。
pmid-12165446.summary_en: The authors report an infant with a sacral teratoma whose peripheral lymphocytes carried a constitutional t(12;15)(q13;q25) translocation. The same translocation was present in four relatives. Tumor loss of heterozygosity analysis showed retention of both translocation-derived chromosomes. Because 12q13 allelic loss has been reported in germ cell tumors, the authors hypothesize that dysregulation of genes near the 12q13 breakpoint contributes to sacral teratoma development. They have constructed a genomic contig spanning the breakpoint as a first step toward identifying the candidate genes.

pmid-12165453.summary_ja: 純粋性性腺形成不全を伴う46,XYの11歳女児がディスジャーミノーマを発症しました。SRY遺伝子の欠失や変異は認められず、DMRT1とDAX1も正常でした。性転換には他の遺伝子が関与することが示唆され、SRY異常とディスジャーミノーマの関連に疑問を投げかけています。
pmid-12165453.summary_en: The authors report an 11-year-old 46,XY girl with pure gonadal dysgenesis who developed a dysgerminoma. The testis-determining gene SRY, previously linked to dysgerminoma, showed no coding-sequence deletions or mutations. DMRT1 on 9p and DAX1 on Xp21 were also normal. These results suggest that other genes contribute to sex reversal and question the proposed relationship between SRY alterations and dysgerminoma. The case highlights that dysgerminoma in dysgenetic gonads may arise without detectable SRY abnormalities.

pmid-12167104.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫（strumal carcinoid）の2症例について、TTF-1の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討しました。甲状腺成分の濾胞上皮はTTF-1陽性でしたが、カルチノイド成分はほぼ陰性でした。カルチノイド成分は甲状腺への分化を示さず、組織発生の理解に寄与するとしています。
pmid-12167104.summary_en: Strumal carcinoid is an ovarian teratoma containing thyroid tissue and carcinoid components. In two cases, the authors immunohistochemically examined thyroid transcription factor-1 (TTF-1) expression. TTF-1 stained the follicular lining cells of the thyroid elements but was largely negative in the carcinoid component. These findings confirm TTF-1 expression in the thyroid element of ovarian teratomas and suggest that the carcinoid component does not show thyroid differentiation, which informs the histogenesis of strumal carcinoid.

pmid-12168080.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍55例と良性生検38例でhTERTとhTRのmRNAを定量しました。未分化な腫瘍と胚細胞を含む良性組織ではhTERTが発現していましたが、成熟奇形腫では化学療法後の腫瘤を含めてほぼ消失していました。hTERT検出は成熟奇形腫の分子診断を補助し、治療判断に役立つ可能性があります。
pmid-12168080.summary_en: The authors quantified hTERT and hTR mRNA by real-time RT-PCR in 55 testicular germ cell tumors and 38 benign testicular biopsies. hTERT was expressed in all undifferentiated tumors and in benign germ-cell-containing tissue, but was nearly absent in mature teratomas, including post-chemotherapy masses. hTR was high in all samples. The inverse relationship between hTERT expression and tumor differentiation suggests that hTERT detection can molecularly confirm a histologic diagnosis of mature teratoma and may aid treatment decisions for this subtype.

pmid-12169779.summary_ja: 38歳女性の悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例。子宮出血の精査中に偶然発見された卵巣腫瘤を切除したところ、奇形腫内に濾胞型乳頭状甲状腺癌を認めた。サイログロブリン測定と放射性ヨウ素全身シンチグラフィによるフォローアップのため甲状腺全摘に近い手術を行い、131I 80 mCiによるアブレーションを実施した。患者は順調に回復した。文献レビューも併記されている。
pmid-12169779.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old woman with malignant struma ovarii, an incidentally discovered ovarian teratoma containing a follicular-variant papillary thyroid carcinoma. After resection, near-total thyroidectomy was performed to permit thyroglobulin monitoring, followed by radioiodine ablation with 80 mCi iodine-131. The patient recovered well. The authors review the scarce literature and note that the rarity of this tumor precludes consensus on treatment and follow-up.

pmid-12169812.summary_ja: 胎児の心膜奇形腫に対する子宮内開胸による切除を初めて報告した症例。妊娠24週で胎児水腫を発症し、胎児正中胸骨切開で腫瘍を切除したが水腫は改善しなかった。母体には母体ミラー症候群が生じ緊急帝王切開となり、新生児は出生直後に死亡した。胎児水腫を伴う例は危機的状態であり、早期娩出、心嚢液穿刺、子宮内切除などが治療選択肢になると結論づけている。
pmid-12169812.summary_en: This report describes the first in utero open resection of a fetal pericardial teratoma. The fetus of a 31-year-old woman developed hydrops at 24 weeks gestation. Open fetal resection via median sternotomy removed the tumor, but hydrops did not resolve. The mother developed maternal mirror syndrome requiring emergent cesarean section, and the neonate died shortly after birth. The authors conclude that hydrops indicates a compromised fetus and list early delivery, pericardial aspiration, and in utero resection as options.

pmid-12171501.summary_ja: 30歳女性の左腎に発生した成熟奇形腫内に原発したカルチノイド腫瘍の症例。CTで石灰化を伴い造影効果がわずかな腎腫瘤を認めた。組織学的にカルチノイド巣と、円柱上皮、平滑筋、骨などの成熟奇形組織が混在していた。免疫染色でサイトケラチン、NSE、クロモグラニンが陽性であった。カルチノイド症候群はみられず、術後経過は良好であった。
pmid-12171501.summary_en: A case report of a primary carcinoid tumor arising within a mature teratoma of the left kidney in a 30-year-old woman. CT showed a calcified renal mass with minimal enhancement. Histology revealed carcinoid nests alongside mature teratoid elements including columnar epithelium, smooth muscle, and bone, with immunohistochemistry positive for cytokeratin, NSE, and chromogranin. The patient had no carcinoid syndrome and recovered uneventfully. The authors note that the histogenesis and prognosis of this extremely rare entity remain unknown.

pmid-12172430.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病期分類法を概説し、今後の治療管理の展望を論じた総説。過去30年で5年生存率は約95%に向上し、病期分類が治療方針の基盤となっている。多くの患者が治癒するため、治療の侵襲低減が課題となり、そのためには正確な病期分類が不可欠である。早期かつ正確な診断は治療選択と予後に影響する。
pmid-12172430.summary_en: This review outlines staging methods for testicular germ cell cancer and considers future directions in management. The five-year survival has improved to about 95% over 30 years, and staging is now the cornerstone of treatment planning. Because most patients are cured, attention has shifted to reducing treatment morbidity, which requires accurate staging before regimens are changed. Early and accurate diagnosis influences treatment choice and prognosis.

pmid-12172431.summary_ja: 本総説は、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する経過観察と初回の神経温存型後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）を比較したものである。いずれも治癒率はほぼ100%に達する。経過観察は不要な治療を避けられるが、20～25%の再発リスクがあり多剤併用化学療法が必要となる。RPLNDは病期分類と治療を兼ね、合併症は約17%に生じる。胎児性癌の割合と血管浸潤が潜在性リンパ節転移を予測し、選択は患者との詳細な話し合いに基づくべきとされる。
pmid-12172431.summary_en: This review compares surveillance with primary nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Both approaches achieve cure rates near 100%. Surveillance avoids unnecessary treatment but carries a 20-25% relapse risk requiring polychemotherapy, while RPLND offers staging and therapy with about 17% surgical complications. Embryonal carcinoma percentage and vascular invasion predict occult nodal metastasis, and the choice should follow detailed patient discussion.

pmid-12172432.summary_ja: 早期胚細胞腫瘍の評価と治療を概観し、補助化学療法の役割に焦点を当てた総説。精巣摘除後の病期I、および病期IIの初期治療において、補助化学療法の役割が広がりつつある。複数の治療法で高い生存率が得られ、治療は患者の希望と医療資源を考慮すべきである。陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)はより適切な治療判断につながる可能性がある。
pmid-12172432.summary_en: This review addresses assessment and management of early germ cell tumors, with a focus on adjuvant chemotherapy. Adjuvant chemotherapy has an evolving role in stage I disease after orchidectomy and in primary management of stage II disease. Multiple approaches achieve high survival, and treatment should account for patient preference and resource availability. PET imaging may enable more appropriate treatment decisions.

pmid-12172433.summary_ja: 精巣がんの外科治療を、腹腔鏡手術と開腹手術の両面から検討した総説。病期Iおよび病期IIに対する手術の位置づけ、腹腔鏡による病期分類の役割、転移性疾患における化学療法後の手術適応を論じている。セミノーマでは残存腫瘍の切除は通常不要だが、非セミノーマでは晩期再発を考慮し完全切除が重要とされる。化学療法のみでの治療は危険であることが示されている。
pmid-12172433.summary_en: This review examines surgical management of testis cancer, covering laparoscopic and open approaches. It discusses surgery for clinical stage I and II disease, the emerging role of laparoscopic staging, and surgery after chemotherapy for metastatic disease. Seminoma usually does not require resection of residual tumor, whereas non-seminoma generally does because of late relapse risk. Long-term data show the danger of treating metastatic disease with chemotherapy alone.

pmid-12172581.summary_ja: 52歳女性の悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告。卵巣甲状腺腫内に濾胞型乳頭状癌を認めた。臨床的に悪性所見や転移は認めず、組織学的所見から病期Iaと判断され、根治的切除のみで治療された。予後が良好なため外科的切除が治療の基本となるが、経過を確認するには長期フォローアップが必要であると述べている。
pmid-12172581.summary_en: A case report of a 52-year-old woman with malignant struma ovarii, showing a follicular variant of papillary carcinoma arising in the struma ovarii. No clinical malignancy or metastases were evident. Based on histopathology, the tumor was classified as stage Ia and treated with radical excision alone. The authors note that its good prognosis favors surgical excision, but long-term follow-up is needed to determine the course of disease.

pmid-12173369.summary_ja: 副腎に生じた成熟奇形腫3例（8歳女性、18歳女性、17歳男性）の画像所見を報告。腫瘍径は5〜11cmで、境界明瞭な脂肪含有腫瘍であり、石灰化や嚢胞変化を伴うものもあった。副腎の脂肪性腫瘍の鑑別診断、特に小児・思春期例では本疾患を考慮すべきと結論している。
pmid-12173369.summary_en: This report describes imaging features of three histologically confirmed mature teratomas of the adrenal gland, in two females aged 8 and 18 and one male aged 17. Tumors measured 5 to 11 cm, were well circumscribed, and contained fat, with calcification in two and cystic change in one. Findings from CT, MRI and ultrasound were compared with pathology. The authors conclude that adrenal mature teratoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of adrenal lipomatous tumors, particularly in children and adolescents.

pmid-12174631.summary_ja: 14歳男性の巨大な縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。血清AFPは1,251ng/mlと高値で、生検で非セミノーマを伴う成熟奇形腫と診断された。シスプラチン・エトポシドによる化学療法2コース後に腫瘍を心膜合併切除し、術後化学療法を追加した。AFPは正常化し、再発は認めていない。
pmid-12174631.summary_en: A 14-year-old boy presented with dyspnea and a huge mass in the right lung field, with serum AFP of 1,251 ng/ml. Needle biopsy showed mature teratoma with non-seminoma. After two cycles of cisplatin and etoposide, AFP fell to 25 ng/ml, and the tumor (14 x 10 x 20 cm) was resected together with pericardium. Two postoperative chemotherapy cycles normalized AFP, and no recurrence was seen. The case shows successful resection of a giant malignant mediastinal germ cell tumor.

pmid-12175407.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の60例を後方視的に検討。化学療法後の精巣摘除術標本の40%に組織学的異常（残存浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍、成熟奇形腫など）を認めた。精巣内に残存浸潤性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有した症例は予後不良で、全例が化学療法抵抗性の進行により再発・死亡した。初回化学療法後の精巣摘除術を全例に推奨している。
pmid-12175407.summary_en: This retrospective review of 60 patients with metastatic testicular germ cell cancer treated with chemotherapy followed by orchidectomy found significant histological abnormalities in 40% of specimens, including residual invasive germ cell cancer and mature teratoma. Residual invasive NSGCT in the testis was associated with residual invasive disease at extragonadal sites, and all three such patients relapsed and died from chemorefractory disease. The authors recommend orchidectomy after primary chemotherapy in all patients.

pmid-12176779.summary_ja: 欧米11施設の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍635例を後方視的に解析。非セミノーマでは肝・肺・中枢神経系転移、縦隔原発、β-hCG高値が不良因子であった。統合リスク分類で5年生存率はセミノーマ89%、非セミノーマで69%・55%・17%（中等度低・中等度高・不良群）。縦隔非セミノーマは予後が不均一であった。
pmid-12176779.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 635 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors from European and US centers identified prognostic factors for survival and chemotherapy response. For non-seminoma, liver, lung or CNS metastases, mediastinal primary tumor and elevated beta-hCG were adverse factors. Integrated risk groups yielded 5-year survival of 89% for seminoma and 69, 55 and 17% for the intermediate-low, intermediate-high and poor non-seminoma groups. Mediastinal non-seminoma showed heterogeneous prognosis.

pmid-12180230.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍354例を後方視的に検討し、術中迅速凍結切片診断（FSE）と最終診断を比較した。悪性・良性病変はすべて正しく判定された。セミノーマと非セミノーマの鑑別では10%・8%の誤判定があったが、外科的管理には影響しなかった。平均105か月のフォローアップで局所再発例はなく、FSEに基づく外科的管理は臨床的に実施可能と結論された。
pmid-12180230.summary_en: This retrospective study of 354 patients operated for testicular tumors evaluated the accuracy of intraoperative frozen section examination (FSE) against the final diagnosis. FSE correctly identified all malignant and benign lesions. Misclassification between seminoma and non-seminoma occurred in 8 to 10%, but this did not affect surgical management. Enucleation complications were few, and no local relapse was seen over a mean follow-up of 105 months. The authors conclude that FSE-guided management is clinically practicable.

pmid-12181493.summary_ja: T細胞白血病の原因遺伝子TCL1は、マウス初期胚の卵割と桑実胚形成に必要であり、欠損雌では妊孕性が低下する。さらにヒトセミノーマでTCL1が過剰発現していることを見いだし、胚細胞腫瘍の発生にも関与しうることを示した。
pmid-12181493.summary_en: This study shows that TCL1, an oncogene implicated in T-cell leukemia, is required for early mouse embryo cleavage and morula formation, with reduced fertility in Tcl1-deficient females. The authors also found TCL1 overexpressed in human seminomas, suggesting that its dysregulation may contribute to germ cell cancer development as well as lymphoid malignancies.

pmid-12183769.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対して放射線療法を受けた男性3例で、照射後5〜16年に若年性の慢性腸骨大腿動脈疾患が生じた症例報告である。全例に従来の動脈硬化リスク因子があり、放射線と血管リスク因子が相乗的に動脈硬化を促進すると考察している。過去の照射歴のある男性には、中年期に動脈疾患のスクリーニングと危険因子の管理を行うことを提案している。
pmid-12183769.summary_en: Three men aged 40 to 45 years developed premature chronic iliofemoral arterial disease 5 to 16 years after receiving dog-leg radiotherapy (3,500 to 4,000 rads) for testicular cancer. All had conventional atherosclerotic risk factors. The authors argue that radiation and vascular risk factors act synergistically to accelerate atherosclerosis. They recommend that young men treated with historical radiotherapy regimens be screened for arterial disease and have risk factors actively reduced in middle age.

pmid-12185288.summary_ja: 本研究はヒトパルボウイルスB19と精巣胚細胞腫瘍の因果関係を検討した症例対照研究である。診断前血清を用いた解析で、B19抗体陽性と腫瘍リスクとの関連は認められなかった。一方、腫瘍組織24例中4例でB19 DNAが検出され、対照では検出されなかった。著者らは、ウイルス受容体Gb4により腫瘍細胞が感受性を持ち、がん発生後に局所的にウイルスが持続した可能性を推測している。
pmid-12185288.summary_en: This case-control study tested whether human parvovirus B19 is linked to testicular germ cell cancer. Pre-diagnostic serum from 80 cases and 241 controls showed no association with B19 seropositivity (OR 1.03). Among 24 retrospectively collected carcinoma tissues, 4 contained B19 DNA, whereas no control tissue did. The authors suggest that susceptibility of tumor cells via the viral receptor Gb4 may lead to localized viral persistence after cancer develops, rather than the virus causing the tumor.

pmid-12185458.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPで壁側内胚葉へ分化させ、cDNAマイクロアレイで約8,900の遺伝子発現を9日間にわたり解析した基礎研究である。発現変化は原始内胚葉を経由する二相性のパターンを示し、有意に変動した516遺伝子の多くは転写因子であった。細胞死、分化、細胞周期停止を決定する複雑なシグナル網が示され、今後の機能解析に利用可能な遺伝子群が提示されている。
pmid-12185458.summary_en: Using cDNA microarrays, the authors profiled more than 8,900 murine genes during differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells into parietal endoderm, induced by retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP over nine days. Expression changes showed a biphasic pattern, passing through primitive endoderm before parietal endoderm. Of 516 significantly changed genes, most encoded transcription factors. The study describes a complex signaling network governing cell death, differentiation, and cell cycle withdrawal, and provides a gene set for future functional studies.

pmid-12185608.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者の31歳男性で、傍大動脈・傍腸骨への照射と化学療法の後に放射線性下位運動ニューロン疾患が生じた症例報告である。照射後15年の時点でMRIに異常はなく、陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)ではFDG集積が増加していた。放射線感受性の亢進は認められず、著者らは脱髄軸索上のナトリウムチャネル密度の増加とエネルギー需要の増大により部分的回復が説明できると考察している。
pmid-12185608.summary_en: A 31-year-old man with seminoma developed radiogenic lower motor neuron disease after para-aortic and para-iliac irradiation and chemotherapy. He had partial spontaneous recovery that stabilized over several years. Fifteen years later, MRI showed no abnormality, while FDG-PET showed increased uptake and methionine-PET negligible uptake in the irradiated cord segments. Radiobiological assays found no increased individual radiosensitivity. The authors propose that increased sodium channel density along demyelinated axons and higher energy demand explain the stable partial recovery.

pmid-12186481.summary_ja: 著者らは妊娠30週の女性が、以前には未発見の絨毛癌による大きな脳転移を呈した症例を述べている。急速なコルチコステロイド療法の後、帝王切開と開頭術が行われ、手術の1週間以内に化学療法と放射線療法が開始された。母子ともに生存し、母親は1年後も病変を認めなかった。本論文は、生存可能な妊娠と同時に生じた転移性絨毛癌の報告としては2例目であり、脳転移の外科的切除を要した唯一の例であることを指摘している。
pmid-12186481.summary_en: The authors describe a woman at 30 weeks of pregnancy who presented with a large brain metastasis from a previously undetected choriocarcinoma. Rapid corticosteroid therapy was followed by cesarean delivery and craniotomy, and chemotherapy and radiation therapy began within a week of surgery. Both mother and infant survived, and the mother had no evidence of disease at one year. The paper notes that this is only the second report of metastatic choriocarcinoma with a simultaneous viable pregnancy and the only case requiring surgical removal of a brain metastasis.

pmid-12187228.summary_ja: 不妊症評価中に超音波検査で偶然見つかった触知しない精巣内病変4例の報告である。術中超音波ガイド下の針定位と顕微鏡下切除により病変を摘出できた。病変はセミノーマ2例とライディッヒ細胞腫瘍2例であった。セミノーマを認めた2例は根治的精巣摘除術を受け、残存腫瘍は認められなかった。良性例では精巣温存が可能であり、両側同時性病変などでは精巣温存手術が検討できるとしている。
pmid-12187228.summary_en: The authors describe four men with incidental nonpalpable intratesticular lesions found by ultrasonography during infertility evaluation. Intraoperative ultrasound-guided needle localization followed by microsurgical excision removed the lesions, which were seminoma in two cases and Leydig cell tumors in two. The two men with seminoma underwent radical orchiectomy and had no residual tumor. The authors conclude that the approach is safe and can preserve the testis for benign lesions and, in selected bilateral synchronous cases, permit testis-sparing surgery.

pmid-12189533.summary_ja: 難治性または再発したセミノーマ13例に対し、大量化学療法(HDCT)を救援治療として施行した第I/II相試験である。4例(33%)が無病となり、4例が部分寛解を得た。非肺内臓転移、再発までの期間が短いこと、シスプラチン抵抗性は治療不成功に関連した。二次救援療法としても根治が得られうると結論づけている。
pmid-12189533.summary_en: This phase I/II study evaluated high-dose chemotherapy (HDCT) as salvage treatment in 13 patients with refractory or relapsed seminoma, most of whom had failed prior cisplatin-based regimens. Four patients (33%) became disease-free and four achieved partial remission, while four progressed. With a median follow-up of 4.5 years, five patients were alive. Non-pulmonary visceral metastases, short relapse-free intervals, and cisplatin-refractory disease predicted failure. The authors conclude that HDCT can be curative even when offered as second salvage treatment.

pmid-12189554.summary_ja: スウェーデンの症例対照研究で、精巣がん628例(セミノーマ308例、非セミノーマ320例)と対照2309例の周産期因子を比較した。妊娠期間が長いことは全体として保護的だった。セミノーマでは長い妊娠期間が保護的で、出生体重が高いことはリスクとなった。非セミノーマでは妊娠期間の短さ、低い出生順位、母体高齢が関連した。子宮内環境が発症に影響するという仮説を支持する結果である。
pmid-12189554.summary_en: This nested case-control study of Swedish boys born 1920 to 1980 compared perinatal factors in 628 testicular cancer patients (308 seminomas, 320 non-seminomas) with 2,309 matched controls. Shorter gestation was linked to a higher risk overall. For seminomas, long gestation was protective and high birth weight increased risk. Short gestation, low birth order, and high maternal age were associated with non-seminomas. The two subtypes showed similar but not entirely congruent risk patterns, supporting an intrauterine origin for germ cell testicular cancer.

pmid-12192487.summary_ja: 63歳女性にみられた卵巣粘液性嚢胞腺癌と卵巣絨毛癌の併存例の報告である。血清β-hCGの上昇と両側卵巣間質の黄体化が認められた。この併存は非常にまれであり、臨床的・病理学的な意義について考察している。希少例として、診断と治療方針の検討に資する症例報告である。
pmid-12192487.summary_en: This case report describes a 63-year-old woman with a rare coexistence of ovarian mucinous cystadenocarcinoma and ovarian choriocarcinoma. Serum beta-hCG was elevated, and bilateral ovarian stromal luteinization was observed. The authors discuss the rarity of this association along with its clinical and pathologic implications.

pmid-12193212.summary_ja: 54歳の閉経後女性が、子宮内膜症性嚢胞内に類内膜腺癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴う約20 cmの卵巣腫瘍を呈した。血清AFPは13,143 ng/mlと著明に上昇していた。臨床病期IC と判定され、腹腔内カルボプラチンに続き、シスプラチン、エトポシド、ペプロマイシンによる5コースの化学療法を受けた。AFPとCA125は正常化し、21か月間再発は認められなかった。従来の予後不良の報告とは対照的な経過である。
pmid-12193212.summary_en: A 54-year-old postmenopausal woman presented with an ovarian tumor of about 20 cm containing endometrioid adenocarcinoma and yolk sac tumor components within an endometriotic cyst. Serum AFP was markedly elevated at 13,143 ng/ml. She was staged IC and received intraperitoneal carboplatin followed by five courses of cisplatin, etoposide, and peplomycin. AFP and CA125 normalized, and she remained recurrence-free for 21 months, in contrast to the poor prognosis previously reported for this rare combination.

pmid-12196237.summary_ja: 2001年にオーストラレーシアの放射線腫瘍医を対象に実施された調査では、根治的精巣摘除術後の臨床病期Iセミノーマの治療選好を評価した。大部分は腹部と骨盤の病期分類CTを実施し、約半数が経過観察について患者と話し合っていたが、経過観察を選ぶと見積もられた患者は少なかった。最も一般的な照射は15または20分割で25 Gyであり、多くの施設が傍大動脈リンパ節のみを治療していた。1999年のMRC研究後に診療は変化したが、経過観察画像検査の間隔は大きく異なり、統一された見解は得られなかった。
pmid-12196237.summary_en: A survey of Australasian radiation oncologists in 2001 assessed management preferences for Stage I testicular seminoma after radical orchidectomy. Most performed abdominal and pelvic staging CT, and about half discussed surveillance, though few patients were estimated to choose it. The most common regimen was 25 Gy in 15 or 20 fractions, and many treated para-aortic nodes alone. Practice changed after a 1999 MRC study, but follow-up imaging schedules varied widely and no consensus emerged.

pmid-12197548.summary_ja: 1994年以降に腹腔鏡下で摘出された卵巣類皮嚢腫83例を後方視的に解析した。経膣超音波で69%が正しく術前診断された。卵巣温存のための嚢腫摘出術が主で、約3分の2で内容物の漏出が起きた。術中・術後の合併症はなく、腹腔鏡手術は安全で実施可能と結論づけている。
pmid-12197548.summary_en: This retrospective review of 83 patients describes laparoscopic removal of benign ovarian dermoid cysts between 1994 and the study period. Transvaginal sonography gave the correct preoperative diagnosis in 69% of cases. Cystectomy with ovarian preservation was the most common procedure, and cyst spillage occurred in about two-thirds of cystectomies. No intra- or postoperative complications were recorded, and no chemical peritonitis occurred. The authors conclude that laparoscopic management is safe and feasible for dermoid cysts.

pmid-12199179.summary_ja: 30歳男性の無痛性の左頸部腫瘤を報告する。生検やCT、病期分類の検査でも診断が確定しなかった。血清学的検査と腫瘍マーカーの検出により、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。若年男性の頸部腫脹では、胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別に含める必要性を示している。
pmid-12199179.summary_en: A 30-year-old man presented with a painless left cervical lump. Multiple biopsies, CT, and staging evaluations failed to establish a diagnosis. The mass was ultimately identified as an extragonadal germ cell tumor, and the diagnosis was confirmed by serologic testing and detection of tumor markers specific to this tumor type. The report emphasizes that germ cell tumor should be considered in the differential diagnosis of a cervical swelling in young men when conventional workup is nondiagnostic.

pmid-12200764.summary_ja: 54歳女性が血糖値の激しい変動を呈し、血中ソマトスタチンが著増していた。MIBGシンチグラフィで良性のソマトスタチン産生腫瘍を局在診断し、卵巣奇形腫の内部に被包化された状態で認めた。摘出により完全回復した。奇形腫内に腫瘍が存在する点で稀な症例である。
pmid-12200764.summary_en: A 54-year-old woman had rapidly alternating extreme hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia with markedly elevated somatostatin. A benign somatostatinoma was localized by MIBG-I123 scintigraphy and found encapsulated within an ovarian teratoma. Surgical removal led to complete recovery. The case is notable for its unusual clinical presentation and the anatomic location of the tumor within a teratoma, which is a germ cell tumor.

pmid-12202994.summary_ja: 小児未熟奇形腫29例でp53発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。びまん性陽性例の約半数で再発または悪性成分が認められた。p53遺伝子変異はほぼ見られず、過剰発現はタンパク質の安定化を反映すると考えられる。陽性細胞が多い場合は悪性成分の検索と慎重なフォローアップが推奨される。
pmid-12202994.summary_en: Twenty-nine pediatric immature teratomas were stained for p53 and correlated with other germ cell elements and outcome. Diffuse p53 positivity occurred in 18 cases, and about half of these were associated with recurrence or malignant components. Sequencing found p53 mutation in only one case, so overexpression likely reflects protein stabilization. The authors suggest that frequent p53-positive cells should prompt a search for malignant elements and close follow-up.

pmid-12203871.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍2例を細胞診で検討した。1例は胎児性癌の免疫表現型を示す非定型セミノーマで、低分化癌との鑑別が問題となった。もう1例は肺に進展した壁側卵黄嚢腫瘍で、当初は肺癌と疑われた。細胞外の硝子様物質が診断に有用であった。
pmid-12203871.summary_en: Two mediastinal germ cell tumors were examined by fine-needle aspiration cytology. The first was an atypical seminoma with embryonal carcinoma immunophenotype that mimicked poorly differentiated carcinoma. The second was a parietal yolk sac tumor extending into the lung, initially suspected to be lung cancer. The extracellular hyaline material seen in yolk sac tumor cytology helped reach the correct diagnosis. The report highlights cytologic pitfalls in diagnosing mediastinal germ cell tumors.

pmid-12204063.summary_ja: 7か月の男児が急速に増大する腹腔内腫瘍を呈し、凍結切片では尿膜腺癌と誤診された。最終的な組織学所見は、シラー・デュバル小体を伴う純粋な卵黄嚢腫瘍であった。腫瘍はAFP陽性であり、外科的切除と補助化学療法で治療された。3年間の経過観察の後も患者は生存し、病変は認められない。本症例は、尿膜の原発性純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍の報告としては2例目である。
pmid-12204063.summary_en: A 7-month-old boy presented with a rapidly enlarging intra-abdominal tumor, initially misdiagnosed as urachal adenocarcinoma on frozen section. Final histology showed pure yolk sac tumor with Schiller-Duval bodies. The tumor was positive for AFP, and it was treated with surgical resection and adjuvant chemotherapy. After 3 years of follow-up, the patient remained alive without disease. The case is only the second reported primary pure yolk sac tumor of the urachus.

pmid-12206639.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞がん1049例のうち、15例に脳転移が認められた。化学療法後に脳のみに再発した6例は切除と頭蓋照射を受け、そのうち4例は長期間無病で経過した。初診時または全身病変の活動期に脳病変を有していた患者は、一般に死亡している。著者らは、全身化学療法後の孤立性脳再発は、積極的な手術と放射線療法により治癒可能であると結論づけている。
pmid-12206639.summary_en: This review of 1049 metastatic germ cell cancer patients identified 15 with cerebral metastases. Six had isolated brain relapse after chemotherapy and underwent resection plus cranial irradiation; four of these remained disease-free long term. Patients with cerebral disease at presentation or relapse alongside active systemic disease generally died. The authors conclude that isolated cerebral relapse after successful systemic chemotherapy is potentially curable with aggressive surgery and radiotherapy.

pmid-12209720.summary_ja: 台北の三次医療機関で1983〜2001年に治療された性腺外胚細胞腫瘍59例の後方視的解析。セミノーマ性腫瘍の成績は欧米と同等だったが、縦隔の非セミノーマ性腫瘍の予後は不良で、救援化学療法を受けた4例は全例死亡した。非セミノーマ性腫瘍の成績差の原因解明が必要とされる。
pmid-12209720.summary_en: This retrospective review of 59 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors treated at a Taipei tertiary center (1983 to 2001) found favorable outcomes for mediastinal seminoma and intracranial germinoma. Mediastinal nonseminomas fared poorly, with only 8 of 24 patients alive. Patients given salvage chemotherapy for mediastinal nonseminoma all died. Seminomatous results matched Western series, but nonseminomatous outcomes were inferior, prompting calls to explore the causes.

pmid-12209744.summary_ja: ロイヤル・マースデン病院で治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍1263例を後方視的に解析し、晩期再発の危険因子と時期を検討。初診時の腫瘍マーカー陽性と化学療法後標本の分化奇形腫が2年以降の再発の予測因子だった。5年を超える再発は主に転移性非セミノーマで起こり、5年以降のフォローアップは同群を除き不要かもしれないと結論された。
pmid-12209744.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 1263 men with testicular germ cell tumors treated at the Royal Marsden Hospital (1979 to 1993) examined the timing and risk factors of late recurrence. Positive markers at presentation and differentiated teratomas in postchemotherapy specimens predicted recurrence after 2 years. Very late recurrence (over 5 years) occurred mostly in metastatic nonseminomatous tumors, with about a 1% annual risk between 5 and 10 years. The authors suggest routine follow-up may be unnecessary beyond 5 years except in metastatic nonseminoma.

pmid-12210085.summary_ja: 上皮内癌（CIS）またはセミノーマが浸潤した精細管のセルトリ細胞におけるコネキシン26およびcx43の発現を検討した。浸潤管ではcx43が消失し、cx26の細胞質内発現とサイトケラチン18の再発現がみられ、脱分化を示した。細胞間通信の障害が精子形成障害や腫瘍進展に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-12210085.summary_en: This study examined connexin 26 and 43 expression in Sertoli cells of seminiferous tubules infiltrated by carcinoma-in-situ or seminoma. Infiltrated tubules lost cx43 at the junctions, gained cx26, and re-expressed cytokeratin 18, indicating dedifferentiation. Western blots showed altered band patterns in impaired spermatogenesis. The authors suggest that disrupted communication between Sertoli cells and germ cells may contribute to spermatogenic impairment and neoplastic progression of CIS cells.

pmid-12210444.summary_ja: フィラデルフィア小児病院で治療された小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍23例の前向き研究。シスプラチンをカルボプラチンに置き換えた併用療法で全例が寛解を達成し、フォローアップ中央値58か月で全生存期間（全生存率）は91%だった。腎毒性・耳毒性は限定的で、小児の一次治療として安全に用いられると結論された。
pmid-12210444.summary_en: This prospective study of 23 children with malignant germ cell tumors at The Children's Hospital of Philadelphia substituted carboplatin for cisplatin to reduce nephro- and ototoxicity. All patients achieved remission, with overall survival of 91% and event-free survival of 87% at a median follow-up of 58 months. Toxicities were limited, and therapy could be given as an outpatient. The authors conclude carboplatin can safely replace cisplatin as primary therapy for pediatric germ cell tumors.

pmid-12213732.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）と類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍（ETT）の分子解析を行った。解析可能な全例でY染色体座位や正常子宮にない父性アレルが検出され、胎児（トロホブラスト）由来であることが示された。完全胞状奇胎とは異なる遺伝学的特徴を持つことも確認された。
pmid-12213732.summary_en: This molecular study analyzed placental site trophoblastic tumors (PSTT) and epithelioid trophoblastic tumors (ETT) to test their presumed trophoblastic origin. All informative tumors carried Y-chromosomal loci or paternal alleles absent from normal uterus, indicating fetal origin. Loss of heterozygosity occurred in 60% of tumors, and the tumors differed from complete hydatidiform moles. The findings provide the first molecular evidence that PSTT and ETT arise from trophoblast.

pmid-12214461.summary_ja: 文献と著者らの臨床経験に基づき、悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍および性索腫瘍の化学療法をまとめた。両腫瘍ともPEB療法が標準的な補助化学療法で、若年患者の妊孕性温存に有効である。一部に化学療法抵抗性の症例があり、新規抗がん剤を用いた二次治療戦略の確立が今後の課題とされる。
pmid-12214461.summary_en: This review summarizes chemotherapy for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors and sex-cord tumors, based on the literature and the authors' clinical experience. PEB is the standard adjuvant regimen for both. Four courses are considered tolerable after incomplete resection and three after complete resection. Chemotherapy can preserve fertility in young patients, but resistance occurs in some cases, calling for new second-line strategies.

pmid-12214462.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の最近の臨床的進展をまとめた総説。改訂WHO危険因子スコアとFIGO病期分類の併用、低リスク例のメトトレキサート単剤療法と高リスク例のEMA/CO療法などの治療方針を解説する。部分奇胎が絨毛癌へ移行しうることも示し、疑い例には中央病理診断とhCGフォローアップを推奨している。
pmid-12214462.summary_en: This review summarizes recent clinical advances in gestational trophoblastic disease. It describes the revised WHO risk scoring system combined with FIGO anatomic staging, treatment of low-risk disease with single-agent methotrexate, and high-risk disease with EMA/CO or EP/EMA. It also reports reproductive outcomes after molar pregnancy and notes that partial hydatidiform moles can transform into choriocarcinoma. The authors recommend central review and hCG follow-up for suspected partial moles.

pmid-12214731.summary_ja: 症例報告として、卵巣の表皮嚢胞と原発性索状カルチノイドを報告する。表皮嚢胞は奇形腫の一型と考えられ、胚細胞由来とされる。診断には病理組織学的検査と免疫組織化学が必要である。悪性転化率は1.4〜2%と低く、予後は良好であるため、保存的外科療法と長期フォローアップが治療の第一選択とされる。
pmid-12214731.summary_en: This case report describes a benign ovarian lesion consisting of an epidermoid cyst coexisting with a primary trabecular carcinoid. The authors note that epidermoid cysts likely arise as unilateral developments of teratomas from germ cells after meiotic nondisjunction. Diagnosis requires histology and immunohistochemistry to distinguish carcinoids from sex-cord tumors and ependymomas. Prognosis is good, with a malignant transformation rate of 1.4% to 2%. Conservative surgery with long-term follow-up is the recommended treatment.

pmid-12214834.summary_ja: 24歳の女性の卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。妊孕性温存手術と補助化学療法後に後腹膜の増大する腫瘤が出現し、成熟奇形腫のみからなっていた。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は正常化していたが、growing teratoma syndromeと診断された。救援化学療法の前に外科的切除と組織学的確認が重要であると強調している。
pmid-12214834.summary_en: This report describes a 24-year-old nulliparous woman with a malignant ovarian germ cell tumor who developed an enlarging retroperitoneal mass after fertility-preserving surgery and adjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy. Serum AFP had normalized, yet the mass contained only mature teratoma. The authors diagnosed growing teratoma syndrome, which is very rare in ovarian germ cell tumors, with only 15 cases reported. They emphasize that surgical resection and histological confirmation of enlarging masses are essential before salvage chemotherapy.

pmid-12216089.summary_ja: 1978〜1999年に治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍2431例のうち、両側発症は24例(1%)であった。セミノーマでは30歳以下の患者で両側発症が多かった。第2の腫瘍の多くは異時性で、70%は5年以内に出現した。予後は良好で、転移性疾患で死亡したのは1例のみであった。第2の腫瘍のリスクがある患者を把握するうえで有用と考えられる。
pmid-12216089.summary_en: This M. D. Anderson series reviewed 2,431 patients with testicular germ cell tumors treated from 1978 to 1999 and identified 24 with bilateral disease, an incidence of 1%. Bilateral seminoma was more frequent in patients aged 30 or younger. Most second tumors were metachronous, with 70% occurring within 5 years, though one occurred 15 years later. Outcomes were excellent, with only one patient dying of metastatic disease. The findings may help identify patients at risk for a second tumor.

pmid-12216440.summary_ja: 絨毛癌に広範な腹腔内膿瘍と播種性血管内凝固(DIC)を合併した29歳女性の症例報告。子宮摘出術と内腸骨動脈結紮術を施行し、術後にDICを発症したが、輸血、抗菌薬、併用化学療法で改善した。20か月以上無病生存した。適切な時期の手術、積極的な抗菌薬投与、術後の速やかな化学療法を推奨している。
pmid-12216440.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma complicated by a diffuse intra-abdominal abscess and disseminated intravascular coagulation. Despite fever and abdominal pain, she underwent hysterectomy and hypogastric artery ligation. DIC developed after surgery, but transfusion, antibiotics, and immediate combination chemotherapy improved her condition and controlled the malignancy. She remained disease-free for more than 20 months. The authors recommend timely surgery, aggressive antibiotics, and immediate postoperative chemotherapy.

pmid-12218592.summary_ja: 小児・思春期の臨床病期I非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍31例を20年間の単施設経験から解析した。小児は主に卵黄嚢腫瘍や奇形腫で、サーベイランスが選択され、21%が再発した(いずれも卵黄嚢腫瘍でAFP上昇を伴う)。思春期例は後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、25%に節転移を認めた。5年無再発生存率は80.6%、全生存期間(全生存率)は100%だった。小児ではAFP測定を含むフォローアップと保存的管理を推奨している。
pmid-12218592.summary_en: This 20-year single-institution review analyzed 31 children and adolescents with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Most children had yolk sac tumors or teratomas and were managed with surveillance. Three of 14 children (21%) relapsed, all with yolk sac tumors and elevated AFP. Adolescents underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, and 25% had nodal metastases. Five-year relapse-free survival was 80.6% and overall survival 100%. The authors recommend AFP monitoring during follow-up and a conservative approach for children.

pmid-12219784.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍7例を対象に、細胞診(FNAB)による診断の有用性を検討した。原発性6例はセミノーマ3例と卵黄嚢腫瘍3例であった。細胞診で5例が胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、2例は低分化癌との鑑別が問題となった。免疫細胞化学が診断の確認に有用であった。縦隔の原発性および転移性胚細胞腫瘍の診断にFNABは高い精度を有すると結論づけている。
pmid-12219784.summary_en: This study evaluated fine-needle aspiration biopsy for diagnosing mediastinal germ cell tumors in seven male patients. Six had primary mediastinal GCTs, including three seminomas and three yolk sac tumors. Cytology and immunocytochemistry established a GCT diagnosis in five cases, while two cases raised differential diagnosis with poorly differentiated carcinoma. The authors conclude that FNAB can accurately diagnose primary or metastatic mediastinal GCTs, with immunocytochemistry aiding confirmation.

pmid-12224161.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iおよび病期IIの精巣腫瘍に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の経験と文献をまとめた総説である。手術時間は開腹手術と同等で合併症は少なく、射精機能はほぼ温存され、長期成績も損なわれなかった。病期Iでは診断的手段として、病期IIでは残存腫瘍の切除に利用できる。
pmid-12224161.summary_en: This article reviews the author's experience and the literature on laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in clinical stage I and II testicular tumors. After the learning curve, operative time was comparable to open surgery with fewer complications, ejaculation was preserved in nearly all patients, and long-term oncologic outcomes were not compromised. Laparoscopic RPLND can serve as a diagnostic procedure in stage I disease and can remove residual tumor in stage II.

pmid-12228753.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）の現在の適応を概説した総説である。転移性精巣がんは転移巣の体積によって50〜75%が治癒しうる。化学療法後の残存病変に奇形腫やがんが含まれる場合には治療的利益があるが、線維化と壊死のみの場合は利益がなく、術前の適切な患者選択が課題である。低病期での有用性は過小評価されているとする。
pmid-12228753.summary_en: This review examines current indications for retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in testicular cancer. RPLND can cure 50% to 75% of metastatic disease, depending on metastatic volume. After chemotherapy, resection confers benefit when the residual tumor contains teratoma or carcinoma, whereas patients with only fibrosis or necrosis derive no benefit. The authors argue that the value of RPLND in low-stage disease is underappreciated and call for better preoperative selection of postchemotherapy patients.

pmid-12232490.summary_ja: 膵頭部腫瘍として精査された57歳男性の症例報告である。膵周囲リンパ節の生検でセミノーマ転移と判明し、右精巣の摘除により原発であることが確認された。BEP療法（シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン）4サイクルで完全奏効が得られた。膵癌様の像を呈しうることを示し、慎重な画像検査と病理組織学的検査の重要性を強調している。
pmid-12232490.summary_en: A case report describes a 57-year-old man with obstructive jaundice and a pancreatic head mass, initially suspected of pancreatic cancer. Biopsy of peripancreatic lymph nodes showed seminoma metastasis, and castration of a suspicious right testis confirmed a primary seminoma (clinical stage III). Four cycles of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin achieved a complete response. The case shows that seminoma metastases can mimic pancreatic malignancy and emphasizes careful radiological and histopathological evaluation.

pmid-12233789.summary_ja: 1990〜1998年に単一施設で治療した妊娠性絨毛性疾患31例の後方視的解析である。WHOリスク分類に基づき、非転移性低リスク群はメトトレキサートによる単剤化学療法で全例が完全奏効した。予後不良群はEMA-CO療法で治療され、69%が完全奏効した。WHOリスク分類による初回治療の決定と、高リスク例におけるEMA/COの有用性を支持している。
pmid-12233789.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective study of 31 women with gestational trophoblastic disease (1990-1998) classified patients by WHO risk groups. Low-risk nonmetastatic patients received single-agent methotrexate with folinic acid, and all achieved complete response. Metastatic high-risk patients received EMA-CO, with complete response in 69% of the poor-prognosis group. The authors support WHO risk-based classification for initial therapy and EMA/CO as a well-tolerated, effective regimen for high-risk disease.

pmid-12234506.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、主に悪性胚細胞腫瘍を有する28例の後腹膜腫瘤に対する超音波ガイド下経腹壁細針穿刺細胞診を評価した。30検体のうち70%が悪性、20%が良性、10%が不適切であった。性腺外の4症例はすべて正しく診断され、4例では病期分類の問題が解決した。腫瘍マーカーが正常であった11例中7例で再発が確認された。著者らは、組織学的検証が重要な症例に対してFNCを推奨している。
pmid-12234506.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated ultrasound-guided transabdominal fine needle cytology (FNC) of retroperitoneal masses in 28 patients, mostly with malignant germ cell tumors. Of 30 specimens, 70% were malignant, 20% benign, and 10% unsatisfactory. FNC correctly diagnosed all four extragonadal cases, resolved staging problems in four patients, and confirmed malignancy in 7 of 11 patients with suspected recurrence and normal tumor markers. The authors recommend FNC for selected cases in which histological verification is critical.

pmid-12237772.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、DNAトポイソメラーゼIおよびIIαの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究です。化学療法前の精巣摘除標本と化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清標本を対比しました。卵黄嚢腫瘍と成熟奇形腫ではトポイソメラーゼIが全例で陽性で、残存奇形腫では発現が増加していました。トポイソメラーゼI阻害薬が難治性胚細胞腫瘍、特に卵黄嚢腫瘍に有用かもしれないと示唆しています。
pmid-12237772.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined DNA topoisomerase I and IIα expression in testicular germ cell tumours, focusing on chemorefractory cases with residual malignancy after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Pre-chemotherapy orchidectomy and post-chemotherapy RPLND specimens were paired. Yolk sac tumours and mature teratoma showed universal topoisomerase I expression, while topoisomerase IIα was strong in embryonal carcinoma. Topoisomerase I rose in residual mature teratoma. The authors suggest topoisomerase I inhibitors may benefit chemorefractory germ cell tumours, particularly yolk sac tumours.

pmid-12238343.summary_ja: 2歳半の女児に生じた悪性仙尾部卵黄嚢腫瘍（内胚葉洞腫瘍）の症例報告です。仙骨前部の腫瘤が皮膚潰瘍を伴って発見され、超音波検査とCTで骨盤内に大きな不整形腫瘤が確認されました。血清AFPは著明に上昇していました。尾骨を含めて一塊に切除し、術後2週間でVAC化学療法を開始しました。極めてまれな性腺外胚細胞腫瘍として、文献的考察を加えています。
pmid-12238343.summary_en: This case report describes a 2.5-year-old girl with a malignant sacrococcygeal yolk sac (endodermal sinus) tumour presenting as a presacral mass with skin ulceration. Ultrasonography and CT showed a large irregular pelvic mass without retroperitoneal nodal enlargement or liver involvement. Serum AFP was markedly elevated. The tumour was excised en bloc with the coccyx, and VAC chemotherapy began two weeks postoperatively. The authors review this extremely rare extragonadal germ cell tumour and the literature.

pmid-12242140.summary_ja: 出生前診断された巨大先天性頸部奇形腫の新生児例の症例報告です。分娩時にOOPS法を用いて気道を確保しました。出生後のCTと血管造影で、頸部両側に及ぶ巨大腫瘤と左側血管の欠損が確認されました。急速な第三間隙現象により早期手術を要し、神経損傷や咽頭皮膚瘻が生じました。病理は悪性所見のない未熟奇形腫でした。多職種連携と出生前診断例へのOOPS法の有用性を強調しています。
pmid-12242140.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a giant congenital cervical teratoma diagnosed prenatally. The team used the operation-on-placenta-support (OOPS) technique during delivery to secure the airway. Postnatal CT and angiography showed a huge mass covering both sides of the neck with left-sided vascular agenesis. Rapid third-space fluid shift required early surgical excision, complicated by nerve injuries and fistula. Pathology confirmed immature teratoma without malignancy. The authors emphasise multidisciplinary care and the value of OOPS in prenatally diagnosed cervical masses.

pmid-12243071.summary_ja: 1998年から2000年にかけて横浜市立大学病院で行われた、胚細胞腫瘍5例への大量化学療法の報告です。標準的なPEB療法4〜6コース後の予後不良または進行例に、カルボプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミドによるCEI療法と末梢血幹細胞移植を施行しました。完全奏効3例、部分奏効1例、不変1例でした。致命的合併症や治療関連死は認められませんでした。
pmid-12243071.summary_en: This Japanese study reports five patients with germ cell tumours treated with high-dose CEI chemotherapy (carboplatin, etoposide, ifosfamide) followed by peripheral blood stem cell transplantation at Yokohama City University Hospital between 1998 and 2000. All had poor-risk or advanced disease after four to six cycles of standard PEB chemotherapy. Three achieved complete response, one partial response, and one no change. No fatal complications or treatment-related deaths occurred. The approach was feasible in this small series.

pmid-12296764.summary_ja: 脾臓と性腺が異常に連結する稀な先天奇形である脾性腺融合の患者の精巣に、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が発生した症例を報告している。腫瘍は腹腔内に位置し、この奇形に伴う精巣腫瘍としては3例目、腹腔内の精巣腫瘍としては初めての報告である。世界の文献では150例余りしか報告がなく、関連する文献的考察も加えられている。
pmid-12296764.summary_en: This case report describes a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor arising in the testis of a patient with splenogonadal fusion, a rare congenital malformation in which the spleen connects abnormally to the gonad or mesonephric derivatives. The tumor was intra-abdominal in location, and it is only the third reported testicular neoplasm associated with this anomaly. The authors review the literature on splenogonadal fusion and the tumors that develop in it. The case suggests that clinicians should consider this association when evaluating an intra-abdominal testicular tumor.

pmid-12297196.summary_ja: 非転移性で肺実質に原発した、胎児性癌・絨毛癌・卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を含む混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例を報告している。開胸術で診断され、右上葉切除により腫瘍の大部分が切除された。胸部胚細胞腫瘍の通常の原発部位は前縦隔であり、肺原発例は極めて稀である。過去に報告された肺内絨毛癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍は数例のみである。
pmid-12297196.summary_en: This case report describes a primary mixed germ cell tumor arising in the lung parenchyma of a patient, without evidence of metastasis elsewhere. Germ cell tumors of the lung are extremely rare, and this tumor contained embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma and yolk sac tumor components. Diagnosis was achieved by open thoracotomy, and the bulk of the tumor was resected by right upper lobectomy. The authors note that only a few intrapulmonary choriocarcinomas and yolk sac tumors have previously been reported, and that the anterior mediastinum is the usual primary site of chest germ cell tumors.

pmid-12350505.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群の男児は思春期早発症のリスクが高く、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の高リスク群である。これらの腫瘍は通常非セミノーマ性だが、セミノーマ成分を伴う混合型もみられる。思春期早発症の原因として縦隔腫瘍を鑑別に含めるべきだと述べており、特に本症候群の男児では重要な鑑別診断となる。
pmid-12350505.summary_en: This short review discusses boys with Klinefelter syndrome, who have an increased risk of precocious puberty and a high risk of primary extragonadal germ cell tumors. Such tumors are usually nonseminomatous but can be mixed, with seminomatous elements. Precocious puberty in this group is either idiopathic or caused by a mediastinal tumor, so mediastinal tumors should be included in the differential diagnosis. The paper frames precocious puberty as a potential early sign of tumor in these patients.

pmid-12352193.summary_ja: 39歳女性の卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)内に発生した、高分化型皮脂腺癌の症例を報告している。卵巣類皮嚢腫における皮脂腺腫瘍は極めて稀で、本例は文献上4例目である。奇形腫成分からの悪性転化であり、卵巣奇形腫の悪性変化を理解する上で重要な症例である。
pmid-12352193.summary_en: This report describes a well-differentiated sebaceous carcinoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst) of the ovary in a 39-year-old woman. Sebaceous neoplasms in ovarian dermoid cysts are exceedingly rare, and this is the fourth such case reported in the literature. The tumor represents malignant transformation of a teratomatous component. The case adds to the limited literature on malignant somatic-type tumors arising in ovarian teratomas and is relevant to the pathology of mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-12352332.summary_ja: 395例の思春期前精巣腫瘍を登録したデータベースを解析し、臨床経過、治療、転帰を検討した。良性腫瘍は38%を占め、卵黄嚢腫瘍の多くは病期Iで発見され全生存期間(全生存率)は良好であった。初回に切除生検を行い、再発・転移した卵黄嚢腫瘍には化学療法を行うことを推奨している。
pmid-12352332.summary_en: This summary of the Prepubertal Testis Tumor Registry, covering 395 patients, reviews the presentation, treatment and outcome of prepubertal testis tumors. Benign tumors made up 38% of cases, and most yolk sac tumors presented at stage 1 with excellent overall survival. Teratomas had no metastases or deaths. The authors recommend initial excisional biopsy for most tumors and chemotherapy for recurrent or metastatic yolk sac tumor. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection is reserved for residual masses after chemotherapy.

pmid-12352400.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣腫瘍患者15例に放射性トレーサーを注入し、センチネルリンパ節の検出を試みた。全例でリンパシンチグラフィーとハンドヘルドガンマプローブにより節が検出された。ガンマプローブ誘導下の腹腔鏡下生検は技術的に可能であり、1例では微小転移がセンチネルリンパ節のみに認められた。精巣腫瘍の管理に有用な可能性があるが、さらなる検証が必要である。
pmid-12352400.summary_en: In 15 patients with clinical stage I testicular tumor, the authors injected a technetium-labeled tracer around the tumor to map lymphatic drainage and detect sentinel lymph nodes. Nodes were identified in all patients by lymphoscintigraphy and a handheld gamma probe. Gamma probe guided laparoscopic biopsy was technically feasible, and in the last patient micrometastasis was found only in the sentinel node. The authors conclude that the technique may aid management of testicular tumors, but further trials are needed.

pmid-12352401.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し、神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清と経過観察の射精機能を意思決定分析で比較している。経過観察の再発率が16%を超える場合や、化学療法後郭清で高い射精機能を維持できる術者の場合を除き、初回の神経温存郭清が推奨された。多くの患者で射精機能を最大化するには初回郭清が望ましいと結論している。
pmid-12352401.summary_en: This decision analysis models ejaculatory function in stage 1 nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis, comparing primary nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with surveillance. The model suggests primary nerve-sparing dissection should generally be performed unless the recurrence risk on surveillance is low or a surgeon can reliably preserve ejaculation after post-chemotherapy dissection. Results were insensitive to chemotherapy effects on ejaculation. If surveillance recurrence exceeds 16%, primary dissection is recommended. The authors conclude that nerve-sparing primary dissection maximizes ejaculatory function in most patients.

pmid-12352402.summary_ja: インディアナ大学の精巣がんデータベースの644例を後方視的に解析した研究である。精巣摘除標本に奇形腫を認めた例の85.6%で後腹膜に奇形腫成分がみられ、認めない例でも48%にみられた。後腹膜腫瘍の体積が大きいほど奇形腫の可能性が高かった。精巣摘除標本の組織型にかかわらず、化学療法後に残存する後腹膜腫瘍には手術が適応となると結論している。
pmid-12352402.summary_en: This retrospective review of 644 patients from the Indiana University testis cancer database examined whether teratoma in the orchiectomy specimen predicts retroperitoneal teratoma at post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Retroperitoneal teratoma was found in 85.6% of patients with teratoma in the orchiectomy specimen, but also in 48% of those without it. Larger retroperitoneal tumor volume increased the likelihood of teratoma. The authors conclude that post-chemotherapy surgery is indicated for residual retroperitoneal tumor regardless of orchiectomy histology.

pmid-12369008.summary_ja: 生後2か月の女児の仙骨尾骨部奇形腫を手術で全摘した症例報告。手術中に偶発的に開放された嚢胞から、血管茎と心臓様の拍動を示す臓器が出現した。組織学的に成熟奇形腫と未発達な心臓と診断された。奇形腫内への心臓分化は文献上2例目とされる。胎児内胎児と奇形腫は同じ発生異常を持つ可能性があり、本例はその中間的な病態と考察されている。
pmid-12369008.summary_en: A two-month-old girl underwent resection of a sacrococcygeal mass diagnosed as a mature teratoma containing a rudimentary heart. The cystic mass was accidentally opened during surgery, revealing a solid organ with a vascular pedicle and cardiac-like pulsation distinct from the infant's heart rate. The entire mass was excised with the coccyx, and histology confirmed mature teratoma and rudimentary heart. The authors report only the second such cardiac differentiation in teratoma in the literature. They propose that fetus-in-fetu and teratoma may share a developmental malformation, and that this case represents a combination of both.

pmid-12372894.summary_ja: 18歳男性が、大きく突出した陰嚢腫瘤で受診したまれな症例報告。精査で後腹膜リンパ節を伴う非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。まず全身化学療法を行い、その後に腫瘤を切除した。精巣腫瘍が陰嚢から外方へ突出して進展する、まれな臨床像を記録している。
pmid-12372894.summary_en: An 18-year-old man presented with a large fungating scrotal mass, a rare presentation of testicular tumor. Investigations revealed a non-seminomatous germ cell tumor with retroperitoneal nodal involvement. Systemic chemotherapy was given first, followed by surgical excision of the mass. The authors report this presentation to highlight its rarity rather than to describe a novel treatment approach. The case documents the clinical course of advanced testicular NSGCT that externally protruded through the scrotum.

pmid-12375021.summary_ja: 37歳男性の後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清の後にβ-hCGが再上昇し、血尿を契機に膀胱および右尿管の腫瘍が見つかった。膀胱全摘と腎尿管全摘の後、これらは転移性胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。6か月後に肝および腸間膜リンパ節に転移が出現し、患者は死亡した。精巣外胚細胞腫瘍からの直接浸潤によらない膀胱転移の初報告とされる。
pmid-12375021.summary_en: A 37-year-old man presented with back pain and was found to have a retroperitoneal tumor and cervical nodes, with normal testes. Lymph node biopsy diagnosed an extragonadal germ cell tumor. After chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy, beta-hCG rose again at follow-up. Hematuria revealed bladder and right ureteral tumors, which after cystectomy and nephroureterectomy proved to be metastatic germ cell tumor. Liver and mesenteric metastases followed six months later, and the patient died. The authors describe this as the first report of bladder metastasis from an extratesticular germ cell tumor not due to direct invasion.

pmid-12375038.summary_ja: 心不全治療薬ベスナリノンの抗腫瘍効果を、絨毛癌8株と胞状奇胎由来株で検討した。絨毛癌株の増殖を用量依存的に抑制し、p53変異の有無にかかわらずアポトーシスを誘導した。胞状奇胎由来株には効果がなかった。c-Myc mRNAの発現も上昇した。細胞株を用いたin vitro研究であり、絨毛癌治療薬としての有用性が示唆された段階である。
pmid-12375038.summary_en: Vesnarinone, a quinolinone inotropic agent used for heart failure, was tested for antitumor effects on eight human choriocarcinoma and hydatidiform mole-derived cell lines. It inhibited proliferation of choriocarcinoma lines in a dose-dependent manner and induced DNA fragmentation regardless of p53 mutation status. A hydatidiform mole-derived line was unresponsive. Vesnarinone also upregulated c-Myc mRNA in choriocarcinoma cells. The authors conclude that vesnarinone may be a useful agent for choriocarcinoma treatment, though this is based on in vitro cell line data.

pmid-12376206.summary_ja: 精巣摘除後に監視療法を行った病期I精巣セミノーマ150例を対象に、腫瘍浸潤リンパ球（TIL）数の再発予測能を検討した。中央値9.4年の追跡で30例が再発した。多変量解析で独立した再発予測因子は33歳以下の若年と腫瘍径6cm超であった。低TIL数は境界的な有意性（HR 1.8）にとどまり、その機能的役割にはさらなる検討が必要である。
pmid-12376206.summary_en: This study examined whether tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) count predicts relapse in 150 men with stage I testicular seminoma managed by surveillance after orchidectomy. With a median follow-up of 9.4 years, 30 patients relapsed. Age of 33 years or younger and tumour diameter above 6 cm were independent predictors of relapse.
